description: Runaway appliances and a magical mystery!

title: Interactive meadow 64
description: Hello there. I am puffy. I am you. Welcome to our interactive meadow. Stay a while. Relax and breath. Forget about anxiety. Forget about depression. Be your own best friend.

title: Paisible Après-midi au Fil des Toiles
description: Relaxing puzzle game about paintings and color.

title: Madden genesis
description:
Witness the beginning of modern football when the game was changed in 2003 by one man single handedly taking on the ancient evils of the football world.

A tale of courage, excitement and woe. Take on the tragedies of american football one step at a time.

title: Jigoku Hell
description: A game about eggs. Made for #AGBIC jam 2017.

title: Undertale 2
description:
Undertale 2 is the new awesome sequel to Undertale everyone has been talking about for the past few decades. It's totally not* a FANGAME OR ANYTHING.
(*Umm... Huh? Maybe it is a fangame... What a mystery...)

title: Bread
description: The Royal Bakery welcomes you to Bread, a fun simple clicker game. Stay a while, have some fun and click a crumb. Careful too much bread makes you fat.

title: Tony Hawk's Existential Nightmare
description: A love letter to the sport of skating, Tony Hawk's Existential Nightmare explores the decisions made along one skater's path to becoming legendary!

title: Muumit ja Taikalamppu
description: The sixth video game in the Moomin franchise. Help the Moominhouse residents with various tasks in the form of 9 unique minigames.

title: Tales of the Black Death
description: Tales of the Black Death is a choice driven interactive fiction plague survival story that pins your morality against your survival. The game is a three-part series set in the Middle Ages during the plague that spread from Italy to France and finally reached England. In Tales of the Black Death, you play as Baldasar, a young Italian boy.

title: Penthos
description: Penthos is a full-length kinetic narrative experience, featuring limited voice acting and original music.

title: Witch: A Special Delivery
description: Take control of a witch and help her find her purpose in life while helping out others with various quests and deliveries. Find power-ups, defeat enemies and explore the world in this short metroidvania-styled game.

title: Mask of the Rose
description: A marvellous romance with a hint of murder. Lose your heart to a stolen city in this game of amorous intrigue! Seek love, for yourself or your friends. Help a murdered man find justice. And watch out for the bats.

title: Tightrope Walking
description: A tightrope walking simulation game using keyboard.

title: Sword of the Stars: The Pit 2
description: The Pit2 returns to the turn-based Roguelike roots of the indie classic and takes you back to a legendary alien facility dug deep into the Feldspar Mountains and beyond!

title: Ranita Fishing
description:
Ranita Fishing is a 3D platformer game with fishing mechanics. It's about a little frog on a simple quest for their grandpa, collecting fishes and helping friends along the way.
You can use a keyboard or a controller to play our demo. You can walk, run and jump to move around, you can use your rod to fish or to solve some puzzles and you can talk with several quirky characters you find along the way.

title: Cards and Castles 2
description: Collectible cards spring to life in this wacky Tactical CCG. Assemble a deck to challenge your friends and rivals, and engage in glorious CARD BATTLES! Will you choose fearsome dragons, or the deadly squirrels?

title: Rainboy
description: You were brought into this universe knowing nothing... Now you explore the 7 worlds to find your purpose and discover what it means to be alive! But beware, those who intend to stop you will not make your journey an easy one... Rainboy is a precision platformer with 100s of exhilarating levels!

title: Hour Night
description: An online multiplayer game with 3-10 players where you survive against a shapeshifting monster. Do you know who you can trust?

title: Smashpunks
description: Smashpunks is a frenetic online multiplayer arena battler where players compete for glory in a dangerous underground vehicle combat sport.

title: Hammer time!
description: It's ”Hammer Time”! Hammer Time is a hardcore platformer with puzzle elements. Use your hammer and puzzle solving skills to complete levels! Only real hardcore players are able to beat all levels. Test yourself!

title: Horde of Directors
description: The game puts the player in the role of an activist trying to advance a social agenda in the complex world of interrelated corporate and government interests. By creating simplified experience of corporate interconnectedness, the game embodies the challenges of overcoming corporate and government nepotism in the name of social causes.

title: Voxie Tactics
description: Free-to-play tactical RPG inspired by retro games of the 90s-2000s. Embark on epic quests, battle fierce enemies, earn VOXELs and game items that you truly own.

title: No Straight Roads: Encore Edition
description:
Start a rock band & end the EDM empire in NO STRAIGHT ROADS, a rockin' action-adventure from the minds of Wan Hazmer (Final Fantasy XV) and Daim Dziauddin (Street Fighter V).

Explore Vinyl City & fight musical megastars on your journey to defeat oppressive EDM empire ‘NSR’, in an action-packed adventure that mashes together rhythm-infused third-person combat with a kick-ass soundtrack!

No Straight Roads: Encore Edition is an enhanced version of the original music action-adventure that features the rock-tastic base game and festive-focused ‘Christmas Edition’ update, plus brand new content, including an expanded collection of tracks, a new opening cinematic, quality of life improvements and over 500 pieces of fan art available to view and collect throughout Vinyl City.

title: Wildflower: From the Embers
description: Wildflower is a story-driven RPG about a young witch and her life in a new town. You will make friends and solve problems, fight demons and witch hunters, commune with the forest spirits, forage, cook, and craft.

title: Hitme
description: A suicidal boy goes out during a friday's night looking for someone to hit him. Could his beaters become his lovers?

title: Spooky Typing: The Ghost Plague
description: Be prepared to dodge the sharp elements and type the words to eliminate the ghosts. Can you to this fast enough and stop the ghost plage to spread across the world?

title: Akita: King Pig Thinks Pink
description: Explore a fantasy world inhabited by charming creatures, with 2D hand-drawn animations. For 1 player or 2 players cooperatively.

title: Wastelander
description: Wastelander is a minimalist turn-based colony building game with roguelike and deckbuilding elements, where you start from nothing as a castaway on an alien world, build your colony, collect resources and protect yourself from mysterious and destructive atmospheric storms while using the secrets of the alien ruins to find a way to escape. As your colony expands you'll find alien artifacts and buildings, perks, technology upgrades, and consumable items scattered across the map.

title: ConcernedApe's Haunted Chocolatier
description: An RPG/simulation game following a chocolatier living in a haunted castle. In order to thrive in your new role, you will have to gather rare ingredients, make delicious chocolates, and sell them in a chocolate shop.

title: Blooming Panic: Full Bloom Edition
description: Depressed day-in and day-out from a draining corporate job, you become invested in a fantasy webnovel and find a mysterious link to a fan server. Everyone is warm and welcoming, but three members take a special interest in you!

title: Hearts of Iron IV: No Step Back
description:
The bitter fighting of the Eastern Front is given new depth and variety in No Step Back, the expansion to Hearts of Iron IV. With new alternate history paths and game systems, this eagerly awaited add-on presents new challenges for fans of Paradox Interactive’s best-selling grand strategy wargame.

The centerpiece of No Step Back is a series of new National Focus Trees, giving players many new ways to imagine the course of World War II in Eastern Europe. Major nations have been entirely reworked to offer unique challenges and original histories.

title: Just Say the Word!
description:
A new take on a familiar board and parlor game. Fun, quick and easy! Play hands-free, no typing required, with only the sound of your voice. Everyone from 13 to 100 year olds will love it as though they were on their very own game show – right on their own PC!

Each round, one team member becomes The Speaker, whose mission is to make their team say as many of The Words as possible, without using any of the Forbidden Words! Can you describe a Unicorn without mentioning “horn”, “mythical” or “fantasy”? What about “shark” without “jaws”, “bite” or “tornado”?

title: Crush Zone: Demolition Derby
description: Crush Zone: Demolition Derby is a thrilling, action multiplayer, vehicular party game. Where drivers around the word enter and compete in the gladiatorial games for the grand prize.

title: Grand Theft Auto III: The Definitive Edition
description: It all starts in Liberty City. With revolutionary freedom to go anywhere and jack anyone, Grand Theft Auto III puts the center of the criminal underworld at your fingertips, if you have enough guts to take it.

title: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City - The Definitive Edition
description: Welcome to the 1980s. Experience Tommy Vercetti’s tale of betrayal and revenge in the neon-soaked tropical sprawl of Vice City, a town brimming with excess, ready to be taken over, your way.

title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas - The Definitive Edition
description: It's the early '90s. After a couple of cops frame him for homicide, Carl "CJ" Johnson is forced on a journey that takes him across the entire state of San Andreas, to save his family and to take control of the streets.

title: Astrea: Six-Sided Oracles
description: An all new dice-deck-building roguelike, Astrea, has you chart a path through the ruins of a lost civilization as one of six brave Oracles. Using an ever-changing deck of dice and enchanted Sentinels, Purify waves of Corrupted foes and a decayed goddess to save the Star System. Choose among hundreds of different dice that suit your penchant; reliably safe, perfectly balanced, or powerfully risky. Tactfully wield an innate risk vs reward system by pacifying enemies through Purification, or Corrupt yourself to unleash abilities that help tip the scales. Laden with bountiful boons to enhance your chances for success and encounters against waves of enemies that impede your progress, chart a course through the ruins of a lost civilization to the source of Corruption.

title: Beodara
description: Beodara is a game that takes place during the Middle Ages. You and your opponent will control a character who will be able to gather resources with different aims: build your village, hire peasants as well as knights and many other soldiers.

title: The Coneflower Dilemma
description: The Coneflower Dilemma is a blend of survival horror, first person action and adventure mechanics, with an eccentric gameplay loop. Inspired by RPG Maker games and other classics such as Killer7 and Resident Evil, the game features a mysterious story with touches of both surrealistic horror and comedic slice of life.

title: Project Kafka
description: Inspired by the Persona series, Project Kafka is an interesting mix of hack n slash and dating sim about love, and death, with a healthy mix of humor that’s expected from the genre.

title: HoloFunk: Hololive Funkin'
description: Hololive Funkin', or HoloFunk for short, is an overhaul mod for Friday Night Funkin' built by a small team of people on a version of Kade Engine heavily modified to the point of being nearly-unrecognizable, dubbed Myth Engine. It features brand new songs, new opponents, and whimsical new settings based on the world and characters of hololive.
2 is an audiovisually-colorful exploration video game designed around surprises.

title: Summer Days
description: Briana has been craving some time off all summer and finally with her shoot wrapped for hiatus she can relax at her summer cottage on the lake. To really enjoy herself she even drags her female co-stars along for the ride.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Doki Doki Takeover!
description: Boyfriend and Girlfriend return to the Hating Sim, and find a new person inside this time around, being Monika. She doesn't know how she got there, but she's happy to put on a show. Until things start to go wrong-

title: Untitled Rage Game
description: An unreasonably unfair game that puts your patience to the test.

title: Holoearth
description:
A new frontier awaits.
Holoearth is an open-world sandbox game based on hololive Alternative for PC and mobile devices.

title: Rivers of Rain
description:
Rivers of Rain is the story of a little girl destined to find her place in the world after the death of her mother, who leaves her love for life, the bond with family, the enjoyment of nature and being happy. with the essentials.
The Mother left her last wish in the hands of her daughter, to know the sea and to live this adventure, she is a little girl, she will travel with her maternal grandfather, through the places of the Maule. It is an emotional and spiritual journey, which leads us to reflect on the legacy that is left after death.

title: LiteBringer
description:
LiteBringer embraces the revolutionary potential of the blockchain like few games before. As a truly decentralized application, the whole game takes place in the Litecoin blockchain, with no servers involved, giving the players unprecedented control over the game.

Level up a fighter, rogue or sorcerer in an imaginative fantasy world, and promote them to an advanced class that's even more powerful. Choose the best equipment for each task and send your heroes on increasingly difficult quests. Let them defeat mighty bosses for you and gather epic loot.

Every move you make in the game is a transaction in the Litecoin blockchain that creates value. Every weapon, item and even your characters can be traded safely and without limits, thanks to the power of cryptocurrency. Make smarter decisions than the other players and earn money while enjoying the game.

LiteBringer is developed by the makers of Tibia, a groundbreaking multiplayer role-playing game that's online since 1997. Expect complex gameplay, innovative features and a lot of knowledge on how to keep a game exciting for decades.

title: Words Can Kill
description: Words Can Kill is a fusion of roguelike deckbuilders and word games. Travel through the world trying to find the perfect combination of letters, weapons and armor. And remember, here your decisions matter, not your vocabulary!

title: Faani
description:
A short narrative-driven game about the afterlife.

Many people that have experienced Coma said that was a totally different place, the geometries were special and they haven't seen such colors before. This game is my notion about how it looks. Who knows, maybe it is.

title: Ara and the Empty Universe
description:
A game where nothing is happening metaphorically.
Let's say... you find yourself in a strange world where the trees and buildings all float 5 meters above ground level? That's no dream sequence, it's not metaphorical either, it's happening. Reality seems to be broken and you are going to have to face that.

Game length: 70 - 100 minutes, depending on how much you explore.

title: Brawlforming
description: Hop on and browse through the variety of levels created by other players! Play through them by yourself, or with up to 15 friends / strangers!

title: Deluge
description:
Take the role of a resurrected warrior in service to an evil entity known as Ganglim. Your instruction is to finish off a terrorized community after they've settled into their new home. How you accomplish this task is left in your hands.

The village of Figaro is full of locked doors, buried history, and the occasional monster in a box. Explore at your own pace, choose where to go and who to trust, and decide whether you’ll rely on your sword, your magic, or your conscience to withstand the night.

Will you carry out your new orders, or embrace who you once were?

title: Trackwars
description: Jump in to an Action packed Role Playing game living in 2056, explore the whole city, and get money by doing jobs. If you wanna be the best in the city you need almost everything, every cars, guns, even apartments! This is the city with bunch of bad guys, explore the future with Trackwars.

title: Ilum
description: Action open-world game that includes elements of exploration. Taking place in ancient Babylon and the surrounding region, including cities like Borsippa, Sippar, Kutha and Kish, among others. The year is 539 BC, the time when the Babylonian empire feel to the Persians and its Jewish captives released from servitude after 70 years. As prophesied, Babylon is to be destroyed. Ilum accurately depicts archaeological findings and cuneiform inscriptions from buildings such as the Tower of Babel, Hanging Gardens and Nebuchadnezzar's palaces. Voice-acted in Akkadian language in a Biblical and Babylonian mythological background.

title: 50 Short Games
description: Being a collection of 50 SHORT GAMES designed by Thecatamites of Harmony World to amuse and instruct, as previously posted individually to glorioustrainwrecks.com, now bundled, for ease of loading.

title: NiftyVille
description: NiftyVille is a place where you get to be you. But the extraordinary is always just around the corner! Demolition Derbies, Races, Zombie Parties... anything can happen in the world's first play-to-earn open world game on the Ethereum network.

title: Afternoon, a story
description:
The hypertext fiction tells the story of Peter, a recently divorced man who witnessed a car crash. Hours later, he suspects that the wrecked car may have involved his ex-wife and their son.

The plot may change each time it is read if the reader chooses different paths.

title: Little Nightmares III
description:
Embark on a new adventure in the unique world of Little Nightmares.

In Little Nightmares III, you follow the journey of Low & Alone, as they search for a path that could lead them out of the Nowhere.

Trapped within the Spiral, a cluster of disturbing places, the two friends will have to work together to survive in a dangerous world full of delusions and escape the grasp of an even greater threat lurking in the shadows.

For the first time in the franchise, face your childhood fears together with a friend using online co-op, or solo with an AI companion.

title: Necrobius
description: In development circa 1995, Necrobius was supposed to be a surreal humorous adventure through the brain of a scientist. The demo appeared in July 1995 issue of PC Gamer, but the game itself was subsequently cancelled by the publisher MicroProse. It was ultimately released as freeware in 2014 by the developer Daniel Auld himself.

title: Popol Maya
description: According to its introduction, popol maya is “not just a game” but a belief system. Supposedly, its tenets are based on Maya mythology, though it flagrantly misinterprets everything about that culture save for a vaguely tropical setting. The game stumbles onto its own ideas instead, attempting to solve that universal question of how to find meaning in a disorderly, malevolent world.

title: Opportunity
description: Opportunity is an atmospheric narrative game where you become the famous NASA rover and brave the many obstacles littering the desolate red planet in order to finally complete its mission.

title: Klim
description: A short game about climbing a tower

title: NGL Biathlon 2026
description: Biathlon simulator. Race as your athlete, progress in Career, and compete for the Big Crystal Globe. World Cup tracks and all disciplines, including relays. Career from rookie to legend. Wide choice of skis, poles, and rifles. Feel real biathlon vibes

title: Gensou Shoujo Taisen
description:
The Super Robot Wars-inspired Touhou Project crossover Gensou Shoujo Wars first launched on PC in 2010 and is now releasing on Nintendo Switch in 2021.

The game, fusion of bullet hell and strategy RPG, “depicts a Gensokyo epic of overwhelming scale, including the bonds between characters, and a thorough arrangement of character backgrounds and stories from their original works.” It features over 70 playable characters, as well as “impactful battle animations, dialogue scenes the fans want to see, cut-ins for every character, different theme songs for each character, and a variety of songs to match the scenario.”

title: The Tale of Lukas
description: Lukas is a traveler with no memory. Join him on his travels!

title: Chaos of the Periodic Table
description:
This game is an educational RPG that puts chemistry at centre stage of the game mechanics. Collect and gather elements form compounds and molecules and battle your way through a dystopian future.

In this game you will learn some chemistry concepts and develop/deepen your knowledge of the periodic table. Perfect for light-hearted study and/or just hack and slash your way to victory.

title: Village Vampire Feast
description: Find villagers wandering alone for safe feasting. Or raise a vampire army to wage war against the police who are gunning for you! Last as long as you can!

title: Bond: Wish of the Forest
description: Bond: Wish of the Forest is an action packed roguelite creature collector about making friends and fighting alongside them.

title: Totally planet
description: This game is a planet simulation that plays in the style of Reins where you make choices that impact how things progressed. Although saying that, this is a much easier game in terms of difficulty.

title: Gebo
description: Gebo is a first-person game where you play as Alexis, a human stuck in a dreamlike world together with a disembodied voice that calls themselves Selene. Explore the temple, solve puzzles and do your best to find a way out, even if everything isn’t what they seem to be.

title: Dangerous platform
description: "Dangerous platform" is a classic 2D platformer. Player has a simple task - collect all the coins to proceed to the next level.

title: The Piano Player
description: An insecure musician meets a girl with a strange name. His life is never the same.

title: Dead Dating
description:
A romantic summer date party gone wild! A sweet party becomes a murder scene...
you have to find a way to survive in an isolated mansion on an isolated island with ten guys! Can you rescue your lover and catch the killer?

title: Seditionis: Crutarch Royale
description: A multifaceted PVP multiplayer arena shooter using traditional dedicated servers for massive 30+ vs. 30+ pvp battles. In early access prototype stages.

title: After School: A Vocaloid RPG
description:
After School-A Vocaloid RPG is a survival-horror Vocaloid RPG experience created using RPG Maker VX Ace. Playing as Oliver, you find yourself in a "Spirit World," an alternate dimension hosted by a single corrupted spirit. You meet new characters, and help spirits along the way while keeping an eye out for the corrupted host spirit. The player must help Oliver escape this world safely, while navigating the dangers it throws his way.

Heavy inspiration was taken from games such as End Roll and Ib, while the initial inspiration to start this project was taken from the song "Crushed Mary" by Mondaiji-P.

title: Ghostlore
description: Ghostlore is an 'Eastpunk' Action-RPG where you fight monsters from Southeast-Asian folklore. This modern take on the classic ARPG features a detailed item and character customization system, procedurally generated maps, and beautiful 2D isometric art.

title: Big Brother Brasil 3D Online
description:
Welcome to Big Brother Brasil 3D Online, as in the program with a big audience throughout Brazil, you will interact online, in real-time, with other participants of the house.

Now the emotions are real and live, you will be able to get to know the participants of the house better, date, plot, have fun, and participate in the competitions to be the HoH of the week.

Choose your character and configure your personal characteristics, change your humor, companionship and charisma.

title: Sky Tale
description: Sky Tale is a cute city building game about creating lovely islands using various tiles and buildings. Sky Tale provides you challenging and yet relaxing experience. You can try to set new highscore by carefully planning all your moves and building up strong economy or you can simply explore colorful biomes and build settlements, villages or even towns.

title: Oddworld: Soulstorm - Enhanced Edition
description: Witness Abe's horrifying conflict with a terrifying new machination. A fresh narrative - a complete story retake inspired by our original tale. A big visual and cinematic leap aiming to break new ground for Oddworld. Intelligent new mechanics, twisted new devices enabling highly explosive deviousness. A dark parable that tells an epic tale of a volatile society pushed to its limits. This new version of Oddworld: Soulstorm includes all previously released updates and gameplay enhancements made to the base game with even more changes and fixes to come.

title: The Sims 4: Incheon Arrivals Kit
description: Upgrade your Sim's wardrobe with The Sims 4: Incheon Arrivals Kit, inspired by iconic Seoul airport fashion. Trendy Korean styles get a modernized twist for clean, minimalist looks in muted colorways.

title: The Sims 4: Fashion Street Kit
description: Expand your style with The Sims 4: Fashion Street Kit collection, inspired by the trendsetting designs of Mumbai. Rich colors, iconic silhouettes, and high-contrast patterns bring energy and vibrancy to each item. Show off your individuality by integrating trendy statement pieces with traditional details for a whole new style.

title: ThreeTwoPix: Fang Runner
description:
Run your way through New Fang City, collecting diamonds, avoiding paperhands and jumping over awful flippers.

An endless arcade runner, can you beat the community highscore?

title: Broken Computer's Dream
description: An adventure game where you explore the inside of a broken computer.

title: Mother of All Secrets
description:
Mother of All Secrets is an RPG of mythical intrigues and occult mysteries.

Become a young ward at an old and remote orphanage. Live your new life for fourteen days as the enigmatic masters of the House prepare you and your mates for the impending visit of the mysterious Guest. Every inhabitant of the orphanage has a history of their own, and the orphanage's little world holds many secrets and mysteries. Decide where to go, what events to participate in, which goals to pursue, and who you should influence. Will you be ready to learn the ultimate truth on the last night of your stay here?

Get ready to dive into the very heart of the events that unfold inside the orphanage's closed society. Hand-drawn graphics will immerse you into the reality of your new home.

title: Ozymandias
description: Build an empire in a single sitting. All the strategy of a classic 4X in a faster format, which also shines in multiplayer.

title: My Defi Pet
description:
My DeFi Pet is the initiative for our vision of a mass-adoption blockchain game. The name encompasses the three characteristics of the game: “Pet” raising game, “DeFi” features integrated, and “My” personalization.

My DeFi Pet" revolves around a core loop of engaging gaming activities such as collecting, breeding, evolving, battling with, and trading/socializing for pets. It uses the
concept of Season to break down the game progress into smaller parts. This mechanism complements our human tendency for short term rewards.

title: Signal Lost
description: A short horror game where you keep a spacecraft operational as it reaches Venus by completing tasks and repairs.

title: Doomer7
description: Doomer7 is a specialized Doom mod based on Suda51's cult classic Killer7. The project translates the unique visual style and characters of the Smith Syndicate into the classic shooter.

title: The Asylum Incident
description: Mr. Fors sets out to get revenge after a horrific incident happens in his asylum. Mr. Fors needs to overcome some tough challenges with different mechanics before finally getting a chance at revenge.

title: The Magick
description: The Magick features 18 unique endings, alternate ways to reach the endings, and 50 different variations of the endings in total. It has combinations of the different types of Magick, which leads to different events.

title: Welcome to Hell
description: A not specifically difficult in terms of mechanics platformer game, but the mechanics are pushed to their limits to make your life a living hell the entire time playing.

title: Sandra Fleming Chronicles: Crystal Skulls
description: Do the Crystal Skulls truly possess mystical powers, or is their magic nothing more than a myth? Join Sandra Fleming on her danger-filled journey to find the legendary artifacts!

title: Echo Beach
description: In the future, all music has been banned. As a clerk at the Ministry, your job is to hunt down the remaining musicians in their place of last refuge - The Musicnet. A puzzle game lasting 1-3 hours. Contains 11 original songs.

title: Ancra
description: Ancra is a narrative driven, puzzle-horror game. Explore the home of a dying photographer, and solve puzzles to access new areas. Solve cryptic puzzles, embrace or evade vengeful specters, decide who to trust and unravel a mystery. Encounter strange, conflicting beings and discover a haunting story, piece by piece. Try to understand why you are here, who you are and what role you play in their story.

title: Blue Wish Desire
description: Blue Wish Desire is a 2D vertically scrolling shump shoot 'em up game in the Blue Wish series, preceded by Blue Wish and Blue Wish Resurrection.. Go through the barrage and destroy the oncoming enemies. In addition, this game is equipped with an auto guard system that automatically prevents mistakes. So even those who are not good at barrage STG are safe.

title: Welcome to Goodland
description:
This is the police + Ozark TV Show = Welcome to Goodland

An ordinary salaryman is forced to work under a merciless Mexican cartel. Stay alive for as long as you can, get enough money for your new bosses, make tough decisions, acquire businesses and find allies you can trust. But in this cutthroat world, will you be able to keep to your humanity?

title: Diver
description: Dive, explore, survive

title: Kuro no Ken
description: Kuro no Ken is a rather standard Japanese-style RPG with all the familiar ingredients: top-down locations, navigation on the world map, random enemies, turn-based combat, automatic leveling up, etc. The battles are viewed from a third-person perspective, using much larger character sprites than during exploration. Shinobu and Kayes can use physical attacks or magic spells (learned automatically when leveling up), which deplete MP.

title: Gromopoli
description: "Gromopoli" is an online board game centered around the ownership of properties: Buy as many properties as you can to get closer to victory and make your enemies go bankrupt, play with a total of 8 players in a chaotic land ownership war, fight with teams going from 4 team of 2 players to 2 teams of 4 players! Enjoy the various board skins and chose to play on varying board sizes for shorter or longer games!

title: Pragma
description: PRAGMA is a fast paced bullet-hell boss-rush game with a minimalist art style.

title: Halloween Scrooge
description: A short kinetic visual novel in which you play the main character, recently moved to a new town and uninterested in celebrating Halloween like the rest of the neighhbours. In a Halloween-themed twist on A Christmas Carol, you're visited by 3 handsome ghosts who attempt to convince you to stop being such a scrooge. Featuring flavourtext-affecting dialogue choices and a customizable protagonist name.

title: Spectrum Forces
description:
Make up your squads out of 9 unique ships and save 3 planets from hordes of robots in this colorful horizontal shoot-em-up!

Each of the 9 pilots in the Spectrum Forces has unique capacities. It's up to you to select the right ones for the right job. You've been commissioned to clear 3 planets from the residing Abandonware. Try your best to not lose anyone while doing so!

title: Odysseus
description: You are Odysseus, a homesick, tired, and moribund pilgrim in a struggle to find meaning in life. Witness his journey and tragedy as he goes to a foreign city in the middle of winter in search of collecting money to continue traveling while meeting and helping all sorts of sad, broken people along the way.

title: Trogloxene
description: Learn to fly as a bat, and wander at your own pace

title: Valley Knights
description: Recruit a company of heroes to save a world in ruins after a devastating cataclysm. Valley Knights is a turn-based, tactical, roguelike, RPG set in a dark-horror fantasy world out of the 1980s, where every decision matters, and no one lives forever...

title: Chair F*cking Simulator
description: Use our innovative patented funky fresh ChairF*cker simulation tech to meet the chair of your wildest dreams.

title: Why You Do This to Me?
description: The original version of this game was made for the Shacknews: The Fourth Game Jam. I decided to make a game in which someone forcibly tries to make you evil and do evil work by you, something worst happen to the player and he have to overcome from his emotional pain! This is a story-based JRPG Game, which tells an interesting story though the game systems!

title: Zapatitos: Suenos de Libertad
description: Zapatitos is the star clown of the Tiliches circus, the best at his job, but unhappy since he lives in a slave work environment, a circus life of 24 hours 365 days, Zapatitos who is tired of his work life decides to seek his independence starting with a well-deserved vacation. His boss, Don Chelo has profited for many years from Zapatitos' work and will not let him retire so easily, thereby losing his gold mine. The player must help Zapatitos through 4 levels, fleeing from Don Chelo and his workers, who under his influence will try to stop him along his way, escaping to his vacation and freedom.

title: Bad End Theater
description: Welcome to Bad End Theater! Select your protagonist and explore a variety of terrible fates! The decisions you make in one story will affect the others. you can toggle these behaviors to open up new paths! unfortunately, every path leads to a bad ending... Can you find a way to save this unlucky cast? Playtime: 2-3 hours to see all endings (it's a puzzle game, so this varies widely).

title: Haunting on Howard Hill
description: This single player horror adventure positions the player as Beckett, and follows the strange occurrences that proceed as the player dives deeper into the secrets of Howard Hill.

title: Gachi Bird
description: Gachi Bird is a classic arcade game featuring Billy Herrington and his friends flying through obstacles in three dimensions: Hell, Heaven and Gym.

title: Why Is Office Coffee So Bad?
description: Nothing like a hot cup of joe before the morning meeting. Your goal is simple. Just keep your eyes on the screen, keep typing away, and do whatever your boss tells you. Also don't drink any gross coffee that might show up. (A totally realistic depiction of working in an office.)

title: Spacious Snake
description: An abstract puzzle game about a snake. The snake must fill all tiles of each level to proceed, with obstacles making it increasingly difficult.

title: Grow in the Hole
description: Grow in the Hole is a 2D side view golf game based around an often-growing and shrinking golf ball and procedurally generated courses. How well can you handle 18 holes when the ball is getting bigger after every failed shot?

title: The Famires: Ano Machi wo Dokusen Seyo
description: A restaurant simulation game where you start up a family restaurant and become successful by taking out the competition, and eventually taking over the whole town.

title: Johnny Trigger
description: Johnny Trigger is a 3rd person shooter with a side view in which out take out criminals.

title: Monopoly Madness
description: Would you like to become the new Mr. Monopoly? It’s your lucky day! Our favorite Real-Estate Mogul is going on a well-earned vacation and he’s looking for a temporary stand-in. The method of selection? A race for fame and fortune. This time the rules have slightly changed. Monopoly Madness brings the Monopoly experience into the arena for the first time ever. Roam the chaotic streets of Monopoly City, collect resources, buy and upgrade properties, mess with your opponents, and avoid their tricks to win the race for riches. This is madness!

title: From Fear
description: From Fear is a 1-4 player survival horror where you choose your fear. In this post-apocalyptic world, you must scavenge to survive with your deepest fear lurking in the shadows. Do not believe everything you see.

title: Honkai: Star Rail
description: Honkai: Star Rail is an all-new strategy-RPG title in the Honkai series that takes players on a cosmic adventure across the stars. Hop aboard the Astral Express and experience the galaxy's infinite wonders on this journey filled with adventure and thrill.

title: Rubicon: A Conspiracy of Silence
description:
Rubicon: A Conspiracy of Silence of silence, is a game inspired by whistleblowers.

In this narrative game, you play as Paula Cole, a food safety officer for a multinational corporation, who gradually takes on the role of whistleblower. Depending on your choices, you will be confronted with different situations inspired by real facts, the whole scenario being based on a journalistic work, coordinated with the online newspaper Mediapart.

As a player, you’ll discuss with multiple protagonists to investigate and find out your truth. From the first discoveries to the revelations to the press, you will make choices that will have an impact on what happens next.

title: Spacefolk City
description: Spacefolk City is a funky, casual take on the city building genre. Construct a floating city in space, decorate it with a variety of absurd items, and keep your Spacefolk citizens happy.

title: The FamiRes: Powerup Kit
description: This add-on pack for The FamiRes contains new scenarios, more new staff to hire, cooking events, and more.

title: Prognostic
description: Prognostic is a supernatural horror about a medium who solves cases for the police. It combines horror elements with detective work. An orphan returns to the house of the deceased fortune-teller to uncover the secret of his family's death. He must accept his legacy and become a prognostic before supernatural madness engulfs people of his town.

title: Demon Doif
description: The demon Doif requires your assistance minion. He is hungry. Find the items he wants from amongst the pile. Do not get them wrong. Feed Doif the correct items! If a particular item isn't available, stun him and pull the lever to give him memory loss and request a new item!

title: Perfect Teams
description: Perfect Teams is a Rogue Like deckbuilder in which you have to assemble a team of three characters, each one with unique cards and unique powers, to explore different universes and fight the corruption caused by the fusion. What will be your Perfect Team?

title: Yolked
description: The Great Egg-Scape! Yolked is a kinetic, physics-based platforming romp where you take control of an anthropomorphic egg as it emancipates itself from one perilous predicament to the next! Climb, mantle, & swing past all sorts of environmental hazards & dastardly dangers as your fellow eggs cheer you on!

title: Calm Horizon
description: "Sea of Serenity" - Sail with friends through ever-changing seas! Fish rare species, tame magical pets, and uncover island mysteries. Build your legendary crew under dynamic day-night cycles. Adventure awaits!

title: Deathverse: Let It Die
description: Players take the stage in the world’s most popular survival reality TV show, set hundreds of years after the events of Let it Die. Armed with a robotic combat tool equipped with many deadly features, each player can use a variety of weapons, protective shields, and skills to create a character who can outlive the competition. They’ll also have to fend off monsters and assassins to stay alive in this gloriously gory arena.

title: Star Ocean: The Divine Force
description: Star Ocean: The Divine Force is the next installment in the Star Ocean series. The game features a story that blends sci-fi and fantasy, a rich lineup of characters and side stories, a battle system delivering exhilarating combat with easy controls, and more. The “Double Hero” system returns in which the story spanning the stars and beyond will unfold from the perspective of each protagonist, one from an advanced civilization (sci-fi) and the other from an underdeveloped planet (fantasy). Events that unfold throughout the story as well as the ally characters you end up with will differ based on the protagonist the player chooses.

title: Adversity Andy
description: A small twitchy frog takes on a mighty climb!

title: Phobos: Subhuman
description: Phobos Subhuman is a story rich action-adventure. An astronauts daughter embarks on a quest to uncover the mystery behind her father’s disappearance.

title: Lady in a Leotard With a Gun
description: Short third-person shooter where you shoot all the enemies and go to the exit.

title: Midnight Scenes: The Nanny
description: The Nanny is a short interactive horror story about the supernatural. Follow siblings Oliver and Tina in their quest to find their nanny after she disappears in the middle of the night. Welcome to a new dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.

title: Bugsnax: The Isle of Bigsnax
description:
Journey to a mysterious new island where the Bugsnax are truly enormous! You’ll need to master new mechanics like the Shrink Spice, which can cut the giant Bugsnax down to a catchable size. Joining you are Chandlo, Floofty, Triffany, and Shelda, who will explore both the island’s long-forgotten history, and more of their own personal stories.

Back in Snaxburg, you’ll finally have your very own hut! You can take on challenges from your mailbox to earn furniture and accessories to customize your living space. These challenges put a few twists in the gameplay, and will shake up how you explore and catch.

And last but not least; capture rare Bughats in order to dress up your favorite Bugsnax.

title: Crossing to the Cold Valley
description: Crossing to the Cold Valley is a short and linear European fable that leads you through a small corner of a rich and dying world. Take a seat, and enjoy its characters and tales.

title: Ao no Kanata no Four Rhythm IF 01: Minamo Shirase
Ise & Kai: Chosen Throne
description: How do you fulfill fate if it’s recorded wrong? Ise & Kai: Chosen Throne is an otome with an interesting take on the isekai genre, where you forge the destiny of the realm and fight to escape a predestined fate. Play as Seina Kaimana, a descendant of the realm's goddess, as she discovers there’s more to her prophesied fate.

title: Hacker Simulator
description: Become a hacker and build your online reputation to the top by discovering a simplified and enjoyable version of real-life hacking methods. Complete contracts, buy new programs, upgrade your computer, crack wifi networks and infiltrate peoples or companies online systems.

title: Love Sweets
description: After Itsuki’s first year at Hayagase Gakuen passed uneventfully, he thought that if things continued as is, then he would graduate without having done anything. His friends all got girlfriends after the spring break. He didn’t think that they were seeing anyone during school, and it seemed that they had met while working part-time. Itsuki wanted a girlfriend too, so he decided to find a part-time at a place where there were lots of girls. That’s how he started working at Cafe Hot Chocolat with his childhood friend, energetic kouhai, kind senpai and a girl who he thought was out of his league.

title: Horror of Minos
description: You are the only survivor from a team of explorers set to discover the misteries of King Minos, Ancient Greece and the mythological beast Minotaur.

title: Tsuro: The Game of The Path
description: Create your own journey with Tsuro: The Game of the Path. Place a tile and slide your stone along the path created, but take care! Other players' paths can lead you in the wrong direction - or off the board entirely! Paths will cross and connect, and the choices you make affect all the journeys across the board.

title: Crab Game
description: Crab Game is a First-Person Multiplayer game where you fight for the ultimate cash price in different minigames based on children's games, until only one player is left to claim it all. Definitely not based on any online streaming pop culture korean tv shows, as that would get me in legal trouble, so we're certainly not doing that.

title: Traffic Confusion II
description: Just like the original, the goal is to solve the traffic congestion while keeping stress level of the drivers low. You lose if stress reaches its maximum point.

title: Five Generations
description: Five Generations is an RPG simulation game where you pit yours and your opponents deck of units fighting in a 24x24 square map.

title: Noara: The Conspiracy
description: Noara: The Conspiracy is a 3D strategy game based on the universe of Noara. At the head of an army where each unit has its own set of skills, the aim of the game is to destroy the opponent's stronghold in order to win the battle. It revisits the turn-based strategy game by combining it with the dynamism of real-time games and the reflection of chess games. From a brand new genre, Noara is a Multiplayer Online Chess Arena (MOCA) with a unique gameplay.

title: Bio Evil 4
description: Bio Evil 4 is a side-scrolling demake of Resident Evil 4.

title: The Dark Pictures Anthology: The Devil in Me
description:
A group of documentary film makers receive a mysterious call inviting them to a modern-day replica of serial killer H.H. Holmes ‘Murder Castle’. But on arrival they soon discover they’re being watched, and even manipulated, and suddenly there is much more at stake than just their ratings.

We hope you enjoy your stay...

title: Howloween Hero
description: A spooky trick-or-treat adventure about a mischievous puppy on a mission to score the evening's best candy. Create your costume, explore the neighborhood, and help your friends track down a menacing monster to save Halloween.

title: Kindling Spirits
description: A small visual novel about camping, magic and change.

title: Gyakuten Touhou 2
description: The game is the second entry in the Gyakuten Touhou series. The game follows Aya Shameimaru as a defense attorney who investigates four cases. The gameplay is mostly the same as in the previous game, divided into two types of phases: investigations, where Aya searches the crime scene for evidence and talks to witnesses, and rebuttals to learn new information. During the courtroom sections, Aya defends their client and cross-examines the witnesses's testimonies using the evidence found during the investigations.

title: Buff Imposter
description:
The imposter is after you! You are in a scary maze and need to find the milk that will give you the power to fight the buff imposter. The creepy buff impostor can hide behind any door, so be careful.

In this nightmare horror game we paid special attention to the difficulty levels, also the maze changes with every adventure! Only a few players will manage to beat this difficult horror game!

You have to be smart and avoid the buff imposter at all times. You will level up overtime, can you surpass the buff impostors strength?

title: Zurry: The Ritual Bat
description: Zurry The Ritual Bat is an arcade game in which you play as Zurry, a bat sent out to gather ingredients for the Halloween Ritual scattered around worlds.

title: Kaiju Klimb
description: Heavily inspired in the monsters from The PowerPuff Girls, famous giant creatures like Godzilla, King Kong, and Mothra as well as mythology from countless cultures around the world, Kaiju Klimb evokes that addicting gameplay from simple games into a sweet casual style, perfectly setting the mood for the destruction of earth while you relax!

title: Pipo's on the Run
description: Pipo's on the Run is about a cat endlessly running through roofs. Jump on chimneys and avoid weather vanes in this cute pixel art game!

title: Beneath the Shadows
description: "What is hidden beneath all the pain and sufferings. What is hidden beneath those shadows. What secrets does the Manfred mansion hold withing its walls". play as a regular man trying to understand what secrets is hidden inside the mansion within the woods

title: Ctrl Alt Ego
description: Transmit your disembodied ego between robots and devices and exploit their capabilities in the first-person, very British 70s/80s-era immersive sci-fi simulator Ctrl Alt Ego. Tool up and break bad bots into broken bits, or sneak a bug quietly into the system as if you were never there.

title: My Place
description: My Place is a 2017 horror game that acts like a normal indie game, but when the player gets more and more into the game, it begins to act corrupt like something is wrong with it and it's up to the player to explore the corruption this game has until there's an end. It features a story of a suspicious "Rose" that is making the game act very strange. It also features characters you meet and some bosses you kill with a powerful flower that you obtain later in the game. You have to obtain the supplies to make the key which leads to the exit of freedom with little you have. But the question is "is it really an exit"?

title: Intruder in Antiquonia
description: In this classic point-and-click adventure, Sarah does not remember how she got to Antiquonia, but she has plenty of time to unravel the puzzle of her past as she explores the town where the Internet is not welcome. A beautiful adventure with high-resolution 2D graphics and a lovely soundtrack.

title: Burrows
description:
After leaving behind his former life in 1920's New Orleans, a jaded possum named Grey finds himself thrown into an unending nightmare by the enigmatic bartender, Virgil. Lost in a churning sea of souls, Grey comes across a group of men somehow connected to his former home, a plantation replete with it's own dark history. Just as quickly as they find each other they're suddenly taken away, leaving Grey only one option:
Dive into their memories and find out what caused this in the first place.

Explore various locations throughout time such as 1960s New York, 1980s Los Angeles ect. and strengthen your bonds with friends new and old. Many choices will lie before you and the results will have high stakes. Virgil's game is a gamble and you're his bet. Will you play into his hand, try to return to your old life or forge a new future?

title: One Night at Flumpty's 3
description:
"Hiya, best friend!"

Flumpty Bumpty is back again with all of his strange companions. You're his friend, too! ...Aren't you? Join the gang for one last round of "survival hide-and-seek" until the clock strikes 6 AM.

This time, you're armed with little more than a point-and-click camera with a flash, and the room you're staying in is freezing. it's too bad you couldn't bundle up ahead of time.

The egg is waiting for you...

title: Knights of the Tiny Table
description: Help King Arthur and his Knights defend the realm. Slay the evil entities with a combination of lucky dice rolls and clever tactics.

title: The Dream
description: A dystopian, open-world shooter set in a simulated Barcelona of 2033. Survive, explore, and uncover the secrets of the metropolis while earning data tokens. Engage in intense battles or form alliances to survive.

title: Fate Chapter 2: The Beginning
description: Fate Chapter 2 is a psychological horror game with a playtime of about 5-6 hours. It includes many puzzles and gnarly scenes and is a single player game. In this game there is blood sexual content and strong language. There are many scenes of blood, dismembered people and much more.

title: Mysteries Under Lake Ophelia
description: In Mysteries Under Lake Ophelia you play as a young kid who has decided to fish at the titular Lake Ophelia. You'll find yourself simply fishing the day away and trading in those fish for either a yummy meal or some new gear.

title: Mindustry Classic
description: The classic version of Mindustry, a sandbox tower defense game-- Create elaborate supply chains of conveyor belts to feed ammo into your turrets, produce materials to use for building, and defend your structures from waves of enemies.

title: 10 Hours Below
description:
10 Hours Below is a game about exploring a scene using a Timeline to find monsters in a 10 hours long animation!

You can try to search actively, or just let the game run in background for 10 hours and see the environment evolve. I think finding the 3 monsters require a lot of patience.

title: Wanrobo
description: Jump into the life of an AI robot. Complete tasks and start to learn more about the world around you..

title: Extraneum
description: Fight your way through mutated fiends and stop their progress in this old school FPS

title: Mass
description: Mass Experiment Uptime-Monitoring Effort and Legacy Support Team

title: Mimo
description: An herbalist awakens in a small, verdant world

title: Fatum Metamorphosis: Void Divers
description: Explore the Void, alter the past, make friends!

Bert the Barbarian is an action-arcade platform game made with charming clay animation that might remind you of old English children's TV series. You control the eponymous barbarian Bert who must find his way through ramparts while fighting or evading numerically superior foes.

Bert the Barbarian is programmed in the DIV2 game development environment. Its was originally created as a DIV2 demo for a competition held by the PC Zone magazine, and won the first prize.

However, the author, Anthony Flack, never expanded the game beyond two levels that will cycle indefinitely until you run out of continues. A Windows version is also available. Later, Bert the Barbarian was ported to other platforms, and may be also played in browser.

Thus, she decided that if she was forever going to be seen as the mean bully, she might as well reside herself to the role.

However, things change when she becomes fast friends with the new commoner transfer student, to everyone’s surprise including her own.

And more weirdly, how this new transfer student can seem to understand her better than anyone else and can see her for her true self rather than the part she had been reluctantly forced to play!

Trust you wits and slowly, surely, you will conquer the mysteries before you.

Something very important to you.

description:
Mycorrhiza is a love letter to horror manga in the form of a visual novel. Some of our biggest inspirations include the works of Junji Ito and Masaaki Nakayama.

While Scott is trying to find a way back home, reality distorts and people’s morals start shifting in cruel and unexpected ways. A peculiar plant transforming animals, a horrifying comedy trend and a strange building trapping people. Each of the three arcs explores different terrors.

As you explore this terrifying world, you'll find out more and more about how and why Scott is trapped in it and what lead up to Scott being spirited away.

The game features a manga aesthetic with animated CGs and character art drawn by a manga artist, a focus on elaborate audio implementation, as well as an honest attempt to make the game accessible by providing visual audio cues and a dyslexic font option.

title: Frantic Freddie
description: This game is a remake of the game "Frantic Freddie". The goal of the game is to have Freddie collect all the pots of gold on each level while avoiding all of the enemies. Optionally collect bonus items to earn more points (10,000 points earn an extra life). When all pots have been collected on a level, you will advance to the next level. What makes the game unique, is that the platforms are connected with telephone poles instead of ladders and Freddie cannot walk past a pole. He must climb up one side and down the other. Enemies however can move past the poles! There are 16 levels of increasing difficulty, featuring different enemies on each level. The earlier levels feature 3 enemies each and the later levels have 4 and 5 enemies. Enemy speed increases gradually each level. Every two levels there are interludes to give the player a short rest.

The game touches upon depression and anxiety, drinking culture, self esteem, and complicated relationships - and how those struggles intersect with everyday life. It also explores the healing power of friendships and the importance of being vulnerable.

An Essay on Insipidity II, also known as Essay II, is an adventure game that follows the tragedy of a peasant and hunter named Arkhip, which finds himself in the middle of a harsh winter alongside his family, who are almost famishing. Said journey will also take him deep inside his own soul.

The dialogue is a mishmash of broken to unintelligible English and Spanish.

description:
Dasher 3D is a top down shooter with time-freezing. And it's controlled with only one button as it's a part of Feldo's 1-Button Jam!

You are the Dasher, a lonely sprite that shoots and well... dashes around. A group of angry bots have attacked you in huge numbers, but you can do something that they can't: Control the time! As you dash around and stop, time freezes and lets you decide to either shoot, or to dash again.

Sadly, your contract doesn't state what kind of work you are required to do, so your boss loads you with all kinds of extra tasks, including firefighting and forest work. Naturally you are completely understaffed, and your short-tempered driver has no intention of stopping the truck to wait for you, just because you couldn't empty all the garbage cans while extinguishing a raging wildfire. Luckily, there are heaps of powerups that help you with all those tasks, so your stress level won't reach dangerous heights... Or so you thought! Due to an accident in your bosses DIY time reverting device, you travel back into medieval times with seemingly no way to return and to make matters worse, your contract states that you are still required to work! So better get yourself a sword because the town is in the middle of a siege!

Triad is about the most difficult puzzle of all: human relationships. The goal of Triad is to fit three lovers in a bed in such a way that everyone can get to sleep comfortably.
