title: Hotel on the Grate
description: Hotel on the Grate is a short(15-20 min), narrative adventure game. Assume the role of an on call therapist and travel across the city on the grate to meet your patients.

title: GDO Masters
description: GDO Masters is a 3D fighting game with mutually assured fun! Pick one from 8 characters and fight for the title of GDO Master!

title: Escape from the Village
description: You are on your way home from a holiday and your car breaks down and you are stranded in the middle of nowhere. You get out of the car, explore the surroundings, and try to get home. Enjoy this escape game set in a deserted mountain village in modern Japan.

title: Kate Don't Wait
description: You are in love with Kate, a beautiful and determined woman who is part of the rebooters movement. She encourages you to keep going by getting involved in the fight against the Accumulator, but you fear that the buts will catch you. Aren't Kate and the reboot worth any risk?

title: Square Dungeon
description: Square Dungeon is a word independent game of dungeon exploration. "Amnesiacs" wake up in an ancient "dungeon". The only way to find their identity and memory is to go to a higher dungeon. In the process, they should make choices and grasp their own destiny.

title: Gimle: The Broken Prophecy
description: Enter the dark world of Norse mythology in a new role-playing game. Play as Brand, a brave warrior on whose shoulders rests the future of the New World. Use his supernatural abilities and make difficult choices that affect the fate of the mythical land.

title: Legend of Krilona
description: Legend of Krilona ist ein RPG Abenteuer bei dem vier Helden durch eine Welt geführt werden, welche noch erkundet werden muss.

title: Block Collide
description: Block collide is a relaxing puzzle game with a minimalistic art style. Move the blocks in the right order so they won’t collide with each other.

title: Red Solstice 2: Survivors - Howell-Barrex Inc.
description: Experience a new story line with new characters and settings. Take on the role as the Strike Commander and bring victory to Howell-Barrex Inc.

title: Cheeky Chickens
description:
70+ fun levels of pig-popping pleasure!

These cheeky chickens are tired of being the main course. It's time for these pigs to pop on a plate.

title: Detective Time
description:
Detective Time is a game in the genre of "short interactive cinema".

The story takes place in an American town. A detective named Randy arrived at the crime scene, where the fishermen found the body of an unknown man in the lake. You need to look for clues, interview witnesses, interrogate suspects, break door locks and safes to figure out who the murderer is. The game has 4 different endings and the outcome will depend on your correct choice.

title: Retro Racers
description: Retro Racers sets the pace for 2D top-down classic racing games. Put the pedal to the metal while speeding by your opponents cars to unlock 12 exciting tracks. Collect the 4 classic power-ups along the way (Acceleration, Top Speed, Nitro Boosts and Traction). Avoid oil slicks and time the opening and closing of gates for shortcuts. Return to your childhood in Retro Racers!

title: UFO No!
description: What would you do in a UFO invasion? How about spacejack a UFO and use their technology against them! 49 Stages of Intensifying Action. Waves of Space Aliens.

title: Crankies Workshop: Whirlbot Assembly
description: Crankies Workshop is a true or false question game with a colorful and friendly atmosphere. Crankie needs help assembling his new order of Whirlbot's and he needs you to answer the knowledge machines questions to keep it assembling the robots.

title: Marlow in Apocalyptic Acid World
description: Marlow in Apocalyptic Acid World is a platformer heavily inspired by Super Mario, where you are led into a not-so-far-away future filled with Nuclear Waste, Flooded lands, Acid rain, and Dystopian societies.

title: Crankies Workshop: Bozzbot Assembly
description: Crankies Workshop is a true or false question game with a colorful and friendly atmosphere. Crankie needs help assembling his new order of Bozzbot's and he needs you to answer the knowledge machines questions to keep it assembling the robots.

title: Cold in the Dark
description: Horror first-person shooter. Warning: viewer discretion is strongly advised.

title: To Crime Nirvana
description: A simple RPG Maker VX Ace game where a former gangster, his demon worshipper boyfriend and their cat fight annoying crooks.

title: Crankies Workshop: Grizzbot Assembly
description: Crankies Workshop is a true or false question game with a colorful and friendly atmosphere. Crankie needs help assembling his new order of Grizzbot's and he needs you to answer the knowledge machines questions to keep it assembling the robots.

title: Crankies Workshop: Grizzbot Assembly 2
description: Crankies Workshop is a true or false question game with a colorful and friendly atmosphere.

title: Jane's Hotel
description: You start as a small 2 star hotel owner at the town suburbs and work your way to the top by upgrading accommodations and achieving an excellent reputation. Keep an eye on customer moods and make them happy by serving them fine drinks and dainty meals, or simply offering perfect room service. We will make your stay unforgettable!!

title: Margikarman ItoA
description: Ghosts who face their own death while going back and forth between the world of the dead and this world. A complete version of the ADV-type modern RPG "Margikarman" from the Eldritch and the School.

title: Out of Darkness
description:
A point and click adventure in a mysterious labyrinth. Select the eye, hand, or movement icon and click around to explore.

Made in about 12 hours as a practice project. "Darkness" was selected from three randomly generated themes.

title: Doppelganger
description: Yukari Niijima, a girl leading a mundane life, finds herself plagued by nightly nightmares filled with puzzles, keys, and eerie creatures, disrupting her usual routine of work and subway rides.

title: Awol Ahab
description: A retro style shmup where every shot lowers the score, but hit and destroryed enemies raise the score.

title: Light Quest
description: Light Quest is a small experimental platformer with a lighting-mechanic twist.

title: Zen
description: A chill little puzzle game. Just watch the moving spheres and the paths they leave behind to discover the hidden word.

title: The Season of the Warlock
description: The Season of the Warlock is a weird adventure game inspired by the gothic tale tradition, with two storylines to choose from. The soul of a warlock of yore, trapped in a portrait, will present Lord Alistair Ainsworth with an offer he will not be able to resist. Or will he? It's your call...

title: Our Great Revolution!
description:
It's a game where you gather friends and make a long line.
However, you cannot slip through the companions who follow you.

How many people can you collect without getting caught by your friends !?

title: Let's Meat Adam 2
description: LMA2 is a Gay Bara Horror Visual Novel, with murder mystery and puzzle elements; the sequel to 2017's "Let's MEAT Adam".

title: Holoquest
description: Holoquest is a comical JRPG featuring the girls of HoloMyth: Mori Calliope, Takanashi Kiara, Watson Amelia, Ninomae Ina'nis, and Gawr Gura. Familiarity with Hololive and its characters is not required to play and complete the game.

title: Riddle School 5: Legacy Edition
description: Riddle School 5: Legacy Edition is the last game of its series.

title: Riddle Transfer: Legacy Edition
description: The unexpected continuation and second-to-last game in the series.

title: Riddle Transfer 2: Legacy Edition
description: The too-long-anticipated conclusion to the story of Riddle Transfer.

title: Holo Dungeon
description: Play as Hololive's ace detective Amelia WATson as she investigates the kingdom of Chicago in search of mythical creatures.
A point-and-click escape game about sleep paralysis.

title: Drynk: Board and Drinking Game
description:
Drynk is the perfect drinking game to play with your friends! Just roll the dice and explore more than 40 different challenges on the board.

Offline and Online Playable

Drynk is now also an online drinking game. This makes Drynk the perfect game whether you're partying at home as a couple or with several friends, or want to meet new people online. If you feel like a night out, invite your friends over for pre-drinks with Drynk before you head over to the next club.

title: Honor of Kings: World
description:
Honor of Kings: World is a new Action RPG open world game based on the popular Honor of Kings MOBA.

Master a host of mighty skills as you roam this continent of vastness and possibilities. Embark on a journey that will captivate your eyes and heart. Experience new wonders, encounter a colorful cast of characters and leave your mark on long-lost ruins.

“Only the relic can grant me the answer.”

Get ready to embark on a fantasy journey in a world of discovery, wonder and adventure.

title: Dweep
description: Dweep is a 1999 puzzle game developed and published by Dexterity Software where you control an adorable creature called Dweep, helping him reach his kids by solving various puzzles using some tools such as mirrors, hammers, wrenches and the likes.

title: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley
description: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley is a musical adventure game in which Snufkin needs to restore the harmony of Moominvalley, after a series of grotesque parks has appeared and ruined the valley's natural balance. The game is an ambient and wholesome experience for both kids and adults, and combines open world-mechanics with puzzles, stealth and melodic elements.

title: Homicide Squad
description: Investigate homicides around the city! Search for clues, find hidden objects or match gems in a row, examine evidence, solve cases, and arrest the criminals!

title: Islets
description: Take to the sky and reunite a fragmented world in this surprisingly wholesome metroidvania! Help Iko adventure across beautiful hand-painted islands, receive letters from a quirky cast of characters, and face powerful monstrous adversaries.

title: Safety Blanket
description: Creepy blanket simulator

title: The Dust of the Violet Crystals
description: A flesh-eating dust leaves you to survive alone against hordes of Listless.

title: Come for a Drink
description: Free visual novel where you meet older glasses-wearing men who practice martial arts during the day...but at night...

title: Abskur
description: A sound based, arcade like sneaking game

title: The Quacken
description: In The Quacken you, as the duckling, must escape the crocodile manor. The game involves hiding from enemies and making your way through each area by going out through a door or down a staircase.

title: JanKenUP!
description:
Welcome to JanKenUP!, an exciting combat game that breaks with traditional schemes. Instead of the typical punches and combos, strategy boils down to three buttons: rock, paper, and scissors. Get ready for a cerebral challenge where your quick thinking and mental agility are key.

Hop on the elevator of fun and prepare to act swiftly. Face all kinds of rivals and prove that you can outshine everyone in the arena. Become the undisputed champion.

title: There Is No Light 616
description: Battle your way through the horrors and face the greater threats of these miserable lands! There is No Light 616 is a free version of the action-adventure There is No Light with 3 locations, a boss-fight, and an exclusive arena mode!

title: Friday Night Funkin': vs. Kapi - Arcade Showdown
description: Friday Night Funkin': vs. Kapi - Arcade Showdown is a mod by PaperKitty that adds 3 new weeks, new opponents, and a bunch of new songs. The main focus of the mod is of the character, Kapi.

title: Whispers in Akarra
description: Whispers in Akarra is a 2D multiplayer online role-playing game with multi-user dungeon elements in a persistent world.

title: D-Day: Normandy
description: D-Day: Normandy is a first-person shooter set across all theatres of war in World War II, originally developed as a Quake II mod in 1999 and later released as a free standalone game.

title: Cyberrrevolution
description: cybeRRRevolution (cyber-R-revolution) is an Indigenous action-adventure cyberpunk game about bartering with monsters, piloting godly mechas, and taking down bandits to secure a prosperous future for a nation of colonized peoples. Play as Sepsis, Rebel, or Barrett, each working toward a common goal of Recovery, Reconnection, and Rebuild.

title: VirtualCast
description: Free yourself from physicality, stream as whoever you desire to be. VirtualCast is the VR live communication service that will turn your desire into reality.

Leaving something behind is a hard task, Niles knows it all too well. When a stranger disturbs his peaceful everyday life and routine, he has no choice but to face the past and make some life-changing decisions.

Yet, it keeps on beckoning him.

title: Shaolin Sudoku
description:
Sharpen your mind by crunching numbers in a relaxing way!

The Yin Yang is a concept of dualism. There must be some darkness in the light and some light in the darkness. Shaolin Sudoku borrows this idea and presents it in an aesthetic sudoku game. It might just be the most beautiful Sudoku game. It is an indie game made by an Indian developer.

title: Stug
description: A 2D multiplayer tank game with exaggerated shell ricochet physics.

title: Daft Disputes
description:
The majority of card games out there take themselves very seriously, Daft Disputes is not one of them. As the player you play as senior citizens who were enjoying a day out in the park until they got lost.

Your objective is to help Sweet Old Agnes and her friends find their way back to their care home before it’s past their bedtime.

title: Cubes and More Cubes
description: A puzzle game with many levels and interesting gameplay. Frequent updates and themed updates such as "winter", "halloween", "new year", etc. will not make you bored.

title: Baldrhead: Busou Kinyuu Gaiden
description: Baldrhead is a linear adventure game with 2D action-shooter elements.

title: Chicken Nuggets
description: Chicken Nuggets is a roll a ball puzzle game set in the countryside as an adorable round chicken. Solve puzzles on a journey that will take your far from your coop!

title: Sailwind
description: Sailing simulator featuring realistic sailing physics and a vast open-world to explore. Embark on cargo delivery missions, customize your boat, try fishing and cooking. A relaxing day sail, or an epic ocean voyage? Your sailing adventure starts here!

title: Team 47 GoMan
description: An unreleased game demoed at E3 1995, developed by 47-Tek.

title: Karawan
description: Guide your caravan turn by turn through a crumbling word. Forage, mine and expand your following. Hire a Magus to perform world transforming spells, and finally reach the portal that will save...most of you.

title: Aura Aspic
description: Aura Aspic is a yume nikki fan game developed by Dream Key for the Dream Jam 2018. The game was developed with RPG Maker MV and produced closely following the spirit of the original yume nikki by kikiyama, as such it focuses mainly on exploration and free interpretation of everything the player experiences.

title: Whiskers
description: This game places you against a pristine white backdrop

title: Sod
description: Sod is an extreme modification or "hack" of id Software’s action game Wolfenstein 3D, in which the goal was to escape from a Nazi dungeon. In Sod, Wolfenstein 3D’s representational renderings (considered state-of-the art at the time of the game’s release in 1992) have been replaced by pure geometrical forms in a limited palette of black, white and gray. The result is a game space that is loosely architectural and extremely disorienting; it is easy to get lost, and it can be difficult to distinguish the walls from the targets one is supposed to shoot. Paesmans and Heemskerk complement the game-play difficulties with a cryptic interface (setting game preferences is no easy task!) and tongue-in-cheek game instructions along the lines of "If you are tough, press N. If not, press Y daintily." With its stark elegance, Sod offers a compelling alternative to the computer game industry’s mindless pursuit of representational realism.

title: Left to My Own Devices
description: Left To My Own Devices uses the codes of digital games to explore a narrative of loss and awkward renewal. The game’s main character navigates a space of playful interaction and fragmented animation. Game segments take inspiration from the shifting emotional states associated with loss. The character’s backstory is gradually revealed through game play.

title: Dream Wires
description: Dream Wires is a collaborated English Yume Nikki fangame created by sniperbob and Madoreptilian in RPG Maker 2003. The game stars Shigeru.

title: Baldr Fist
description: Baldr Fist is a branching adventure game with 2D action-shooter elements.

title: The City Must Grow
description: A new city will be established on a flat plain and its administration has been given to you. In order to keep the administration in your hands, the city needs to develop continuously.

title: Shadows of Forbidden Gods
description:
A strategy game in which you attempt to bring about the apocalypse, by moving covert agents through a complex fantasy world to accomplish a wide range of schemes, plots and rituals. You start the game by bribing guards and infiltrating minor farming communities and slowly build up your forces until you are bringing about ice ages, eradicating entire nations with plague, summoning volcanoes and commanding city-devouring snake-gods.

You play a set of agents and corrupted heroes against the forces of good, the rulers and heroes of humanity, lead by the Chosen One. They may be stronger than you, and could eliminate your agents with ease, but you have the advantage of secrecy, and humans are easily turned one against each other. Why fight a war against a unified empire when you could shatter in into civil war and clean up the pieces with orcish hordes?

title: Octofight Escape
description:
Directly inspired from escape and guessing games, Octofight Escape allows you to show your strategic skills to get out of the place in which you have chosen to appear as quickly as possible.
Each game is unique: the exits, the roles, and the items change.
It's up to you and your teammates to adapt in order to escape as discreetly as possible. Communication will be your best friend, remember you play as a team.

Two teams are facing each other, the « defenders » and the « attackers ».
The defenders must complete missions all game long, if they manage to accomplish them, they’ll win.
The attackers must attempt to escape by finding solutions, while doing tasks that the defenders will require them to do.

The lobby system allows you to create private or public games, in order to play, as you wish, only with your friends or other players from the Octofight community.
Thanks to the in-game mic system, you can as well coordinate and chat verbally with your friends and as well as with other players.
Updates are common for the delight of players, in order to add content such as characters, cosmetics, maps, and other ways of playing...

Time is running out, don’t waste it, run aways or catch them all!

title: Mister Versatile: A Gay Superhero Visual Novel
description: A gay superhero visual novel! The Lone Wolf Mister Versatile thinks super teams are a pain in the ass, but four super-hotties have decided they want to watch his back anyway!

title: StreamWalker Tribes
description: Social RPG built for streamer communities.

title: Everything I Do is Art, But Nothing I Do Makes Any Difference, Part II Or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Gallery
description: Everything I Do is Art, But Nothing I Do Makes Any Difference, Part II Or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Gallery is the second in a series of playable levels for the popular first-person shooter video game, Half Life 2. This version was made for the 2006 Undergraduate Exhibition at the School of the Art Institute of Chicago. The entire 50,000+ square foot gallery has been meticulously modeled, along with some of the artwork from the show.

title: Untitled Game
description: Untitled Game was made just as game modifications began to gain widespread recognition as an art form unto itself. JODI made the piece by altering the graphics of Quake as well as the software code that makes it work. Their mods reduced the complex graphics of Quake 1 to the bare minimum, aiming for maximum contrast between the complex soundscapes and the minimal visual environment. For the mod 'Arena,' JODI took this principle to the extreme: they completely erased every graphical element of the game, turning monsters, characters and backgrounds all to white. The more psychedelic 'Crl-Space,' the earliest of the set, is not based on a static image. Instead, it features a swirling black-and-white background. The game engine generates this effect as it continuously tries, and fails, to visualize the interior of a cube lined with black-and-white wallpaper.

title: Elden Ring: Collector's Edition
Elden Ring: Launch Edition
ArsDoom
description:
An attempt for an artists project using the well known doom engine and
wellhacked internal formats. No blood-feast!
About 20 artists have been invited to exhibit in the virtual museum located
in the Brucknerhaus in Linz, where every year an exhibition for the worlds
greatest computer art contest, the prix ars electronica is celebrated.
So people around the world who cannot come to Linz this time participate at
the exhibition in the virtual Brucknerhaus. All the artists are there
virtually (at least there heads and projects). Some personally, some
computer generated. Max. 4 of them on the net, the other 20
as monsters. And have fun interacting with the different projects, be an
artist like Arnulf Rainer, Hermann Nitsch, Baselitz or Nam June Paik.

title: Anno 2070: Bonus Edition
description:
This Bonus Edition was only released in Germany, and it includes:

Anno 2070 (base game)
Anno 2070: The Eden Series Package (DLC)
Anno 2070: The Distrust Series Package (DLC)
Anno 2070: The Nordamark Line Package (DLC)
Plus various skins and missions.

title: Dance Dance Revolution Grand Prix
description: The cloud-based home release of the arcade series DanceDanceRevolution, released as part of Konami's Konaste line.

title: Anno 2070: Royal Edition
description:
The German-released version of Anno 2070.
This bundle of the Anno 2070 game includes:

Anno 2070 (base game)
Anno 2070: Deep Ocean (DLC)
Anno 2070: The Eden Series Package (DLC)
Anno 2070: The Distrust Series Package (DLC)
Anno 2070: The Nordamark Line Package (DLC)
Soundtrack

title: Anno 1701 A.D.: Gold Edition
description: A German-released compilation of 1701 A.D. and the expansion 1701 A.D.: The Sunken Dragon

title: Anno 1701: Limited Edition
description:
This limited edition of 1701 A.D., of which only 17,001 units exist, includes:

- 1701 A.D.
- 1701 A.D. art book
- 1701 A.D. key fob
- 1701 A.D. soundtrack DVD in 5.1 surround sound
- One of 3,400 drawings signed by the artist framed in Passepartout
- Five postcards with 1701 A.D. motives
- Production overview-poster
- Certificate of authentication

title: Windrush Tales
description: Windrush Tales is an illustrated text-based narrative game exploring the courage, community and culture of a generation.

title: Tomb of Trials
description: A third-person puzzle-action-platformer where players must escape a mysterious deadly tomb by solving puzzles involving a variety of different types of switches, making use of found objects and more. There are also segments that challenge the player's dexterity where they will have to be weary of deadly traps including spikes, flames, trapdoors, bottomless pits, swinging balls, and more.

title: Anno 1602 A.D.
description: This release is a bundle that combines the original game Anno 1602: Creation of a New World and its German-only add-on Anno 1602: Erschaffung einer neuen Welt - Neue Inseln, Neue Abenteuer.

title: Dungeon Avenger
description: Your arch-nemesis and his goons have thrown you into one of the most dangerous dungeons – fight your way to freedom & revenge! Arcade-style hack & slash adventure. Procedurally generated levels: never see the same dungeon twice!

title: V.G. Re-birth
description:
A visual novel game in which the player plays the part of a reporter working on a story about the V.G. competition. The game also introduces the new character Sakuragi Hiyori. Depending on the choices the player makes, he/she will be paired with Yuka, Tamao or Reimi.

V.G. Rebirth Dash:
An update to V.G. Rebirth which includes nearly every other non-boss character (Yuuki Ayako is absent as she is a lesbian) as an option to pair with the player. It also introduces the new character Hatano Keiko.

title: Hot Springs Story 2
description: A "hot" new hot springs resort sim with a ton of new exclusive features! What lies beyond the bath curtain? A "hot" new entry into the hotel sim genre!

title: Naiad
description: A relaxing and colorful exploration adventure about flowing by a river. Immerse yourself in a relaxing, minimalist and colorful exploration adventure. Flow with Naiad across a mysterious river and interact with its fauna and flora to discover little secrets. A very personal and unique game created with love by a solo dev.

title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2 - Mental Omega
description: Mental Omega is a free unofficial expansion pack for Command & Conquer Red Alert 2 Yuri's Revenge. It started off as a balance modification and after a few years, it had grown into an unofficial sequel with new campaigns for the Allies, Soviets and Yuri. Now, version 3.3 marks the end of the long road and is the final iteration of the Mental Omega mod series.

title: Illuminaria
description: Command a swarm of intelligent robots in their quest to save the world. Mine resources, manage, and defend multiple bases. Go on expeditions, fight in auto-battles, research new technologies, and create your army of golems to bring back the light.

title: Gedda Cake
description: Gedda Cake is a 2D action-platformer about Dragons and Cakes. Play as 6 characters with unique skills and play-styles, swap between them on the fly, battle dangerous foes and explore the vast sugar-coated lands of Sugria. Help them reclaim their invaded world and get The Cake!

title: The Colossus Is Coming: The Interactive Experience
description: All seems calm. The multitude of towering trees sway in the breeze... But something feels wrong. Something is watching you, something omniscient. The feeling that you may not be alone grows ever-stronger... It's coming... find the tapes...

title: Adversator
description: Adversator is a fast-paced MOBA with short and intense matches. Fight your way up the highly competitive ranked ladder or play for fun in casual matches with no waiting time. Made by a solo indie developer with an old-school graphical touch and unique features you’ll find nowhere else.

title: Perestroika
description: Perestroika is a Russian video game. The game consists of controlling a small frog-like creature which jumps from one lily pad to another, trying to collect dots in four colors symbolizing grocery goods, currency transactions, progressive taxes and adventures and to reach a certain pad in the right-top corner of the screen. The lilies, symbolizing the ever-changing laws and acts in the USSR, constantly shrink and disappear only to appear in other places. Higher levels also feature one or more evil creatures called "bureaucrats" which follow the frog and try to eat it. The frog dies if the lily pad on which it is standing disappears, if the player moves it to a place where there is no lily pad, or if it is caught by a bureaucrat.

title: Tiny Tina's Assault on Dragon Keep: A Wonderlands One-shot Adventure
description: Smash skeletons, defeat dragons, and battle giant golems in Tiny Tina's Assault on Dragon Keep: A Wonderlands One-Shot Adventure. Experience the acclaimed 2013 quest jam-packed with fantasy, fun, and mountains of magical loot!

title: Hextech Mayhem: A League of Legends Story
description: Hextech Mayhem: A League of Legends Story is a fast-paced rhythm runner where every action has an explosive reaction and no amount of mayhem is too much, featuring familiar champions from the League of Legends universe. Take on the role of Hexplosives expert Ziggs as you rampage through the neighborhoods of Piltover while you bomb, bounce, and bop to the beat of the music to avoid obstacles, disarm enemies, and light fuses. Use the Freestyle Mayhem System to create spontaneous blasts and grab bonus points… all while dodging the fun police and showing them what they’re really missing.

title: Haunted Hotel: Ancient Bane - Collector's Edition
description: What kind of evil resides in the hotel? An exciting investigation in the cursed hotel awaits you!

title: Political Arena
description: POLITICAL ARENA is a one-of-a-kind strategy/sim about American power. Seek fame or infamy in a fully simulated political world, complete with high stakes campaign strategizing, backroom deals, scandals, special interests, and the press. Be the politician of your dreams (or nightmares).

title: Wing Breakers
description:
Wing Breakers is extreme battle air racing mayhem with crazy cows.
Survive chaotic air fights full of missile loaded planes, threatening drones and angry animals. Beat them all and become a hero of Wing Breakers!

title: Haunted Hotel: Ancient Bane
description: A famous engineer buys an old residence and turns it into a hotel, then people start to disappear there! An exciting investigation in the cursed hotel awaits you!

title: The Last One Month
description: The Last One Month is a unique mix of Battle Royale, Survival RPG and Turn-based Strategy games where you become one of 50 warriors and battle each other to become the hero who will save the kingdom.

title: CS2D
description: CS2D is a free fast-paced top-down multiplayer shooter. Featuring many different game modes, a built-in map editor and much more.

title: Winging It
description: Play as a young owl born into a desert full of tasty prey and scary predators. Glide through the desert on a journey of survival, growing your abilities along the way.

title: Nearly Dead
description: Nearly Dead is a 2D open world survival game. It's a game about survivors who try to remain alive in a situation where demons from a different dimension have turned most humans into zombies.

title: Umineko Redacted: Some Kind of Sunny Little Dream
description:
A curious Forgery.

A Forgery for Umineko no Naku Koro Ni (When They Cry). Not an official work. No association with 07th Expansion is claimed or implied.

title: Head North
description:
Welcome To Head North. A Top-Down Fast-Paced Puzzle Platformer where you guide our protagonist, Fell, north by using the ancient power known as 'Earth Shifting.'

How far north will you get?

title: Cosplay Therapy
description: Naughty parody game about cosplay

title: Another Day?
description: Ivan sets out for the abandoned hospital in the town of Olkhov, where his brother Tolya disappeared after witnessing something horrifying, causing him to stop communicating and eventually vanish.

title: Mermaid Shores
description: A summer visit to your aunt’s home leads to a very memorable encounter with an unforgettable merboy. When the two of you reconnect many years later, you realize a little too late that handsome mermen aren’t the only secrets that lie within the ocean’s depths…

title: Room 400
description: Can you escape this room?

title: Omen of Rain
description: You play as Hans, who, after fifteen years, has returned to the old hideout where he used to play with his friends.

title: Mister Mandragora's Special Errands!
description: Short and sweet monster errand sim!

title: The New Resident
description: An anonymous tip for a missing people's case leads you to ManneCorp.

title: Mendum Memoria
description: A Yume Nikki Fangame about a boy who hides something in his dream world.

title: GeaSaga
description: "Your journey into the land of Cirhena awaits!"

title: At the Sea's End
description: The story focuses on a lighthouse keeper on a quest to find all the pieces of their soul deep in the sea in order to go back home.

title: Kohana
description:
Kohana is a short visual novel made in one month by Mushroomallow Studio for Spooktober VN Jam 2021 event.

"Once close, now far apart. What should be done to close the distance?"

Kohana, a Japanese confection store in a world where humans and youkai coexist together. Ren, the young confection maker and the owner of the store, has been continuously attacked by a fox-shaped shadow. He knows the perpetrator, yet did nothing to stop them. Once the store guardian, Komainu, has enough and swears that he will eliminate the attacker, Ren has to do whatever it takes to stop the bloodshed between the two people he holds dear, even if it costs him his own life.

Witness the relationship between two childhood friends and unravel the tragedy that pushed them apart.

title: Heroes and Monsters

title: Hercules

title: Bloody Barrage
description:
Bloody Barrage was supposed to be a zombie round survival game where you have to survive
as many rounds as you can against zombies, with each round getting harder as you go on.

title: JunkPunk
description: JUNKPUNK is a factory management, base building, exploration game where a New World Robotics ship has crash landed. You and any survivors must restore this ruined planet and prepare it for habitable life. Craft, build, explore, discover, and grow to terraform the planet.

title: BrickBreak
description: BrickBreak is a simple breakout game.

title: Clotheslines

title: Z's Room

title: Wild Child
description: Have a relaxing time exploring a colorful island. Gather collectibles to befriend cute animals during a quiet journey.

title: My Grumpy Hyena!

As a reclusive critter living in the woods, filling your days playing games, your roommate suggests you take a step outside and head into the bustling village of Toppletown. Here you'll find plenty of people in need of help, but could there be a true friend in sight, too?

title: Kaiju Noir
description: Kaiju Noir is a piece of pulp fiction tale of giant monsters in a world rebuilt in humanity’s image, for better or worse. Mysteries, corruption, & deception abound in this twisted city of stone.

title: The House Swich Places
description: cool and new hiveswap - now one the internent!

title: Tiny Golf Puzzles
description: Jack Nicklaus, step aside! Tom Brinton invites you join him in the putting greens of the mind. A small, but entertaining puzzle game.

title: Scoot Scoot
description: Scooter Agility, Time-Attack.

title: Fighting Fiends
description: Fighting Fiends is a top-down fighting game. Play it 1 on 1 for intense matches or with up to 4 players for chaotic fun, both locally and online.

title: Attack of the Murder Hornets

title: Super Sec Soccer

title: Pico Tennis

title: Space Explorer Iyo!!
description: A romantic comedy about a human explorer who meets a stingy alien boy!

description: As the future ruler of Khorinea, you are the heir to a kingdom filled with magic and mystery, but one that is also in a state of decline. When a dragon attacks the castle during one fateful day, you're brought to its tower and kept prisoner. Although your "host" tries to be hospitable, you can't help but notice that it's hiding a very big secret...

title: Through the Panels
description: Make friends, cause drama, survive high school!

title: Love Rewind: A Magical Time Travel Romance
description: What would you do with a second chance at life?

title: Rhythm Road
description: Fast-paced rhythm game with a retro soundtrack

In the game, you play as Aya, a socially awkward girl in her second year of high school, who only wants to make friends. Unfortunately, being a new transfer student starts turning heads and gets the attention of everyone in her class.

title: Cyber Rescue: Virus Eruption
description: Race through cyberspace to destroy the source of your friend's virus.

title: Zombies Shall Not Pass!
description: Became a zombie and ambush survivors with Leap Motion!

title: SpaceBeaver
description: SpaceBeaver is unusual 2d-action in a circular room. You're playing as SpaceBeaver, who must defend his SpaceDam from evil aliens. Use your weapons and four powerful abilities to show enemies what's what and save the world… SpaceBeaver.

title: Void-Dogs
description: A third-person rails shooter. Dive through space in the 25th Century in an effort to save mankind.

title: Dinorage
description: Dinorage is a FPS shooter.

title: Space Kahuna
description:
Are those California waves too bogus for you? Why don't you take a surf in SPACE!!!

Space Kahuna is horizontally scrolling shooter developed as a tribute to silly shoot' em ups from the past such as Parodius, Harmful Park, and Cho Aniki. Therefore don't expect the usual space tropes and get ready for some silly levels.

title: Spice Evaders
description: The Extra Hot Shooting Challenge! Spice Evaders is a retro-style arcade shoot 'em up where you get to destroy spicy food. Can you take the heat?

title: Tactical Retreat
description: Tactical Retreat is a Wave Based Survival Shooter with some basic tasks to perform between each wave.

title: Jukaya
description: Jukaya is an on-rails endless shooter in the vein of the classics with a heavy emphasis on Vaporwave visuals and sound. The game consists of surviving increasingly intense waves of enemies in an attempt to stave off the inevitable setting of the Vaporwave sun.

title: Pacifist Outside
description: Pacifist Outside is a classic cinematic platformer. An uncompromising experience, where failure is frequent and progress is hard-earned. Play as a brave tribal leader, grappling with strange trials and unknown forces, as he makes a spiritual journey through a dark cave.

title: Dragon Gate
description: Dragon Gate is a top down platformer following a koi carp scaling the Yellow River.

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Deadlands
description: Experience the cataclysmic conclusion to the Gates of Oblivion year-long adventure in The Elder Scrolls Online: Deadlands. Explore new worlds, discover strange new allies, and bring destruction to Oblivion itself in this new zone and story DLC.

title: Material Brave
description: Material Brave is a 2D Fighting / Action game, similar to Duel Savior

title: Shadow Wrangler
description:
Your shadows have split from you and you must guide them to the exit. You can move at will, but the shadows need to be given commands. Pick up command boxes (turn, jump, explode) and drop them where you want the shadows to act.

Take on TEN CHALLENGING STAGES of PUZZLE PLATFORMING BY PROXY.

title: A Drift for the Irresolute
description: You play a video game. Your phone rings.

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Waking Flame
description: Continue the battle against Mehrunes Dagon and delve into two exciting new dungeons in the next installment of the Gates of Oblivion year-long adventure,The Elder Scrolls Online: Waking Flame.

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Flames of Ambition
description: The Gates of Oblivion year-long adventure starts here! Delve into two new dungeons, uncover ancient knowledge, confront a dangerous new cult, and begin a journey that takes you to The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood.

title: Lugaru HD
description: Third-person rabbit kung fu, with a built-in editor

title: Club de Detectives: Caso 01
description: Visual novel of comedy and mystery.

title: Material Brave Ignition
description: This is the fandisc for the action adventure Material Brave, consisting of after stories for the 5 heroines, as well as a new story for the childhood friend Ena. There are additional dungeons during the ADV/ACT part, with new weapons and outfits.

title: I Will Be There
description: A Crazy Ex Girlfriend Adventure!

title: Don't Talk to Strangers
description: You are a kid that loves candy. You just arrived in a new city with your family. And it’s Halloween.

title: Chinese Takeout!
description: Help Kung Pow take down the Kung Fu Hustlers!

title: Keep On
description: Keep the blob on the stage.

title: Toast Jammer
description: A cute flip-and-match bread game and splats!

title: The Deliverer
description: The Deliverer is a first-person delivery game where you deliver quests as fast as possible!

title: Endless Q
description: Classic Q-Bert inspired gameplay cranked up for quick frantic play sessions. Bright and colorful, frantic arcade fun!

title: Baldr Bringer Extend Code
description: One day, Fuji and others receive a rescue signal from Hristina, a girl who calls herself "VERTEX ORDER 4". The party heads to the virtual space "Naraku" that continues to absorb information and investigates the cause of the abnormality.

title: The Radio Station
description:
The Radio Station is a Japanese psychological horror game. It gives the player an atmospheric, photo-realistic graphics intensifies the horror experience.
This game is primarily a "walking simulator" genre with puzzle-solving elements.

title: An ExScourgeon Through Space and Time!
description: Go on an inter-dimensional adventure as the Pied Piper!

title: Sunset Squid
description: Swim fast as lightning in Sunset Squid!

title: The Great Tsunami
description: Ride the wave and help our hero Tsunami to rid the sea by monsters of Japanese mythology!

title: You Are Undead
description: You didn't survive the zombie apocalypse and now you are a brain eater undead feeding on the last remnants of humanity. You will use freaking creepy mutations and lurk among the shadows to hunt your prey. There is a brief tutorial, but it's up to you to discover the special abilities of the infected ones.

title: Questizin
description: A short action RPG. You are a brave hero trying to open up the path to the east through a misterious cave. The game features 5 sets of equipment, 4 enemies with particular attacks, 4 very nice npcs and a main quest to be solved with a final puzzle.

title: Glass Walls
description: Glass Walls is a 3D, 3rd-person puzzle game featuring a unique perspective switching mechanic, a surrealist visual style, an original soundtrack, and an intergenerational story about mothers and daughters. Playing as 3 generations of women, players swap between different perspectives to solve intricate puzzles and discover the stories behind each of them.

title: Art of Not Getting Found
description: Sometimes the only way of getting to your destination is by getting lost...

title: A Melon's Tale
description: A discarded water melon decides to help those in need.

title: Slow Down
description: Blast 'n bop your friends in this Local Multiplayer Arcade game! (2-4 players)

title: Scarlet and Blank
description:
In 1888 in Yoshiwara, the pleasure district of Tokyo, a man meets a woman. Soon after, the illustrious escort Hakuhi dies, her throat slit by a gilded silver hairpin.

So begins a tale of the events leading up to her death, told from the perspective of one man who loves her and another who hates her more than life itself.

title: Pitch Shift
description: Beginning again and again can be a whole new journey with just the right shift.

title: Turnin' Tail
description: Use the power of perspective to find the animals that escaped from the pet store!

title: Rick Shaw's Radical Rickshaw
description: Grab townsfolk and transport them in this wild reimagining of crazy taxi.

title: Mollie
description: Mollie is a platformer where jumping separates you from your skateboard.

title: KMG Tournament: Kiss More Girls
description: KMG Tournament is a collection of small local multiplayer sports games ranging from 2 to 8 players in which you win by kissing your teammates and opponents.

title: Quality Television
description: Those guards never knew what hit 'em.

title: Tunnel View
description:
Puzzle your way through only one dimension. Solve some colour shenanigans, navigate the limited space and bend the dimension using mirrors.
Solve 14 stages, then get one of two endings. The game explores trust, blindness and the importance of grey area, but for all of that, you'll need to see both endings.

title: Tungsten Orbital Destroyer
description: Tungsten Orbital Destroyer is a game about an unconventional weapon. TOD offers cutting edge 3D graphics combined with an awesome retro soundtrack.

title: The Tick of Guilt
description: A short, interactive story about how the choices we make affect the lives of others.

title: Udom Nebdon
description: Udom Nebdon is a short fixed camera adventure horror-themed game.

title: Her Majesty's Apathy Bomb
description: Her Majesty's Apathy Bomb is a first person narrative game. It's a short, narrative game with six different endings, depending on how well you listen to the narrator.

title: Allergy Assassin
description: Exploit your enemy's weakness

title: Astro Error
description: Our character, who fell to a planet as a result of our ship's malfunction, collects the parts of our ship and tries to get rid of the planet by restarting the ship. have the right to carry a maximum of one piece. With energy crystals, it can charge our radio and call reinforcements.

title: Star Wars: The Fighter II
description: Searching for an exciting game about space? You found it! Star Wars: The Fighter II is a Star Wars themed space shooter.

title: Heartland
description: Heartland is a Doom II episode developed exclusively for the Eternity Engine. Heartland takes place in the nation's decaying industrial heartland. An inscrutable evil lurks somewhere beneath the abandoned factory on the city's outskirts, beckoning you closer with every beat of your heart...

title: 1921: Shadow of the Old World
description: A spiritual successor to the 3D game called "Old World", set in Russian Civil War (1917-1922).

title: Shit Country Sweeper

title: A Frog Took My Sister

title: Karaoke Ninja
description: The only stealth game where you make noise to win!

title: Crushing Reality
description: Hack into game's system in order to beat unfair levels.

title: Astropover
description: Astropover is not an easy game to run through. It’s important to remember where your opponents appear. There is the possibility to start a level again or you can even jump to the next level. This game was created combining 2 incompatible genres: a mixture of Jump & Run and Bullet Hell/shmup.

title: Optical Ball
description: Brutal brick-breaker.

title: Gustavo Go!
description: Run, jump and dash to the beat to gain speed and contest with others' times in this fast-paced rhythm platformer.

title: Snekman
description: Pacman and Snake! Two Arcade Classics Mashed together!

title: Run for Love
description: 3D-Platformer-Dating-Sim-Mashup

title: Timeheist
description: It's heisting time! Compete against up to 128 friends in a maze that changes by the minute in search for gold until there remains only one! It's competitive gaming reduced down to its bare essentials!

description: Don't Choke is a challenging yet simplistic Rhythm Game that simulates the experience of maintaining a steady heart-rate and reducing your anxiety before high pressure sporting competition.

title: OldBerserker
description: Get involved in this adventure, a Viking tradition that succumbed to the greatest warriors to enter sacred ground with beasts to die with honor and all the Berserker force still intact, With one reason, unite the armies of Odin in Valhalla for a Last Fight, The Raggnarock.

title: Come Dine at Valhalla
description: Come Dine at Valhalla is a single-player diner game. The game is designed to be played using a keyboard and mouse.

title: Lucerna Tenebris
description: Energetic teens, Rex and Regina, are starting out their first adventure, unaware of the fate within the darkness.

title: Origin Hunt

title: Grabanakki
description: Clear 30 levels of block-throwing combat!

title: Among the Monolyths
description: A short game about solving puzzles to heal.

title: Psycho-unstable Journey
description: This game is about traveling by car. Here you have to overcome a long way through rain and lightning.

title: Hexworld
description: Unusual Medieval Strategy.

title: LoveCrafting
description: A game about conducting an unstable Lovecraftian ritual.

title: Quantum Qitty
description: A game about unstable little qitty.

title: Puzzled Love
description: Puzzled Love is a a point-and-click-and-drag-and-drop game where you will cover pictures with other pictures to uncover the love story layer by layer. Meet Jonathan and Lily, the two troubled hearts who have just moved into a new apartment to start a life together—a life that is full of new hopes and beginnings. Or is it?

title: Mother Is Gone
description: Where is Mother?

title: Humorpractor
description: Balance humors in an unstable patient.

title: Pizza Pony
description: Deliver pizzas, like only a horse can.

title: 00:00 Zerotime
description: Escape to the Warpgate on the last remaining rescue shuttle before the shock wave reaches you!

title: Catty Shack
description:
The cats that live in your cat shelter have run away, and you'll need to meet their ridiculous demands before they'll follow you home again.
Also, you are a ghost.

title: Pwn Adventure 3: Pwnie Island
description: Pwn Adventure 3: Pwnie Island is a limited-release, first-person, true open-world MMORPG set on a beautiful island where anything could happen. That's because this game is intentionally vulnerable to all kinds of silly hacks! Flying, endless cash, and more are all one client change or network proxy away. Are you ready for the mayhem?!

title: Ebon Light
description: A dark tale of old secrets and romance!

title: DeFacto
description: Build a big automated factory on an isolated asteroid, sell your products and send rockets into space.

title: Astral Ascent
description: Choose one of four heroes and explore the Garden, an astral prison guarded by 12 powerful mystical bosses: the Zodiacs. Challenge them with dozens of unique spells and faithful friends by your side to unfold the story of this platform roguelite with lightning fast combat.

title: Festa Estranha
description: A "social escape the room" game that takes place in the most difficult place to escape: a college party!

title: Clockwork Calamity in Mushroom World
description: "Clockwork Calamity" in Mushroom World: What would you do if the time stopped ticking? is a platformer-game with colourful graphics, many items to find, a lovely trading system, huge procedurally generated labyrinths to explore, strange characters, a cozy lyrical soundtrack, and a mysterious witch named Eivlys at the heart of it all.

title: Triforce: The Topologies of Zelda
description: The Topologies of Zelda: Triforce is a head melting non-euclidean puzzle adventure in which you attempt to collect three Triforce pieces while traversing a The Legend of Zelda's inspired 2D world that's mapped onto rotatable 3D structures.

title: A Forest Walk
description: Can you get home on time?

title: Breakfast at Cemetery
description: Breakfast at Cemetery is a QWOP styled game, where your task, as a skeleton, is to eat a nutritious breakfast against the clock!

title: Idle Idol
description: Idle Idol is a clicker (sort-of) and resource management game about a goddess and her followers. Building temples or destroying obstacles will cost you some followers, but the temples will generate more over time. Manage your limited space around the statue to place temples.

This is a game jam game made by team NoIdea for UE4 July Jam.
The theme was "Speak softly and carry a huge stick"

title: Rusty's Rail
description: Casual train clicker resource management sim

title: Instant Summer
description: If you ever play with weather, please be careful!!!

title: Off the Record
description: Ever dreamt of running a record store?

description: Collect snowflakes and start a village in this relaxing idle incremental game.

title: Holonoptic
description: As the new CEO of a derelict company, you must deal (or side) with rogue corporate AIs, rebellious labor unions and globalist aristocrats. Holonoptic combines economic simulation and party-based RPG into a story-rich corporate alpine cyberpunk.

title: Almora Darkosen
description: A game created with passion by one person! Almora Darkosen is a retro style hack and slash, role-playing game set in a fantasy world.

title: Morbid Metal
description: Morbid Metal is a stylish fast-paced hack’n’slash action rogue-lite. Shapeshift into powerful characters in real time, chain impactful combos, and tear through waves of deadly machines and brutal bosses.

title: Pokémon Prisme
description: Pokémon Prisme is a French fangame developed since 2012 and will make you travel through the different regions with a brand new story mixing the anime, the games and the Pokémon Adventures manga.

title: Genpei Ryouran Emaki: Gikei
description:
The latest historical adaptation from Inre, focusing on the late Heian period.

Protagonist Kanou Yoshitsune is the son of Kanou shrine keeper's family.
He is going to a school with other two. One is his sister Roko, and the other is childhood friend Shizuka.

They go to Kyoto with school trip, but Roko goes missing in Kuramadera. Yoshitsune and Shizuka goes to Kuramadera to find her, but they loses consciousness in the main hall. When they woke up, they were still in Kuramadera but something was different.

They were in Heian period, which is about 850 years ago.

title: Pokémon Jaspe
description: Pokémon Jaspe is a French Pokémon fan game, it tells the story of a trainer looking for his brother through an open world.

title: Kid A Mnesia Exhibition
description: Kid A Mnesia Exhibition is an upside-down digital/analogue universe created from original artwork and recordings to commemorate 21 years of Radiohead’s Kid A and Amnesiac.

title: Archery Club
description: Archery Club is an archery game with multiple exciting game types and an extensive upgrade system. Become a master archer, collect the best equipment and win!

title: FishWitch Halloween
description: Grab your diving gear and join Beatrice, the guardian of the seven seas, in this enchanted underwater Halloween adventure. Enjoy addictive gameplay as you earn money to decorate a sanctuary with colorful fishes and awesome thematic ornaments. As your sanctuary progresses, you get diamonds with which you can buy cool power-ups to help you beat the levels. Match your way through the wonders of the marine life and explore a bewitching underwater world. Get hooked on FishWitch Halloween.

title: Mercenaries Rebirth: Call of the Wild Lynx
description: Mercenaries Rebirth is a tactical RPG set in a fantasy world. Battles occur on quarter-view maps with height differences, wherein the front, back, and side of the map determine each battle’s outcome. Support effects depend on where allied characters from your party are in position, etc., features of high strategic maneuvers. Talented Illustrator Makimura Shunsuke-san is the appointed character designer! Beautifully drawn characters play more active roles with rich facial expressions that vary from joy, sadness, anger, etc.

title: The Adventure of Ravi 'n' Navi
description: "Radiant Rabbits" is a village where rabbits and fairies live in peace. Ravi and Navi have to defeat the great demon king "Shivarra", who is planning to destroy the village! The main character, rabbit "Ravi", joins forces with fairy "Navi" and sets out on an adventure to collect the "Sacred Carrot", the source of happiness hidden by Shivarra. On their way, they are greeted by a variety of tricks and unique characters. They can compete in boat races with beaver, ride a minecart down a mining railroad, and even play retro arcade games! As they progress through the story, they can take advantage of the increasing number of actions, use the coins they've collected to buy dress-up items in the souvenir shop, and more... There's so much to do in Ravi world! Let's go on a great adventure with Ravi 'n' Navi!

title: Sealife Safari
description: Single Player, HD (High Definition). Photograph the sparkling personalities of 60 fascinating fish and explore 5 unique deep sea destinations. Take your picture-taking skills to the next level by creating memorable photo albums! The fun never stops as you uncover secret routes, discover hidden items and encounter special fish appearances. Unlock the full game now for an adventure the whole family can enjoy!

title: Catana
description: Guide Catana as he masters the attacks that will save not only the monastery but also the world beyond it. With point-and-click simplicity, you'll create matches that eliminate groups of enemies, unleash powerful special attacks and take down crafty bosses.

title: Insect Seeker
description: Finding game for insects and animals hidden in photographs

title: Little Stars

title: Medieval Arms
description: Medieval Arms is a third person, action slasher game. Engage in hack and slash action vs NPCs, as well as holding control points to win.

title: Rage Chicken 2
description: Happiness is fleeting, the struggle is endless. You click and drag your mouse to direct your jump, and that's all you need to reach the end. The objective is simple - get to the top and escape.

title: The Railway
description: The vibe of a typical Russian train is conveyed through illustrations, sounds, and characters. So, hold your seat on the train!

title: The Game of Squids: Ultimate Parody Game
description: A crazy and colorful runner in a cartoon style, where the player has to go through many rooms with various trials and try to survive. The game contains a huge number of references, parodies and memes to make fun!

title: Clarity of the Soul
description: Clarity of the soul is a psychological horror where the player has to cope with his nightmares after the end of his prison term.

title: I am Your King
description: Be a King and rally your countrymen to fight on the field of battle. Build an army and survive as long as you can while defeating the invading enemies, kill points are multiplied by the size of your army at the time of the kill.

title: Robo Vacuum Simulator
description: Play as a cleaning robot, as you vacuum a variety of unique environments. Whilst listening to a relaxing soundtrack, in this fun and casual simulator.

title: Coolbit
description: Coolbit is a endless synthwave color match game. Beat your record by surviving through lasers while listening to cool retro music.

title: Epic Maze
description: 'Epic Maze' is a third-person shooter game in which you must find your way to the gramophone in a procedurally generated 3d maze by following its music, turn it off, and then return. Trick is to remember your path, do not get lost in witches’ mansion.

title: Wonky Wizard
description: In this relaxed indie adventure game, you play a wizard that can shoot 'mouse-pointer' spells at little mushroom enemies, and whatever else lurks in the forrests... Explore the map, and enjoy the 3D, level based gameplay!

title: Faster Than Possible
description: Try to get the lowest time by abusing triple jump, wall climb, and wall hugging mechanics! The fastest time wins!

title: Barro 22
description: Barro 22 is a racing game with a toy car / go kart style, the next gen for Barro Racing now with the tracks from the first game of the series.

title: Jump! Fork!
description: Foodies boldly rush forward!

title: Electronic Universe
description: Prepare yourself to shoot obstacles across a electronic musical game.

title: Bricky to Me

title: RagingFist
description: Battle game of two characters, use one key to perform its nirvana! Players who have never played any fighting games do not need to worry.

title: Puzzlezon
description: Grid-based logic game where your goal is to get to the end of each level. Manage all the obstacles on your way to make a path. Push cardboxes, rotate racks and fill holes with boxes.

Humanity degraded too far into greed and is hurting the planet, your sister, Gaia. Incarnate the God of decay and save the world by eradicating humanity.

title: Dead Way
description: A multiplayer zombie horde style game to play with your friends!

title: Killer in the Cabin

title: Memory Lost-Pairs

It holds a balance of bright and cheerful to emotional and depressing, and follows the protagonists as they come to terms with their traumas.

title: Airplane Racer 2021

Play with your gamepad or your keyboard. Race with your opponents with weapons and shields. Follow up yourself on the leaderboard.

title: The Last Cell
description: It is not going to be easy to complete the steps of the game and it will take you some time. Be ready for more difficult challenges in the next chapters. The story of the game will not be told to you in the beginning. Be careful not to mark the end of the world with your choices

title: Shillelagh

Huaxia civilization was on the verge of destruction. There are two roles in Ancient Huntsmen for players to rescue the ancient civilization.

Use the twin-stick slash action to slash down everything and defeat the strongest enemies that stand in your way.

description: Are you a horror movies fanatic? Test your deduction skills and your horror movies knowledge trying to guess the name of the film represented by the emojis. Don't be shy to ask for help, you probably won't discover all the answers by yourself!

description: Join to epic boxing battle. Fight unusual opponents. Visit many fantasy arenas. Wreak havoc to obtain Legendary Boxing Belt.

Join Ellie, a protagonist who has lost her memory, and her companion Will as they freely explore the abandoned city. With no restrictions, players are free to explore and uncover the mysteries of this vast world.

description: Passin'Time is a VR game with a variety of mini-games inspired by Squid Game, Alice in borderland and Hunger Games.

title: 4 Alice Magical Autistic Girls
description: A semi-linear visual novel featuring an autistic teenage girl. Written by a Quebecer autistic woman and voiced entirely in French by the very talented Chloé Guerin! "My name is Alice Lorange. Yes, like an orange." As the title suggests, this story contains magical girls.

title: Xangel
description: As the largest economy of mankind, Naya launched the angel coming plan to transform human genes. The project failed. Naya was occupied by the crazy gene scientist Longli. As a former executive of Naya, grace began to fight against evil. This work is a third person shooting game.

title: Nakornsampan
description: A match-3 city building strategy game with building interaction, resource management, and more!

description: Find the castle as a medieval courier while avoiding the deadly mines.

description: An arcade space shooter with a simple retro design. The player earns score for destroying asteroids and enemy space ships. The game has a single player mode and a two players co-op mode on a single computer.

description: Madrid Noir is a 45 minute mystery adventure that unfolds across two acts in this VR film. With her uncle declared dead, a disenchanted young woman must delve into her memories to pick up his shadowy trail. Solving the puzzles of the past ain't gonna be easy!

title: Garda
description: Garda is a 2d pixel art tower defense and exploration game. Protect your totem that is keeping your world out of the darkness. Wander across an immense desert. Learn about the weird laws of this world by using technology and energy systems to power defense turret against the numerous enemies…

title: Uninvited Guest
description: Uninvited Guest is a first-person psychological horror game set in 1930. You play as a villager who was destined to end up in an old mansion.

title: Hardcore: The Game
description: A 2D platform game with HARDCORE obstacles!!!

title: Coin Rush
description: Roll your coin along the Coin Rush twisty road track and get a perfect hit right into the hole!

title: Sumy Shelltris: Iceblocks 2
description: Tetris? Not! Mutant Tetris!

description: Is a game in the genre of "hidden object", in which you need to find all the candies (candy wrappers) on a large location drawn in the style of "doodling". The game location displays an elven industrial town located in a forest where elves make their sweets

title: Starry Moon Island 2
description: This is an old school game collection with ten different types of mini-games. The story tells of a series of wars that took place on the island.

title: Skautfold: Knight's End
description: Skautfold: Knight's End is the final chapter in the Skautfold series. Explore the Waltham Industries factory and uncover its dark secrets; with a unique timeline-based RPG battle system, you'll come face-to-face with Eldritch horrors as humanity reaches its final days on Earth...

title: Dark Effigy
description: The effigy holding back the monsters have been destroyed and its pieces scattered. You need to find these pieces and restore the effigy to banish the monsters from these lands.

title: Return Alive

title: FlightChess
description: FlightChess is a game base on tradition game mode ludo to made,the name is it be called at China.Our game include classic mode and prop mode.You can play it with friends at host.And we will upload the online room soon.We hope you can play our game at weekend with your friends, enjoy the game.

title: Welcome Home 2
description: David is trapped in his grandmother's basement, help him escape! Warning for flashing images and disturbing imagery

description: Star Fisher is a top down action fishing game with procedurally generated levels and a simple story to keep you hooked. Dodge monsters and rocks, swing your net, and catch fish to keep your run going and feed your cat!

description: "Purify" is a 2D action RPG game in which a cleaning robot aims to reach the deepest part of a closed underground laboratory. Become the cleaning robot "Zero" and engage in tense battles with robots that have gone out of control.

title: Control Headlights!
description: In Control Headlights! You guide a boat through lighthouses, dodging obstacles on the way, reach the flag to pass the level and collect stars to unlock new levels.

title: Blue Barbarian Man
description: Indie platform game in which you control the blue barbarian man who has the sword to hint his opponents. You can also jump on your enemies' heads to defeat them. You need to collect items and defeat the bosses at the end of each level to win the game.

title: Bobok
description: Grotesque notes written not by Fyodor Dostoevsky, but by "certain person".

title: Alone in the Mars
description: Alone In The Mars is a 2D side-scrolling shooter. Your main character is a cannon operator at a guarded facility. Your goal is to defend the mines from malicious insect-like geeks for a year. Order upgrades from the main base and protect civilization from an alien threat in all possible ways!

title: Inside the Forest
description: You and a group of friends decide to go on a camping trip in the Darkwood Forest, It starts off smoothly, but unforeseen events occur. and it’s only a matter of time before the true horror reveals itself.

title: Bubble Hunt
description: Bubble Hunt - a game in which you need to pop bubbles with the help of a gorpoon on a chain.

title: Frog Ball Rerolled
description: Collect pineapples as you roll your way to victory in Frog Ball Rerolled! Frog Ball Rerolled is a deluxe version of Frog Ball, a marble-rolling game with charming characters and precise controls. With over 35 full levels and over 1,400+ customization options, you'll never get bored!

title: Kingdom of Maverta
description: Minimalist, relaxing, motion logic, interactive mind game.

description: A first-of-its-kind SUDOKU adventure game featuring the gang from EverythingHerbs, two separate story lines, and at least one super villain.

title: Opus Castle
description: Opus Castle it's a 3D horror, adventure and mysterious game with a narrative based on the real tragic history of the little castle on Apa Street, located in the city of São Paulo, Brazil.

title: Gear of Glass: Eolarn's war
description: A visual novel with elements of romance for both sexes, telling about children who escaped to the street from an orphanage. Will they be able to survive if they are needed by a secret organization as cannon fodder?

title: Curatours
description: Museum of Plastic 2121 is the first museum tour available on Curatours! Built 100 years from now in an imagined future where things have worked out well for the planet and for humanity. Visitors uncover the story of plastic - its history, science, industry, and impact on our environment.

title: Zombie Quest
description: Top down survival RPG. Customise your character, follow the trail of quests, craft ammunition and chose to collect or recycle your objects to survive!

title: A Winter Story
description: A breath-taking RPG. In a winter, a studious villager, Holder, leave his hometown and go aboard to find his missed lover.

title: Airship Killer
description: airplane killer - We only dream of peace - the enemies are preparing a treacherous attack on your homeland, which you simply cannot forgive them. Without thinking of anything better how to accept an unequal battle, you get on your plane and go to the enemy's lair to destroy it once and for all!

title: The Quiet Apocalypse
description: The Quiet Apocalypse is a first-person story adventure set in a beautiful open world. Join your father on a dangerous trek through 400 km² of pristine wilderness, as you race to save the life of a very special child.

title: Resonance Wars
description: This game is a turn-based strategy game. You will be playing the role of Lord Lyle, the planner. You will have to plan a battle against the empire to save the Estelle Kingdom. Don't worry, your assistant is queen Aviana and her warriors. You can order them freely.

title: Nott Longa
description: A folk horror graphic adventure about nostalgia, lost futures & decay, designed as an interactive nighttime story to enhance your dreams. Collect hidden objects, help strange inhabitants, solve arcane riddles: find your way home through a ruinous reality haunted by glitches and folkloric creatures.

title: Three Color Ball
description: A platform jumping gameCore features: high difficulty, boss, chase, role switching

title: True Detective Solitaire 2
description: In the new Detective Solitaire, you're going to have to solve 120 puzzles, 120 unique card deals! 12 new locations await you! Find the stolen gold, collect chains of cards, and find special golden cards to complete levels.

description: Your mission is to help the inhabitants of Rayland to transport the energy of the Domus through the various lands contained in the path. For this, you must correctly position the Reflectus and rotate them so that the energy rays reach the necessary Domus.

title: Give Me More Pills
description: Create a medication schedule for John. Press "Play" and let's hope he doesn't die before reaching the yellow area.

title: New York Rat Simulator
description: In a world bound by the very laws of traffic, one Rat has been chosen.... Roam the streets of New York, imbued with unnatural jumping abilities, you can now disrupt the very fabric of society and collect pizza slices in the name of the glorious Rat King to summon the dark eldritch being of New York.

title: Xenture
description: Xenture is a short looter shooter game. Players need to destroy six hives located on the map then return to the spaceship to complete the game. We support multiple achievements for you to challenge.

description: Industry Mania is a casual and time management video game. This game utilizes a point-and-click arcade gameplay model that enables the player to recruit workers, give workers salaries, manage energy resources, operate factories, collect products, sell products, and make even more cash.

description: Four gems came into existence when the world was created, mankind fused these to create the aeternum gem, too powerful to be used by the humans, they decided to shatter the gem back into four pieces and hide it. Thousand years have now past and mankind now wants the power of the gems back...

description: Solve over 100 logic based nonograms to earn crystals and rebuild 3 tranquil sanctuaries. Unlock gorgeous wallpapers along the way. Level progress is saved at all times.

description: Sixtar Gate: Startrail is a rhythm game for keyboard set against a space exploration backdrop. Captain your science vessel alongside your navigator Shii as you explore the vast Sixtar system!

title: Labyrinth Inf

description: One of the scariest horror games ever. You find yourself inside your dream, which turns into one continuous nightmare.

title: Kemonopoly
description: Raise money and monopolize the land! A simple and cute animal board game!

description: You wake up in an eerily mysterious town filled with mannequins. They seem to live their own lives and do not want your presence. The only thing you know is a certain laboratory called Brewding. It is up to you to find out what stands behind this organization and what they are up to.

description: This is a tank shooting game. You will control a spider car to find an exit in the maze. Of course, you need to find the key to open the exit. Some strange robots in the maze are not friendly to you. You can find some props in the boxes in the maze. They will help you deal with your enemies.

description: In the second part of the Match3 mystery thriller, Morgan and Jack return on another exciting mystery in London in the 19 century. Test your skills with challenging match-3 puzzles, win 20 upgrades and investigate the mystery across the five chapters!

description: Deep inside a forest, a voice calls out to the hero. It is there that he crosses paths with Omaylas, the Dark Magic Queen. Imprisoned in the forest, she offers to swear an oath to the hero in exchange for her freedom, but is there a secret agenda to her actions?

description: V.R.G. is a FPS cross between a retro-style and a modern-style , Defeat enemies and get combos to improve operability, and eat scatter pieces of meat to recover.

title: Ragnarok Remastered: A Mythic Hating Sim
description: Things get a little spicy during the Nordic Apocalypse...

title: The Ashes of the Fallen Fires
description: "From the ashes of the fallen fires, you crawl out of the dark shell that was your prison. Go now into the world that is all but forgotten. Embark on an epic and unexpected adventure." It's sounds well right? But, all that we said before, is a lie. This is a short game that teaches you important lessons about expectations, debugging, taking care of your system and repairing that which breaks.

description: Shoot magnetic monopoles. Fix the portal.

In BROKEN MIND, you play Agent Frank Morgan, a detective with a dark past. You will have to investigate the disappearance of a teenage girl who was abducted during a live Internet broadcast. The investigation is accelerated when Laura's phone emits a signal a few miles away in the middle of the forest!

BROKEN MIND is an action Survival Horror. Investigate, solve the puzzles and find out what happened to Laura Campbell. If she is still alive you must act quickly!

title: A Chainsaw Across My Heart
description: Feel my feels

description: Lone is an experimental game about love. F to Fullscreen, R to restart.

description: Chronokicker 202K is a two-player versus/brawler game that will melt your face through the fabric of time.

title: Promenade
description: Go on an adventure in a world packed with secrets helped by your friend, a poulp with many abilities. Explore, solve puzzles, wander across dungeons, blast through races and much more in this game inspired by the best 3D platformers

description:
September, 1935 EC. After a narrow victory, Squad E is given a special assignment: Cut off one of the Empire's critical supply lines.

But when Claude's squadron storms the enemy's base, they unexpectedly find themselves standing on a pristine sandy beach...

This story can be played after completing Chapter 10 of the main story.

title: Valkyria Chronicles 4: A United Front with Squad 7
description:
This story features an encounter with Squad 7, the heroes of the original Valkyria Chronicles. After playing through this extra story, you will get the characters Welkin (in the tank Edelweiss), Alicia, Isara, Largo, and Rosie for use in the main game.

This story can be played after unlocking the Headquarters in Chapter 2 of the main story.

description: A gardening roguelike made in PICO-8 for PROCJAM 2020. The player takes the role of a gardener trapped within Father Time's watchtower, who must both tend the plants on each floor and escape the tower before illness claims their life.

description:
Take the helm of your own technology company in Hardware Tycoon.

Start your journey in 1986 and lead your enterprise through four decades of innovation to 2026. This game is about shaping the future of computing. Design the brains of tomorrow's devices, outsmart ruthless competitors, and build a legacy that lasts.

Dive deep into the heart of silicon. Decide on core counts, clock speeds, cache sizes, and thermals. Balance raw performance against power efficiency and cost to create the perfect processor for every market segment. Every design choice impacts benchmarks, reviews, and your bottom line.

title: Micro Murder: But It's Robots So It's OK
description: Micro Murder is a game of ballistic extermination for 1 or 2 tactical modules, organic or otherwise. Assert your domination over four pictoresque and extremely resource-rich celestial bodies using a flexible arsenal designed to fit any situation.

description: calamity occult-horror rpg

description: De-make of "No Man's Sky"... in PICO-8

description: Optain cute creatures! Evolve! Battle!
