description: The exact midpoint between Super Crate Box and Disc Room, a zippy little score attack challenge built for the Disc Room game jam.

title: Diamond Rose
description:
Diamond Rose is a short fantasy RPG developed for the NaNoRenO game jam.

The story follows Van, a promising young craftsman. Fueled only by his passion for crafting, he left his hometown and set out to make it big in the bustling city of Azalea.

He soon realized that passion alone was not enough to survive in the big city. Without fame to his name, no decent customer looked at his wares. Without a decent workshop, he was treated as a common merchant. A month passed and he became just another in the long line of failures.

This all changed when he met a swordswoman who gave him the chance to turn his life around.

title: King for a Knight
description: A chess knight puzzle adventure with over 100 levels to stomp your way through!

title: NieR:Cogito
description: This game is a non-commercial work, produced for the Nier:Re[in]carnation Content Creator Competition hosted by Square Enix on August 2021. It's an unofficial derivative game made in just 3 weeks about monsters and machines who think they are humans.

title: Our Home
description: Welcome to Our Home Unveil the forbidden secrets and let yourself be seduced by a fiery game of riddles and pleasures.

title: Sunrise on the Moon
description: On the moon, consecutive sunrises and sunsets occur approximately 29 1/2 days apart. For as long as Maria has lived in the Lunar Colonies, she's never failed in her tradition to watch the sunrises from the station's viewing platform. As she's waiting for her tram to arrive, however, she encounters a curious young woman that piques her interest. For once, Maria feels compelled to engage in a friendly conversation.

title: Remember the Flowers
description:
Remember the Flowers follows the tale of an amnesiac man.

With memories fleeting, he wakes up in what seems to be a new world.

The only thing he's certain of is his desire to return home.

The only question is: what has become of it?

title: Humanity Is Dead
description: A third-person action shooter where you are facing a war between humans and robots.

title: City Racing 2
description: City Racing 2 is a fun real racing game with top 3D graphics and high quality, giving you the ultimate visual enjoyment. It gathers more than 50 top classic cars and also designs a brand new challenge for you! You can customize to create a car that reflects your personal style, plunge into a thrilling speed race, use your superb driving skills to conquer rivals, win epic races, and create your own ace car club to become a legend of the track.

But things soon take a dramatic turn from simple errands—eventually, Mylne finds herself caught up in an unsolved mystery, requiring her to take on what lies in the Underground Ruins, deep beneath the forest...

description: A Platformer game where you control a human-like work to reach the top of Mt. Martin! But don't fall, or you'll have to start again.

title: Scrap Race

Frantically build a wheel from scrap to roll down a hill: The contraption to roll the farthest wins! Start constructing your wheel by placing a scrap part anywhere on your blueprint! After that, just make sure any new parts you want to add are touching your contraption. To qualify for the race, make sure your construction covers all of the points on your blueprint.

title: Rekea: GOTY Edition
description: Cut, move and glue your way to the furniture of your dreams. Based on our iconic designs and your endless imagination.

title: Wurmus
description: Endless snake-like game of tag

title: ClusterCluck
description: ClusterCluck is a chaotic murder mystery game where not everyone is what they seem. Collect clues, complete tasks, deceive others and talk your way to safety. Whether hunting as a fox or surviving as a chicken, every player has unique skills that can change the game. Trust no one… and cluck wisely.

title: Beasts of Burden
description: A psychological horror game and ARG inspired by the late 90s era of handheld gaming

title: Ribby: The Game
description: It's Ribby: The Game! An RPG/Visual Novel hybrid about finding yourself, acceptance, and frogs! Use empathy to resolve issues of the potential friends you'll meet along your journey, or take a more cruel approach and murder them with words.

title: Pillar of Rust
description: Enter the Pillar of Rust, a third-person “walking simulator” pain, sorrow, anger, and peace manifested in concrete, rust, and bittersweet memories.

title: Silent Santicado
description: Explore a silent, crumbling world in Silent Santicado! A retro journey through a fallen kingdom tainted by lost magic. Explore overgrown ruins, encounter a cast of peculiar characters, and defeat a menagerie of twisted enemies as you search for the source of Santicado's curse.

description:
You Are What You Eat is a fast-paced, frantic top-down action game in which you must fight through densely-packed levels, killing enemies and taking over their bodies.

Every time you defeat an enemy, you become them -- weaknesses and all. You must learn to constantly adapt to new play styles and craft strategies to survive as the game gets more and more difficult.

title: SandShifter
description: Find your way through a mysterious desert temple.

title: Aether Crypt
description: Short metroidvania with molecules-based mechanics.

title: Computer Crisis
description: Computer Crisis is a game where you must complete various mini-games and gain points, aiming to complete them as many times as possible before your computer runs out of charge.

title: 30s Quest Tile

description: You didn't ask to lead this expedition but here you are: stuck in the ice, Captain missing, miles from civilization and everyone looking for you to lead. Manage your meager resources, balance safety and morale, make the hard calls and head in the only direction you can - into The Pale Beyond.

description: With Your Mom's Tits is an Adventure RPG set in a vast fantasy world filled with various countries, towns, humans, animals, and monsters. Fight your way through a treacherous continent to rediscover the meaning of life — with the help of a cute magical dog!

description: Explore the vast abandoned V.I.R.U.S. Compound corrupted by machines. Restore order to the facility with a full arsenal of customizable weapons and armory acquired around the debris of this forgotten world. Can you uncover the mystery behind the Soul Cipher?

description:
"The Internet will be the world."

I heard someone say that. Will such a "world" be full of happiness?

...I'm tired of thinking about such things. I'm asking you. Please, know the truth about this "world" instead of me. Please, please, please... Please forgive me. I have not done anything wrong... I'm sorry.

title: Bootleg Krew
description: Pirate bootleg roms as part of a 90s cracking group organised on IRC!

title: Pokémon PC Master
description:
Pokémon PC Master is a game for the PC, released only in Japan.

The game's focus is to help children to use the computer, learning how to type, draw on the computer, browse the web, and altogether use the mouse.

title: Pokémon Project Studio: Red Version
description: This program lets the user create all kinds of Pokémon-related projects such as calendars or greeting cards.

title: Pokémon Project Studio: Blue Version
description: From the main menu users can choose the type of media they wish to create including greeting cards, signs, birthday kits, banners, photos, stationery, envelopes, calendars, paper crafts, certificates and stickers. The user can use several included images and templates or they can import custom images into the picture. Each CD contains 81 different Pokémon. The kind of Pokémon they get depends on whether they are running the Red CD or the Blue CD. For example only the Red CD has Mewtwo, while Raichu only appears in the Blue CD.

title: Hoshi no Oujo: Uchuu Ishiki ni Mezameta Yoshitsune
description:
Her brother Shanaou was killed by a member of the Heike clan.
For vengeance and to restore the Minamoto clan, the protagonist Sakurako vows to destroy all the Heike.
Introducing herself as Shanaou in place of her late brother, along with her childhood friend Kisanta she goes off to Kurama Temple for training.

One day a merchant named Kichiji appeared in front of them.
He had been told to come and pick them up by order of Fujiwara no Hidehara.
In order to defeat the Heike, they couldn't afford to stay at this tranquil temple any longer...
So Sakurako decided that they should go to Oushuu Hiraizumi where Fujiwara no Hidehara was waiting.

Hiraizumi where Hidehara ruled was a peaceful land that had no relation to war.
There the protagonist trained her sword arm in the dojo of the famed teacher Satou Tsugunobu.

However, Kichiji brought news that would smash that peace.
Sakurako's big brother Minamoto no Yoritomo, was raising an army to defeat the Heike.
She wanted to run to her brother's side immediately, but as she was now she was powerless.

Once again she went to the capital. To find a man whose name reached even Hiraizumi, the "Demon of Gojou", and become his retainer.

She advances deeply and quietly into an entangled destiny like many heroes before her.

title: VectorField
description: VectorField is a game that goes back to basics. In the days of slot machines in the 80s. Take control of a super car and become the best racer in the world.

title: Mystery of the Opera: The Phantom's Secret
description: Find hidden objects, explore beautiful worlds, play dozens of mini-games, enjoy challenging quests, and solve the Phantom's Mystery!

title: Train Your Brain
description: Train Your Brain is a mental training game for improving the interaction between both sides of the brain. For best results use both hands to control the game, play daily and try to hit your last day's score each time.

title: Mahjong Village
description: Attend new challenge for fans of mahjong solitaire games: free endless game with levels and bonuses from an expert in casual games - 1C Wireless! If you think that you are a mahjong expert, this game is just for you!

title: Grim Leaper
description: A vertical platformer inspired by Jump King based on Calliope Mori of Hololive.

title: Azarashi
description:
An adorably cute game that will challenge your reflexes and keep you coming back. Use your lightning-fast fingers to stop one of three seal keychains from dropping. Your score depends on your reflex - if you catch the seal quickly, you will get more points. Make sure you're not too fast with your finger, or the seal might get hurt!

Azarashi is a classic arcade style game from Studio Pixel, the creator of Kero Blaster and Cave Story. Simple and addicting, it's a great way to kill time.

title: Welcome to the Mansion Remastered
description: A RPG game where you have to escape a mansion which is infested by a ghost killer created by one of the major characters. You'll need to find out who is the creator and eventually get out of the house.

title: Typeds
description: The space war started here and now! The victory depends only on you and all your years as a gamer. Show what you are capable of and destroy everything by writing quickly and correctly! "The keyboard is your weapon!"

title: I need to pee
description: A short horror game made in 24 hours for Halloween 2021.

title: Trip Troupe
description: A social RPG played directly on stream.

title: Gimme Money! Neverquaker
description: You seek the treasure of the Neverquaker, don't you?! Well, TOO BAD!. The architect of his tower was drunk, you can barely maneuver in the air while you run and your lighting spell sucks too! At least your robe can sustain enough damage, but... can you climb the tower and get away with... The Gold of the Neverquaker?!

title: Kraino ReAnimated
description: Nine levels of Hi-Bit action platforming with juicy melee combat, magical abilities, epic boss battles, and secrets hidden throughout.

title: First Bite
description: An LGBTQ+ Vampiric Visual Novel. One Night. Three vampires. Make a deal with death or die trying.

title: Soletrando
description: The Soletrando segment, from Caldeirão do Huck, has now become a game! Soletrando is a super spelling competition for you and your entire family.

title: Forsake
description: Forsake is a 1 to 4 player co-op online survival horror game where each player is a member of an urban explorer group. Choose your equipment to explore places full of paranormal and exorcise them, if you think you can handle it!

title: Necrocage Year: Ep1
description: The necrocage is a floating structure parked on a rotten planet, a jail for organic and mechanical waste in equal parts. The beings that inhabit in the universe call humans "Day", "Week" or "Month", depending on their age. Time is relative, but they know of its old existence. Their only mistake was to throw the waste to xb23, the only human being valued as "Year".

title: Be dog do borks
description: wow, am dog, goodest boy, owner away, do bork.

title: Andromeda Six: Tea Time with Oppo
description: An Andromeda Six DLC

title: Wizard's Way Out
description: A small puzzle game about getting out of big trouble! Trapped in a prison, a Wizard uses telekinesis to push and pull their way out and escape together with newfound friends!

title: Osteotic Bypass
description: the holy art of getting your entire skeleton to the other side

title: Rewriter
description: Rewriter is a grid-based roguelite.

title: Chess of the SOL
description: The most unusual and fast chess for two in the style of the Middle Ages!

title: United We Chess
description: Divide and conquer in this twist on Chess

title: The Sims 4: Blooming Rooms Kit
description: Bring the outdoors inside with lush greenery that breathes new life into any space in The Sims 4: Blooming Rooms Kit. Fill your Sim's home with cheerful, peaceful plants. From dangling vines to decorative propagation stations, a perfect tranquility awaits.

title: Elex II: Collector's Edition
description:
This edition includes the following:
- Game: ELEX II
- 9.2" Alb figurine
- Original Soundtrack
- Official artbook, 2
- "Cleric Amulett" key chain
- SteelBook
- A concept album by Bjorn Pankratz, “Cassandra”

title: Paper Pilgrim: The Crystal Case
description:
You and your brother have another Detective Case to solve. More and more citizens of the “Crystal City” are disappearing without a trace.

Experience a strange Adventure and bring the truth to light. Is the pickpocket party involved? Or is it the king with his robotic police force? And what’s up with the cursed swamp?

Get to the bottom of the case by solving tricky riddles, gaining information from peculiar inhabitants and collecting various items throughout your journey that can open up new doors and ways for you to succeed in your quest!

title: Extreme Offrоad Cars 2
description: Extreme Offroad Cars 2 is the next instalment of this fun driving game. If you enjoyed the original title, you are sure to love this second improved edition. This game brings everything that was great about the original, and adds some cool new off-road tracks to test your driving skills out on!

title: Jewels of the Wild West
description: Swap and match gems on thousands of puzzling levels to collect resources and bring a destroyed Western town back to life!

title: Jewels of Rome
description: Swap and match gems on thousands of puzzling levels to collect resources and bring the ancient Roman village to life!

title: Mystery Tales: The House of Others
description: Your brother is the host of Ghost Riders – a popular ghost hunting TV show, but one night you receive a strange package that forewarns his death! You’ll need your special astral glasses to help you view the past and interact with the astral plane, but first you’ll have to find them! Travel to the haunted mansion of a serial killer and unwrap this unsolved ghost story, before you and your brother become the next chapter of it in this haunting hidden-object puzzle adventure game!

title: Christmas Fever!
description: Classic 2D platformer with powerups. Holidays are approaching, so get in the Christmas mood by playing Christmas Fever! Help santa collect coins to buy gifts for Christmas!

title: Can You Escape: Island
description: If you think that this island is deserted, then you are mistaken. You were thrown on the island shore after surviving a terrible shipwreck. Now you need to find a way to get out from this island. In this Escape game you'll have to wade through the wild jungle inhabited by predators, ancient temples full of deadly traps, abandoned pirate fort and many more. Solve puzzles, find secret items and then you'll have a chance to get out from this island alive. Each level is a unique location - so don't think it'll be an easy journey for you.

title: Global City
description: Become the mayor and build the city of your dreams! In this game, anything is possible. Whatever you can imagine in a city-building and development simulator, you can do. Start from the very beginning and unlock new possibilities for developing your city in Global City!

title: Badminton Clash: Master League - World Championship Arena
description: Becoming a champion is now easy! Take a racket in your hands and prove to the whole world that nothing and no one can compare with your talent.

title: Hana no Ibara: Yuurei Kitan
description:
In the Taisho period -- In the Imperial Capital Tokyo.

The protagonist finds a job in the Hanasaki Zaibatsu's estate.
Taking a role of an exclusive maid of the family's son Kirito, she happens to know Kirito's surprising secret...

After a while she hears a weird rumor from another maid.
"A ghost of a past madam haunts this mansion."

Mysteries in the Hanasaki family will be revealed in this "Taisho Romantic" horror otome game.

title: Zero G Golf
description: Space travel is boring; let's play golf!

title: Who's Your Weapon
description: Die to obtain your killer's weapon.

title: Spellchain
description: A first-person action fantasy RPG where you create and combine your own spells through a dynamic spellcrafting system. Fight through a hostile kingdom, disrupt its events, grow your magical power, and ultimately slay the king.

description: A bog standard minigolf game with 4-player pass-and-play multiplayer

description: Everything you have is a tiny oil lamp.

description: a short game about a certain widely-used categorization system that's toooootally fit for purpose

title: The Button
description: A short game about finding your true self

title: Planet Dysphoria
description:
Where? Planet Dysphoria—the manifestation of gender dysphoria.
Who? A person in their twenties experiencing dysphoria.
How? First-person-POV, mystery game with point and click interactions.

title: Conversations We Have In My Head
description: A game about a ghost from your past.

title: Ninja Scroller
description:
Ninja Scroller is a challenging pixel art action runner game with a retro gaming vibe, where you will face ninjas, wolves and tornadoes.
You have to collect the 100 Shadow Scrolls and defeat the Guardians, Ninjas and Wolves, within the time limit.

title: Escape From the Castle of Sad Ghosts
description: Escape from sad ghosts without hurting their feelings!

description: Slash your way through monsters in this black and white adventure.

description: Assassination with the blade in his mouth - The Legendary Assassin KAL

description: make some burgers for the hungry masses

title: Frog Finder
description: A cute lightweight puzzle game. Can you find the frog?

title: Secluded
description: Rooms define you.

title: Dry Path
description: Explore a desert without running out of water

title: Turnip
description: Exploration farming game with a lot of turnips. Explore the turnip realm and find turnips to grow furniture. Music by Laurie Spiegel

title: Eggs for Bart
description: Eggs for Bart is a Simpsons Parody horror game, in chapter 1 you play as Homer and you need to get eggs for Bart. You must get 2 dozens of eggs and leave the house to give to Bart, but you can only carry a half dozen at a time so you'll have to make 4 trips inside the house and out, also the night will get progressively harder as the night goes on.. with cutscenes after each level that connect into a story of loss and a mystery left unsolved. It won't be easy, as you're not the only one who needs eggs, such as Marge. Only eggs can sustain her and she will go after you and try to take you and your eggs. However she's not the only one who needs e g g . . .

title: Nytro
description: 3D platformer inspired by the original Spyro trilogy, featuring a robot cat.

title: Nguoi La Part 1
description:
Người Lạ Part 1 is a cinematic 3D visual novel that follows the story of professional speedrunner Tien.

Tien and her brother Duc have recently moved to Ho Chi Minh City. While Tien is preparing for a major tournament, an obsessive fan begins to creep into her life.

title: Paper Doll
description: Dress-up game with introspection and lesbians

title: Cat Boy's Stellar Journey
description: Join cat boy as he travels through the stars on his way to meet his sister. Along the way, relax at a hot spring and pick flowers in a meadow. Cat Boy's Stellar Journey is a tiny adventure game about traveling and the things we leave behind...

title: Nightwalk
description:
Go on a quiet night adventure to find a very special someone. Where could they have gone?

Switch between human and ghost forms to navigate and explore the environment. Delve into graves to speak with the deceased. Reflect during a silent journey in the night.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Cowabunga
description:
TMNT Cowabunga is a free fan game created by me, i love ninja turtles since i was a 5yo kid and that's my way to celebrate that love.
It's a good old platformer in gameboy style, just 4 colors on screen.
Simple gameplay, you can switch the 4 turtles and use them during the stage, you can collect ninja stars and perform ground attack and aerial attack. (each turtle a different one).

Each turtle's got a lifebar, but be careful, if you loose one of the four it's game over! So you are forced to use all of them as a good team. (obviously ;)

title: Kiara and the Case of the Missing Chocolates
description: A short, 15ish-minute Hololive fan game about Kiara losing the chocolates she made for Valentine's Day!

title: Gum Girl
description: Use your bubble gum to create temporary platforms to solve puzzles and traverse through the cosmic Starbase. Defeat the treacherous drill in order to save your solar system.

title: Robo Blaster
description: BLAST ROBOTS before ROBOTS BLAST you. Let's play a twin stick arcade shooter called ROBO BLASTER!

title: Don't Get a Virus
description: Battle computer viruses in frantic bullet hell showdowns on a Windows 98 styled deskop!

title: Kromer Kollector
description: Game starring Spamton from DELTARUNE Chapter 2

title: ProtoDungeon: Episode I
description: Explore the first episode in the prequel series for The Waking Cloak!

title: Blank Frame
description: Blank Frame is a first person surreal horror game with a look akin to early 2000's pc/ps2 games.. In the small town of Dim River, one resident, Henri, has found himself trapped inside of his own apartment, perhaps not completely by himself. The night is going to be long and peculiar.

title: Remembrance
description:
Remembrance is the story of a woman named Kim who wakes up in a bizarre place with only hazy memories of her past and how she got there. Together with a strange, magic-wielding entity named Jesse, she sets out in search of what she's lost, as well as to complete the mission assigned to her that, in Jesse's words, is of the utmost importance.

As she recovers and reflects on the memories of her life, however, Kim quickly realizes that some of the more powerful feelings and impressions in her mind, despite their nostalgic familiarity, don't match up with any of her memories...

title: Take Me Home
description: A 2D side scroller where player can play as 2 swappable character, a girl and a rabbit. Stay together through various obstacle until they reach their destination.

title: Kissa
description: take your cat for a walk

title: Touhou Chouseisho: Sapphire Panlogism
description: A Touhou Project fangame by Team Urban Magic where you both dodge and collect rain.

title: Bullet Fractals
description:
Bullet Fractals is a bullet hell where the bullets move when you move.

Invade the evil space communist empire and dodge bullets while broadcasting music to the oppressed citizens.

title: Untitled: The Flower Game
description: A kaleidoscopic bullet-hell arcade game and drawing machine, with generative sound.

title: Hero Tactics
description: A love letter to oldschool tactics rpgs.

title: Touhou: Unmei no Hoshi
description: A Touhou fangame made with the PICO-8 fantasy console.

title: Heart is Muscle
description: A light RPG/VN about flexing your muscles, helping friends and saving the world.

title: Spacewar
description: A hidden Steam game that was made to demonstrate Steamworks API.

title: Motomancer: Auto Battle
description:
The motorcycle combat simulator built for Twitch!

Inspired by games such as Marbles on Stream and King of the Pit, your Twitch audience takes control of their own 'motomancer', riders of magically imbued motorcycles, as they dodge obstacles, take down rivals and talk trash in this gang vs gang skirmish. Let's Ride!

title: Soletrando: Nova Ortografia
description: With major changes happening to the Brazilian Portuguese orthography in 2009, Soletrando gets an updated version with those changes and new words that you and your family need to guess.

title: Kyokujitsu ni Kokoro Arawasu Ni: Haruhi to Nisshin
description: A maiden game set in the Navy during the Russo-Japanese War. The number of captures is three. There is a quiz in the mini-game. Playtime is about 7 hours. Live performances are also welcome!

title: Lemon: Kageetei Nostalgia
description: The game begins when the main character, Ryuichiro, visits Kageitei, and first interacts with the heroines who work as female salaries. When the interaction at the cafe is over, select the night opponent from the heroines in the cafe and select the play from there. The content of the play is hinted at by the lines of the heroines. The types of play increase depending on the degree of interaction with the heroines, and even in the same play, the scenario development differs depending on the number of times.

title: Cooking Diary: Restaurant Game
description:
Become the chef of your own restaurant in a fun time management game! Cooking Diary is the cooking game loved and supported by players around the world! Caution: this game can cause real culinary fever!

Welcome to Tasty Hills—a city where everyone loves to cook! It's your turn to keep a cooking diary. Help your grandpa save his family restaurant chain and restore his good name! Don't give your competitors a single chance to cook up evil plans, while you find true friends, manage restaurants and cafés, and cook top-quality dishes! Join fascinating events in the vibrant life of the city and gain fame as a great chef!

title: Alphadia Genesis 1 & 2
description: Experience epic RPG adventures at once! This bundle includes Alphadia Genesis and Alphadia Genesis 2.

title: Grim Tales: Heritage
description: When the future sends a chilling warning...

title: Red Alert: Hail to the Great Yuri
description: The story background of "Red Alert" is set up on the real modern battlefield. Various mysterious military organizations in the world appear one by one, trying to unify the world through war. As a military commander trained by the country. In order to defeat The evil forces of other countries, you establish your own military base and develop yourself to fight against them, and also establish contacts with other commanders, communicate information, arrange troops, and fight the enemy together.

title: Manor Matters
description: Welcome to mysterious Castlewood Manor! Find hidden objects in search scenes while restoring an old manor and unearthing all of its secrets.

title: Twin Mind: Power of Love - Collector's Edition
description: Famed twin detectives go on a new case! They are the only people skilled enough to find out what happened to a woman that vanished in the broad daylight. But it seems like they need your help to uncover this mystery.

title: Supermarket Mania Journey
description: Play hundreds of levels, open new stores and restaurants, serve customers and upgrade equipment to boost revenue in this Christmas update of your favorite adventure!

title: Heart Box
description: Professor Rat created Robby but gave him a weak battery, which is why our hero has to constantly recharge and participate in crazy experiments.

title: Surface: Lost Tales
description: Surface: Lost Tales is the 9th game of the Surface series in Elephant Games.

title: Rise and Conflict
description: "Rise and Conflict" is a medieval real-time strategy game. Set SLG and RTs in one, and at the same time realize the global PC and mobile players to fight together in all directions. Embedded real-time translation function, to achieve global barrier free communication, during the online period, there are a lot of welfare to send, let you one-step in place, have a good time!

title: Ignis Universia: Eternal Sisters Saga
description: Save the world with the Chosen Sisters in this epic 15 minute adventure!

title: Dragonsweeper
description: A minesweeper game that requires observation by mixing roguelike elements with the classic gameplay.

title: Christmas Wonderland 6
description:
Christmas Wonderland 6 is an indie adventure game crammed full of gorgeous HOG scenes & superb mini puzzles, guaranteeing hours of fabulous fun for players of all ages. Find presents, and get game rewards and achievements as you play along.

Go to Springfield's Amazing Fun Park and win the helicopter ride of a lifetime. Go mall shopping and visit Mike and Emmas' Grandparents. Meet Elves and Rudolph at Santa's North Pole Workshops. Find oodles of Christmas Bonuses & Gold Reindeer, then Fly with Santa on Christmas Eve.

title: Anode Heart
description: A semi-open world monster tamer RPG, set in a futuristic environment where digital and analog reality have become indistinguishable from one another.

title: Altered Fates
description: Obscure JRPG made with RPG Maker VX with many routes.

title: Vikings of Midgard
description: Vikings of Midgard is a retro-style turn-based RPG about a group of heroes (10 in total with their strengths) travelling across an expansive world that changes with the players actions. The setting is inspired by Norse Mythology but contains other eclectic and eccentric influences. The game also has helpful features like being able to turn off random encounters and an in-game library bereft with information.

title: Frameland: A Binary Tale
description: Frameland is a retro inspired RPG brought into the modern age. The story is not about you. You are just in it.

title: Yellow Sails
description: A short and surreal dream exploration game created for the "Dream Diary Jam 4" event and submitted as a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. Go to bed and dream of strange islands across distant oceans...

title: I Hate You, Please Suffer
description: A woman becomes an adventurer and makes friends on a quest to pay rent - and maybe something much more. I Hate You, Please Suffer is an RPG set in a world where becoming an adventurer is a common career choice, where a woman tries to get by and find happiness regardless of how screwed up the world can be. Make money and find success in any way you can: from larger scale quests with loose continuity with each other and the surrounding world, to hunting down assorted weirdos for bounties, to catching fish.

title: Wild Life: Rescue
description:
Welcome to the real nature reserve right on your screen. Wild Life Rescue - a unique game where you can feel in the role of a reserve employee. Wild animals, diverse and picturesque nature, exciting missions are all waiting for you in our simulator.

Come face to face with the wild nature and save the innocent animals from death. Their lives are in your hands!

title: Advanced Education with Viktor Strobovski
description: Free-to-play indie horror survival game inspired by Baldi's Basics in Education and Learning. The player explores Viktor's school while collecting a number of notebooks, answering problems written in them as they are collected. However, the game itself is "buggy", and so Viktor himself along with other teachers will begin pursuing the player after failing to solve impossible equations correctly.

title: Light Fairytale: Episode 1
description: A 3D turn-based Japanese-style RPG inspired by the retro classics.

title: Metrash
description: A top-down-shooter Metroid-like.

title: The Red Mummy
description:
This is a cinematic platformer experience. Become The Red Mummy in a quest to reclaim your stolen hands and feet!
Watch the story unfold through comic book panels as you glide, fight, and snake through hidden caves.

title: Elypse
description: Embark upon a tragic tale and discover the ravaged world of Elypse! Fight your destiny in an arduous 2D adventure, story rich platformer, in a mesmerising and mysterious world.

title: Agent Pyxel
description: Do what secret agents do best - set off for a dangerous mission and silence high importance target.

title: Izel's Observatory
description: An underwater action-adventure game.

title: Roody: 2d
description: A factory were the machine details are designed by you.

description: a game about gardening in space

title: Beartopia
description: Welcome to the world of Beartopia! Drop as many bears as your computer can handle and turn the infinite gray lands into a Bear Playground.

title: 360 Chicken

title: Bird by Example
description: Deep Learning Bird RPG

description: Rose, a retired outlaw, wanders through the spirit realm of the Underwest. Take up the once-forgotten skills of the gunslinger, and journey along the breathtaking, cinematic hand-painted landscapes on a quest to rescue your daughter’s spirit.

title: Garden Witch Life
description: Journey through various distant and isolated skies, making and helping friends along the way. Sharing company with those who have stories to tell and new perspectives to discover.

title: The Ranch of Rivershine
description: Saddle up and build your own horse ranch! Raise foals, care for your horses and train them as you explore the western wilderness! Participate in cross country competitions and become your town's champion. Befriend the villagers who'll help you on your adventure at the Ranch of Rivershine!

title: River Tails: Stronger Together
description: River Tails: Stronger Together is a 3D platform action-adventure game designed around an asymmetrical co-op system. All you need is communication, coordination and complete trust!

title: Sker Ritual
description: The co-op survival FPS and spiritual successor to the award-winning occult horror, Maid of Sker. Play solo or up to 4 players to survive the supernatural onslaught of the Quiet Ones.

title: Togges
description: Togges is a collect-a-thon 3D Platformer about spreading and stacking adorable cubes around the cosmos! Explore unique worlds, solve mysteries and overcome challenges in this adventure to dominate the universe!

title: Swordship
description: What does a Shoot’Em Up look like if you remove the shooting? It looks like Swordship: an intense dodging game where placement is everything. Sharpen your skills because this is the Dodge'em Up you are looking for!

title: MechNest
description: MechNest is a 3D bullet hell shooter developed by a single person. As you progress through the map, which changes with each challenge, collect reinforcement items and defeat powerful enemies with flashy shooting! Combine your skills freely and rampage through the hive of mechs!

title: Far Cry 6: Collapse
description: For the first time in Far Cry history, you are the villain. Get up close and personal as you take control of the legends themselves: Vaas Montenegro, Pagan Min and Joseph Seed – all played by the original cast. Across three DLC episodes, you will delve into these iconic villain’s twisted minds, uncover their backstories, battle their inner demons, and reunite with familiar faces. All of this in a new Far Cry gameplay experience in which you will have to die… and retry. Can you escape the mind of a villain?

description: Temperia: Soul of Majestic is a competitive card-based board game. Quick, strategic and totally open-handed, every match is different from others thanks to the abilities of the creatures, the equipment, the powers and the elemental spaces presented in the board.

title: Andi's Moving Company
description: a game about moving

title: Royal Order
description:
Royal Order is a LGBT+ historical fantasy Visual Novel featuring survival stats-raising elements, magic and court intrigue.

Keep the main characters alive through the story by improving their skills. Host social events to gain different factions’ approval. You can also go on campaigns to bring the ongoing war to an end.

This game is an indirect sequel to the Visual Novel "Royal Alchemist". The story takes place in the same world, but follows a different cast. Both games can be played separately from each other.

title: Baldr Sky "Zero" Extreme
description:
Sold during Winter Comiket 85 (C85), in 2013.

Includes extra scenarios with heroines Sakura, Kei and Francisca.

title: Moving In
description: Moving In is about relaxing in a cozy environment. You decorate the house you are moving in. There is no goal, no timer, no challenges it is all about having a relaxing experience.

title: Maniac Inc.
description: Classic defend the castle game with lots of fun store items and weapons!

title: Haunted Hotel: Death Sentence - Collector's Edition
description: Hidden object puzzle game where you help your partner solve a group of murders, possibly even his own.

title: Dragon Ball: The Breakers
description: Dragon Ball: The Breakers is a 1-on-7 online asymmetrical action game in which a band of seven everyday humans tries to survive the Raider (a classic Dragon Ball rival such as Cell and Frieza) who will hunt and evolve into an unstoppable force.

title: An Outcry
description: A branching-path narrative horror RPG set in Vienna, Austria. Guide the Unnamed through the worst night of their life: Harass your neighbours. Debate with birds. Smoke to survive.

title: Kung Fury: Street Rage - A Day at the Beach
description:
Celebrate the Kung Fury 5-year anniversary with this DLC!
Hasselhoff joins the fight as a new playable hero and you can now team up in the brand new multiplayer game mode!
And pummel your way through a new blazing stage!

Beat nazis all day long, everywhere. become the action! uphold the law!!!

title: Heroes of Xanfurth
description: Travel across Xanfurth in a coming of age JRPG.

title: Fire Lancer
description:
This is a vertical scrolling shooting game, with many unique selectable characters, and a data progression system.
There are a total of 8 stages, but only 4 stages will be played in one game. There is a course determination feature which players are able to influence.

This game can be played on Wonder Swan flash cart or PC.

title: A=B
description: A=B is a programming puzzle game with only one instruction: A=B, which means replacing A with B.

title: Shattle
description: Shattle is an action-packed PVP, points-based survival game where you shoot, loot and craft your way to shelter as you dodge bombs on the way.

title: Song of Nunu: A League of Legends Story
description:
In this single-player adventure, venture into the idyllic but treacherous world of the Freljord as Nunu, a young boy on a quest to find his lost mother. Unearth the secrets, myths, and legends buried deep in the frozen tundra alongside your best friend, a wise and playful yeti named Willump, and unfold an inspiring story one puzzle at a time.

Developed by Tequila Works, the studio behind RiME, Song of Nunu: A League of Legends StoryTM invites players old and new to experience the League of Legends universe from a fresh lens.

title: Beneath Oresa
description: Beneath Oresa, a fighting roguelike deckbuilder, takes you deep within the city to confront your foes. As a strategist, choose your cards, upgrades, and artifacts wisely, but as a fighter, turn their positioning to your advantage.

title: Isekai Cowboy
description: Dive into the magical land of Isekai Cowboy, a JRPG - inspired by classics such as Dragon Quest and Final Fantasy - where you take over the role of a cowboy, finding himself in a fantastical world. Solve many mysteries, find out why you were brought here and how to escape.

title: Dono's Tale
description: Relive the glory days of the 16 and 32-bit era in Dono's Tale. A super cute and colorful platformer about a hungry little dragon! Jump, dash, climb, and shoot your way through detailed and colorful worlds in order to get back your precious fruit!

title: Sven's SudokuPad
description: Sven's SudokuPad finally lets you play your own Sudoku puzzles in the same app as used by Cracking the Cryptic in their videos. Created by Sven, the same developer who has created and improved the Cracking the Cryptic Sudoku webapp over the past year.

title: Halo Infinite: Season 1 - Heroes of Reach
description: The first season of Halo Infinite's multiplayer ran from November 15, 2021 until May 3, 2022. Many of the customization options available in this season are exclusive for the Mark V(B) armor core, based on Halo: Reach's armor permutations, including armor kits based on NOBLE Team's permutations. The Season also features customization options for the Mark VII armor core and other options for players, such as Death animations.

title: Fall Guys: Ultimate Knockout - Season 6
description: Party on! Dive into a carnival of crowns, with an all-new festival-fresh Blunderdome headlined by new rounds, obstacles and bean celebrations galore...

title: Pro Soccer Online
description: Pro Soccer Online is a 1st/3rd person, highly skill based, online multiplayer soccer game. It offers a sports game experience unlike any other with smooth, physics based, input driven gameplay that is competitive and rewarding with no pay to win mechanics.

title: C-Dogs SDL
description:
C-Dogs SDL is an open source port of the original C-Dogs that was released in 1997.

It has many improvements such as 4 player local multiplayer, LAN multiplayer, and more campaigns.

title: Arkfront
description: ARKFRONT is an arcade shooter with beautiful pixel-art graphics, RPG upgrades, and a rogue-lite style progression system reminiscent of FTL. Battle your way across the galaxy in search of a new home for mankind.

title: Examination Chambers
description: In this short puzzle adventure, you play as a tester who has to overcome increasingly harder logic puzzles. Room by room, your actions will be commented on by a test supervisor. Place different sizes of cubes on buttons in first person to solve logic-gate-like riddles.

title: Five Nights at Sonic's 3 Reburned
description: Five Nights at Sonic's 3 Reburned (or for short FNaS 3 Reburned) it's a FNAF fangame, which is basically a copy of FNAF 3 but with new story, characters, etc.

title: Socialize
description: Socialize is a multiplayer role-playing game, based on real life. Join a unique community that will fit your vision of roleplaying in this endless living world and write your own story with no limits!

title: See-Through Jewels
description: Enjoying a simple, addictive puzzle of rules. Have a happy conversation with various smiley girls!

title: Prepare For Warp: Unlimited Edition - Beyond Insanji
description: Intense and exciting arcade spaceflight through dense fields of asteroids, hostile ships, and other obstacles.

title: Cat Stories: New Year
description: A small interactive hidden objects game about a cat who slept through everything and now has to prepare for the New Year in the shortest possible time while the owner is not at home. Puzzles, mini-games and a festive mood await you.

title: Psychic Cat
description: A journey across a blasted psychosphere. A cat in trouble.

title: Shakadou-san no Jun'ai Road
description:
Shakadou decides to move temporarily to Shounan, where he "turns out" to survive and to live under the bridge, bathing at the beach shower and feeding by working to the fishermen.
Until one day, when a different girl seems to change the attitude of the yankee looking oji-san.

title: Cube Gravity
description: You are a cube that can control gravity

title: Keep Moving Forward
description: Keep Moving Forward is a small arcade game representing the idea of moving forward instead of getting stuck in the past, no matter what obstacles may come your way.

title: Trainbow
description: TRAINBOW is a mouse-based, maze-action game about collecting bulbs and restoring colour to the world! With a click of your mouse, you can lay down five consecutive tracks for your heroic Manpuck to travel along - and as Manpuck moves faster, so does the world around them.

title: Cosmos Bit
description: Cosmos Bit is an old school metroidvania that will take you in an extraterrestrial world painted with the legendary Amstrad CPC's colour palette, reworked for modern devices. The game is enjoyable for both veterans and newbies of this genre!

title: PunchMan Online
description: PunchMan is an online game designed for everyone who wants to enjoy their free time doing something funny. Whether you're good or bad at gaming, whether you're a grown adult or child, your gender, your job doesn't matter. All you need to do is punch and punch.

title: Dog Petting Simulator
description: Dog Petting Simulator is a first person indie game that emulates a highly realistic experience of the universal human dream: walking around a park all day and petting some playful pups.

title: Warhall
description: Warhall is a free to play online wargaming simulator for The 9th Age: Fantasy Battles.

title: Megaquarium: Architect's Collection
description: With Megaquarium's second expansion, the Architect's Collection in your arsenal, you'll be equipped to take your aquarium design skills to new heights! Build bridges above existing thoroughfares and lay tunnels underneath your tanks! These paradigm-shifting tools will help you realize your creations like never before. The Architect's Collection is a celebration of the spaces outside the tanks. With this in mind it comes fully equipped with a new gift shop toy - the adorable Hermit Crab - as well as two customer-focused accessories.

title: Gone Rogue
description: Get into the role of a thief from the city slums. Your weapons are your dexterous fingers, your skills are your cunning, attentiveness and planning, your motivation is silent disobedience to the will of the ruling party. Lurking in the shadows, slip unnoticed past enemies, get behind any locked doors, and carry off rich loot. But it's not just money and valuables you're after. In this harsh and unjust world, many need help, and it is in your power to help them.

title: CBT With Yuuka Kazami: Getting Help With Patchouli Knowledge
description: You decide to seek out someone who's been looking for you, that person is none other than Patchouli Knowledge! She seems to have a surprise prepared, but what could it be?

title: Cupid Nonogram
description: Use your logic to paint beautiful images in this relaxing puzzle. The gorgeous visuals and relaxing soundtrack will help you forget all your problems and have a great time!

title: Dreadful Tales: The Space Between - Collector's Edition
description: The Spencers picked up an abandoned country estate for cheap, hoping to flip it and turn a profit, but when they come to check out the property, they discover it has dark secrets hidden inside its walls. A creature begins to terrorize them, rifling through their things, smashing furniture and causing a ruckus, but soon their annoyance turns into terror. Can they escape something that lives within the very walls themselves? Find out in this terrifying hidden object puzzle adventure game!

title: Overcooked! All You Can Eat: The Ever Peckish Rises
description: This freshly baked adventure brings seven brand new spooky kitchens and adds three chefs to the roster: The adorable Axolotl Chef, our less-than-fresh Unbread Chef, and the original omnivorous Overlord, Everpeckish Chef.

title: Overcooked! All You Can Eat: The Overcooked Birthday Party
description: Five new birthday themed levels, the new Tabby Cat chef, a recipe to make a cup of tea, and in-game Switcheroo mechanic where living playing cards stalk the levels transporting players across the kitchen, are all on the menu.

title: Operation: Tango - Challenge Mode
description: Operation: Tango launches into action with brand new free DLC for all players! Put your communication skills to the ultimate test in our new Challenge Mode!

title: Indie Rumble
description: Indie Rumble is an indie crossover platform fighting game, featuring a cast of some of indie gaming's biggest icons. Indie icons clash when you duke it out with up to eight players, both locally and online.

title: Sword of Elpisia
description: On Terra, a world whose civilization developed thanks to magic tools, there are frequent cases of people being turned into magic swords. Alice, a girl who is traveling with Aldo, the main character, chooses to become a sword to rescue her friends. Will their journey and encounters lead them to a predetermined fate? Throw yourself into the beautiful, complex turn-based battles, using magic swords with up to three weapons set! The overwhelming charm of pixelated graphics surround your entire world and adventure in a unique fantasy JRPG. Not to mention all the necessary elements from treasure hunting, quests, pet buddies to almost-infinite level caps!

title: Arcticmind
description: You wake up in an abandoned hospital, not knowing what has happened to you or where you are. soon noticing that you are not alone and must find out what happened to you and the world while trying to survive that nightmare..

title: Sinsations
description: In Sinsations, a BL / Yaoi Visual Novel, you play as Kosuke, Lucifer's newest Deadly Sin of Lust. Kosuke has to seduce all 6 of the other Deadly Sins to prove to Lucifer he's up to the challenge! Numerous ends, hundreds of backgrounds and CGs, and full voice acting!

title: Smelogs Playground
description: Smelogs Playground is a Free-to-Play Real-Time Strategy game with charming aesthetics and a simple but effective gameplay mechanism. Take over the playful and rocky Smelogs to compete against each other for fun and honor!

title: Lord Ambermaze
description: This world and all life in it have stopped. Only your steps can force the flow of time to move. In this adventure, time is your best ally and your enemy. You need to restore the flow of time - and for that purpose, you'll have to delve into the depths of the underworld and challenge the evil Lord.

title: Recursor
description: An action roguelite inspired by platform fighters

title: Lyre
description: Lyre is a romance furry visual novel story where you travel to a strange kingdom as a human ambassador, surrounded by diverse characters. Your only weakness is that you have no idea what their motives are. They're all deceiving each other and every one of them is better at it than you. You find yourself only able to trust the most unlikely individual as a terrible plot unfolds around you.

title: Dragon Kingdom
description: Do you want to farm and have an easy life, attempt to go down in the mines to collect resources, or spend your time fishing by the river? With this game you can do all three, while also having a dragon! Take your time discovering what this game has to offer, and immerse yourself in this adventure!

title: MultiVersus
description:
MultiVersus is a free-to-play platform fighter that brings the depth of iconic WB stars to life across the nearly endless possibilities of play.

MultiVersus was taken offline permanently and delisted from storefronts on May 30, 2025, while remaining playable through its offline modes.

title: Haunted Hotel: Silent Waters
description: Can you uncover the hotel's secrets and escape before it's too late? Find out in this gripping hidden-object puzzle adventure!

title: Haunted Hotel: The Thirteenth
description: Search the mysterious hotel, uncover the secrets of the Bakers family, explore the rooms and save your son Matthew. Remember, that any hotel can keep more secrets, than you can imagine.

title: Haunted Hotel: Personal Nightmare
description: After 20 years, you receive a letter about your missing mom and sister. Answers are waiting at the Freedom Hotel. Find them out in this spine-tingling hidden-object puzzle adventure!

title: Rusted Moss
description: Traverse the perilous lands of a dying world in this bullet-hell inspired metroidvania! Strong enemies emerge from distant lands as the iron inventions of men succumb to the decay of rust and time. Use a trusty grappling hook and uncover new powers to battle monstrous machines, powerful witches, and explore a new emerging world.

title: Hatchwell
description: Hatchwell is a top-down action RPG set in a day in this slowly changing town! Everyone is preparing for the Hatchwell Festival, but a series of curious events will make you help the Mayor investigate these unwanted occurrences.

title: Setr's Auto Battler
description: A chill online fantasy auto battler

title: The Lost Wild
description: True fear is primal. Embark on an evasion-based survival horror experience against nature’s ultimate hunters — dinosaurs. Explore overgrown research facilities nestled in a lush wilderness. Be resourceful as you evade, distract, survive, and unravel the mystery at the heart of the island.

title: Pirates of Gravitae
description:
Pirates of Gravitae is an action roguelike game with fast-paced aerial dogfights, set in a fictional version of the Golden Age of Piracy.

The player commands a rocket propelled pirate ship that they can equip with various weapons and abilities, as they fight against a variety of enemies. They can choose from a selection of different bonuses at the end of every battle, to customize their ship as they go. These bonuses expire at the end of a run. They can also unlock new abilities or upgrade crew members, for perks that persist between runs.

title: Bounce On 2: Drallo's Demise
description:
Roll your way through the Floating Ruins, explore space on the Orbital Platform, and finish the fight in Drallo's Fortress. Customize your character, find hidden secrets, fight against unique bosses and collect gems! With different level objectives to select, and over 100 keys to collect, Bounce On 2: Drallo's Demise will keep you playing and playing!

Fans of the original will love the improvements, and newcomers to the series will have no problem jumping right in. Bounce On 2 features incredible 2D/3D graphics, amazing lighting effects, and is packed with beautiful artwork and 21 unique musical tracks to add to the fun. Use the accelerometer or touch controls. The graphics scale to utilize the capabilities of newer devices.

Bounce On 2: Drallo's Demise is suitable for all ages and skill levels. With level difficulties ranging from super easy to near impossible, Bounce On 2 has something for everyone.

title: Idle Superpowers
description: Idle Superpowers is a roguelike idle rpg where you are a superhero who can get multiple superpowers that are combinable and synergize with each other! - Many superpowers to unlock - procedural generation - combine and synergize superpowers - challenges which require different playstyles

title: Rugby 22
description:
Take control of the biggest clubs and top rugby nations, and enter the most prestigious competitions in single-player and multiplayer modes, local and online.

Rugby 22 offers total rugby, combining tactics and intensity through gameplay that stays true to the sport.

title: I Became Gay from Translating My New Roommate's Short Story
description:
An anti-work antifiction yuri ADV.

A mediocre translator burned out by capitalism.

A writer who has only been published once in her entire life.

They meet as roommates and develop a relationship that is perhaps much more than love.

title: Violation
description: Violation is a First Person Horror Game that takes Place in many other Worlds.

title: Fight N' Fall
description: Fight N' Fall is a top-down hero brawler where you can destroy the environment to make your enemies fall onto their demise. The game has several heroes to choose from and a wide array of colorful arenas to destroy!

title: League of Light: The Gatherer
description: League of Light: The Gatherer is the fourth title in the League of Light series. Can you and your little scarecrow friend track down the imposter and uncover his devious plans? Find out in this spooky hidden object puzzle adventure game!

title: League of Light: The Gatherer - Collector's Edition
description: League of Light: The Gatherer is the fourth title in the League of Light series. Can you and your little scarecrow friend track down the imposter and uncover his devious plans? Find out in this spooky hidden object puzzle adventure game!

title: Arcade Galaxy
description: A fast-paced party platformer where you race, jump, and outplay rivals as customizable animal Cubs. Create and share your own levels with an intuitive editor, or tackle hundreds of player-made maps filled with traps, boosts, and surprises.

title: Herios
description: Herios is an online collectible card game. It will be available on Steam for Windows/Mac and in a second time on Android and Ios. The game is turn-based, single or multiplayer, and is based on the folklore of the Toria universe through its card's illustrations as well as with the atmosphere of its medieval tavern.

title: Rinne
description: A simple yet challenging action game that can be played with just one button! Control the "Fool", a cursed soul cast into hell with the ability to only change direction, and collect golden souls to reach the goal! If you hit a wall, you die! If you hit a red laser, you die! If you hit a chasing needle, you die!

title: Feral Flowers
description: Feral Flowers is a quick-fire roguelite platformer for hay fever haters: dodge the pollen, beat the flowers! Rather than a traditional health meter, the game's timer needs to be topped up by killing enemies. The player can tank any number of hits - unless the timer reaches zero, in which case bullet hell ensues, and a single hit will send them all the way back to the first stage.

title: Hidden Treasures in the Forest of Dreams
description:
Hidden Treasures in the Forest of Dreams is a casual procedural exploration game.
Each level (dream) consists of a procedurally generated 1/2 mile square terrain with items (treasures) dispersed semi-randomly.
The player must find a certain amount of treasures by exploring the dream without a predefined path or map. Some assistance is available in the form of Signs that indicate the general direction of a Treasure.
New treasure categories become available as the player completes dreams. Categories include: Mushrooms, Animals, Creatures, Dark Creatures, Monuments, Boats, etc.

title: Zero Sievert
description: Zero Sievert is a tense top-down shooter that challenges you to scavenge a procedurally-generated wasteland, loot gear, and explore what’s left of a devastated world. When the odds are stacked against you, you’ll need to do more than just survive...

title: Waka-sama no Zasuru Sekai
description: Ryouga inherits his late grandfather's Shinto shrine, having nowhere else to go and no relatives left to stay with. There, he accidentally summons and unseals a goddess which nearly eats him alive. Fortunately, he is able to get out of it by offering to cook and buy said goddess Waka-sama all the delicious food that the little money he earns from his part-time job can buy. Brimming with curiousity, Waka-sama ventures out into modern Japan with Ryouga, looking for her sister and discovering new foods, sights, spirits, monsters, and gods all the while.

title: Sinfeld Remastered
description: A comedy-horror parody game inspired by various sitcoms and movies

title: Deltatraveler
description: A Deltarune fangame. Kris and Susie suddenly wake up on a flower bed in the world of Undertale. They, along with Noelle, must travel between different worlds to make their way back home.

title: Maple County
description:
Maple County is a very creepy little horror game where you watch a police training VHS tape about dealing with an unknown threat.

Drawing inspiration from the Mandela Catalog YouTube videos, Maple County is a short and very unsettling horror game where you watch and interact with a creepy old interactive police training VHS. While watching the video you’ll need to follow the instructions and absolutely nothing weird will happen whatsoever (if you can spot the lie in that sentence then you’ll make a great cop).

title: Train Crew
description: A train driving simulation game created by Japanese developer Mizotsuki Rail.

title: Tactical Manager 2
description:
Tactical Manager 2 is a soccer/football manager game for Windows.

This sequel goes much further than the predecessor, including a massive database with 30 championships with 60 leagues, with over 32000 players.

The game runs from a regular Windows interface, and all options can be selected with the mouse or the keyboard. Game options include the usual tactical selection, sending the player to train weaker parts of their game or send them to recovery.

title: Dubium
description: Dubium is a five-player social deduction game set in a near-future sci-fi universe. Players take on the role of Frontier or Traitor and must escape from an abandoned space station by any means necessary. Everyone wants to get out alive. Trust no one

title: Destiny's Plan
description: Finn is the protagonist of this story, by a ridiculous coincidence, gets to the hospital, but contrary to fate - rejoicing in this, begins to live in a new way. And falling in love with his new friend, unfortunately, cannot remember one important thing. Will you understand what you have forgotten?

title: Cat of Khronos
description: Use four-dimensional space-time thinking and time travel ability to eat the fish within the specified time and return to the original position, while avoiding the guards' pursuit.

title: Laserboy
description: Help Laserboy escape The Scientist's experimental vision facility without racking up a massive bill. 13 levels of mayhem and confusion in glorious CRT vision.

title: Bogdanoff vs. Wojak Simulator
description: Ever wanted to manipulate the world financial markets? Well now you can! Fight against the Wojaks of the world as you manipulate the world markets and destroy their savings. Carefully pick the correct stock and then choose whether to "Bompeet" or "Dompeet"

title: Fate Seeker II
description: Following the previous one, “Fate Seeker II” character development, thinking and exploration and other elements. You can experience real-time combat without switching scenes, and feel the delightful martial arts anytime.

title: Midnight Mahjong
description: Somewhere in Tokyo, in an exclusive mahjong Club. Rei is a clerk in this club. Her job is to play Mahjong with the guests. Players will operate Rei and play with 3 guests in the authentic Japanese Mahjong. Dead wall draw and Last tile from the wall... It all depends on your skills!!

title: Faircroft's Antiques: The Forbidden Crypt
description: Mia Faircroft goes to Italy! Tag along on her travels in this Hidden Object game. Search through gorgeously rendered locations, breathe new life into a collection of antiques, and discover the secret that lies in the crypt of Porto Nacosti!

title: Undemon
description: Go on a mysterious adventure as a virgin ghost. Various stages that stimulate a sense of challenge are waiting for the virgin ghost Luna. If you want to feel the genre of 2D platformer in the 90s, try it!

title: Robot88
description: Robot88 is a robot tournament, an epic battle with unlimited punches and movements that the player creates.

title: Search All: Steampunk
description: is a game in the genre of "hidden object", in which you need to find all the bolts and screws on a large location drawn in the style of "doodling"

title: Jo-Jo Fighter
description: Jo-Jo Fighter is a 2D side-scrolling platformer. You are a loner fighter who was thrown into the jungle. Defeat pirates, smugglers and bandits, get out of the dangerous jungle alive!

title: Duck Simulator 2
description: A genre-switching phenomenon that will take you on a journey to stop a rubber duck from taking over the developer's game!

title: Patriots: Back to Civilization
description: Patriots: Back to Civilization - Side Scroller tractor control game in physical space, where any tilt and speed can flip your tractor and end the game. Dodging sticks flying by, jumping over gates and other obstacles, you need to keep your balance and drive forward.

title: Eternal Starshine
description: In a space adventure thriller with elements of a first-person detective, you, as a member of the crew of a spaceship, must put an end to the tyranny of the captain of a starship. Act quickly, because someone has set off an explosion and there is little time left!

title: Somewhere in a Clay Nowhere
description: An exploration-based language decoding game made out of clay!

title: Headache
description: 頭痛【資料館編】 行方不明者を探しに資料館へ... 廃墟の資料館に隠された謎を解く一人称視点の探索系国産ホラーゲームです。

title: Neden
description: Step into the fantastic world of Neden and create your unique character! You can meet new friends and explore thrilling game modes like deathmatch, battle royale, survival, and much more. But what exactly is Neden?

title: Anivenge
description: An arcade style game where you play as an animal hopping around a road trying to crash cars. Work your way through different levels or play in survival mode - how many can you crash before you're run over?

title: Tactical Manager 3
description:
Tactical Manager 3 is a football/soccer management game that puts the player in charge of a professional club chosen from the approximately 1200 clubs available in the 68 divisions that are supported.

As a manager, the player can buy and sell players from the 30,000 in the game database, choose a line-up, and pick tactics. All matches are played in turn and during the ones involving their team, the player is able to intervene, make substitutions, inspect performance, mark players, etc. If their rating is good enough, they can also be in charge of a national team for the World Cup.

A total of twelve sessions can be played in parallel. The game can also be played online against other players.

title: Men of War II
description: Experience warfare like never before! Men of War II, the anticipated sequel to the acclaimed RTS franchise is here with all-new units, locations, campaigns and game modes, combined with the series’ trademark historical accuracy and action-filled gameplay on Eastern and Western Fronts of WWII.

title: Korsakovia
description: Korsakovia is a single-player mod for Valve's video game Half-Life 2. It was developed by The Chinese Room. Korsakovia was released as freeware download on 20 September 2009.

title: System Purge
description: ﻿Trapped in a buried, forgotten facility, you must reach the core of an ancient machine to rescue your lost lover. System Purge is a challenging, atmospheric 2D platformer.

title: Snake Force
description: Snake Force is an alternative top-down shooting game inspired by the classic game Snake.

title: Getting It Up
description: An open world action / comedy variety game with a unique blend of 2D and 3D game modes. With Multi-player PvE, open world racing, combat based 2D platforming and tons of quirky humor.

title: TKKG: Alarm in der Geisterbahn
description:
With their annual pass, Tim, Karl, Dumpling and Gaby have already been to the amusement park "Snappyland" countless times. It was almost getting boring! But when they overhear a conversation between 2 entertainers who are planning a crime, they get into an exciting case. The "goose man", they hear, is to have a "fatal accident" on the same day! Time is running out. Stress at the amusement park!

Take on the roles of Tim, Karl, Dumpling and Gaby. Interview witnesses, look for clues and evidence ...

title: Evering
description:
Evering is an adventure RPG with a turn-based combat system and pixel art style that tells an epic story through witty and funny dialogues with charismatic characters in a completely unique and very detailed world where time loops around in circles.

This is an era of peace and the world faces no danger but if this legend turns out to be true... our days could be numbered.

Evering is a love letter to nostalgia, a tribute to the games we grew up with, with a renewed look and feel, with no random encounters and accessibility options. You don’t want to fight? That’s okay, you can escape every combat with no punishment so you can follow the story at your pace.

The world of Evering is full of treasures, maestros and crystals to learn new skills and alchemy ingredients. There are secrets hidden in the last place you would imagine. Can you find them all?

title: Haunted Hotel: Death Sentence
description: Hidden object puzzle game where you help your partner solve a group of murders, possibly even his own.

title: Haunted Hotel: Lost Dreams
description: Can you unravel the secrets of that mysterious place that is somehow connected to your memories and save your wife?

title: Kimagure Temptation
description: Mysterious murders. A cursed apartment building. Cohabitating with a cute demon girl?! All in a day's work for diviner, Haruhisa but will he be able to solve the case and not be distracted by a demon girl only interested in him?

title: Meikyu Wakusei des Paraiso
description: RPG like Wizardry in 3D Dungeon. Many of the characters are maids. This game can be run on a PC, Windows OS.

title: Game Grumps: Joint Justice - Turnabout Hour
description:
Meet your favorite YouTube duo in an intense
Ace Attorney-like game! Someone stole the 10
Minute Power Hour dinos, and only Arin & Dan
can figure out the culprit of this heinous crime
and save their friend Jory!

title: The Netrunner Awaken1ng
description:
A fast paced 3D plateform-parkour game in procedurally generated levels in which the player hacks the Matrix by collecting all the Datas in time and going as far as possible before being caught by the Logout().

By running and jumping from walls to walls as fast as possible, you will discover, learn and by-pass each new database defenses you will encounter throughout the levels.
Or die, repeat, improve and succeed!

Unlock each level by hacking its password using clues from previous levels!

title: The Wheel of Fortune
description: The only visual novel dating sim with turbo-folk music playing in the background.

title: Pro Basketball Manager 2022
description:
Have you ever dreamt of replaying the last possession during the playoffs’ finals? Which player should have taken that last shot? With Pro Basketball Manager 2022 you become the coach of your favorite team and will be able to change history.

With more than 160 playable competitions - including 25 international competitions, 11 continental competitions, 12 female competitions, over 40 national cups - spread across 55 countries, you will never run out of new opportunities, each team will face different challenges depending on their league, budget or history.
All teams include updated rosters for the 2021-2022 season.

For the first time Pro Basketball Manager also features 2 licensed leagues with official names, logos and photos.

Through your journey to the hall of fame, you must not only recruit and train your players, but also take part in live games, giving on-court instructions or scouting to find the stars of tomorrow. Ensure the stability of your team by managing the day-to-day operations such as club finances, staff management or improving your arena.

Will you lead your team to glory or lead yourself to unemployment? It all depends on you with Pro Basketball Manager 2022. Get it now to enjoy the most realistic basketball management game ever made.

title: Haunted Hotel: Beyond the Page
description: A prolific horror writer invites you to a desolate hotel for an interview where you start to see impossible things, monstrous things.

title: Haunted Hotel: A Past Redeemed
description: Your cousin goes missing and ghosts start taking over your wedding venue! Can you defeat an old adversary and change the course of fate before it’s too late?

title: Invasion Versus
description:
Invasion Versus is a fast-paced asymmetric action game that pits two players against each other. One is a mobile Earth turret pointing heavenward, shooting enemies out of the sky. The other is a fleet of invaders who slowly descend to Earth.

Earth wins if all alien invaders are destroyed. The invaders win if all turrets are destroyed or they pass the defense line.

title: Neptunia: Sisters vs. Sisters
description:
The "sisters" get their long-awaited star role in this genuine Neptunia series spin-off!

The four younger sisters rise up to take back their share of the portable games market stolen by the mysterious smartphone called "MagiPhone." The character models that decorate game scenes are all-new, and the characters are cuter than ever!

In addition to a battle system that combines action and strategy, the familiar "Goddess Transformations" and "EXE Drive" systems return, allowing players to enjoy dynamic battles. Utilize strategy to seize victory with the sisters!

title: Error#54
description: Error#54 - first person indie horror game in P.T style, developed by only one person during two months.

title: Komorebi
description: Komorebi is a coming-of-age/slice of life story about a group of friends who happen to experience visions of their future; and the fears and anxieties they face as they try to find their own way in a life that may be predestined. From Klace, critically acclaimed creator of Winds of Change.

title: Post Trauma
description: Post Trauma is a game that takes inspiration from classic horror games. Play as Roman, a 57 year old man who has awakened in a strange and hostile place and find a way back home with his family. Get inside this world through fixed camera angles, alternating the gameplay with some sections in first person view. Solve puzzles and riddles with the information you will gather exploring your surroundings. Avoid (or kill) the creatures that you will find along the way, but be careful because some of them might not be hostile.

title: Space Hoarders Inc.
description:
A Sci-Fi turn based resource management game.
Mine, craft and ship resources across the galaxy!

title: Chronicles of Etia: A Yuletide Story
description: This is the second game from the Chronicles of Etia: A Samhain Story. It is a story that happens at Yule and is a story of magic, mystery and evil fairies. A story to get you into the festive spirit.

title: OverDrive
description: Overdrive is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. The player starts as a girl named 323, staying in a laboratory-ish room who doesn't want to go out of it. She can travel to a world called Outer World by entering the capsule machine in the room. Her purpose is to collect all Concepts in the Outer World. There is an unlockable character named 543, a boy that stays in a patient room and doesn't want to go out, after you find the way to meet him in Outer World.

title: Veiled Experts
description: Free-to-Play 5v5 tactical shooter where agent's unique Lepton skills meet action- packed gun mechanics. Available on Steam!

title: TKKG: Zelle 13
description: Superstition is not the order of the day for the 13th case of TKKG. Or is it? For the school newspaper, Gaby interviews an inmate in prison about his everyday life in jail. The prisoner from cell 13, Bodo Heppner, willingly gives information. But Heppner is still silent about what happened to the loot after his bank robbery and whether he had an accomplice. When Gaby visits the bank robber again to give him the freshly printed school newspaper, he suddenly becomes nervous. A short time later he breaks out of prison! And again TKKG is involved in a new case. The clues lead to a horror store, to hard-core crime readers, illiterates and last but not least to an abandoned bunker ...

title: TKKG: Gefährliche Ferien
description: Vacation at last! Camping in Cyprus is the motto, but the four detectives have hardly unrolled their sleeping bag when they get involved in a new case. A picture that at first seems inconspicuous is stolen from a hotel safe. The more TKKG look into the history of the picture, the more people show up who want it desperately. So something is not right with this painting ...

title: TKKG: Verfolgt!
description:
Investigate with TKKG in a new, exciting case that you do not know from the radio plays or books!
Stalked! Gaby feels a shiver down her spine: At the end of a Spanish class at the adult education center, she discovers an anonymous letter between the pages of her book. A stranger who signs "Your faithful prince" seems to be constantly watching her and trying to intimidate her. Tim, Karl, Klößchen and Gaby take up the pursuit of the stranger. The clues soon lead them into the world of the Internet, webcam spying and chat rooms Just when the young detectives think they are on the right track, the case takes a dramatic turn. Will TKKG win the hunt for the "prince" across the city?

title: TKKG: Das Unheimliche Zimmer
description:
Actually, the four friends of TKKG just wanted to go for a bike ride, turn their backs on the city of millions and spend a relaxing weekend in the countryside.
But when they are surprised by a thunderstorm and have to seek shelter in an abandoned hotel, they come across a terrible secret ... And before they know it, they are in the middle of a thrilling criminal case, in which it quickly becomes clear that this is no ordinary case. The clues lead into the past - a past that scares the inhabitants of the small village Oberfeldbach so much that they don't want to talk about it.
Is this case perhaps a bit too big for TKKG?

title: Stick It!
description: Swing, spin, and launch your way to victory in Stick It!, a fast-paced physics-based platformer where angular momentum is your greatest tool. Master the art of movement, conquer dynamic environments, and challenge your friends in chaotic multiplayer races to the top!

title: Nothing Special
description: A short disturbing game about about being held captive by a mysterious girl.

title: Civil War: The Battle of Bull Run - Take Command 1861
description: Real-time strategy game in which the player commands all or elements of the Union Army of Northeastern Virginia or the Confederate Army of the Potomac or Army of the Shenandoah in a series of historical or speculative scenarios related to the first major land battle of the American Civil War--the First Battle of Bull Run or Manassas.

title: Agent Hlina
description: Agent Hlina is an adventure game from 1C. This is one of the first Russian projects where all characters are clay-made. Owing to this technology heroes and characters look very comical and thus the whole picture considerably differs from classically drawn quests.
