Though clay is a very attractive material, and there is a great tradition of clay-toons in Russia, game developers did not attempt to make a fuss-clay game for a long time. Modeling of clay creatures is a long and hard business, yet it looks quite simple on the face of it...

title: Duvet
description: Duvet is a short adventure-puzzle game made in Unity by Jacaranda Studio about a dystopical world with militarized magical girls.

title: Marmitta
description: Marmitta is an online multiplayer fishing game in which 1 to 10 players come together to fish and collect flowers in a short amount of time in order to get the most points at the town's beer cauldron.

title: Dia
description:
Dia is a short free indie horror game.

There is nothing scary ahead.
No sudden noises.
No flashing images.
No one will follow you.
Welcome to Dia.

title: Polyrhythm Mania
description: A game that faithfully recreates the Polyrhythm minigame from Rhythm Tengoku (リズム天国), with a built-in level editor and side modes.

title: The Magic Land
description: The Magic Land is a massive online role-playing game where people live in a magical world of adventures, In an MMORPG people from all over the world meet on a virtual playground to explore areas, solve tricky riddles and undertake heroic exploits. Players are faced with the challenge of developing the skills of their selected characters, exploring a large variety of areas and dangerous dungeons and interacting with other players on a social and diplomatic level.

title: Deathball
description:
DeathBall is a top class First Person Sport Game that combines elements of Football, Rugby and Handball. It's a mod for UT2004, but it has nothing to do with a shooter (a pure sports game).

So you got these football pitches, and you have to get the ball into the enemy goal. You have a hammer tool. With that one you can kick other players around, kill the enemy ballowner with 2 hits and also kick the ball away (volley).
In your own penalty zone you can kill all enemy players with one hit. With the ball launcher you can charge up a shot, the longer you hold it the harder it will be and you can even add spin to the ball, so it will curl in the air.
Just like in football you should have a keeper in your goal. He has some special abilities like he's 30% faster than others,he can dodge and jump higher.
Death Ball should be played with 6-10 players
The gameplay is very easy too learn, but it's hard to master. At first it seems to be pretty simple, but the more you play the more you realise how complex it is and how many possibilities your team has. The ways to score are infinite.

title: Enenra
description: Enenra is a third person, hack and slash game which takes place in future Japan with a heavy emphasis on time manipulation abilities.

title: Unoklive vs. Zuck
description:
UnOk's twitch account was terminated!

UnOk will have to go to Twitch HQ and find out who is banning everyone.,

but not without some people in the way...

UnOkLive Vs Zuck is a 2D singleplayer bullet-hell game with tons of bosses and levels that shoots bullets. You are UnOk and you have to get to Twitch HQ to unban your twitch account.

title: .Hack//G.U. Vol. 1: Rebirth HD
description: .Hack//G.U. simulates a massively multiplayer online role-playing game; players assume the role of a participant in a fictional game called The World. While in The World, the player controls the on-screen player character, Haseo, from a third-person person perspective (with optional first-person mode). The player may control the camera using the game controller's right analog stick.

title: .Hack//G.U. Vol. 3: Redemption HD
description: .Hack//G.U. Vol. 3: Redemption is the third entry in the .hack//G.U. series containing: Vol. 1: Rebirth, .hack//G.U. Vol. 2: Reminisce and .hack//G.U. Vol. 3: Redemption. As in the previous .hack games, .hack//G.U. simulates a massively multiplayer online role-playing game as the player controls a character who starts playing it. Players assume the role of a participant in a fictional game called The World. While in The World, the player controls the on-screen player character, Haseo, from a third-person person perspective (with optional first-person mode). The player may control the camera using the game controller's right analog stick.

title: .Hack//G.U. Vol. 2: Reminisce HD
description: .Hack//G.U. Vol. 2: Reminisce is the second entry in the .hack//G.U. series containing: Vol. 1: Rebirth, .hack//G.U. Vol. 2: Reminisce and .hack//G.U. Vol. 3: Redemption. As in the previous .hack games, .hack//G.U. simulates a massively multiplayer online role-playing game as the player controls a character who starts playing it. Players assume the role of a participant in a fictional game called The World. While in The World, the player controls the on-screen player character, Haseo, from a third-person person perspective (with optional first-person mode). The player may control the camera using the game controller's right analog stick.

title: Nodrog's Fortress
description: Nodrog's Fortress is a Tactics-like Turn-Based All at Once Battler that features elements of Chess and American Football in a JRPG inspired package. Choose your Archmage, companions to fight for them, and try your hand in the 9 Story Missions, Local Pass and Play, PVP Online or in Survival mode, where there is no true Victory...

title: Kirakira Monstars
description: It's sure to bring a smile to everyone's face! In the big city of the human world, a group of monstrous girls go about their daily lives in a serious, anything-goes, slapstick frenzy!

title: Danganronpa Forge:Re
description: Danganronpa Forge:Re is a fan-made visual novel based on the Danganronpa and Ace Attorney series, which features pre-existing characters from various games and visual novels trapped on an island by Foxy and forcing them to play a life or death game.

title: Monster & Me
description: Monster and Me was a 2D MMORPG from NetDragon Websoft and TQ Digital Studio inspired by Chinese myth and culture. Players could find and train over 200 monsters as pets, to fight alongside their characters, or to sell, trade with others, or battle with other players' monsters. Players could craft their own spells, and the game also featured several minigames. Monster and Me was shut down in June of 2012.

title: Lessons in Love
description:
Welcome to Lessons in Love, an ongoing adult dating sim about a class of 20 students trying to make their way through life. Take over as their teacher and build relationships with each of them as you attempt to find your own place in their world.

Please note, some things in this game may be meant to confuse or disturb you. Please don't worry, though. Everything will be okay ~

title: God Killer Aria
description: God Killer Aria (also known as Kamigoroshi Aria) is a 3D role-playing game developed by EXNOA. The game will be available on both PC and Android.

title: Monster Energy Supercross: The Official Videogame 5
description: Hold on fast to the handlebar of your bike because a new chapter of the series has finally arrived. Try Monster Energy Supercross: The Official Videogame 5 and discover the quintessence of indoor supercross! The road to become a true champion starts here. With the new career mode, you'll have to prove your skills on two-wheel bikes to be able to win glory!

title: BounceShot
description: BounceShot is a Action Puzzle FPS where all shots must be bounced. Position your body and weapon to fire projectiles that bounce around corners, hit switches on ceilings, or strike unsuspecting droids. Race to each level's exit portal in order to get the best time. Scores reward speed and style!

title: Car Detailing Simulator
description: In Car Detailing Simulator, you have the chance to renew and restore shine to any car, commissioned by demanding customers! A good and well-kept car can be the pride of every car owner! Clean, polish and admire your car creations in this highly realistic game where every detail counts!

title: Void Dementia
description: Void -Dementia- is a rogue-like action game that takes place in a void zone. The game features stylish fast action and hardcore production and difficulty. It is an action game that will amplify the user's sense of challenge and immersion in the game with the story and roguelike elements of the voice area.

title: Million on Mars: Land Rush
description: Million on Mars: Land Rush, is a 2D browser-based play-to-earn game that uses NFTs on the WAX blockchain. Players in Land Rush partner with DuskWorks co-founder Leon Dusk in a not-so-secret settlement just outside of the view of the Ad Astra Unlimited headquarters in Valles Marineris. Land Rush features similar elements of crafting and land development, but with a more simplified approach to realism and science, and a greater emphasis on creating a rich player-owned economy to support the game as it evolves. We see a future in which time spent playing games like Land Rush can not only be incredibly fun and engaging but also provide an economic opportunity for players who invest their time and resources skillfully.

title: Spellbreak: Chapter 3 - The Wardens
description: A strange and powerful threat has awakened in Chapter 3: The Wardens! Outmaneuver your foes using the revamped movement system, explore transformed Dominions across the Hollow Lands, and battle an invasion of ancient automatons imperiling all of existence.

title: Knockout City: Season 4 - Alien Invaders
description: Take me to your crew leader! Reports are coming in all over the city. UFO sightings in the skies. Increased military presence on the ground. Smoke rising from Overland Farms. Aliens are invading Knockout City!

title: Knockout City: Season 3 - H@cked
description: Season 3 is here! Speaking of, it’s a little… different out there. Seems like the DJ isn’t the only one who’s been paying attention to what’s going on in Knockout City—looks like we got an extra visitor here with us. Keeps poppin’ in and lookin’ around, calls themself Zer0. Not sure how they got here, but pretty sure it’s got something to do with this Season’s theme. They’ve taken over the airwaves and it sounds like they’re here to stay.

title: Simple FPS Aim Trainer
description: An FPS Aim Trainer for fast and lightweight target practice with built in game sensitivity conversion and matching, easily switch between popular games to match your mouse sensitivity

title: Loch Ness
description: Loch Ness is a 1-4 Player Co-Op Horror Hunter. You and your team must navigate precarious waters, use your equipment to hunt for Nessie’s feeding ground and lay bait to lure her out. But be careful, for lurking deep beneath the lake is a creature more ancient than all mankind…

title: That Blooming Feeling
description: Post-Colonial Lanky-Water-Golem Gardening Videopicturebook

title: Blake Strongflank
description: The pixel perfect platformer you'll love to hate

title: Smoothie Galaxy
description: An adventure game in a unknown planet

title: Static Cling
description: Solve 21 levels of unique, electric puzzles! Made in 48 hours for GMTK Jam 2021.

title: In Search of Light
description: Adventure game in which you are playing as an outcast engineer living in a dystopian future.

title: Genre Hopper
description: The constantly changing genre is out of control!

title: The Bird Museum
description: a menagerie of crowdsourced birds

title: Letters to the Metro
description: In the middle of a lonely night, the man remembers home...

title: 3 Minute Walk
description: 3 Minute Walk is a COVID-19 anxiety simulator.

title: A Bright Light in the Middle of the Ocean
description: climb to the top of a lighthouse, watch the sunset, look at the stars

title: SectorA23
description: Stranded in an ever changing cave system you seek an exit out of this strange world.

title: Grand Story
description: Experience the life of an older lady in a rural area.

title: The Observed
description: Will you survive the nightmare? Play as an urban explorer trapped in his old abandoned middle school. Not all is right in this broken-down building. Will you be able to escape? Or will you fall victim to the vicious spirits that roam the halls?

title: The Last Light
description: Rediscover a log lost love in a heartfelt journey through life's stages.

title: Deathroned
description: Deathroned is a hectic first-person shooter in which the player takes on the role of a powerful sorceress making her way within an enchanted palace inspired by One Thousand and One Nights. The random generation of its levels every time the game is played and the freedom to modify the combat style in real time make every playthrough a unique experience.

title: Ronald
description: Ronald wants to play!

title: Lucid Heist
description: A tiny game where you dream to steal art for inspiration.

title: Museum of the Saved Image
description: a gallery of the pics I saved in 2017

title: Blood Reminds
description: Puzzle thriller game where you play as a time-traveling Vampire in a pre-Victorian Castle!

title: Follow the blackbird
description: Follow the blackbird is a hand-drawn 2d game made in a form of comics with lovely watercolour illustrations. Follow the heart-warming story about little adventrure of Sonya and the blackbird. As the story unfolds, couple of light puzzles will be on your way.

title: Invite the Blackbird
description: Invite The Blackbird is a hand-drawn watercolour 2d game made in a form of comics. Follow the heart-warming story about Sonya and the blackbird. As the story unfolds, few point-and-click puzzles will be on your way.

title: Toxic Pink!
description: A nervous third-person Beat'em up downloadable for windows!

title: While Waiting
description: A transformative adventure exploring the art of waiting. Clear the game by doing nothing, but discover the power of acceptance and patience in 100+ situations from birth to death. Learn to embrace life as you wait.

title: Pumpkin Eater
description: Family is family.

title: Plangman
description: In Plangman, you take on the role of a space pilot imprisoned in a dungeon of forgotten memories. Guess words to reconstruct your past, and use what you learn to rescue the girl you love and defeat the wizard who holds you both prisoner.

title: Bear, Vodka, Stalingrad!
description: This time, Motherland sent you to fight vs Nazi forces in the ruins of the snowy Stalingrad. Kill enemies and conquer trophy weapons to get the maximum chance to survive.

title: Flaklypa Grand Prix
description: Immerse yourself in the world of Flåklypa in this game for the whole family. Play nine mini games, enjoy the classic story and take it to the tracks for high-octane racing, alone or with a friend in split-screen. But watch out, your competitors will use dirty tricks to win – and so can you!

title: Russiaphobia
description: Immerse yourself in the Russian Realities as Foreign Agents and help the Presidents Make Russia Great Again! Cooperative Multiplayer, World Government, Evil Russians and more! Russia is Waiting for You!

title: Warpswap
description: Teleport, swap, and solve puzzles! Use your unique ability to swap places with blocks and uncover the secrets of a lost planet.

title: Strange Keyworld
description:
Welcome to Strange Keyworld.

A side scrolling game where players must hold down specific keys on their keyboard to activate platforms and progress.

title: A Key(s) Path
description:
Build your way with your keys.

You have 3 movement keys - Left, Right and Jump - available at the bottom of the screen. You can drag them in the world to use them as platforms. But don't use too many, or you could run out of movement options! Because as soon as a key is placed, you can't use it for movement. It will be locked until you retrieve it from the world.

A Key(s) Path is one of the winners of the GMTK Game Jam 2020, with the theme "Out of Control". It reached 6th place overall and was featured in GMTK's video.

title: Walkerwall
description: mini-exploration-puzzle-platformer

title: Cast 'n' Blast
description: Cast'N'Blast. It's a magical, action-packed vermin extermination.

title: Honk
description: The eternal battle between goose guy and evil.

title: Cloud Jumpers
description: Multiplayer Party Game

title: Soul Labyrinth
description: Psychological Fantasy VN/Adventure: Explore the complexities of the heart and mind.

title: Dungeon Witches
description: A tiny Rogue-lite RPG with cute girls and the magic of the "Home".

title: Strawberry Daiquiri
description: Two men sitting in a bar talking about their lives in a cyberpunk-inspired setting.

title: Research and Development
description: Research and Development is a puzzle-centric mod for Half-Life 2: Episode Two featuring an unarmed player but plenty of violent mayhem.

title: This Is the President
description: This Is the President is a political thriller. You are the newly elected leader with a shady background. It is up to you to abuse the position of the most powerful man in the world to escape justice for past crimes - even if that pitches the country into utter chaos.

title: Hellstar
description:
HELLSTAR is a fast-paced shoot ’em up set in outer space that puts the player up against an adapting enemy.

Shoot your way through the drone armies as you salvage upgrade modules to customize your fighter vessel. Avoid scanners that will gather information about your preferences and the way you fight. Defeat bosses adapting to counter your strengths. Manage your weapon resources carefully as you push deeper into enemy territory. Transform your fighter while in combat and master the two different flight modes and six different weapons.

title: Turbo Island Purger
description:
Become a professional Island Cleaner. Your job is to eliminate Rebellious Scrap. Each attempt to save the world presents a new randomly generated challenge: you will face number of unique robots - which you will choose yourself.

The atmospheric islands that you will be traversing will also be completely new - they are procedurally generated each time.

title: Notebook Detective
description: Explore a slice of the prohibition era of the United States while solving a murder case. Armed with a Notebook containing the power to unlock narrators you will use different perspectives to help deduct the truth.

title: Cards with Personalities
description: A singleplayer deckbuilding game full of charm.

title: Sub Dragon
description: A shooter inspired by Saint Dragon on Atari ST. You have 2 sides, one invicible and one with guns!

title: Unlock Everything
description: A love letter to Mega Man with a twist!

title: Ye Olde Gunslinger
description: Run n Gun your way through a dungeon in this extremely generic dungeon crawler!

title: Reap
description: One swing. One cut. One endless harvest.

title: Greek Tragedy
description: Greek Tragedy is a retro-styled indie survival horror game with puzzle elements. Help Amy keep her life on the college campus overrun by cultists and maybe save her relationship in the process. Uncover conspiracies, sabotage occult rituals and run for your life! Nostalgic PS1 aesthetics included.

title: PewPew Live
description: Fast-paced twin joystick shooter.

title: Accurate Coastlines
description: A most comprehensive atlas

title: The One Spell
description: The One Spell is a small Platformer game. Learn mastery of your only spell : The magic Shield.

title: Pyme's Genocide
description: A cute and murderous game set in space.

title: Polly the Frog
description: A fun and froggy 3D platformer with a Paper Mario inspired art style!

title: Pac-Man Palace: Festive Folleys
description: Just in time for Christmas in July, you can beat the heat with the Pac-Man Palace: Festive Folleys demo! It's a brand new Pac-Man experience. Run, jump, swim, bounce your way to the top but watch out for those pesky ghosts!

title: Knights and Castles
description: (KnC) Knights and Castles is an idle game, which is a game where most of the mechanics and battles are automated so you can enjoy making progress while drinking a coffee without having to work so hard to play =)

title: Wizsnooks
description: Are you ready for the hottest entertainment in this side of the world of wizards?

title: Filch
description: A Harry Potter Horror Fan Game

title: The Three Princes and Adarna
description: An otome game very loosely based on the Filipino epic poem, "Ibong Adarna".

title: At Dawn's Edge
description: MSX-style cyberpunk graphic adventure game set in Megacaracas, Venezuela

title: Gilded Shadows
description: A cyberpunk and solarpunk adventure-romance that explores a world where one side is forever day and the other, night.

title: Tales from the Outer Zone: Cyborg Seppuku
description:
A cyberpunk tale of marriage and self-destruction.

You're a cyborg and your wife has left you. To find her you must leave "The Structure" - a dystopian city in which you are imprisoned. The only way of escaping The Structure is to rid yourself of your implants and become a plain-skin.

title: Transfer
description: A queer narrative game about computers, identity, and what happens after you no longer understand who you are. It is meant to be short and highly replayable, taking an average of 4-10 minutes per playthrough where each can culminate in wildly different outcomes.

title: Solarpunkification
description: A guerilla gardener in a crumbling cyberpunk city plants gardens in abandoned buildings to solarpunkify her world.

title: Barback Blues: A Valhalla Story - Uttoushiki Hibi
description: The disheartening story of an empty man and his life in Glitch City

title: Trails of Tenere
description: Trails of Tenere is inspired by Thierry Sabine's story of getting lost in the desert during the 1977 Abidjan-Nice rally. I just couldn't stop thinking how it must've felt to be all alone in a vast empty landscape with no awareness of where to go.

title: Cyberway
description: Endless driving game with Synthwave music

title: Snek
description: A fantastic snake game

title: Margareta
description: Margareta is a full length psychological-horror based game, although the game fundamentally relies on both psychological-horror and the comedy genre, it's a fun game that will leave you trembling in fear. While trying to escape, you must finding the right path, solve puzzles and hide from the frightening entity.

title: Rot: Purgatory Hill
description: ROT is short psychological horror game inspired by "Silent Hill" series.

title: Castle Watch VR
description: An asymmetrical PC vs VR multiplayer game with archery and magic.

title: Animal Intern
description: Intern with animals!

title: Dire
description: A survival car chase about a single mother in a dying world

title: Silent Hill 2.5
description:
Silent Hill 2.5 is a fangame developed by s5zone intertwining Silent Hill 2 and Silent Hill 3.

You appear as Heather at the same place where James in Silent Hill 2 went to the city. While you browse through locations you meet Valtiel, who tries to open a gateway to the second part of the map for you. In order for him to do it, you must collect bunnies scattered all over the map. The more bunnies you pick up, the more monsters come at you. When you pick up all bunnies, you run to the final door and the second part of the game begins. During the final run to the end, Alessa appears and shows you the direction you should go towards the end. The events of this game happen after Silent Hill 3, when Heather tries to leave Silent Hill but for some reason, she must go back to it.

title: More than u no
description: On an evening like any other in a small-town saloon, Hannah meets Charlotte and feels immediately drawn to her.

title: Sacrifices Must Be Made
description: You find yourself in a dimly lit log cabin in the middle of the woods. You are starving to death. The stranger who resides there tells you that he will feed you if you defeat him in a game of cards.

title: Castle Defense
description: Tiny strategy game about defending a castle. Please read the description on the game page

title: Another Piece of Candy: Sweet Fusions
description: A cute fusing card game made with ren'py

title: Tiny House
description: Embark on an adventure to unlock the secrets hidden within an enigmatic mansion with Tiny House.

title: Impressionista: Water Lilies
description: Imagine yourself at an art gallery... You get closer to Claude Monet´s "Bridge over water lilies pond" painting and magically is transposed to it!

title: Must Love Jaws
description: Two men, one shark, lots of love!

title: Yaso: Curse of Soirée
description: A new horror game from the creator of GOHOME, Itimatu Suzuka! This is a rhythm horror adventure game set in a Western-style house from the Meiji era.

title: Hexagourds
description:
Hexagourds is a casual, relaxing builder and puzzle game where you place tiles on a grid to make your own pumpkin patch! Grow pumpkins, feed animals, and pick apples as you gain points for rotating, placing and connecting different tiles.

If you're in love with the fall season or are in need of a relaxing game to distract you from the stressful day-to-day activities of life, then Hexagourds is definitely for you. This game has no winning or losing. You play at your own pace, gaining points for placing tiles wherever you want. You place some pumpkins here, some goats there, and haybales everywhere. This game was meant to be played on a chill, autumn Sunday morning with a coffee next to you. I hope you try it out and enjoy the game.

For those more strategically inclined, there is definitely some strategy involved with maximizing points. I've added dailies and a mutliplayer scoreboard if you want to show the rest of the community your sweet score in Hexagourds. But that's all up to you.

title: Auto Museum 64
description: Auto Museum 64 is a virtual museum featuring cars, boats, and other vehicles from 20 racing games in the Nintendo 64 library. Using an emulator, extraction software, and a 3D modeling program these vehicles have been lifted out of their games of origin and recreated under one roof. These vehicles represent the hard work of hundreds of artists over many studios and are credited herein. This is meant as an educational showcase of late 90's polygonal art specific to racing games of the era.

title: The Clock Chronicle
description:
Can you solve the clock's mystery?

The Central Clock is a barrier. A barrier separating the two rivalling countries, Zethania and Palymr. But when the clock breaks, war is on the verge of starting any time.

You were suddenly transferred to the Ithel Continent by an strange mage after being instructed to fix the problem at hand... but the clock hides a secret in its history that no one knows...

Now it's your turn to decide. Which side will you choose?

title: Death Strike
description: Death Strike is an old school horizontal shoot em up with four levels packed with action, made to look like a potential arcade release in the late eighties.

title: Spolous Ex
description: Save the galaxy Danioy from invasion of army corps Doscoponian.

title: Cursor Car
description: Race around your desktop!

title: Winter Magic
description: a lonely girl moves into a witch town and meets a cool witch~

title: Quest of Graal
description: Racing platformer with splitscreen multiplayer

title: 16 Bit Rally
description:
Revisit the good old days of arcade racers with 16 Bit Rally, developed by Photon Creations.

Race on tracks all around the world, through some of the harshest and picturesque environments against 19 other competitors all aiming for the prized 16 Bit Cup.
Earn prize money from races, purchase car upgrades & new car models, gaining that edge over the competition.

title: Acceler 8
description: A retro style pseudo-3d bike racing game

title: Neon Race
description: Cute retro racer. Go loop and loop in this relaxing animal racing game!

title: Orb of Creation
description: A magic theme incremental about creating everything from nothing.

title: Threadbound
description: Use magical yarn to bind the fates of objects, enemies, and yourself in this puzzle-platformer.

title: Dreaming by day
description: A game about memes and dreams.

title: ViviDex
description: A pastel-punk beat'em up that stars a magical fighting duo Vivi and Dex.

title: Magic Mirror Hall
description: Remedy a relationship plagued by a magical malady (and repression)

title: Devil of the Mirror
description:
RPG Maker MV remake of Devil of the Mirror (2017), featuring an extended story, new graphic assets and two additional endings.

Striving to escape her futile existence, a lonely and sick girl is performing a spell upon a mirror, wishing for friends and for a better life... But she didn't know that the mirror she used was holding a demonic entity in it. Will that spell be a blessing for the girl... or a curse?

title: Thermal Power Plant K-13
description: Made for Ludum Dare 39. A post-apocalyptic game about a group of survivors who have built their town around a giant thermal plant.

title: Box of Limes
description: Box of Limes is a mix of Tetris and Lemmings.

title: Scrapmetalship
description: Made for Ludum Dare 35.

title: Achilles vs. Turtles
description: Shoot turtles sweet spots and defend your heel

title: Gratia
description: Gratia is a short, narrative role-playing game with an emphasis on gratitude and friendship! Play as a slime, unravel the mysteries of the town of Gratia, and make some friends along the way!

title: Flour Hour
description: Romance the grumpy ex or the cheerful city boy? (BL)

title: Lilian: The beginning of the end
description: An angel falls in love with a boy who talks to the skies. Who is he talking to?

title: All Men Are Pigs
description:
A queer and raunchy adult comedy with a tropical flavor. As the main character, you get to move to a Caribbean island named Santa Locura, working the summer away in a bar named The Inqueersition.

Your day to day routine gets derailed by the men you meet, all of them hiding a dealbreaker in their closet. What IS their deal? WHY is it so hard to find a proper man? Do you even NEED a man?

...well, this is a dating sim, so we’ll go with “yes”.

You will get to interact with your friends, coworkers and possible love interests in a variety of ways. Will you manage to land the man of your dreams and love him despite the issues they might have, or will they chew you up and spit you like gum?

title: Bara Boarders
description: Bara Surfer VN Dating Game where you are a newbie surfer on an idyllic beach in Hawaii. Featuring 3 Buff Love Interests and 9 Endings.

title: A Cat Cafe Story
description: Ertal Games' Visual Novels characters as cats

title: The Love Interests get their Own Game
description: When the rejected love interests of another game get together, they experience a cute and wholesome first date.

title: Defying Heaven's Will
description: A BL murder mystery in xianxia setting!

title: Other Minds
description: Brutal collectathon platforming action with added mind control

title: Momoe Link
description:
Momoe is an active and sweet pink cybergirl who loves to sing. She has many friends, great career...

But for now, she decided to take a break and visit her friends. There are Jambu, Shade, and... Candy.
But wait! The real reason behind all that is... a love confession from somebody?!

title: Marigold
description: Lost in space and moments away from death, what do you do?

title: Two Peas in a pod
description: Two gays wander around an island and talk non-stop

title: Shadow Over Normoth
description:
Taking inspiration from PS1 classics like Resident Evil and Silent Hill, Shadow over Normoth sets out to bring you back to the original survival horror experience. With fixed cameras, tank controls and visuals that are reminiscent of the good old days, you will truly feel like it's 1996 again.

Unravel the mystery behind the town of Normoth, gather resources and survive the horrors of this forsaken place. You will once again enter the world of survival horror... Good luck!

title: Northbury Grove: Walls Closing In
description: At the tattered ends of trauma...can you survive the Butcher of Northbury Grove one last time?

title: La Vie en Rose
description: In this beautiful rose-coloured world, which path will our love lead to?

title: Play Dead! #2
description: A story about a band, and their strange life on the road accompanied by a surprisingly lively dead dog.

title: Hedon Bloodrite
description: Immerse yourself in a crystalpunk underworld where the visceral combat of the 90s' FPS games blends with the exploration and puzzle solving of classic dungeon crawlers and adventure games.

title: Enter the Skinja
description: When cowboys and ninjas meet strange things happen... This was made for Haunted PS1 Jam 2020. It is an experiment in 2d & 3d space...a skins-periment.

title: Piece by Piece
description: Piece by Piece is a jigsaw puzzle platformer where each level is fragmented into jigsaw pieces. Clear each puzzle by connecting and disconnecting each piece to make your way through each of our 100 handcrafted levels. Discover new themes and mechanics along the way!

title: Arcadea
description: Follow Maisie on a quest across the fantastical world of Arcadea to find someone precious to her....

title: The Inn Between
description: A modern fantasy BL Visual Novel following a young mans journey into a parallel world to recover the past he's lost, and find his missing family. Alongside 3 attractive romance options, Myka Riley delves into the unknown.

title: Phantom Seeds
description: The events of this mysterious and sad tale take place in the traditional Asian rural landscape, and start on the day that a curious looking child enters a small village...

title: Honey Sweet Lies
description:
Discover the truth - but at what cost?

Honey Sweet Lies is a psychological horror mystery visual novel project. Throughout the game, you have 5 opportunities to ask various characters questions. But, be aware of getting too close to the truth, as some truths can be too hard to handle.

Pay attention to the World Warning System; a sign that you’re getting close to an unwanted truth, and to proceed and make decisions carefully.

title: Claude and the Phantom
description: A cartoon point-and-click adventure about a cursed painting and a ghost cat.

title: Wails For Freedom
description: Escape a haunted Asylum whilst riding on a wheelchair. Can you escape with your sanity or will madness consume you?

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege: Crystal Guard
description:
Introducing Crystal Guard, Rainbow Six Siege's third season of Year 6! This season, we're introducing our latest Operator, Osa, an engineering prodigy from Croatia who brings expertise to Nighthaven with her quick wits and unapologetic enthusiasm for '60s sci-fi movies.

This season is packed with a plethora of updates including changes to Operator armor and DBNO scoring as well as balancing for Twitch, IQ, Mute, and Fuze. Players also have a new way to customize Elite Uniforms.

title: Castle Morihisa
description: Castle Morihisa is a roguelike strategic deck-builder. You need to build up your deck through constant battles, acquire powerful talents, and wield the power of the Fallen Heroes to unveil the truth behind the rebellion in Castle Morihisa. When facing difficulties, you could also ask for assistance from the Sengoku fallen heroes with different skills, which could give you an edge during the battles.

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege: High Calibre
description:
Rainbow Six Siege introduces the fourth season of Year 6, High Calibre! Our newest Operator, Thorn, joins Rainbow as a Technical Weapons Expert from Ireland's Emergency Response Unit. Never one to back down from a challenge, her strength and leadership set a new course for Rainbow. Her Razorbloom Shell proximity grenade is as sharp as her temper.

This season we've integrated some select updates including Team Colors, a Bulletproof Camera Rework and changes on the Test Server. We're bringing balance to Finka, Drone Counters, Elite 2.0, and more! Read the Patch Notes below for full details.

title: For Honor: Season 19 - Tempest
description: Year of the Covenants: Season 3, named "Tempest," is the nineteenth season of the ongoing Faction War. Warriors prayed for an answer for their parched throats during the drought... and it was answered. But, the answer these warriors received from their gods was much more than simple rain, but a roaring storm, ready to wipe all who remained unprepared.

title: Romancing Kanon: Eien no Shoujo Densetsu
description: RPG game released in 2002 in the Japanese comic market. The latest version is 1.5 A.

title: Conqueror's Blade: Season IX - Tyranny
description: The new Seasonal Campaign invites you to rise up against an evil Tyrant with your rebel armies, take back the devastated Borderlands, and claim epic rewards from the Battle Pass.

title: Sea of Thieves: Season 5
description: Grab a grog and don your best party finery – Sea of Thieves Season Five’s boatload of Voyage-enhancing features arrives December 2nd! Bury loot for safety or share your treasure maps with curious crews, employ fresh strategies and schemes with the Cannon Rowboat or simply celebrate another year of free content updates by pulling up a pew to ‘ooh’ and ‘ahh’ at a flashy fireworks display. No matter what style of scoundrel you play, there’s sure to be something for you to enjoy!

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds - Season 13
description: Season 13 will introduce a series of updates to the recently released Taego map, which is set in 1980s South Korea. Chief among these updates is the introduction of the Taego Secret Room, which will randomly spawn on the map and contains some of the best gear Survivors can find. However, players will have to discover a secret key before they can access the Secret Room!

title: One By One
description: One By One is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: Langton's Ant
description: Based on simple inputs, amazing patterns can be achieved!

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds - Season 14
description:
First up in this Season is the ability to pick up and carry a downed survivor. You can now throw them over your shoulders and bring them with you to victory.

Next up, Taego has received a lot of changes. Additional covers are added in some areas, and the terrain has also received improvements. Furthermore, Breakable Pots have items inside so break and loot! Error Space are special new zones marked on the map that can spawn items featured in other Battlegrounds, so make sure to check the map for locations.

In addition, Taego and Paramo have been added to the Ranked. The rulesets have also been changed accordingly, so check out the details below. Many changes have been made to Erangel’s hot place Pochinki, along with the Pony Coupe and Porter, Halloween decor and weather on Erangel, the new Trick-or-Treat Progressive M416, and more.

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds - Season 15
description: Season 15 comes to you with a map service update, a new vehicle (the mountain bike). balance and world updates, as well as some Christmas themed fun!

title: Ghostrunner: Project Hel
description:
Take control of Hel, one of the original games’ bosses, as she descends Dharma Tower on a bloody quest of her own. Designed to appeal to new players and veterans, she’s more combat-oriented and can survive an additional attack compared to the Ghostrunner.

Run on walls, soar through neon cityscapes, and slice through six levels while mastering Hel’s powers through her own ability progression system. Battle new enemies and bosses to the beat of six fresh tracks courtesy of electronic musician Daniel Deluxe.

title: AirlineSim
description: In AirlineSim, players build their own virtual airlines using realistic fleet management, flight scheduling, network planning and monitoring tools. Get ready to compete for passengers in a real time market and make your airline stand out from the others in this browser-based simulation game!

title: Terminator: Resistance - Annihilation Line
description: Annihilation Line is a new narrative DLC campaign for Terminator: Resistance and picks up mid-way through the main campaign story. The DLC sees Jacob Rivers and a small team of Resistance soldiers led by Kyle Reese heading into the most dangerous territory imaginable...the land beyond the Annihilation Line.

title: Dead Cells: The Queen and the Sea
description: Dead Cells: The Queen & the Sea will conclude the DLC trilogy that began with The Bad Seed in 2020 and continued with Fatal Falls in 2021. The new expansion will introduce two new biomes, called "The Infested Shipwreck" and "The Lighthouse"), new weapons, and of course a magnificent boss, which once you will be allowed to finish an alternate ending.

title: Pixel Dash
description: Pixel dash is a fast-paced platformer focused on allowing every player to feel what it is like to be a speedrunner.

title: CRSED: F.O.A.D. - Ice Age
description: There will be a lot of new items for the upcoming season, including new challenges, new items and ways to customize your champion, but that definitely isn’t all! In the new season, you’ll learn to be afraid of the cold, meet new Spirit Guardians, be able to shoot more effectively, and reveal new benefits of the Battle Pass!

title: CRSED: F.O.A.D. - Rock Solid
description: Welcome to the new season and the ‘Rock Solid’ major update in CRSED: F.O.A.D.!

title: CRSED: F.O.A.D. - Claws
description:
Long time familiar game mechanics will be transformed with this update! A new looting and inventory interface, changed Dark Zone mechanics, more user friendly ammo boxes instead of clips and magazines.

New weapons, outfits, tombstones with astonishing effects will make this season fun, and all those new things you can test in the “Game of Crowns” - where everyone is hunting the one.

title: CRSED: F.O.A.D. - Fangs
description: As you already know, the new season brings many new opportunities to outsmart, trap, and destroy your opponents, but that's not all!

title: Spellbreak: Chapter 2 - The Fracture
description: Play the new Dominion 5v5 capture and control mode as you rank-up in competitive Leagues and join the struggle against the nefarious Vowkeepers.

title: Spellbreak: Chapter 1 - The Spellstorm
description:
“We have to stop it. But in order to do that…we need you.”
Welcome to Chapter 1: The Spellstorm!

title: The Sims 4: Modern Menswear Kit
description: Revolutionize the classics with The Sims 4: Modern Menswear Kit, featuring a thought-provoking, accessible collection designed by Stefan Cooke. Reimagined shapes redefine traditionally masculine fashions, while textiles and patterns elevate each unique piece for today's style.

title: Hexblade
description: Take the curse sword and fight against the Blademaster and his monsters.

title: A Sister's Journey
description: Explore a charmingly beautiful, hand-crafted pixel art world and help Violet on her journey searching for her sister. Uncover its mysteries, face its threatening foes, and run 'n gun your way through this challenging action-metroidvania - which will put your true platforming skills to the test.

title: DNAxCat
description: In the virtual adventure world of DNAxCat, players can raise and breed a variety of cute meow warriors and fight side by side with them. And players can get more rewards through daily missions, PVE, and PVP systems in the game. At the same time, DNAxCat is also an economy in which ownership is totally decided by players, allowing players to seamlessly sell and trade their game assets into Token. DNAxCat wants to lead the trend of GameFi and “Play To Earn”, allowing players to earn by playing games.

title: Room of Batik
description: Batik themed escape room puzzle game.

title: The Rise of Dracula
description: You are Dracula and do what Dracula would do.

title: Inheritance
description:
Inheritance is a neo-noir detective visual novel where players step into the role of Detective Graves, locked in a psychological duel with Richard Alden, a suspect whose calm composure hides unsettling truths. Through branching dialogue, flashbacks, and shifting memories, the story unravels a haunting case about patterns, control, and the weight of what we inherit.

Inheritance places players in the middle of this psychological standoff, where truth and lies twist into a suffocating knot. As Graves, you are not only chasing answers — you are defending your own sanity. Each question you ask, each choice you make, draws you deeper into Alden’s mind games, and the line between hunter and hunted begins to blur.

Through flashbacks, branching dialogue, and atmospheric tension, the story reveals fragments of the case that brought you here — a case tied to power, betrayal, and a legacy soaked in blood. But nothing is ever what it seems. Even memory can be a weapon.

At its core, Inheritance is about more than solving a crime. It is about facing the past we carry, the truths we deny, and the consequences of digging too deep. Some answers, once spoken aloud, can never be taken back.

title: A Hole to Another Place SCP-1437
description: Short Experience with SCP-1437

title: Escape the Slender forest
description: Escape the Slender forest is a free Creepypasta visual novel made with Ren'Py.

title: Chimps on a Blimp
description:
GHXYK2, Swee Neezy, PilotRedSun, Penneh2006, GHXXXYK2, wolfpupy and Nick Flanagan present the 20th century’s hardest dirigible escape game:

Grow a brain to solve puzzles
Celebrate the Titanic of the dust bowl era.
How will the search for Amelia Earhart ever end?
Air Bud? Air Foe? Air Force One?
The Red Baron can spot any plane on the horizon.

But he couldn’t see this coming.

title: Soft Drizzle: B-Track
description: Soft Drizzle: B-Track is a short visual novel about friendship and Halloween Festivals. It even includes an escape room!

title: Facets
description: Don't give up yet.

title: Bit Jail
description: Bit Jail is an escape room game with an MS Paint theme. Play as Mr. Anderson who has been jailed in a house. Solve puzzles to find two house keys and escape the jail, or at least try to escape...

title: Starstruck Vagabond
description: Explore space. Deliver cargo. Make friends. Deliver more cargo.

title: Crunchy Lunch
description:
A story in sticky notes. Crunchy Lunch is a comedy game about when you take your lunch to work and IT'S SO LOUD THAT EVERYONE ELSE IN THE OFFICE HEARS IT!!!

It was created in 30 days for the game jam NaNoRenO 2018, using pen, paper, sticky notes, and a smartphone camera.

title: 10 Mississippi
description: A stop motion game about a daily routine.

title: Fiil Mark 37
description: Finish your masterpiece.

title: If One Thing Changed
description: What would your life be like... If one thing changed...

title: GearHead 2
description: Giant robot roguelike in space.

title: Melkhior's Mansion
description: A retro style tribute to the great 8-bit isometric games of the 1980's, set in a beautiful pixel art castle.

title: Terabey: The Room Builder
description: Decorate your room in this isometric style sandbox and let your creativity run wild!

title: Sloppy Shopping
description: A comedic combination of stealth and shopping

title: Mandrake Phantasy
description: ​The sun is setting. Please help.

title: Desolation Seed
description: Society is a decay system you are imprisoned as the reveled flesh that feeds the cybernetic wire, through a cryptic email chain Oceancide Systematics a mysterious corporation pays you to perform seemingly random acts of debasement against society on their behalf. they seethe within the darkened vomitoriums of computational networks. do these debased acts of destruction hold any meaning? can you break from out the hollow shell of pleasure systems? how far will they push you? how far will you go? Nothing can prepare you for the apex of human understanding.

title: Triple Jump
description: Triple Jump is an auto-running puzzle platformer where you have a library of different "jumps" that you can assign in any combination to three slots. You are then faced with levels that require some combination of those jumps to solve.

title: Exit Mask
description: Inspired by obsessive thought patterns and the compulsions that come with them, Exit Mask is an experimental art game where your biggest threat is yourself. Depicted in grainy black-and-white, this project details the experience of being plagued with ceaseless intrusive thoughts and the struggle to coexist with the uglier side within.

title: Memoryleak
description: Immerse yourself in MEMORYLEAK, a unique FPS that blends 2D, 3D, and VR gameplay. Set in 2000s Texas with a gripping narrative, it offers stunning Unreal Engine 5 visuals and a dynamic, interactive world. Ready for an adventure that redefines gaming?

title: Minima
description:
Minima is a short narrative exploration game about an 11-year-old boy named Ian, whose imagination brings his bedroom to life. The story is told without dialogue, using light, sound, and environmental interaction.
Players explore small, intimate scenes inspired by childhood memories, with a focus on observation rather than challenges. The game features minimalist visuals and a calm soundtrack, creating a reflective, atmospheric experience.

title: .Dog
description: This is the dog game in which you must jump onto all your foes in order to move to the next level. The game is super fun and rated for all ages.

title: Co-Pilot
description: The job of a pilot is taxing; non-stop work, hyper-specific scheduling, with only soulless computer screens for company. In order to help Pilot cope, her mind is split into two. Maybe she can keep herself company.

title: Light Weaver
description: First person puzzle game in a city lost to the waves.

title: Her Sign
description: The former janitor of a space station returns to Earth on a recruitment mission.

title: Flockoban
description: A text-less game about a shepherd and his day. Guide sheep to their sleeping spots.

title: Groundskeeper
description: The flowers call.

title: Campfire
description: a small camp fire, for getting away.

title: A Hero's Guide to Gardening
description: Interactive narrative game about emotional literacy and mental health

title: Planted!
description: What do you get when you combine gardening and extreme sports? A head-to-head ‘horticultural combat’ game for 1-4 players, where gardens are arenas and players battle for resources to Sow, Grow and Throw as much produce as they can at goals (and each other!!).

title: #Drive
description: #Drive is an endless driving video game inspired by road and action movies from the 70s and 80s. As simple as possible, allowing the player to pick a car, pick the place and just hit the road. Just be aware not to hit anything else. No matter where we drive, no matter what we drive or how fast we drive. We simply chose to drive.

title: Monarchies.io
description: Take on the role of a queen honey bee, build a colony, and dominate the field.

title: Toad Sushi
description: Toad Sushi is a small game where you have to beat your friends to get the sushi first.

title: Fluffland
description: Fluffland is a fantasy life simulation & visual novel hybrid.

title: Prison of Lies
description: Four innocent prisoners on death row must decide which among them will die to meet the prison's quota.

title: Portal 2: And the Abyss Gazes Back Part 1
description: Waking up on the wrong side of the bed is the least of your worries when being plunged to the bottom of Aperture Science's "bottomless" pits.

title: A Taste of the Past
description: Reconnect with your mother’s culture through food while navigating a train that goes deeper and deeper in time.

title: Shotgun Angelic
description: Short Touhou-but-backwards shooter for the 48 Secret Jam

title: Bigger Than Me
description: Point & click graphic (mis)adventure about Max, a young man full of uncertainties with a peculiar problem: he becomes giant everytime he hears the word 'FUTURE'. Puzzles, minigames and existential crises spiced up with humor in a story about growing up in a world that seems to be ending.

title: A New Don
description:
Fia grew up on her mother's hog farm, always dreaming about running away to the bustling city that dotted the horizon.

Just when she thinks this is all her life will ever be, a letter comes in the mail from an old eccentric man she used to call "Grandfather".

He asks her to come to the city so that he may give her something. When she gets there, it turns out that his gift is the ownership of his crime family!

But not everyone is excited to see Fia and internal tensions threaten to tear the family apart.

Can you survive the 6 days it takes to inherit the family?

Become the new Donna, or die trying.

title: Solipsism Reigns
description: A twisted tale of tortured love. Travel through various dimensions to seek the truth about yourself and the worlds around you. Your only constant will be your spirit companion, Kuro.

title: Terra
description: Jump, dodge, and claw your way through a cute and chaotic world in Terra!This casual platformer is packed with tricky platforms, weird monsters, and lovable characters. Can Terra make it through the obstacles and collect every last Magic Orb?

title: Locked Heart
description: A trip to the next town has diverted Aura to the infamous haunted De Lockes mansion... of talking toys?! Play as Aura as she breaks the curse and possibly strike a romance with one of the 3 bears.

title: Soulward
description: An ethereal platformer where your one tool is used as your life, transportation, and weapon.​

title: Powerglove
description:
Powerglove is a classic-era run 'n' gun game developed by Lazycow for the 30 year old Commodore 64 home computer, initially released as an entry in the 2013 RGCD 16K C64 Game Development Competition (where it placed 3rd out of 15 entries). The final version was released as a 16KB physical game cartridge in September 2014, complete with additional content and features.

Guide the hero through the polar thermal reactor complex, navigate the complex network of transport tubes, locate the five control diamonds and blast away every rogue robot that stands in your path!

title: Memorial Pillage
description: Venture into the cave...

title: Leticia Land
description: A classic little platformer for GBJam8

title: Dagdrom
description: Create colorful platforms to traverse levels.

title: Aloisius
description:
Defend your kingdom and outwit the AI in Aloisius!

Your subjects act similar to a widely known board game, but you can also construct buildings and harvest natural resources.

title: Stray Souls
description:
Enter a world of nightmares in this third person, action-horror, inspired by the classics of the genre. Fight terrifying creatures, solve mind-bending puzzles, and unravel a horrid family secret to expose the chilling truth behind your existence.

Unlock the secrets hidden within the haunted town of Aspen Falls, featuring gruesome enemy encounters, epic bosses, cunning puzzles, and a deep story where not everyone is who they seem. Play as Daniel – an average teenager whose life is forever changed after inheriting the home of his estranged grandmother and meeting a mysterious woman with intimate knowledge about his family, the house, and its shocking connection to his past. The gameplay elements inspired by classic horror combat with souls-like precision, put a fresh spin on the modern action-horror genre.

title: The Matter at Hand
description: A Card Game... Or a Puzzle Game?

title: Courage's Curse
description: King Ramses wants his slab back, even if it means killing you. (A Courage the Cowardly Dog horror game)

title: Luigi's Mansion 2D: Eternal Night
description: Luigi's Mansion 2D: Eternal Night is a Metroid styled fan game of the popular game series known as Luigi's Mansion, where you go through various rooms, clearing them by vacuuming up ghosts in order to save Luigi's brother Mario.

title: Dullahan
description: gameboy style action puzzle platformer

title: Crumble and Fall
description: A high tempo build and shoot game.

title: Alpha Squirrel
description: Rescue the stranded squirrels from the forest fire!

title: Sector Alpha
description: A boom compatible map from Async Unicorn.

title: Woofice Chair!
description: Welcome to Goodboi Park! Help the park defenders defend it from body-builders with their swivelling chairs!

title: Hexagon Hamlet
description: A casual building game for highscore hunters

title: Butterfly Collector
description: Butterfly Collector is a point-and-click adventure game inspired by escape rooms, Myst, and fantastical gardens. Play as a captured butterfly hybrid looking for a way to heal her broken wings.

title: A Broken City
description: There is no one here anymore, yet the trains continue to run.

title: Noise Snke
description: Noise Snke is a classic Snake game that writes its board state directly to your sound card. It is harsh and experimental. Headphones recommended only for the strong of heart.

title: Let There Be Cat!
description: Play as a cat, run around and break stuffs!

title: Meow Nights
description:
Two cats get lost on a magic and cloudy dungeon while looking for some delicious sky fish. They will have to find 5 fish each and then make their way towards each other, so they can go home and have a cozy sleepover.

There is a catch, however. The cats cannot see each other. For that reason, they have to follow their friend's "meow" ability so they make their way to the same room, after catching their share of snacks.

Once this happens, both cats must "meow" so they can free themselves from the cloudy dungeon.

title: Delirious
description: a short 3D horror game

title: Lord Clicker
description: Lord Clicker gathers Clicker and Tower Defense in one game. Find a good balance between peasants, defenses and village.

title: Submarine Samurai
description: Shred submarines with your battleship using explosives and powerups

title: Hidden Cats
description: Find and rescue cats!

title: Battle Gem Ponies
description:
A super-powered, shapeshifting pony RPG.

Command a super-powered, shape-shifting pony in this RPG Adventure! In a world where unpredictable legendary beasts pose an existential threat, you'll embark on a journey across the Pinto region to become the best pony tamer in the world and protect your magical companion from those who want to use her as a secret weapon.

Customize your team with hundreds of different moves, stat arrangements, & collectible battle gear to gain the upper hand in this rapid-switchout Rock/Paper/Scissors combat system.

A years-in-the-making love letter to the My Little Pony & Pokémon communities, celebrating one year of progress since the successful Kickstarter campaign!

title: South Scrimshaw, Part One
description: South Scrimshaw is the story of a newborn whale in a vast alien ocean. It is a richly illustrated experimental visual novel, written in the style of a nature documentary.

title: Wintersdawn in the Deep
description: Help young Quinlan complete his patrol in the dangerous forests of the Western Deep in this short adventure game!

title: Noble Fates
description: A 3D Fantasy Kingdom Sim driven by intelligent characters with a rich simulation of opinions and memories. Build, Craft, Farm, Mine, Hunt, Defend, and more! Command from the sky or take control in third person as your story goes where the people, your actions, and their reactions take it.

title: Mason and Strings
description: Mason needs Strings' help to learn how to play guitar so she can perform at the Castle Concert. Travel around Hub City to collect music sheets, solve puzzles, and interact with the many inhabitants! With Strings, you can grapple between platforms and play different chords using the Chord Wheel! Enjoy exploring a lively world and becoming a master musician!

title: Smilinguido: Desafio na Floresta
description:
The time has come!
Get a closer look at Smilingüido. Take part in a dangerous and fun adventure. Test your skills and limits inside the Brazilian forest. The challenge is great. The difficulties and dangers are enormous, but the mission is worth it.
Face the challenge and discover the great lesson that Jesus has to teach you, whom he loves and cares for!

title: Impious Pumpkins
description: Impious Pumpkins is a cute/spooky real time tactics game where you take control of your own ghostly army to defend their resting places from hordes of evil pumpkins!

title: Cloud Escape
description:
Cloud Escape is a fast-paced 3D precision platformer with countless traps, obstacles and cool movement mechanics. Whether you're dashing through the large, themed areas in Classic Mode or trying to climb to the top in the new game mode: The Tower.
Both game modes have their own worlds with unique challenges, traps, secrets and collectibles. In the new tower, you'll even encounter real enemies for the first time!

title: Super Mumtaz Bros.
description: In Super Mumtaz Bros. you join the titular plumbing brothers on their mission to rescue Princess Sana from... chickens?

title: Over My Dead Body
description: Over My Dead Body is a local multiplayer game where your goal is to be the first to die. Heal the others! Damage yourself! Kick the bucket! Goofy characters, fun stages and an overall colorful and cartoonish style come together to make up a fast-paced gameplay to share with friends.

title: Freetime Event: Poolside Edition
description: A Super Danganronpa 2 fangame about a freetime event with Komaeda Nagito.

title: Freetime Event: Theatrical Release

title: Momotype

The monotype, an off-shoot virtual pet, is being play-tested by members of your company. You have been selected.

An experimental, retro take on tamogotchi-lite games. Will you fulfill Momo's needs or does he need something greater?

title: Implements of Hell
description: Implements of Hell is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore the mysteries, unlock the secrets, and change the outcome in a slow-paced atmospheric, and extremely horrifying experience.

title: Ricochet Ranger
description: A top down arena shooter with only one bullet.

title: 3D Ultra Cool Pool
description: Do you love a good game of pool? Cool Pool has all your favorites - Eight Ball, Rotation, Cutthroat, Nine Ball, and Classic Pocket Billiards - on dazzling tables with a super-easy interface and with the option to use standard balls and custom balls. But Cool Pool also has five totally original "cool" games that'll curl your cue and which can be played both on a standard or a differently shaped "cool" table. They give pool a whole new angle of strategy, surprise, and fun!

title: Queue Simulator
description: Queue simulator brings you your favorite part of MMORPG experience - waiting in Queue!

title: The Citizen
description: The Citizen is a very short first person exploration game about learning to be a good citizen featuring an overly talkative person who doesn’t really like you.

title: Mission Improbable
description: Mission Improbable is a singleplayer mod for Half-Life 2: Episode 2. In it, Gordon Freeman is tasked with re-activating a Resistance listening post. From there, things quickly escalate.

title: Espionage: Mafia Evolved
description: A free-to-play social deduction game for PC and mobile devices in which you attempt to find your adversaries hidden amongst the other players. Set in 1958, role-based play rewards those who rely on strategy and their creative instincts.

title: Latish Destroyer
description:
Latish Destroyer is the game where you dynamically and fast destroy the corporation of one man - Latish.
You will meet multiple enemy types, which Latish's laboratories made especially to kill you, The Destroyer.
This game consists of 6 levels, where you have to complete the objective of it. Simply run through level destroying enemies and do some little activities. You are playing as a cool Dota 2 player named Roman.

title: Fortnite: Chapter 3
description: The island from Chapter 2 has been turned upside down... literally. Step onto the new island and explore every corner of an undiscovered world in Fortnite Chapter 3 Season 1: Flipped.

title: Precursor
description:
Precursor is a mod for Half-Life 2: Episode Two, created by Precursor Team.

It is set in City 17 prior to the events of Half Life 2. You assume the role of a resistance fighter during a Combine crackdown. Your goal is to evade your pursuers and flee the city. At the same time, a mysterious force is working towards ends unknown.

title: Hero of the Kingdom: The Lost Tales 2
description:
Save your city and your people from great evil and become a heroic princess.

You are having a small adventure outside the city walls. You are the princess, in the guise of a rogue. However, returning home is no longer possible. The city is on fire and the streets have been plundered by hordes of unknown monsters. People are leaving their homes in panic and seek refuge from certain doom. But this is your city and your people. You can’t lie idle. You have to protect your city and get allies to fight by your side against great evil. Gain courage and become a heroic princess.

title: Goalkeeper Training VR
description: VR Goalkeeping game! 3 different modes and a lot of fun!

title: Deep Down
description: Deep Down is a brand-new pseudo-medieval aesthetic themed IP from Capcom powered by its new Panta Rhei engine that is being developed for the PlayStation 4.

title: DC League of Super-Pets: The Adventures of Krypto and Ace
description:
DC League of Super-Pets: The Adventures of Krypto and Ace is a 2022 video game tie-in to the 2022 movie DC League of Super-Pets.

The player controls Krypto and Ace as they take to the skies to protect the animal population of Metropolis from a new and looming threat.

title: Ball Boys
description: Ball Boys is an online ball-racing championship where you play as a customizable ball and try to score the most points in various parkour challenges. You can roll, double-jump, dash, and maneuver in the air to try and navigate your way through various scenarios.

title: Chicken Attack
description:
Chicken Attack is a single player, 3-D, top-down, isometric game based loosely on the classic Breakout. It is the sequel to the game Chicken's Revenge.

The game features a hen who's out to rescue her chickens which have been captured and imprisoned. To secure their release our heroine fires a ball, 'Breakout style', at everything in her path. This clears the ground uncovers treasure which increases the score, pressure plates that allow her to advance and power-ups that may either help or hinder. All of which, if used carefully, will ultimately enable her to free the chicks. When the last chick has been freed the level is complete.

There are three types of game play, normal, easy and timed, in all the objective is to release the chicks and score points.

The game is entirely mouse controlled.

title: Cop Bastard
description: Cop Bastard - is a сlassic FPS takes place in the early 90s in Japan. Fight against yakuza, and other mobs...

title: Eve: Ghost Enemies
description: This game follows the story of its two protagonists: Kojirou Amagi and Marina Houjou, as they pursue the truth behind another mystery.

title: CBS: Escape from the Mall 3D
description: Escape the mall, don't let the cargo stop you on your way!

description:
Super Nanaru is a cute and pixel art concept.
A hardcore side-scrolling jumping platformer game.
Test the limits of the player
Obtain and use skins with various abilities
Defeat all bosses with strong power
Bring back all the bread!

title: Obgoose
description: Do you despise playing scrabble with others? The feeling that everyone knows more words than you? Well, now this time is over. Obgoose is a single-player non-competitive scrabble-like game where no one will ever know when you are obtuse.

title: Make the Jump
description: This is a 3D first person hardcore jumping game, where your enemy is time! Try to complete all three levels and get a trophy!

title: Humanities Legend: Hollow Ascending
description: A challenging yet forgiving souls-like action adventure. Parry, block, and dodge enemy attacks while exploring a ruined fort. Discover rich lore and epic boss fights.

title: Do Not Open
description: Survival horror game Do Not Open is a mix of escape room elements, plus it's said to be based entirely on true events. You're playing for Michael J. Goreng, "a well-known zoologist and epidemiologist imprisoned in his own home, where his wife and daughter are held against their will".

title: Indie Dev Story
description:
Quit your job to become an indie developer and make your first game!

A short single-player 'clicker' game which tries to mimic the frantic feeling of being an indie developer; make your game while trying to stay healthy, social and earning enough money to pay the bills.

How will your game do when it releases?

title: Tetragun
description: Tetragun is a top-down shooter where you play as a stationary turret and defend yourself against waves of enemies. As you progress through the waves, you will acquire upgrades to help you keep up with the growing strength and numbers of your enemies. The arena is split into 4 quadrants, and your turret will only be able to aim within the confines of the quadrant it is currently in. To aim at enemies outside of your current quadrant, you'll need to enter rotate mode with RMB and click on the quadrant you would like to rotate to. The goal of the game is to make it as far as possible, and get the highest score you can.

title: Void Inc
description: You are the Head of Tech at Void Inc., a rapidly growing SaaS startup where every decision creates another problem. Plan your day, survive frantic technical minigames, manage unstable staff and infrastructure, and try to reach the company's targets before stress consumes you.

title: Blocked Up
description:
A platforming match 3 puzzle game.
Swap blocks to clear them off the board, and keep enough space for your little guy to run around safely.

title: 100 Flaps
description: In 100 Flaps your goal is to get as high as you can without running out of flaps. Through collecting coins you are also able to unlock more birds as you go.

title: I Want to be Popular!
description:
Hey, you! Yes, you. Do you want to know what's this game about? Keep reading.

Have you ever felt the difficulties of having a public life in social media? Have you been annoyed by comments from people who hide in anonymity to say insulting things? Well, this game is for you!

title: Atom OI

title: Star Stealing Prince: Definitive
description: Beyond the stars and under the flakes of fallen snow, a kingdom sleeps.

title: Merc Tactics
description:
Merc Tactics is a top-down tactical turn-based RPG in which you engage in epic tactical shootouts.
The game takes place in a region where civil war has left the country in chaos. The Khondo, a vicious band of looting militia have taken control of the country. You lead a small squad of mercenaries, who have vowed to restore order and rid the country of the Khondo.

You need to carefully plot your way through the region, recruiting mercenaries, upgrading your skills procuring armour and weapons and forming alliances with friendly militia. Each location in the campaign map hosts hostile militia, which you must fight in turn-based squad combat.

When your squad is strong enough you can confront the ringleader militia, but it will not be easy.

Nearly everything in the game is randomly generated, including the campaign map, enemy and resource locations. Scene layout and buildings are procedurally generated, leading to a huge variety of different scenes which your squad has to fight through.

title: Tonight We Hunt
description: The Valoré town is being attacked by four spirits under the Hoarsing Box Devil’s leadership. Your mission as hunter is to free the town and fight in amazing stages against these spirits.

title: Whale Eater
description: Puzzle game about exploring a living, breathing whale

title: Trust the blackbird
description: Trust the blackbird is a hand-drawn 2d game made in a form of comics with lovely watercolour illustrations. Follow the heart-warming story about meeting new friend and following the dreams. As the story unfolds, couple of light puzzles will be on your way.

title: Code Bunny
description:
The planet of Lumna is threatened by a group of terrorists called Mad Bunny! Join Axel and Hazel on their mission to fight them, as they discover more about the world and its people, in this fast-paced 2D-action platformer!

Code Bunny is a momentum-based, melee-oriented platformer where the action is nonstop! Master both character's play styles to deliver flashy and exciting attacks that rip and bounce through enemies and levels!

title: Best Romance Game Ever
description: The Absolute Ultimate Best Romance Game Ever...

A disconcerting pseudohorror walking journey through noisecore purgatories. Study the 5 glyphs of silence and cross the dead river with Wōden...

Are all first loves this bittersweet?

Quiet, shy and anxious, confessing to your crush takes every ounce of your courage. And when it all goes wrong, the last space left that is safe is the roof. But when a kind hand offers a carton of lemonade, how will your paths collide?

description:
The Year Is 1968. Trying to sleep amid academic pressure, pretending to be alright, and a raging thunderstorm outside of your dorm room, all you have to do is get in bed and get some rest. If only your dreams would cooperate...

Rain And Red Roses is an English Yume Nikki fangame created for Dream Diary Jam 4. It primarily uses Alice in Wonderland as its theme mixed with 1960's aesthetic. The goal is to explore and collect effects, with the option to collect four counts of red paint as well, which unlocks a different ending.

title: Miss Bullard's School for Former Ladies
description: A Victorian fantasy lesbian romance, set in a boarding school for women who are not quite as human as they once were.

Cook up a variety of skewers to warm bellies and hearts as you cross paths with travellers on their own journeys.

Here's the best, smol and adorable shark! Gawr Gura!!!
She's from the mysterious deep sea city Atlantis. However the people can't find the city anymore. Gura decided to take an adventure! Help her to eat some food, beat the bad guys and find Atlantis! Maybe something still left there then Gura can keep it safe...

It stars Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, Yuuka Kazami and Mima and features many Touhou characters from the PC-98 and Windows canon, along with several characters from the Mother series and a few fan-made characters. The majority of the outside influence and references comes from EarthBound, but other notorious video games are paid homage as well.

title: Sfare: Relax your mind

Take control of a boy or girl character and run and jump around in several biomes, collecting coins or food bonuses as the world moves and reacts dynamically to an audio file on your system; affecting the ground beneath your feet, some objects, and even the weather.

Hyperreal realtime 70bpm.

Connect programmable Node-Terminal machines and create a sonic singularity.

title: Athemore
description: Explore the underground ruins of Athemore and learn about the forgotten past. Will you make it out alive?

title: The Peak
description: What will you find on your climb up the mountain?

title: Bludgeons & Krakens
description:
Bludgeons & Krakens is a turn-based, open world RPG in which the player must seek out and destroy, or outwit, the seven Beasts of Destruction threatening the land of Abraxas.

Keep It Classy (Or Don't). Build your character from one of five classes: Fighter, Paladin, Ranger, Rogue, or Druid. Play to the strengths of your class or define your own style through mastering weapon skills and magic abilities.
Explore a Strange World. Quests and secrets abound in every corner of Abraxas. Engage in a variety of side quests with multiple endings, or simply wander the land in search of your fortune.
Loot the Bodies. Take on hordes of foes in turn-based combat. Sling spells, quaff potions, rend your enemies, and reap the glorious rewards. When your skills are honed, seek out powerful bosses who will truly challenge your abilities.

title: Nivearum
description: Print a map, mark your path, or be lost forever.

title: 51 Baffes

title: A-Maze Batz

It was in active development for about four years before the developer went on hiatus. After a long pause in development with no updates, the game was cancelled but remains released and available in an unfinished state.

title: Octet

title: Sokker Mayhem

title: Thine Cometh

Dirk McSteel is a knight who's not good at fighting, but is at running. He's decided to try raiding the Dungeon of Forgotten Spine Monsters in search of the Five Treasures of Complacency.

Many have died here, but none were as fast as him.

title: Assimilate

title: Helen's Doll House
description: Helen's Doll House is a doll collection game with visual novel elements.

title: Astlan
description: A gravity game for PC. The gameplay is all about controlling a ship versus the inertia and gravity

title: Satanya's Adventure: All You Need is Melonpan
description: A casual game with a moe demon girl.

title: In Next Life
description:
In next Life is a crafting, survival, and civilization building game, where collaboration with other players gives you very real advantages (it is possible to play alone, but it will be harder to survive). Your technology level starts at stone age level, and then it's up to you and your village members to invent and craft tools and technologies such as fire, baskets, spears, ..., in order to survive easier and to advance to new development stages. Time moves quickly and each game played equals one life, including birth, childhood, adulthood and old age.

The goal of each life is to contribute as much as possible to the survival and development of your village, children and future descendants. What you leave behind will be the foundation for others to keep building on. The flint spear you invented one life, could turn out to be the difference between survival and annihilation for your whole civilization. There are hundreds of objects you can craft, collect, cook, and eat. We intend to add at least 1,000 more during the Early Access period.

title: Maestro

title: Ashes: Afterglow
description: Reprise your rule as a "scav" in this post-apocalyptic first-person shooter. A voice on the radio is calling for you. Find this mysterious "Athena" and you might finally get some answers. Be mindful of your choices along your journey or face unintended consequences.

title: Puzzle Inlay
