title: Slide-A-Lama
description:
Slide-A-Lama is a two player 2D strategy/puzzle game. The goal is to collect most points by matching at least three tiles of the same type in a five-by-five grid. Players take turns to insert their current tile in one of the rows or columns. If a column is full, the bottom most tiles is crushed, if a row is full, tile falls at the opposite end out of the grid. Once three or more tiles of a kind form a line, the player is awarded points depending on type and number of tiles. With each 60 points of difference between the two players, one of the ten lamas switches the side. The game ends once the first player has all the lamas on their side.

The game became popular as a flash game ICQ users could play against their contacts. It later appeared on several mobile platforms and as a website.

description: Based on the successful Windstorm movies and best-selling books, experience exciting riding tasks together with Windstorm and freely explore the breathtaking surroundings of the Kaltenbach estate. Ride alongside other horses, look for hidden objects and try to become the racing champion. Numerous secrets and hidden locations are waiting to be discovered! After a long day of adventuring across the beautiful hills of Kaltenbach, take care of your animal friend with all of your love! Grooming, scraping out hooves and much more is necessary to keep your newly made friend in good shape.

title: My Last First Kiss
description: The Story: Even after all these years, you haven’t forgotten about your first love. You try confessing your feelings to him, but he turns you down. Luckily the friends you grew up with are there to help mend your broken heart… until that night, when you become more than just friends… Characters: Ayato Hidaka "The Likeable Popular Guy" Ichiya Misono "The Unfriendly Lone Wolf" Makoto Morimachi "The Loyal Older Brother" Takamune Kitami "The Passive Soccer Player" Riku Morimachi "The Quiet Younger Brother" Contents: Includes "Main Stories" in the app "Love 365: Find Your Story," up until "Delivering the News"

title: Last Bastion
description: Nonstop, fast paced castle defense shooting action against relentless armies of evil in a dark, brooding atmosphere.

title: Mutation of J.B.
description:
You control a young boy called Johnny Burger who plans to visit his cousin Emanuel for two weeks. As he arrives he finds him gone. A scientist, who's also looking for Johnny's cousin, comes by and offers Johnny 500DM (Deutsche Mark) for an experiment. Of course, the experiment goes awry. During the procedure a mysterious guy flashes the scientist's memory. The emerging irritation causes the professor to start pushing random buttons, which results in Johnny's transformation as a human pig. After Johnny wakes up the professor is gone, too, as he was kidnapped to the Planet Ladea.

So, Johnny's quest comprises of finding the professor to be transformed back into a normal state and finding out what happened to Emanuel.

title: Floragram
description:
Write a few words for someone dear to you, without naming them.

End your message by pressing the validation key, and see the vegetation on the island grows ~

Done in 48h-ish during Zoomachines 2016, Floragram was originally playable with a real typewriter.

title: Evelyn's Farm
description: To save money for college, you and your friends Ivan and Lucy have agreed to help an old lady, Evelyn, with the harvest. What could possibly go wrong? As you pick pumpkins and apples, you notice a barn full of incomprehensible machines and a forest full of unfriendly creatures. Clearly, there's more to Evelyn than meets the eye...

title: Sloppy Eater
description:
Get to the end of the supermarket without running out of blood!
This game was originally developed for the 2021 GMTK Game Jam.

title: Strange Horticulture
description: An occult puzzle game in which you play as the proprietor of a local plant store. Find and identify new plants, pet your cat, speak to a coven, or join a cult. Use your collection of powerful plants to influence the story and unravel Undermere’s dark mysteries.

title: To the Ones We Lost
description: To The Ones We Lost is an emotional storydriven adventure/horror singleplayer game about mental health. Main character seeks for answers to what happened with his best friend until things start to get weird and he begins to question his own mental health.

title: Laptop Tycoon
description: Welcome to Laptop Tycoon! Compete with the tech giants! You will have the opportunity to show your skills in business management. Start your own laptop company! Choose and hire the best people for your company, buy and upgrade your own office and start building your dream laptop.

title: D.I.R: Death is Random
description: Death is Random (DIR) is an entry-level post-apocalyptic RPG zombie randomizer with survival elements, auto-battle and replayability. The main objective is to find all needed vehicle parts to escape the city. All key items are shuffled across the seven maps and you need to explore every single one to grab resources and find the fastest way to get out.

title: Free Heroes of Might and Magic II: Resurrection
description:
Free Heroes of Might and Magic II (fheroes2) is a recreation of HoMM2 game engine.

This open source multiplatform project, written from scratch, is designed to reproduce the original game with significant improvements in the gameplay, graphics and logic (including support for high-resolution graphics, improved AI, numerous fixes and UI improvements), breathing new life into one of the most addictive turn-based strategies.

title: Worst World
description: Worst World is a Hardcore zombie multiplayer survival game. Survive in a post apocalyptic world, collect resources and set up camps. Make friends or join a micro society of survivors. The World does not give you a gift. No crosshair, menu, life bar. You can be happy to breathe and to have spent the night every day.

title: Pinni and the Lost Voice
description: Pinni and the Lost Voice is a classic adventure platformer with a cute hand-drawn art style. Play as Pinni, a brave little doggy in a mysterious dreamland where the sun and the moon have stopped moving!

title: Showa American Story
description: Showa American Story is a brand new RPG and an enthusiastic love letter to the 80s' pop culture that features a strong taste of B-Movies. Follow Choko's journey of truth and revenge across North America as she grows stronger.

title: Sycamore
description: Sycamore is my submission for LSDJAM 2023, made in 5 days. It's a short top-down game with a surreal look. The goal is to find items hidden in the worlds you reach. The game is focused on exploration, so you'll have to interact with the level to find. There's a planets order, so keep this in mind. The game has two states: When you're in the planets and when you're in the spaceship. The spaceship controls quick, while the cowboy controls at a slower pace.

title: Technicity
description: A first-person city-building game with powerful tools that allow you to build faster and bigger. Design your own construction blocks and furniture in factories, terraform the open world, build roads and use vehicles to travel to different cities that you or your friends create in solo or coop mode.

title: Ohr Oni
description: Ohr Oni is an Ao Oni spinoff game created with the OHRRPGCE (Official Hamster Republic Role Playing Game Creation Engine), a program that was pretty popular in the late 90s/early 00s pre-RPG Maker years. It is made in the style of late-80s Famicom games like Sweet Home and MOTHER, so if you’ve ever wanted to be chased around by a very cute, chunky 8-bit Oni, then this is your chance. The game is veeeeerrrry short (for players on their second playthrough, it can be cleared in less than 15 minutes) and has two endings.

title: Hololive Error
description: Hololive Error is a survival horror game where an occult magazine journalist decides to visit the town of Aogami to investigate its strange happenings.

title: Via Negativa
description: A Religious Comedy/Horror Game

title: Panicked and Surrounded by Hot Vampires
description: In the harsh season of Winter, 47-year-old Chester H. Smith was sent out to survey a property that wasn't on the registry. When he goes to inspect the house, he finds that the two owners, Dez and Viscardi, are vampires! He finds himself trapped with these strangers until the winter storm passes over. Will Chester make it out alive? Will sparks fly between him and one of the vampiric homeowners?

title: Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel - Handsome Jack Doppelganger
description: Play as the crazy and irresistible tyrant-to-be ... or at least his double. With the Beau Jack Double pack, use your charms and quite simply your good looks to achieve your ends with your enemies. Or put them where they belong with your inimitable jokes. Or kill them. It works well too.

title: Castle of the Red Prince
description: Castle of the Red Prince is a small text adventure with a different perspective on how locations can work in a parser game.

title: Pullywog
description: Leap to the Top in a challenging platformer that follows the journey of a small frog on a big adventure. The goal is simple: climb to the top of the world! But the journey is far from easy. Do you have what it takes to make the leap to the top?

title: Sloppy Eater: Meal Deal Edition
description:
A new and improved version of the classic sloppy eater game!
Get to the end of the supermarket without running out of blood!
This game was originally developed for the 2021 GMTK Game Jam.

title: Roboplant
description: Design, build and manage your own hydroponic farm on Mars. Place buildings and machinery, hire robot workers, grow food, research new technologies, manage contracts and avoid being destroyed by random space events!

title: Atoll: The Last Ghost
description: Come and save us.

title: Blockman 1989
description:
In trying times like these, the world needs a hero!

Blockman is back in an all new adventure! Return to the skies and take down a new threat and restore peace and order to the ski resort!

Blockman 1989 is a direct sequel to the cult favorite, Blockman 1988. Play as John Q. Blockman - the 'Q' stands for 'Qube' - and take down a new terrorist threat that's cutting into his vacation. Buy upgrades and expand your arsenal, and get creative with your kills. Blockman 1989 is a platformer made for the retro enthusiast, with tight controls, and old-school game mechanics (with a modern twist).

In light of world news, Blockman 1989 will be free for all. I hope you enjoy playing Blockman 1989 as much as I did making it. <3 i3

title: Refraction: Beyond the Mirror
description: Refraction is a first-person survival horror game about escaping The Mansion that has trapped you inside itself. The Creature is out on the hunt. Explore the house, find the Runes and the Altar, hide away from the Creature, and use the Mirrors to learn all of the secrets of the house to escape it!

title: Tamriel Rebuilt
description: Tamriel Rebuilt is a long-running fan effort to expand the borders of The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind beyond the cut-down area shipped with the original 2002 game. Although incomplete, interested players are encouraged to download the mod and play through its hundreds of hours of content, the fruit of nearly two decades of work.

title: Bapbap
description: Join BAPBAP, the Roguelike Party game where no two matches are ever the same. Round up your homies, pick a character, and build a giga-unfair build that'll make them hate you - then do it all over again!

title: Projekt Melody: A Nut Between Worlds!
description: Projekt Melody: A Nut Between Worlds! is a high-quality next-gen hentai game, a 3D sci-fi dating Game with roleplay elements.

title: MER Innebandy
description: MER Innebandy is a game based on Floorball. It features the entire Svenska Elitserien – the national league of Sweden – with real teams and actual players as of the 1996 season.

title: Oxide: Room 104
description:
A bone-chilling body-horror game with escape room gameplay. Bad decisions have brought Matthew to this terrifying motel. Now it’s up to you to decide how to escape – will you make it out alive?

Combining escape room gameplay and action, Oxide Room 104 is a bone-chilling single-player body-horror game set inside an old motel. Abducted, at the mercy of a ruthless scientist, and stalked by a horrible creature, you must try to escape using common sense, just as you would in real life. Can you get out of Oxide?

title: Sulka
description:
Help Sulka find a new home!
A game made in 60 hours with 20 tiny levels to solve!

title: Camp Wars
description: First-person shooter, science fantasy. Slime Weapons. No deaths.

title: The Living Handra
description: Explotre the empty Russian streets, filled with depressive athmosphere. Find all the interesting places. Feel the sharm of an lately abandoned post-soviet town. Walk through all the streets and avenues you can find.

title: Towns Battleground
description: Towns Battleground Is a new war strategy game, the game players need to pass the reasonable placement of arms to fight, is a test of the ability of platoon arrangement!
Sensei challenge you! This is a hardcore arcade game in which you will need to complete level in less than 5 seconds!

title: Vektor Z
description: Vektor Z brings fast and furious retro space blasting action to Steam! Blast your way through endless waves of asteroids and enemies to write your name among the stars! Vektor Z offers both relentless action and vibrant visuals that is certain to have you playing again and again!

title: Escape From Eternity
description: A satisfying shooting game with 3 game modes and simple controls! Kill all the monsters that appear in front of you!

title: Graveyard Spells
description: Graveyard Spells is a fast FPS inspired by 90's games, and combines elements of classic retro-shooter with low poly style. Graveyard Spells is an experience from beyond the grave.

title: Defend from Candyland!
description: Step into the world of Defend from Candyland! where retro tower defense meets strategic depth. Plant and upgrade trees, use powerful buffs, and reveal enemy paths to shield Eden from waves of candy invaders. Master the challenge now!

title: Search All: Christmas
description: Search All: Christmas is a game in the genre of "hidden object", in which you need to find all the Christmas candy in the form of a cane (caramel cane) on a large location drawn in the style of "doodling".

title: Leading the Dead
description: A lot of zombies are inducted in Leading the Dead. You can try thrilling experience never before. Revenge the stupid people by destroying the barricade that is the only weak point in the wall.

title: Haunted Hotel: Silent Waters - Collector's Edition
description: You won't enjoy your stay...

title: Extreme Race
description: In this challenging game you control a car that has no brake and only gains more speed. All you have to do is collect the coins and not crash into the other cars. Collect coins and buy new vehicles.

title: Rock Star Manager
description: Manage your own music studio, hire bands, schedule shows and pay your bills.

title: Karen Sees
description: Nightwatch Bob faces chaos erupting at his mall when a bloodthirsty Karen breaks in! Escape the terrifying AI using your webcam to see you!

title: The Vision of the Ant
description: A monster-catching, dungeon-crawling RPG. Delve into mysterious dungeons, capture and train a diverse roster of unique monsters, and unleash them in intense, strategic turn-based battles. Level up your team, discover hidden secrets, and unlock powerful abilities.

title: Save Billy
description: Save Billy is a colorful and enjoyable side-scrolling platformer. Pirates kidnapped K., Bv. buheire of our hero Ronald, help him save her.

title: Size It
description: Size It is an action puzzle game that will send you to help a mad scientist who created a device to resize his body.

title: Meow Express
description: You are a cat on a robot vacuum cleaner. Which means you are bus driver in the cat world! Dodge obstacles, pop innocent kids' baloons, dash through buildings to collect your fellow cat pussengers. Meow Express is a cute, fun and annoying casual arcade game, just like our furry friends.

title: Laser Bounce
description: Move and rotate pieces to get the laser to hit the goal. Colored lasers, gates, and activators add additional challenge to this relatively simple concept. Can you complete all of the levels?

title: Roads of Rome: Portals - Collector's Edition
description: By some quirk of fate, a group of brave Romans found themselves in mysterious worlds. Help them find their way back home. Build settlements, clear paths, defeat enemies. All for the glory of Rome! Open portals and caches - help the heroes survive!

title: Bouncy Goat Climb
description: Bouncy Goat Climb is a highly punishing 3D precision platformer about a goat bouncing up a beautiful mountain to save its scared baby goat. Can you handle the challenge and endure all obstacles that you will face on your way up the mountain?

title: Elif
description: Elif is a 3rd person puzzle-platformer. You will experience a wholesome narration following the main character Elif. You will have to face challenges and succeed in all trials. But you won't be alone: your favorite friend and companion Crocus will be there to help you!

title: Asteroides
description: it's simple, fast, rocking, without pauses, without life, without time will you save the earth? Asteroides is a 70/80s shooter with realistic physics and a completely three-dimensional environment. Moving, destroying and surviving is complicated in an infinitely finite space.

title: Blazend
description: Blaze through 7 action packed levels in this sci-fi shoot 'em up made to test even the toughest of shmup veterans. No tricks and no gimmicks; all you have is your raw skill. Board the Phoenix G7, and blast those alien lifeforms to interstellar space!

title: The Royal Game of Ur 3D
description: The oldest board game known to mankind!

title: Mafia: Family's Secret
description: Mafia: Family's Secret is a top-down shooting game. Kill your enemies, go through all the missions and discover the secrets of Guidice mafia family.

title: NinNinDays 2
description: A young man is dazing off while working the night shift at a convenience store, when a girl stops in to ask for a meat bun. The one next to her appears to be her boyfriend, and after doing their shopping, the two of them link arms affectionately and take off. Just when the young man is thinking how nice it would be to have a girlfriend, a pair of girls in ninja cosplay show up.

title: Our Summer Festival
description: This summer fair is bursting with activities! Grab a Joy-Con controller with up to 3 of your friends and join in the fun and games! Check out the festival-themed games like Takoyaki Cooking, Whac-a-Mole, and Mikoshi Racing! Try your hand at all the games in order as part of the Festival Master Championship, build up your own Coin Collection, and challenge yourself to get your best score yet! Pick your favorite of the 8 characters and enjoy a total of 10 exciting games!

title: PopSlinger
description: PopSlinger is a vibrant, narrative-focused musical shooter inspired by ‘80s and ‘90s New Retro culture. Join Ria Carbon, a funky heroine on a stylish quest to save the world from sinister invaders from another dimension using soda-powered guns. Backing Ria up is former PopSlinger heroine, Gin! Experience the whimsical story of Ria and Gin as they fight against the "Corazones", people whose hearts have been corrupted by the dark forces from the other dimension, all while grooving to a fully dynamic soundtrack that reacts to your in-game performance in real-time.
Have you done everything you need?

title: GZ P.T.
description:
GZ PT is a standalone non-profit GZDOOM based remake of Hideo Kojima's Playable Teaser. While not a 1:1 remake, every sequence has been recreated as close as possible to the original, with low res assets and textures in true retro fashion.
Will you manage to escape the haunted corridor?

This game is completely standalone, only GZDOOM is required to play!

title: Dragoncrest RPG: Arc 1
description: Adventures await you in the lands of the Dragoncrest Empire. Set out in search of fame, fortune and mastery of the many adventurer skills in this Zero-to-Hero Adventure RPG series! Brought to you by a team of fellow gaming enthusiasts with a passion for the RPG Genre and playing Dungeons & Dragons. The games in this series are designed like playable volumes of a Light Novel written in the expandable story style of a D&D Campaign.

title: Hidden Motives: The Diamond Rush - Collector's Edition
description: Embark on a journey through the Wild West! You're an actress taking on the role of the sheriff's daughter in a film called Gold Rush! The director gives you a mysterious ring that transports you back to the Wild West times. While we find out the cause of the town mayor's death that we have witnessed, we stumble upon Wild Jack, a criminal who threatens all the locals with a mysterious Diamond Ghost haunting the mines. We later learn that our father has been trying to catch Wild Jack for years. Will he manage to escape punishment for his new crime in this new Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure?

title: At Home Alone Final
description: A leisure healing mini-pixel plot game exploring at home. Players will wander at home from the perspective of a little girl. What will she do when she is alone? What strange stories will be encounters in this process? During the exploration, maybe... you can even find some weird secrets?

title: Krabat: The Secret of the Sorbian King
description:
"Krabat" is a classic point-and-click adventure game about the famous Sorbian fairy-tale figure Krabat.
Adventure scenes drawn by hand which take you to historic events and places such as Moritzburg Castle near Dresden, or to Bautzen.
Authentic Sorbian voice recordings and optional subtitles in English, German, Lower and Upper Sorbian.

title: Vampire Survivors
description: Mow thousands of night creatures and survive until dawn! Vampire Survivors is a gothic horror casual game with rogue-lite elements, where your choices can allow you to quickly snowball against the hundreds of monsters that get thrown at you.

title: The Candyman
description: The Candyman is a short horror retro PS1 style video-game, where you explore an abandoned manor during Halloween night. What secrets will you find inside, and what or who lurks in the dark?

title: Aisu Kuriimu Simulator
description: Ice Cream Simulator is a game about making ice cream.

title: Peculiar Fables: The Werebed
description: The Werebed is a small horror parody story about The Werebed.

title: Daikoukai Jidai III: Costa del Sol
description: The third release in the Uncharted Waters series, it was only released for PC and Mac and is exclusive to Japan.

title: Box's Dream
description: Box's Dream is an elegant puzzle game in which you'll have to push boxes to the correct positions, but it won't be easy, as various challenges such as ice floors, holes, pistons and many others await you in this exciting and unforgettable experience.

title: Tube Adventures Offline Collection 1-3
description:
Recreation in Unity in offline version of the video games originally created by Víctor Losa Regañón, alias pinofas on YouTube.

This recreation brings together the first 3 installments (Tube Adventures 1-3) and makes them playable offline with controls similar to Youtube, with an interactive timeline in each video. It also contains a system of Merits as Achievements; basically the endings, collectibles and secrets (eg access to Hall of Fame) that could be originally unlocked in each installment. Once each Merit has been obtained, it can be viewed again in its corresponding Merits section from the main menu.

title: Oz World
description:
Oz World was a virtual world social MMORPG with an emphasis on meeting others as well as dating. Players could build their own in-game homes, collaborate on fishing, get married, and participate in various social activities. There was also a personals component to the game.

Oz World mostly focused on fishing and collaboration rather than quests and combat, but there were in-game events and tons of customization options for those who wanted a casual relaxing MMO space. The game also had an item shop for extras.

title: The Patrick Polly Swooshball Challenge
description:
The Patrick Polly Swooshball Challenge is a game with a mix of Pong and Tennis.

The game concept is based on a major commercial campaign by Candelia, one of the leading candy manufacturers in Scandinavia. Released as freeware, people had to send in 5 scanned barcodes from bags of Polly in order to receive the game.

title: Party Paradise
description:
A cancelled strategy sim game where you would organize parties.

Release was supposed to be Q1 2002.

title: Point of Light
description:
A new game was created to impress people and give them something new!

The colors are chosen carefully to immerse player in the atmosphere of the game.

Avoid the figures and reach the highest score, with the points you can buy not only the skins but also new figures for developing your skills.

And stay concentrated! The game does not spare anyone!

title: Forget-Me-Knot
description:
Forget-Me-Knot is a short video game in which the player embodies the character of an elderly man, Harold. Confined to the living room that has become his world, the player shares his confusion and disability.
Through a series of interactions with objects in his environment, it becomes apparent that Harold is suffering from Alzheimer’s disease - affording the player the insight into his condition which Harold himself lacks. The game aims to raise awareness of Alzheimer’s disease and provide a first-person perspective of living with this condition.

title: BallFrog
description:
Use fun and experimental controls to roll ball frog around awesome environments!
Use Ball Frogs tongue as a grappling hook to grab, swing and fling Ball Frog through the map! Check Points are used so you don't lose progress and will save your checkpoint for the next time you play.
Since this game uses physics a lot, we have many mechanics that can bounce, swing and even pop you as you play through the game.
The in game currency "Flies" can be collected throughout the game and can be spent in the shop to buy cosmetic hats and skins!

title: Wall Street Raider
description: Wall Street Raider offers the deepest stock market simulations in gaming history. Control publicly traded corporations, futures, options, and even crypto. Whether you want to make billions in equities, short-sell overvalued stocks, or hedge risk using derivatives, the market is yours to conquer!

title: Hyperbaroque
description: A shoot'em up inspired by classics of the genre such as Touhou and Gradius. With an out-there artistic direction that epitomizes the game's name: Hyperbaroque.

title: Newgothic Movement 1
description: My little repository of insane slaughter maps. Movement 1 released because I wanted to focus on Uacultra 2 with 40oz. So about the maps, this wad contains 18 gothic, industrial, or hell-themed maps, many are actually a bit of a combination of themes. Expect numbers of monsters around the largest slaughter maps you've encountered, or possibly more. But the gameplay in most will be a little easier cause I overstock powerups.

title: Leap
description: Leap is a fast-paced, multiplayer first-person shooter featuring epic battles with up to 60 players, each armed to the teeth. Become an elite Leap mercenary as you soar into battle. Fight for either the United Earth Defense Coalition (UEDC) or the rebel Exo-Terrans - whoever pays the most, wins your trigger finger and excessive arsenal.

title: Raskopnik: The Trench Warrior
description: Raskopnik: The Trench Warrior it's not just grid-based roguelike game in World War II setting. This is the shrill story about valiant adventure of brave soviet sergeant against Nazi's horde. The story about the Trench Warrior who is destined to squash the Reich and save the Motherland on his own.

title: Azar
description: Azar is a top view shoot'em up where you and your friends must rebel against the violence of the police and the lies of the mainstream media! Get prizes in robberies and damage to property! Have fun in various different scenarios full of shooting action, hard bosses to defeat and a lot of glass to break!

title: Dungeonball
description: Dungeonball is a first-person dodgeball roguelike. Use your hands and throwing power to fight your way through the dungeons.

title: Di-Da-Dobble
description: A weird Yahtzee-like toy. Roll your beloved dice, collect cool props like plants, worms, and snacks by opening presents, and climb the ranks on the di da dobble leaderboards!!!

title: Library of Babel 3D
description: A 3D simulation of the Library of Babel, as described in the short story by Jorge Luis Borges.

title: Entfremdung
description: A Marxist business-sim.

title: File Under Kingdom
description: File Under Kingdom is a mix of city builder, puzzle game, and interactive story. How you build the kingdom will alter events and/or influence the choices of its leaders. Use a variety of buildings to satisfy the kingdom's needs. See if you have what it takes to be the kings new Royal Planner.

title: Fewar-DVD
description:
A rapid arcade game
Avoid the swords
Find the key
Enter the portal

title: Solitaire Expeditions
description: Inspired by the 1992 hit Solitaire's Journey, Solitaire Expeditions is a modern take on a classic game. Play over 100 variants, including Klondike, FreeCell, Spider, Canfield, and Golf. Embark on a campaign or play individual games. Unlock new backgrounds, card backs, and decks as you play.

title: World War 2: Strategy Simulator
description: Tactics & Collocations 30+ Historical Campaigns: Normandy Landing, Operation Market Garden 2 Warfare Conflict Camps: Allies faction and ally Axis 30+ large battlefield maps are provide in this strategy games Omni-directional combat space: naval battle, air combat, land battle.

title: Writer's Life
description: In "Writer's Life", the player will play a novel lover, open their career as a novel writer. The hardships of writing, the anxiety of shelving a new book will bring you a new and exciting experience.

title: Carrier Commander
description: Advance from Commander to Fleet Admiral while in charge of the USS Nimitz (CVN-68) - a supercarrier of the United States Navy, and the lead ship of her class. Manage your Carrier's Assets and Resources to defend yourself from enemy engagements and advance your Naval Career. 15 Levels of challenge!

title: Legend of the Phoenix
description: Legend of the Phoenix is an otome mobile game genre which focuses on ancient style love story.

title: Mot De Pass
description: The main character pursues the Antagonist, but he manages to open a portal and enter the world. The world can be different: whether it be a fantasy city with magic or a post-apocalypse

title: Spooky Shooter 3D
description: Spooky Shooter 3D - is a hardcore 3D shooter where you will survive in an old castle full of monsters.

title: Runewaker
description: A solo dev, first person magic slinging souls-like with an emphasis on combat and exploration.

title: Forest Kingdom
description: Forest Kingdom Adventure Game Collect Resources which you can exchange with the villagers Weapon bases are upgraded to collect rare items. and upgrade equipment Resource Farming Tools Insert an engaging storyline and a variety of areas for adventurers to explore!

title: Operation S
description: Puzzle strategy game,where the player has to rotate the rings to save astronauts

title: Anthropocene Epoch
description: A dark atmospheric scifi First Person Shooter. Encounter characters including Jade An A.I implanted in your head, do missions to help others and get you off Earth before the Mantis destroy it.

title: Fruit Salad Theory
description: It's the night of the big ball, and things are going...well...they're going. When so many people of so many different species are gathered together in one place, you're sure to have an interesting time. But what if something a little more malicious is happening under the surface?

title: Secret Mission: The Forgotten Island
description: Help Chanel explore the island, and make her way back to her ship in Secret Mission – The Forgotten Island, a fun and exciting Hidden Object game.

title: Disaster
description: Disaster - You are going to take on the role of a bank robber in an ordinary city. This day did not bode well, but a terrible event happened.

title: Mini Golf Worlds VR
description: Golf through immersive worlds ranging from the depths of the sea to the far reaches of outer space. Customize your appearance, and show off your golfing skills online with up to 8 people.

title: Turk-A-Lurk
description: Turk-A-Lurk is a 2D Metroidvania precision platformer. Explore a large open world with 5 unique biomes. 100+ collectables to find. Multiple upgrades to unlock allowing new areas to be reached and easier movement. 20+ timed bonus levels to test your skills in. Full original soundtrack. Indie game.

title: Nested Rooms
description: Nested rooms is a single player, first person experience taking place in a confusing non-euclidean world. Your goal is to navigate everyday life in a realm where rooms seem to coexist in the same space without interfering with one another.

title: Over the Counter
description: A pharmaceutical business management game.

title: Brain Bait
description: Arcade, Puzzles, Speedrunning: Old school one-screen puzzle action game. Lure all Zombies into the traps to advance to the next level. Includes Steam Leaderboards and Personal Challenges.

title: Hero Lodge
description: Hero Lodge is a fantasy tactical turn based strategy RPG with a focus on player knowledge. Learn enemy attack patterns to fight your way to redemption.

title: Coma: Lost in the Maze
description: Find out the story of the main character and get out of the sinister nightmare.

title: Eagle Simulator
description: If you've ever wondered what it's like to be a bird, then Eagle Simulator is just for you!

title: Sucker for Love: First Date
description: Put the 'love' in 'Lovecraftian horror'! Perform terrifying rituals to win the affections of eldritch horrors and smooch 'em... at any cost!

title: V696
description: V696 is a first-person horror-thriller game. It contains a cult subject of veiled beings. Even if everything seems clear at first glance, it has a gripping story that will throw you a curve.

title: Slums of Tetsoidea
description: Slums of Tetsoidea is an RPG about 4 women who need each others aid to save the world from a few evil plots. An interesting story about a corporation that desires collecting magical crystals, with a more sinister twist!

title: ImpossiBubble
description: Face off against an endless stream of bubbles. Keep them from reaching the top by adding, subtracting, dividing or multiplying the numbers inside. And you need to match the target number before the timer runs out. Fail to do either and you’ll lose health. Lose enough health and it’s game over.

title: Mirrorama
description: A unique puzzle game with an interesting story. Witness the story of Josh Lattey while solving mind boggling puzzles using mirrors and reflections. Mirrorama offers an exceptional experience for puzzle game lovers.

title: Sugarcane Empire
description: Plant Sugarcane! Employ Pandas! Conquer the World! Sugarcane Empire is story-based clicker game set in Chengdu, China and Kentucky, USA. Play as three generations of Chinese and American women. Experience how stories preserve us from death.

title: Cataplexy
description: Waking up at night, the main character realizes that he cannot move. A terrible sense of panic gradually overtakes his mind, and the imagination begins to paint frightening pictures.

title: Parrot
description: Parrot is a 2D ninja parkour game

title: Love Accident
description: Friendships begin and end. Everyone has their plans.

title: Succubus War
description: It has been four years since the succubus and human beings started war. As the strongest remaining mankind, you have embarked on the road to crusade against the succubus alone.....

title: Farmer Adventure
description: The story of a farmer from whom an ancient dragon stole a sheep. And now you need to do everything to get it back. Embark on an incredible adventure, visit an ancient castle and appear on the doorstep to its ruler.

title: VR Async Balls
description: It's a simulator of a slot machine. Swipe two balls simultaneously on different moving tracks. Do not try to push two balls at the same time moving your hands asynchronous, not everyone can do it. Check if you can do it! 20 levels in the game, each of them is more difficult than the previous one.

title: Shape TD
description: A Tower Defense game, where geometric shapes face each other, and you, the Leader of the Order, must carefully plan your time and money to defeat enemies. With a minimalist design, this is the game for those looking to relax and at the same time train their agility and logical thinking.

title: VIrus Killer
description: Virus Killer - You are the only uninfected cell in the body that quickly absorbs a dangerous virus. Destroy all the infection in this explosive sidescroller shooter and save your host's body from complete extinction ..

title: Far Far Away From Here
description: Very far away - Once upon a time in the same kingdom there lived a king .. No, he did not sit all his life on his throne, he was very fond of adventure and danger. Take over the reins of the rebellious king and show the goblins who's in charge!

title: Bound by Love
description: When Yokoshima finds out his office crush, Hazuki Ichinose, is transferring overseas, he realizes that he needs to act and finally ask her out.

title: Basketball Baby
description: A boy with a strong body can always win the favor of girls, and a boy who loves basketball can always capture the hearts of girls. It feels so good to play ball with the babies!

title: Hisui no Kikai
description: This is a fun addicting casual game. The plot is presented from the perspective of a guy from an archaeological expedition. In addition to visual scenes with various characters, the player will have to solve simple but interesting puzzles. Passing the level, the player receives a reward!

title: Santa Jump
description: Santa Jump is a 2D side-scrolling arcade platformer about Santa giving out gifts to all the kids for the holiday. For a larger area of coverage, he needs to climb higher and higher, jumping on platforms.

title: Shiori no Kotoha: Dark Reflections
description: A series of murders and bizarre incidents occur in a private library that has become inescapable. Eventually, the food runs out and the library becomes filled with madness... This work is a visual novel of the survival suspense genre, set in a private library.

title: Kandra the Moonwalker
description: Kandra The Moonwalker is a 3D platformer demo inspired by the great classics of N64 and PlayStation. Find collectibles, explore different worlds, unlock habilities, and return magic to the world by recovering the magic feathers.

title: Polygon Hunter VR
description: Polygon Hunter VR is a fast paced shooter in which a child falls asleep in geometry class and in his dream faces polygonal figures at cute scenarios inspired by different countries of the world, to achieve his goal he must clear level after level, will you help Eddie?

title: Maverta Island
description: Maverta Island - minimalist, relaxing, motion logic, mind game. The player's goal is to survive the labyrinth and save the mates.

title: Bimous
description: In Bimous, you are in a region with different biomes and enemy species such as yetis, goblins and wizards. Explore the map, discover new buildings, fight enemies and destroy whatever you want.

title: Cramit's Keep
description: Cramit's Keep, is a top down, roguelike, where you navigate through various dungeon levels. Customize Cramits abilities with potions and powers, and ultimately defeat the evil within the Keep.

title: Exotic
description: "Exotic" is a fantasy adventure game. Players need to hunt in the endless wilderness, search for various resources to develop weapons, eliminate mutants, and find a way home.

title: Sakura Alien
description: Haru is a university student with a passion for the stars. He was content enough to observe space from afar, through a telescope - until a strange girl who claims to be an alien crash lands into him, and claims him for her husband!

title: My Nemesis and Hero
description: Join Kai in his daily life as he fails to realize the two guys, who he knew since childhood, have a huge crush on him. One is his best friend, and the other is his rival. So they can't possibly have romantic feelings for him... right?

title: Word of the Law: Death Mask - Collector's Edition
description: Investigate serial crimes and city government secrets! You're the only one who can get on the trail and break the chain of murders. Are you up for the challenge?

title: P1441vr
description: P1441vr is a basic gun range simulator with semi realistic mechanics and a variety of game modes to sling lead in. Move n shoot your way through steel targets or disable enemy threats in Simunitions mode. *Read Early Access section*

title: My Soldiers
description: My Soldiers places you in the role of a soldier who's new to a post near the border, you are gonna meet three soldiers here. So "My Soldiers" tells a story that happens in this small post with these guys. These guys have different personalities, There are 3 routes and over 100 CGs in all.

title: Day on Mars
description: An adventure awaits you on Mars where you need to save a team of sexy girls from an unknown disease. Making them... sexually active.

title: Missing Plane: Survival
description: You survived a plane crash, and now you will need to find a way to be rescued, for that you will be building an SOS signal and wait for a rescue. In the meantime you will need to eat, drink and build stuff to stay alive

title: Magical Deathpair
description: 16 Witches, 8 Couples, Game to escape death... Hunt down the Imposter. Save the world from impending catastrophe. Life and death adventure game for those who love charming witches.

title: Trial of Empires TD
description: Trial of Empires TD, is a Free to Play 3D tower defense game. Pick your ally and build your army to defend your lane against powerful enemies. Compete with other players on Leaderboards.

title: Catch them!
description: Catch them is the simplest and exciting game that will help develop your attentiveness. You have to play as a hen catching different fruit and avoid uneatable food.

title: Hina-chan's Big Trade! Millionaire Lunch
description: With no offers to be in the mainline games, Hina-chan finally finds herself with no more than a single cucumber in her fridge. Help her by searching for and trading all sorts of items to various humans and youkai to get enough food to make her lunch a rich one!

title: Santhai
description: This is a legendary game. come back for everyone to join again The great adventures of the same boy. and so many activities that await now.

title: Quickerflak
description: Quickerflak is an experimental fast-paced time-attack top-down combat retro-hardcore minigame, that can be finished in a minute.

title: Set 'N Det
description: Solve puzzles with explosions! Casual 2D puzzle game with 72 levels/puzzles to solve.

title: Red Conquer
description: Red Conquer is a strategic third-person shooter set in the second war on an alien planet

title: Fencing Girl
description: This is a fencing competition game. According to the prompt of quick time event (QTE) on the screen, press the corresponding key to avoid the girl's attack and fight back. When you win the competition, you will get the favor of girls and interact with girls.

title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Love Beyond Death
description: The demonic invasion cut many lives short without warning. The unstoppable catastrophe brought death to all in equal measure — rich and poor, fortunate and unfortunate, young and old.

title: Elements
description: Medium-sized medival level with distinctly themed areas for each element, and classic gameplay. A skybox and the map source are included.

title: Glitchhikers: The Spaces Between
description: Glitchhikers is a surreal journey through the spaces between places. A late night drive, a deserted airport lounge, a moonlit walk through an empty park, a quiet carriage on an overnight train. Who will you meet? What will you talk about? Where will the journey take you? Find yourself along the way.

title: Stronghold: Warlords - Rise of the Shogun Campaign
description: The Rise of the Shogun Campaign expands the base Stronghold: Warlords game with six missions, two new warlords and extra achievements. Relive historical conflicts from The Battle of Uji in 1180 AD, through to the culmination of the Genpei War and founding of the Kamakura shogunate.

title: Stronghold: Warlords - The Mongol Empire Campaign
description: The Mongol Empire Campaign expands the base Stronghold: Warlords game with six missions, two new warlords and extra achievements. Play as emperor Kublai Khan as you relive famous sieges, civil war and skirmishes against the Song Dynasty.

title: Botanicula: Collector's Edition
description: Collector's Edition contains the full game, 50-minute original soundtrack from acclaimed band DVA and 59-page digital art book with designs by creator Jaromir Plachy.

title: Beholder 3
description: When a high-ranking security officer saves you from prison, you end up a pawn in her schemes. Now you must eliminate anyone standing in the way of her secret plans and try to get your life back while working two jobs. No tenant, employee or superior is safe from your spying.

title: Vestaria Saga II: The Sacred Sword of Silvanister
description: Vestaria Saga II continues the adventures of Zade, bringing the tales of him and his companions to a thrilling, satisfying end. They will encounter allies both new and old while uncovering more mysteries behind the vile Margulites and their plan to plunge Vestaria into a new age of darkness.

title: Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance
description: Terminator: Dark Fate – Defiance is a gritty RTS that puts you in the middle of the Future Wars between humanity and Legion's synthetic intelligent machine network. Take command and lead your army to foil Legion's plan to destroy humanity or play as one of three factions in skirmish and multiplayer.

title: Dead End Aegis
description: Extraterrestrial invaders have come to take over Earth, and only an elite force of "magical girls" that have been infused with alien superpowers can stop them.

title: Sherlock Holmes: Chapter One - Beyond a Joke
description: Race to outsmart a daring opponent who targets only rich people.

title: Headquarters World War II
description: Headquarters World War II is a fast-paced turn-based strategy game where your battlefield tactics are as important as your army management skills. Experience both sides of the war, battling in Europe as the USA, the UK, or Germany. Storm bunkers, occupy houses, win tank duels.

title: Summer Memories: Deluxe Edition
description:
It is the summer break again and you've just graduated from university, so you decided to pay your aunt and cousins in the countryside a long-overdue visit. However, it has been years since you've last seen them, so you don't know what to expect. What could go wrong? Find out in Summer Memories!

Summer Memories: Deluxe Edition consists of the base game, as well as the "Summer Memories+ - Expansion DLC".

title: Field of Glory II: Medieval - Storm of Arrows
description: Field of Glory II: Storm of Arrows is a turn-based tactical game set in the High Middle Ages and it's the third DLC for Field of Glory II: Medieval. Developed by the legendary Richard Bodley Scott it brings the best from the tabletop world into the best digital framework.

title: X4: Foundations - Tides of Avarice
description: X4: Tides of Avarice, the third expansion for X4: Foundations, invites you on new exploration adventures. Encounter and interact with previously unknown, lawless pirate and scavenger factions, and discover new ships and stations.

title: Just Cause 2: Complete Edition
description:
This compilation includes:

- Just Cause 2 (base game)
- Just Cause 2: Agency Hovercraft (DLC)
- Just Cause 2: Black Market Aerial Pack (DLC)
- Just Cause 2: Black Market Boom Pack (DLC)
- Just Cause 2: Bull's Eye Assault Rifle (DLC)
- Just Cause 2: Chevalier Classic (DLC)
- Just Cause 2: Monster Truck (DLC)
- Just Cause 2: Rico's Signature Gun (DLC)

title: Modern Naval Warfare
description: Modern Naval Warfare is the next generation naval combat simulator, which will immerse you in the dark and unforgiving world of the modern high-tech naval battlefield.

title: Journalist
description:
Journalist is a Swedish educational game about being a journalist and write articles for the made up news publishing company Midköpingskuriren. The game is targeted toward teenagers.

Your objective is to go around asking people, look up in the official registry, and so on in order to complete your article for the day and thereby completing the mission. Every mission will get more difficult as you complete more of them, but will become easier if you don't manage to complete it that day.

In order to ask people questions you have to answer their question first, challenging the player to all sorts of topics and facts. When you think you have sufficient information, you will go in to your boss' office and he will ask relevant questions before completing the article. If any of the answers are wrong, you have to wait a few hours to try again but the mission fails as soon as the next day hits at 12 AM.

title: Transient: Extended Edition
description: From the creators of Conarium and the Darkness Within series, comes Transient, a Lovecraftian Cyberpunk thriller.

title: Duel Princess
description: This is a side-scrolling tower defense game where you lead your units from your own castle towards the Princess' castle and capture it. There are roguelite elements that lets you enjoy building new decks each time you play the story mode. There are also many sexy rewards that men all over the world can enjoy!

title: Titan Quest: Collector's Edition
description:
This edition includes the following:

- Titan Quest and its expansion Titan Quest: Immortal Throne
- Replica of a Greek War Helmet, 23cm (9.06 inches)
- Notepad
- Premium Box

title: Saints Row: Criminal Customs Edition
description: Welcome to Santo Also, a vibrant fictional city in the heart of the American Southwest. In a world rife with crime, where lawless factions fight for power, a group of young friends embark on their own criminal venture, as they rise to the top in their bid to become Self Made.

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Extraction: Guardian Edition
description: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Quarantine is a three-player tactical co-op game set several years in the future of the Rainbow Six universe. Rainbow Six Quarantine is being developed by an entirely new team at Ubisoft Montreal, who were inspired by the long-standing brand legacy of tactical co-op shooters and the varied cast of operators from Rainbow SixSiege, to develop something that is truly more than the sum of its parts.

title: Bash the Teacher!
description: It's time to show the teacher who is the real boss of the classroom in this hilarious clicker game! Click away to blast the teacher with your chosen weapon - watch as the teacher’s frustration grows and discover their funny reactions!

title: Xtreme Aces Racing
description: Xtreme Aces Racing brings a new exciting racing genre with combat mechanics and jets! Race through stunning locations around the globe in story mode or challenge a friend in local multiplayer mode. Defeat your enemies using attack and defense powerups and be the first to see the checkered flag.

title: Beastie Bay DX
description: Washed ashore a desolate island and surrounded by savage beasts, can you thrive...or merely survive? Blaze trails into unknown territory...and then make it your own! Plant crops, build housing and power sources, and transform the island into your own personal paradise. As you progress, you'll be able to develop new gear and technology to take your adventure to the next level, including ways to travel to unexplored islands nearby! The native fauna eyeing you as their next meal? Capture the critters, trade them with friends, and train them to fight for you! Most have elemental strengths and weaknesses, so use these to your advantage in battle. Venture far enough afield and you may find signs of civilization. If you make the right friends, your humble isle could grow into an economic powerhouse, complete with hot springs, hotels, and heliport. The possibilities are as limitless as the horizon! Survival of the fittest was never so fun! You call the shots as you develop your primitive isle into a luxurious slice of paradise! Try searching for "Kairosoft" to see all of our games!!

title: Unstrong: Space Calamity
description: A long time ago, the star people of the Sun City Pyrmia made sure that nothing would go wrong with the sun. But then they disappeared, and whatever happened remains a mystery. Many centuries later, a star-shaped world held together by chains was torn apart by a big explosion, its debris sent drifting through space. One of the inhabitants of this destroyed world, Glasses Unstrong, plans to put the old world back together with the help of her new friend, Flounder the star child. It's not gonna be easy, but mad scientists like Glasses always find a way to get what they want! Unstrong: Space Calamity is a 3d platformer all about planets, weird gravity and the secrets of outer space. Explore or follow the main storyline -- it's all up to you!

title: Murder Diaries 3: Santa's Trail of Blood
description: In this game you abstractly follow the narration of a young man who slowly but surely becomes insane. This leads you straight into the middle of an exciting murder case and a murder mystery unfolds while you listen to the testimonies of witness, friends and relatives. The whole game is somewhat Christmas flavored - however, don't get yourself comfortable, the game not going to give you a nice and warm feeling but rather confront you with a cold and harsh reality as the thrilling storytelling of the game will leave you with a cold shiver down your spine. The game is a must have for any true fan of thrillers and anyone how enjoys a murder mystery that goes beyond the normal story telling. How does the gameplay work? You will play as a free-floating ghost like creature. Basically, as the soul of someone who is experiencing the story. You are very small in comparison to the surroundings and can fly freely through the area. You start by exploring the area and enjoying the feeling of flying as well as the gentle yet mysterious background music. Soon after starting to explore, you will find the first memory piece. You can collect the memory pieces to continue with the story and to advance with the overall narration. The story talks about a young boy, about his live and about how everything changes. It is setup as a thrilling murder mystery and acts as a contrast to the somewhat calm and enjoyable gameplay.

title: Kubinashi Recollection
description: Use your own head to try to clear stages full of all sorts of tricks in a 2D action puzzle game like you've never experienced.

title: Menseki: Area Maze puzzles
description: That satisfying feeling that comes from solving a puzzle! Presenting the novel Japanese logic puzzle game that's been attracting attention from around the world! Find your way to the solution, deducing unknown lengths and areas from known lengths and areas.

title: E>scape Nature Simulator
description: A relaxing bug catching simulator

title: A Wonderful Day For Fishing
description: An experimental horror game made in a weekend, exploring isolation, the uncanny valley, and repetition as core concepts. You play as a lonely man out at sea for a lovely day of fishing. A mood piece.

title: Flood
description: Prepare yourself for the flood! Build crazy, wobbly boats and battle your friends until only one is left afloat.

title: Dungeon Masters
description: Dungeon Masters is a skill-based dungeon crawler without any random based gameplay mechanics.The game includes a powerful in-game level editor using which you can create your own dungeons.

title: Card Storm Idle
description: Card Storm Idle is an incremental game with both idle and active play-styles. Research and craft card deсks to earn as many resources as possible! Build up your power and see how far you can get. Bring the card storm down on monsters!

title: Legendary Mosaics 2: The Stolen Freedom
description: Everyone knows that The Statue of Liberty is very special. It was created to celebrate a most important virtue - freedom. It emits a very strong power that can give people hope and strength. In the hands of evil, the statue can do the exact opposite! And it has been stolen!

title: Legendary Mosaics 3: Eagle Owl Saves the World
description: Welcome back to the Enchanted Forest. The Dwarf, Terrible Cat, and friends will have to put their knowledge of alchemy to the test when mysterious portals appear and strange monsters begin to emerge!

title: Five Nights at F***boy's: Complete Collection
description: Five Nights at F---boy’s is a FNaF fangame series created in RPG Maker VX Ace featuring f---ing unfair difficulty, text-to-speech voice acting, and beautiful, beautiful animatronic yiffing. Here, these games are remade in the Complete Collection edition, upgraded in RPG Maker MV.

title: SGS Glory Recalled
description: Relive the Battle of Hong Kong (8–26 December 1941), one of the first battles of the Pacific War in World War II.

title: RetroDrift: Retrowave Online Road
description: Dive into the atmosphere of the 80's, rushing along the neon roads towards the sunset, letting your supercar drift, enjoying the wonderful tracks in retrowave style.

title: Kuma: The Environmental Protector
description: A fantasy based Action-RPG game with main hero Kuma the bear. Aside from being a bear Kuma is also The Environmental Protector with the mission to protect the forest from pollution by killing all humans. The game contains fast paced combat along with jumping puzzles and clever mechanics.

title: Infiltraliens
description: Infiltraliens is an action adventure game in which you take on the role of Gorp. Place 52, the world's most advanced and well-guarded military base is holding your alien friends captive. Can you make your way through the obstacles and pass the guards to save them?

title: Cubes and Knights
description: You are strong and huge, you have a heavy sword in your hands, and somewhere deep an ancient evil is hidden. The King himself sent you on a difficult campaign: to find the immortal enemy of all people. Find ancient artifacts and work your way through the labyrinths with steel and magic.

title: Turbo Shot
description: Turbo Shot combines a puzzle-filled top-down adventure with exciting gun-based combat that plays out in regular seasons of free-to-play single player and PvP content.

title: Tor-tor cubes
description: Tor-tor cubes is a puzzle game with a 2D view. The goal of the game is to destroy all the cubes in the level. Many different powerups.

title: Five Nights at Sonic's Collection
description: A collection of all 5 Five Nights at Sonic's games, with the addition of reviews from the developers and an accessible menu.

title: Bushi
description: Wield your bow and sword against fierce opponents as you navigate obstacles with dynamic parkour in the samurai-themed arena brawler, Bushi! Inspired by the cult classic GunZ The Duel and The Legend of Son-Goku.

title: Cham the Cat Adventure
description: The first in the fictional "GAME BUDDY" portable game series! Dedicated to the game boys and girls of the past. A retro-style action game!

title: Oumuamua
description: The third installment in the fictional "GAME BUDDY" portable game series! Retro-style Breakout clone!

title: Jewelinx
description: The second installment in the fictional "GAME BUDDY" portable game series! A retro-style Falling block puzzle!!

title: Biggerman.io
description: One left-stick rules them ALL! Biggerman - a simple yet satisfying action game for everyone! Smash! Absorb! And Get Bigger!

title: It's on You
description: It's On You is an FMV game in which your choices will affect the outcome of Curtis and those around him. The latter caught between a world of crime and violence, in the wake of a gang taking control of the community and a potential career as an international footballer.

title: StreamFest
description: StreamFest is a game made for streamers. This game offers you direct interaction with your viewers, providing even greater interaction in your live streams. Create rooms, mini games and sweepstakes in this game, you and your viewers will have your own avatars within the game to interact and have fun.

title: Stötnisse Åker Hiss
description: Stötnisse Åker Hiss is a game based on a Swedish children book character created by Björn Schumacher and Kenneth Andersson. One of his greatest interests is to ride the elevator of his grandmother's apartment building and that is essentially what the game is about.

title: Keng's Little Universe
description: The game is divided into three parts, which simulate three stages of civilization respectively. The first is the survival of civilization in a multi-stars system. The second is the expansion and war of civilization in a galaxy. The third part is the exploration of god civilization in the universe.

title: Funny Pets
description: In this cute Match-3 game a terrible tornado carried away all the funny pets! Help them to find the way to their small town Petsville

title: Secrets of the Past: Mother's Diary
description: Exciting hidden object game with many levels and a thrilling story line. Uncover the Secrets of the Past: Mothers Diary!

title: Panzers on the Steppe
description: A fast-paced WWII Eastern Front campaign game that simulates the titanic clashes of armor and armies across the Russian steppe from Finland to the Caucasus mountains. The game does all the logistics so you can focus on strategy and tactics.

title: Project Myriad 2
description: Project Myriad 2 is a tower defense strategy game. Build towers on a grid of hexagons floating in space. 35 levels with unique tiles and mechanics each providing a unique challenge. 3 difficulty levels including extreme mode which has never ending waves of enemies. Strive for your new high score!

title: Ragnar
description: In this epic Norse myth-inspired roguelike dungeon crawler, wield divine power to challenge Loki and uncover the secrets of the Nine Realms through the branches of Yggdrasil. Grow stronger and reshape Ragnarok’s fate with legendary weapons of the gods.

title: Hot Pickle!
description: Hot Pickle! Is a 2D platform jumping game. Run, jump, shoot, and dash your way through 10 epic food-themed levels.

title: Where's My Horse? An Escape the Room Adventure
description: Experience an at-home Escape Room adventure! Find secrets, solve puzzles, and open locked chests to help you solve the mystery- where did your horse go?

title: Ultra Thunderball
description: Are you ready for the greatest arcade challenge yet? Equip your Gun-Bat and try to defeat the evil geometrics. See you in the tournament!

title: Riddle Girl
description: Any girl is a riddle - solve each one.

title: Project Umbra
description: Project Umbra is a twin sticks shooter game set in a colored voxel world. Travel back in time to destroy enemies and score!

title: Zwart Wit
description: It looks simple to get to the exit in the first few levels, but it keeps getting harder! If you don't have a good brain and a quick finger then forget about playing this.

title: New
description: New is an Off fangame, acting as a continuation of OFF's events. New is notable for answering major questions posed by Off, as well as reworking the combat system to be more challenging and tactical.

title: Levitation Simulator
description: Levitation Simulator is a game where you can experience levitation.

title: Monsters Domain
description: Defend the Monsters’ Domain. Kill heroes and collect their treasures. Play the Monsters’ side and loot foolish warriors who dare to explore your realm. Build up your forces, upgrade them and equip them with better weapons, skills and tricks to lure and kill even more shiny forces of the light.

title: Evilmun 2
description: Evilmun 2 is the continuation of the successful part of the game and part of the Evilmun trilogy. You play as a mage and a knight in new incomprehensible and unforgettable map locations that you will have to go through using two powers, Mage's powers and Knight's powers!

title: Football Club
description: Football Club - 2D football simulator. The game has titles, awards, points and bonuses, which makes the game more interesting and unique. The game has more than 10 different maps in which we can play 1vs1 against a bot, or a friend, as well as on a local network. In your hands are 3 football players for whom you can manage!

title: Smart Factory Tycoon
description: Smart Factory Tycoon is a factory management and automatization simulator game about running your dream factory with robots. Design your dream factory, plan all steps of production, research new technologies and become a tycoon!

title: Kurokami-sama's Feast
description: Kurokami-sama's Feast is an adventure visual novel following an unlucky trio who find themselves hunting monsters for the powerful being known as Kurokami-sama.

title: Sunset Spirit Steel
description: Explore a lost mesa filled with memories and singing sculptures.

title: Undercurrent
description: You are a diplomat in interstellar negotiations when a science station on an ocean world goes quiet. Your brother works there, so you secure the mission. Something inside is wrong. The longer you stay, the harder it gets to act like yourself. What you discover may change the very nature of humanity.

title: Sea Rovers: MetaPlunder
description:
One of the first ever playable Solana Blockchain NFT games. See your Coves, Captains, and Rovers come to life in our interactive MetaPlunder Beta.

Explore your unique pirate haven, play mini-games, and compete for $RUM on the leaderboards!

title: Kawaii Girls Puzzle
description: Kawaii girls puzzle is a puzzle game, swap blocks to assemble an image.

title: Vaccine Delivery Adventure
description: Vaccine Delivery Adventure is a classic side-scrolling action game where a healthcare worker has to overcome the challenges of delivering the BCG Vaccine to the communities that need it!

title: Moon Dancer
description: Moon Dancer is a vertically scrolling shmup featuring an exhilarating lock-on laser.

title: Dave Dave Dave
description: Dave Dave Dave, is a retro style hardcore platforming game set in an unknown world for you to explore with a single goal, reaching freedom.

title: Honored
description: Honored is a stealth, action-adventure game where the player uses various gadgets and powers to knock out or kill enemies in order to escape and take down the Egyptian empire.

title: Shores of Loci
description: Escape the Ordinary, Create the Extraordinary. A Puzzling Adventure by MikeTeevee.

title: Bald Luigi's Crustmust Deluxe
description:
Take a look into the history of Ralorche, the creator of Essence Of Waluigi with the definitive way to play his last Joke Game, Bald Luigi's Crustmust.

In Bald Luigi's Crustmust: Christmas has been canceled (for a basically obvious reason) and Santario, the biggest christmas fanboy is livid! He plans to kill literally everyone! As Bald Luigi, it is up to you to stop him, but little do you know that there is something strange going on behind the scenes......

title: Random-Pac
description: RandomPac is a tribute to Pac-Man (Pakkuman), an arcade game released by Namco in 1980.

title: Dig Dug Revival
description:
This game is a homage to Dig Dug, an arcade game developed by Namco in 1982.

In this version, except the first one, the playfields are generated randomly.

title: Sunrise: The Game
description:
In Sunrise the player controls Rydec who is working on a teleportation experiment with his friends Brian and Max. Unfortunately the experiment goes wrong and suddenly New York is deserted and the sun fails to rise. And then there is that unconscious woman lying in front of the house door...

In many ways Sunrise: The Game tries to bring innovations to the adventure genre. Despite the puzzles are item based the game features no classic inventory system: Rydec won't take an item until it is directly needed for the next puzzle. If he has all items needed he uses them himself. The only things he always carry is a multi tool with three functions, e.g. as screwdriver and a PDA which shows the next task and optionally gives hints. Another help function is the possibility to mark all hot spots on the screen. The puzzles itself often feature multiple solutions. Another speciality is that all the conversations are automatic. Despite the dark scenario the dialogues are also humorous and long - if the player doesn't like listening to them he can use an option to shorten them.

Scavenge resources to survive, face the dangers of the surface as you will hunt for viral pathogens to cure a mysterious illness.

Fight your way through the cursed castle, find treasures, upgrade skills, execute the damned souls and unravel the mystery of this once mighty castle.

You can explore different levels within which nothing can kill you.

Explore different levels, about 5 hours of gameplay.
Mini-story: An important emerald was stolen and has to be retrieved.
Re-play value: Some game elements, like items, are randomly placed in the level. So each new game is different.

Welcome to Yara, a tropical paradise frozen in time. Far Cry 6 thrusts players into a modern-day guerrilla revolution. Become a guerrilla fighter and burn ruthless dictator Antón Castillo's regime to the ground.

The Deluxe Edition includes:
- the base game
- the Ultimate Pack, a compilation featuring three in-game content packs:
- the Jungle Expedition Pack
- the Croc Hunter Pack

Grab your bike, skis, snowboard, or wingsuit and explore an open world sports paradise where the rules are yours to make - or break.

title: Contact
description:
Contact is a visual novel where you play as Mike, who comes to see his grandmother in the summer. She runs a local store, but things are not going as she did a few years ago.
Mike decides to help her grandmother restore her household and meet her old friends simultaneously.

title: Ronin: Tales of a Ghost
description:
Ronin: Tales of a Ghost takes you on an endless adventure through a stunningly beautiful world.

Play as Ghost - a skilled Ronin - set on clearing ancient Japan of all the dangerous and and mysterious creatures inhabiting it.

Conquer all in your way as you cross perilous bridges, jump large chasms and across mysterious floating rocks.

Visit the shop and your companion at your camp for upgrades and customisation.

A satisfying and fast paced combat system with multiple enemy types each with varied attacks ranging from projectiles to melee.

Unlock a variety of weapons ranging from Katana's to Tridents, find the weapon to suit your style. Weapons can be bought from the shopkeeper Senshi, who can be found in your camp.

title: Warframe: The New War

Experience The New War, Warframe's largest cinematic expansion yet. Fight on the frontlines in every corner of the Origin System in a thrilling storyline of exploration and discovery. Unite opposing forces and test your mettle against the full mustered force of the Sentients, a legion of adaptable, self-replicating drones capable of untold destruction. You must stop them, Tenno, and reckon with the Lotus, or all you have fought to protect will fall to ruin.

With several new playable characters, a new Warframe, a dramatic cinematic Quest, and an Arsenal reinforced with new Customizations, Weapons and Accessories, get ready to wield limitless power to look and play the way you want in this all-out-war.

title: Emeritus Pong
description:
Emeritus Pong is a clone of the good old "Pong" game. It tries to be relatively close to the original, therefore no fancy graphic or astonishing sound effects there. Emeritus Pong is written to be able to run on any modern PC. There are three versions available: DOS, Windows and Linux. Emeritus Pong features also a cool demo mode, which makes it playing against itself, displaying the current time as scores.

The game is programmed to run flawlessly on any modern PC, but it will run on older architectures, too. A 90 MHz Pentium CPU and 2 Mb of RAM should be enough to run comfortably the DOS version. Emeritus Pong may run in any usual resolution, ranging from 320x240 to 1280x1024, fullscreen or windowed. If you would like to use any other video mode (not available from the game's setup), you will have to manually edit the empong.cfg configuration file.

Windows and Linux versions require a sound card for sound, and DOS version simply uses the internal PC Speaker.

title: Wicked Rider

description:
Dragon Age Legends Remix 01 is a "remix" of Dragon Age Legends. It features the same graphics as the aforementioned game, but completely different gameplay. Where the original game was a turn-based RPG on social networks, the remix is an action-based hack and slash game.

The player controls the main character through a side-scrolling environment using only the mouse. The player can use mouse gestures to perform special combos, which are required to kill the many monsters that will appear from both in front of and behind the character. Killing enemies unlocks experience points which can be used to upgrade stats such as health and stamina when the player reaches a campsite.
