description: Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown is a complex city builder, where the fate of your kingdom hinges on your every decision. Explore this medieval land alone or with friends, make tough moral choices and conquer your foes in RTS combat. Will you struggle to survive, or find the strength to Thrive?

title: CosmoPlayerZ
description: A Sci-Fi action game for a single player bringing you to fight rebellions, level up your character and choose new skills, dress up your character in the epic space wars.

title: ZooSim
description: The humans have disappeared, and the animals are stuck in the Zoo! Rescue them in this adventure exploration comedy!

title: KaM Remake
description:
The KaM Remake mod is an attempt to reinvigorate the original “Knights and Merchants: The Shattered Kingdom” strategy game. Our goals are to make it work on today’s computers and operating systems, implement a fully featured online multiplayer system, as well as to fix the many bugs in the game engine. To do this we have started from scratch, writing our own code for the game engine but still relying on many original resource files. We assume that you own the original KaM game, (the installer checks for it) otherwise you should buy it – it’s available in a number of online gaming stores.
The KaM Remake executable is freeware and is built by enthusiasts. Applications used: Delphi 6, Delphi 7, FastMM4, Lazarus, OpenGL, OpenAL, zLib, PNGImage, MadExcept, libZPlay.

title: Stix: Combat Devolved
description: Stix is a multiplayer top-down arena shooter!

title: Penelope's Odyssey
description: Penelope's Odyssey is an adventure-platfomer game where you play as Penelope, an orphaned pet rat. Use your unique sense of smell to navigate the maze of a post apocalyptic city, collect memories of your owner and eventually escape to freedom.

title: Meet Cute: Cafe
description: A day that seemed awful at start turns out to be one of the best days in your life. Sometimes even a pair of dirty pants can lead to a date with a hot waitress.

title: Word of Kitchen
description: This is a word search game. Theme: kitchen. You are presented with several letters and your task is to add words from these letters.

title: For the Hive
description: Survive as a tiny insect in a big harsh world. Fight your way to the top of the food chain. Build a strong colony that stands the test of time and become the ruler of the insect world.

title: Ride 4: Naked Japan Style
description: Buy Naked Japan Style and expand your gaming experience with 5 exclusive bikes and 10 extra events.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: VR Healesville 1913-1920 TRS19
description: Drive classic Victorian Railways steam locomotives through the famed Yarra Valley, north east of Melbourne, during the WW1 era. Comes with a selection of pre-made sessions, a pre-made multiplayer freeplay session, and a variety of Victorian Railways steam locomotives and rolling stock.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Model Trainz - New South Wales Region
description: Model Trainz: NSW Rails is an N scale model train layout set in the late 90’s early 2000’s of the New South Wales (NSW) region of Australia. Grab your favourite NSW (or VR / V/ Line) locomotive and rolling stock and drive down the tracks through the Australian countryside and towns.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: DB DBmu748 080
description: Built by the "VEB Waggonbau Goerlitz" factory in Germany, these versatile doubledecker cars were used on regional passenger transport by Deutsche Reichsbahn and then by Deutsche Bahn. They feature custom bogeysounds, custom interior, and more!

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Mine & Field railway
description: A small module showcasing a set of content designed for representing underground mining scenes and particularly the underground transport of coal and other ores plus mining equipment and personnel. Includes mining locomotives and rolling stock, and a range of infrastructure.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: DR DBmtrue 215
description: Built by the "VEB Waggonbau Goerlitz" factory in Germany, these versatile doubledecker cars were used on regional passenger transport by Deutsche Reichsbahn and then by Deutsche Bahn. They feature custom bogeysounds, custom interior, and more!

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Switch Model Railroad - TRS19
description: Switch Model Railroad is a small two baseboard route that offers plenty of switching opportunities between the yard and the industries.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Rodnye Prostory Route
description: A detailed 58km route set in the 'Commonwealth of Independent States' region of Eurasia, with 38km of single track and 9km of double track.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Centrella Sub Division
description: Located in the United States, the Centrella Sub Division runs through the mountains to the countryside, with 5 yards, 40 miles of mainline and 4 branchlines, many industries, and passenger stations. At least 50 trains uses this track as a shortcut to go east/west, with two amtrak trains per day.

title: Capelord: Bounty Hunters
description: Capelord:Bounty Hunter is a multiplayer lateral action shooter for up to 4 players, play campaign missions alone or as a team, compete against other players for loot by defeating the area boss.

title: Badlands
description: Multiplayer Post-Apocalyptic Survival Crafting Game

title: The Oldest Edda
description: Control the brave Runar, the toothy, one on a journey to the ends of Niflheim to fulfill a mission given by Odin: Stop a beast known as Grabak in exchange for survival. Venture into this Oldschool 2D platform game through a variety of unique and hostile environments.

title: Wormatozoa
description: A gross 2D point-and-click precision platformer about parasitic worms. Guide them through a human body in this tough-as-nails arcade slither-em-up!

title: ScreamCap
description: ScreamCap is a team of paranormal investigators live streaming their dives into the unknown to an audience of believers.

title: Animaddicts
description: Animaddicts is an arcade game.

title: Pong Temple
description: Set in a fantasy atmosphere inspired by Incan mythology, Pong Temple takes the well-known gameplays of Pong and Brick Breaker and mixes them into a procedural dungeon crawler focused on action and reflexes.

title: Skycliffs
description: Skycliffs is an action shooter roguelike dungeon crawler with fast-paced top-down platforming. Jump and dash across sky islands, fight loads of monsters, and get upgrades to survive the many dangers of your journey. Will you be strong enough to reach and defeat the keeper of this floating world?

title: The Hellbrand
description: Set in a time where gods and monsters still share the world with humans. Embark on a quest as The Hellbrand, a king who has made a deal with the devil to bring his son back to life, as long as you retrieve an ancient weapon for her in return... How far are you willing to go to save your son's life?

title: I Love Finding More Cats
description: I Love Finding Cats is back with even MORE CATS! Find all the different kinds of cute and adorable cats as you visit different locations.

title: Warden's Will
description: Warden’s Will is a fast paced movement shooter roguelite, playable solo or in up-to 3 player co-op. Choose your Warden, master unique movements and abilities, and overpower hordes of robots in intense battles. Fly, dash, smash, and turn bullet-hell into bullet-heaven!

title: SkyJumper
description: SkyJumper - Side Scroller with Runner elements. A game in which the player parries with a flying parachutist and dodges obstacles and sharp blades that fold on the move, which line up randomly and each time complicate the race.

title: Storm Swordsman
description: This is a 2D action adventure game of stealth assassination, swordsmanship and ninjutsu duel! There is no refreshing combo, and there is no Wushuang who mows the grass. hesitates will not lose, but carelessness will die! In the world of swordsmen, the victory or defeat is in the blink of an eye!

title: Tank Sudoku
description: In Tank Sudoku your goal is to finish a sudoku puzzle as fast as possible, but every cell is guarded by enemy tanks. Battle your way through each cell to finish the puzzle.

title: MeiQi 2022
description: At the end of 1990, there was a murder in Changzhuang community. Both mother and son were killed. The case is full of doubts. According to the clues, you plan to visit the murder scene alone at night, search for evidence, obtain clues, and crack the truth.

title: Flipped
description: Come join us on Ethan Klein's journey through meme-land to get to the bottom of the app which is flipped. Experience the memes like you're actually there!

title: Cybernetica: Final
description: The final part of the Cybernetica trilogy. The action takes place in the center of a small town. Cybernetica is a tower defense game. The player's task is to destroy enemies with the help of buildings before they cross the base. With the help of 7 towers you need to cope with 85 waves of enemies.

title: Paladin's Oath
description: Paladin's Oath combines elements of RPG and light deck-building where Cards / Mana / Recruitable Followers and always-on Blessings must be synergized to Move, Interact and Battle with unlimited undo mechanics during battles to find the best possible outcome.

title: 2048 Royal Cards
description: 2048 is a classic puzzle with a simple goal; reach 2048. Move your tiles across the grid and merge identical numbers into one. Plan ahead and watch out for new tiles spawning, that may prevent you from joining your numbers.

title: Break Bounds: Exile
description: This is a interactive story game. Players will take on the role of a legendary character in a near-realistic sci-fi-set world, unlocking the great mysteries hidden about the world, and the character himself, through dialogue with others, psychological analysis, environmental exploration and combat.

title: Xvirus
description: Trapped inside your own computer—are you living a dream or a nightmare?

title: Dark City: Paris - Collector's Edition
description: The World Expo is coming to Paris!

title: Amelie
description: A psychological mystery yuri visual novel about a girl named Amelie. Forbidden from leaving the house, Amelie awaits the arrival of her long time penpal, Sofia, to her dear friend Lilika’s dismay. What secrets will Sofia unravel that were best kept buried?

title: Corpsênia
description: Take on the role of Crow, a vigilante seeking revenge whose plot involves two intelligence services from four warring nations and a mysterious company that emerges in Brazil in the 90s, clearly in an alternate reality.

title: Zombie Blender
description: Zombie Blender is a retro indie 2D shooter where you kill zombies, explore the world, find new resources & items, and build bases.

title: Armed and Armoured
description: Armed and Armoured is a historical action & strategy RPG. The game dedicates to recreate the most realistic ancient sword fighting battles, with an immersive army organizing simulation system. The story background is based on the late Ming dynasty of China (late 16th Century).

title: TV Thief
description: Do you like stealth games with beautiful graphics? If yes, then TV Thief is for you! In this game you will be a TV thief and you will need to steal all the TVs from the houses. The residents of this house can prevent you from doing this. Don't get caught in their eyes!

title: Nanook's Revenge
description: A two team multiplayer, top-down, survival game. There is only one deity in the shape of a bear against a team of robots builders. Robots need to create a base and gather resources in order to defend themselves against the bear. Nanook's task is to kill and destroy all robots bases.

title: Against Death: Dead-end road
description: Action adventure thriller "Against Death: dead-end road " takes place in the harsh world of the beginning of the apocalypse due to an unknown virus. The John Carter is a former military man, and now a simple biker who is in search of himself.And this day was supposed to be the same...

title: Chibi Girl vs. Evil Zombie Dead
description: Suddenly there was a zombie apocalypse. All the adults turned into zombies! Chibi Girl is looking for her mother and tries to save the world.

title: Rain Puzzle
description: Rain Puzzle is a classic puzzle game where your best friend is logic and sleight of hand. Collect all the pictures together and enjoy your sharpness of mind. Time and number of lives are limited.

title: Space Warden
description: Space Warden is Sci-Fi shooter in space where whole environment can be destroyed. Use lots of weapons which can burn, stun, damage, explode enemy ships, bases and terrain. Use turrets to defend your base and complete various missions.

title: Angels Prayer
description: Angels Prayer is a horror filled with dark personalities and terrible demons who constantly strive to catch you. Explore all the rooms and return the shrines of heaven. Remember, in this place only prayers light your halo and old greasy candles. Avoid the demons and complete the ultimate mission.

title: Chaos Brigade
description: Chaos Brigade is an arcade platform-shooter space odyssey where you control a team of six space exterminators and lead them in the ultimate space cleanse. Wipe out the enemies with your arsenal, but don't overdo or you'll risk destroying the spaceships you are meant to save in the first place!

title: Stardander Revenant
description: Griselda just wants to be friends with Dianthus... but Dianthus can't stand her! Love or hate, they have to work together to keep the forest safe from dangerous Fae. Will working together help bring them closer? And can Griselda somehow pass Blantree's class?

title: Fall For You
description: Fall For You is a rhythm-based roguelike. Move and attack with the beat to power up, win the hearts of every damned soul you meet, traverse perilous obstacle courses, win fabulous prizes that change the way you play, and cuddle with a scary demon mom to keep yourself going!

title: Mythos: Sudoku
description: Embark on a mythic adventure and experience sudoku in a whole new way, with new rules and magical items as you overcome trials and find your way home.

title: Monsters and Weapons
description: Monsters and Weapons is a strategic rogue-like game based on decision making. You fight your way through 3 floors as one of ten different classes slaying monsters, buying items in shops and spending your resources wisely. In Monsters and Weapons every decision counts!

title: Gore Tears
description: GoreTears is an action-platformer with RPG elements that tells about the adventures of traveler Mia, searching for the expedition that has gone into the mountains. She will meet a mysty crystal that will enable her with power over time, and also turn the adventure in a totally different direction...

title: Endustry
description: Endustry is a game about building, exploring and surviving. Build machines and conveyor belts to collect resources.

title: CorpseOcean
description: Pilot a tiny submersible on a job to retrieve organic material from a sunken navy sub. Follow the coordinates, use Sonar and hope you don't run into anything on the way.

title: Stealth Kart
description: Stealth Kart is Racing plus Real-Time Tactics. Enjoy the classic thrill of sneaking past enemies in a few minutes per level. Or race past everyone. Play alone, or coordinate special cars alone, or play coop.

title: Adventure of Rikka: The Cursed Kingdom
description: The kingdom had not always been a peaceful place, over a hundred years ago there was a forgotten event that took place to thwart the darkness and bring in prosperity and peace. The king called all willing to stand up for their kingdom to once again banish the curse which laid upon the land.

title: Buffet Knight
description: A short Action/Adventure game following the gluttonous Buffet Knight who gobbles up everything and spits them back at his foes. Grow bigger and bigger to face the evil Demon Chef, but who knows what can happen when your appetite grows out of control…

title: Istanbul Ship Simulator
description: Istanbul Ship Simulator is a simple and fun ship simulation game located in the city of Istanbul. You can play all 22 challenging mission or choose any ship you like and sail at the coasts of Istanbul.

title: World Empire 2027
description: Lead your empire in turn based strategy war game. Select your country and start to play.

title: Paper Mages
description: A CCG / Deckbuilder / RTS / Third Person Platformer. Take part in the Pentad Mage Duels, where you and other apprentices control paper avatars to duel in a paper castle and become mages. With a deck of 130 cards that combine in different ways, use real-time systemic strategy to win.

title: Scuffed Party
description: Welcome to the party! Here we have everything from the classic board game to the Scuffed Card match! Play with yourself or with up to 4 people in frantic and fun online multiplayer battles! Will you be able to conquer the party?

title: Cheat Day
description: Your wife is captured by demons! You must find the passwords to the doors to release demons so they free your wife. Try to survive and crack the puzzles to find the passwords.

title: Jump Movement
description: Hardcore 2D platformer with a minimalistic design. You can only move left and right while jumping. You have many obstacles to overcome on your way to the finish line. With 5 locations and 5 levels of difficulty - 25 combinations in total - try to pass them all. Can you do it?

title: Pin Them
description: Use your bow to pin enemies to wooden surfaces. Hit them with long range shots. Use skills and traps to fortify your defenses. Prevent the otherworldly creatures from reaching the blue portal and climb the leaderboards!

title: Adventures of Two Foxes
description: The game has a lot of dialogues, as well as a plot. There are many endings, 3 main episodes and one additional one that completes the story, but to open it, you will have to reveal a lot of secrets

title: Vulkan: Lost Planet
description: Choose between 5 weapons cards, Upgrade your abilities in this insane top-down shooter! Arriving at the Lost Planet, Vulkan is surrounded by an variety of hostile creatures in his last mission as an intergalactic bounty-hunter.

title: Fingun
description: In a horrible tragedy, the world has been invaded by giant anime girls causing erotic mayhem everywhere.

title: Chibi Dash
description: Chibi Dash is a fully procedural endless Running adventure. Explore unique Magnificent world using characters from different time periods.

title: Hymns of Resurrection
description: Calder and Ygritte are the King's elite soldiers. They come upon Karandir and the Occultists' wicked plans and become the ones responsible for preventing an evil resurrection and a new war.

title: Cyndefense 2
description: Cyndefense 2 is a well crafted, hardcore, tower defense game. While there are easier modes for those who want casual game-play, the game will test your ability to manage your resources and rely on superb tower placement in order to be capable of beating harder maps.

title: Saffron Fields
description: An arcade game about a little brave tank fighting terrorists and drug dealing PMCs. Play campaign or endless mode with your friends. Brawl enemies out of fight. Defeat mighty bosses. Bring peace to the Saffron Fields!

title: Hello Goodboy
description:
Hello Goodboy - a cozy and wholesome narrative adventure game about finding the purpose of your journey in the afterlife, together with a huggable cute doggo.

Play as Iko, a kid new to the afterlife without a memory of their past, trying to find the purpose of their journey in this place. You will be accompanied by Coco, a cute and huggable dog that will help solve the mysteries and will always be by your side.

In Hello Goodboy, you will meet various souls on their own adventures through the afterlife, experience heart-warming stories from them that are full of kind messages, help their problems by clearing lightweight challenges, and enjoy time with delicious food together. There are several paths to the end to find the purpose of your journey, but the choices and time are limited, so decide well how you will spend your time with.

title: Basilisk
description: Shmup. Unlock. Customise. Experiment. Upgrade. Basilisk. Petrify. Easy.

title: Magic Sexyland
description: Magic Sexyland – probably the only classic NSFW point and click adventure game available! Everything is possible here! Horny girls, sexy fairies, angel beauties and devilish babes await you! Help Adam solve interesting and funny point and click puzzles, save girls!

title: Animal Match
description: Animal Match is a simple match 3 game, drag the screen, drag the animal icon to get a high score. Made in Construct 2. Enjoy your game!The game has nice graphics and music.Collect as much jelly as possible and how to get more points.Forward!

title: Hentai Sea Battle
description: Classic sea battle. Destroy all enemy ships faster than he can destroy yours to win the battle.

title: Writer's Block
description: Writer's Block is a falling block word game mashup where you write one block at a time. Put your vocabulary to the test, set up combos, and try not to let the letters pile up!

title: Unknown Number: A First Person Talker
description: A phone call from a stranger. A daring heist in the middle of the North Sea. A chance to save the world using nothing but your voice. Unknown Number is voice-controlled adventure game. And it's the first of it's kind. Will you answer the call?

title: Move That Box!
description: Move that Box is a retro, arcade, top-down style action-puzzle game based on logical thinking, but also requiring reflexes. Move, push, throw, melt and even blow up items to reach the goal.

title: Kirkileons
description: Kirkileons is a single player Tower Defence game. The game includes 2 planets containing 20 missions each(40 missions). The game relies on an original spawning method. The amount of foes depends on the percentage of magic energy VS anti-magic energy that your generators produce.

title: Geo Zombies
description: We find ourselves in a city infested with zombies. Our goal is to kill the zombies that come upon us and get the highest score. You can survive longer by getting bonuses that will increase your health in some parts of the map.

title: Metavusking
description: Enjoy singing in vast VR Concert hall.

title: Ceilless
description: Spin world and push the box into the crystal. Then make your way like magic!

title: Milling Machine 3D
description: A milling simulation that will inspire novices and experts alike. Realistic physics and movements allow you to familiarize yourself with the machine in a 3D workshop setting. Wonderful for learning and prototyping.

title: Deep Base
description: Deep Base is a world were you place towers to defend against waves of enemies.

title: Hero of the Day
description: Hero of the Day is a classic platformer game. The goal is to collect all the coins, after that you can proceed to the next level.

title: Polyfury
description: Polyfury is an intense bullet hell with a circular twist and a minimalistic visual style. Seven Deadly Shapes will push your abilities to the edge with a barrage of bullets and lasers as you freely orbit around the arena with the analog stick.

title: Blaster Alert
description: A classic old-school shooter with the possibility of upgrading your own spaceship.

title: Ninja Blast
description: Independent action game that features an action game mode and a stealth game mode, with strong narrative and graphic violence.

title: Everything Is For Humanity
description: Everything is for Humanity is a story-driven, exploration and puzzle-solving based science fiction horror game which sets in a massive science facility in 2020. You will discover tons of things and find out about the blood-chilling truths with its first-person experience.

title: Molecoole
description: Molecoole is an action shooter roguelike. Make awesome weapons by attaching different atoms together. Defeat enemies, bosses and complete randomly generated levels! Adapt your playstyle every playthrough based on the atoms you get!

title: NeuroWorm
description: A 6DoF take on the classic game concept set in cyberpunk future, where sentient programs escape the grasp of their creators.

title: Precursors: Armored Angels
description: Armored Angels is a turn-based strategy game in which players struggle with intelligent machines, competitive corporations and time. Deal with the invention of new technologies and the construction of huge walking units that allow you to counter the scale of the threat.

title: Laugsh!
description: "Laugsh! " is a one-player game and a new feeling 2D action game where 100 friends can come to your world from play data collected from all over the world and advance the game to your advantage. Explore the stage with 100 friends, defeat the boss while cooperating, and have fun!

title: Griddlers: Beach Season
description: It’s time for adventures at sea with Griddlers Beach Season! 120 unique griddlers will make your vacation even more fun

title: Cardow!
description: Cardow! is a simple strategy card game. It combines a card game with turn-based strategy games. Build your way to your opponent and use your deck wisely. It depends not only on the strength of your cards, but also on your tactical skills.

title: Cubic Dweller
description: Cubic Dweller is a hard 2d platformer that is made to be fun and enjoyable but has tricky jumps and movement. There are boss fights and new mechanics that you will come across whenever you start a new world. Give this game a try and have fun!

title: Dreamer: Puzzle
description: A very relaxing puzzle based on the Dreamer game. When putting together the paintings, gradually discover the story of a sick boy.

title: Pinecone Game
description: Welcome to Pinecone Game, where you can plunge into the wonderful world of throwing pinecones into a well!

title: Mines of Frostheim
description: Explore the deep depths of this randomly generated mine! This dungeon crawler features over 100+ diverse monsters to fight and hundreds of treasures to collect as you help the Guilds discover the secrets of the mine.

title: Rabbit Meadow
description: Play as a rabbit and explore a beautiful meadow. Customize your rabbit's appearance, dig for toys, and interact with other animals. A lighthearted game for bunny lovers to run around and relax with nature. If you love rabbits, then this is the game for you!

title: Asteroids Extreme
description: Asteroids Extreme is a fast-paced, top-down, arcade-style asteroid mining adventure. Players blast asteroids and various enemies, collecting crystals along the way to upgrade their ship.

title: Spaceflight Simulator
description: In Spaceflight Simulator, you will get to build your rockets, plan launches and flights, attempt landings, deploy payloads and explore new worlds.

title: Idiotic
description: Switch between alternate dimensions at will in this fast-paced single-player FPS game. Wreak chaos and improve your character as you move at break-neck speed.

title: Pilie Pals
description: Lead a group of adorable creatures known as Pilies and help them climb and stack their way to the goal in this unique and family-friendly puzzle game!

title: Panda Punch
description: Panda Punch is a puzzle platformer game in which you have to control a red panda and save the world from evil alien robots.

title: Endless War
description: "Endless war" is a third person shooting game, which controls tanks to experience the feeling of fighting on the battlefield!

title: Gladiator: About to Die
description: Travel to the ancient roman world and experience thrilling gladiator fights. Buy new arenas, train and take care of your gladiators and manage your fighting events to entertain the audience with the most exciting spectacles.

title: PolyShot
description: E-Girls group was born as anti-male groups came together. This cute but wild girl group aims to take over the BoyZ clan and create chaos across Polylandia to enforce their will. We need to stop them!

title: World of Barn
description: World of Bärn is an RPG game where you fight from your village that is under attack you have to do quests to get ahead in the game

title: Firearms Factory
description: In 1909, your workshop that produced sweet candies for children was hastily turned into a firearms workshop, according to an order from the government. Are you ready to make them win the war?

title: Brooke vs. World Doom
description: Brooke Vs. World Doom is an explosive action 2.5D platformer with crazy weapons, wacky powerups, and snappy platforming! Put an end to an evil ring of corporations before they eliminate all things fun!

title: Medieval Knightmare
description: Hordes of monsters has invaded the village, the last opportunity to avoid them reach the king is you. Arm with weapons and fight the hordes solo or with a team.

title: Draken
description: Draken is a hardcore survival FPS rogue-like with modern weapons that need to be operated as is in real life: Insert magazine, load chamber, and check safety. Vampires abducted you for blood and left for dead in their deep dungeon. Your mission is to climb back up to the surface and escape.

title: Scrapshoot
description: Grab some friends and duke it out in chaotic party mayhem for up to four players! Send enough bots hurtling into your opponent's nexus to win, but watch out for unpredictable weather hazards! Snap up precious upgrades to gain control of the arena, crush your enemies, and seize victory!

title: Wasting Away
description: Retro horror 3D game tells a gloomy story of the Vainonmiel camping destination. It used to be popular, until some of the visitors started disappearing without a trace. Can the Reporter survive and keep his job, or will he get arrested or fall victim to the mysterious killer of Vainonmiel?

title: Ocean Current Punk
description: "Ocean Current Punk" is a Marine survival sim that expands the living space by building complex and massive infrastructure systems and fortifications. On your quest to find the truth, you will meet different groups, encounter unexpected events, and strive to become the ruler of the sea.

title: Cry Baby
description: DxD is a zombie survival shooter that lets you experience the big fight against the undead. A variety of different environments are coming for you. Day or night. It's your choice.

title: Dino Mercs
description: DINO MERCS is a roguelike deckbuilding game where you take on the role of a veteran member of Dark Solar Defense, a shadowy private military corporation. To survive, build multiple decks while conducting operations, engaging in fierce combat, and defending your base from attackers.

title: Siege of Treboulain
description: Defend your magical city from an enemy army in an epic fantasy game of swordfights, political maneuvering, and romance! Will you prove worthy of your crown?

title: Kibbi Keeper
description: Forage, explore, tame, and wrangle your adorable companions in this beautiful first-person, virtual-pet, adventure game!

title: Fireflies & Figments: A Willow's Journey
description: Adventure is better together! Using the buddy system, take control of two young adventurers as they journey deep into a mysterious forest full of fear and wonder, retracing the steps of teacher and KIN Willows founder, Hazel Willow, who disappeared over a century ago.

title: Maze Art: Purple
description: Maze Art: Purple - is a minimalist game of simple mazes with relaxing music.

title: Maze Art: Orange
description: Maze Art: Orange - is a minimalist game of simple mazes with relaxing music.

title: Maze Art: Brown
description: Maze Art: Brown - is a minimalist game of simple mazes with relaxing music.

title: Maze Art: Yellow
description: Maze Art: Yellow - is a minimalist game of simple mazes with relaxing music.

title: Maze Art: Blue
description: Maze Art: Blue - is a minimalist game of simple mazes with relaxing music.

title: Maze Art: Black
description: Maze Art: Black - is a minimalist game of simple mazes with relaxing music.

title: Maze Art: Rainbow
description: Maze Art: Rainbow - is a minimalist game of simple mazes with relaxing music.

title: Maze Art: Pink
description: Maze Art: Pink - is a minimalist game of simple mazes with relaxing music.

title: Maze Art: Green
description: Maze Art: Green - is a minimalist game of simple mazes with relaxing music.

title: Destruction Dummies
description: Bone crunching, head exploding, limb tearing ragdoll dismemberment action in 3D.

title: Mr Meal
description: You are newly employed agent and you work for an Agency investigating the mysterious Mr Meal. The first day you appeared in your office and right away you got your first mission: find out what is behind all Mr Meal's activities.

title: A.R.D. Alien Removal Division
description: Alien Removal Division is a fast paced, action-packed first-person shooter, set in a military research facility during the 1950s. The base has been overrun by aliens and you find yourself, as the only survivor, at the center of the invasion. Your escape will be challenging, but you'll have an array of weapons and movement abilities to help you during your fight and on your getaway.

title: Variable Pictogram Jump
description: An instant death action game with flying pictographs. Use jumping and zooming in and out to reach your goal! In addition to the single mode, there is also a mode that allows up to four players to compete.

title: The Forgotten Castle
description: Play as an old man who wakes up in a mysterious castle full of magic and danger. Explore every corner of the castle and discover what is hidden between the walls of this misterious and ancient place while you keep fighting with monsters and improving your abilities.

title: Wardrive
description: You can crack into a lot of crypto wallets in one second when you were born with a lymphatic system that doubles as an RF transmitter, but now you're on the lam, riding shotgun with a cybernetic stranger at the wheel of your new ride. warDrive is a casual cyberpunk rail shooter.

title: Argonauts Agency: Captive of Circe
description: The Argonauts Agency – An invitation to a wedding sets in motion an incredible investigation with an unexpected twist!

title: Guacuco
description: Guacuco is an experimental interactive diorama about confronting traumatic memories and letting them go. You're stuck in your nightmares, and the only way out is to face your pain, gather all your memories, and return them to the flow of time.

title: Gibbon: Beyond the Trees
description: Master the Gibbon’s art of movement with a unique move-set that lets you swing, slide and somersault through a lush jungle canopy. Experience a free-flowing story of family and survival as you search for a home that may be lost forever in Gibbon: Beyond the Trees.

title: Super Rolling Heroes
description: Super Rolling Heroes is an unforgiving physics-based 3D platformer. Destroy every object while maintaining momentum, exploding, bouncing, using power-ups and avoiding deadly obstacles. It includes ‘Rolling Hell’, an extremely hard mode that challenges you to beat the game in a single run.

title: Dream of the Hikikomori
description: The reverse dating simulator, where you're the waifu!!! Will you escape? Or will the protagonist get you first?!

title: Bossa Presents
description: Play prototypes created at Bossa's game jams and help decide which ideas should go into production, becoming real games launched on Steam – with your help and feedback!

title: Bloody Everybody
description: Bloody Everybody is a bloody slasher game where you have to fight hordes of bloodthirsty demons, vampires and other undead, performing stylish combo attacks on them and turning the battlefield into a bloody mess.

title: The Thorn of Warldia
description: The Thorn of Warldia is a fantasy turn-based tactical RPG with an interesting story and unique character art that takes place in the world of Warldia! Take command of Thorn and his friends in their journey towards freedom.

title: Dungeon Conundrum
description: Bound to your bones in a decrepit dungeon, you must jump, stomp and carefully navigate round the different rooms to escape and save yourself from the Dark Wizards clutches.

title: Bingus: My Beloved
description: Bingus: My Beloved is a visual novel and dating sim where you choose to pursue Bingus or Big Floppa while you attend Zabloing Academy. Join your favorite high school club, make friends, and prepare to enter the Floppaverse!

title: Legendarium Online
description: Legendarium Online is a new 3D sandbox MMORPG with huge open world.Non-target combat system, no levels, no classes. Hundreds of combination for your unique play style. Currently is in Pre-Alpha development process.

title: Flower Shop
description: It is a hermetic horror that pretends to be your friend. The game begins at a flower shop. At first, it looks like a naive florist simulator. Gradually, the game pulls you into the abyss of madness.

title: Eelah
description: A baby girl is kidnapped and taken to a strange and mysterious place for unknown reasons. You must save her!

title: USS Tempest: Spaceship Simulator
description: Crewman, you are lost in deep space and threats are lurking everywhere. Survive and bring you and your allies back to known space. It's in your hands!

title: Ableford
description: A 2d exploration game. You play as Casey and do some odd jobs for folks around town so you can build your machine.

title: Eldritch Lands: The Witch Queen's Eternal War
description: Dive into a dark fantasy world and fight against the endless undead horde. Unlock, upgrade and deploy units in a simple to understand yet engaging strategy gameplay loop. Grow plants that grant exp bonuses and converse with each unit to learn more about their character and backstory.

title: Ash & Rust
description: The next generation of ARPG is finally here! Fight your way through mysterious places, face mighty foes, and construct the perfect build. Enemies are strong and smart, but you'll have a massive arsenal of tools and abilities to master in order to vanquish them. Dive in!

title: Magnet Crusher
description:
Use your magnets to control your puck and send it onto your enemies to blast them.
You can either master the magnetic forces, keep your momentum and destroy any incoming threat, or fail to keep up the pace and perish. Good luck!

Remember, brute strength won't help you here. Use the pulling force of the magnets to dodge, weave and gain distance until you can project yourself into the enemies and destroy them. Thankfully, you have some other tools at your disposal: special abilities that you can unlock and use regularly to help you against the waves of foes.

title: The Last Exterminator
description: You're an exterminator. You kill things for a living. When a hostile invasion of alien cockroaches rocks your city, you've got a job to do. A high-octane retro-FPS inspired by some of the best games of the 90s.

title: Gunner Deadly Expedition
description: Gunner Deadly expedition - In this shoot em up + platformer hybrid game, you have to fight hordes of your evil clones who are trying to ruin your vacation. Take your rifle and show who's in charge

title: Golf Club Architect
description: Build and manage your very own golf club from tee to green and everything in-between.

title: JezzBall Atomic
description: Welcome back! JezzBall Atomic is a remake of the classic Windows game JezzBall. You’re tasked with capturing the Jezz atoms bouncing around inside the chambers by building new walls and trapping them in smaller spaces. But be careful, incomplete walls can’t withstand the impact of a Jezz atom!

title: Morph King
description: A single-player Chess variant where you go up against endless enemies while controlling a single piece. Use your wits and a morphing mechanic to outmaneuver swarms of pieces in this arcade, randomized strategy game!

title: Crystalreach Islands
description: Crystalreach Islands is an open-world action RPG. Battle various enemies, gather gear, explore the world and fly the skies around the islands.

title: Britannia
description: Live over a thousand years of Britain’s early history in this epic game of conquest and rule. From the Roman conquest to the William the Conqueror’s Norman invasion, explore the destiny of many nations, and fight to become King.

title: Mirror Party
description: Come out and party with bishojos from the Mirror series in a world of fun mini-games featuring online mode. There’s also a Gacha Machine where you can easily get OVER 300 pieces of collectibles (1000+ when upon formal release): CGs/Cosplay Album/Video/OST and more!

title: Magic Thief
description: Become a Magic Thief in a new reinterpretation of the classic minesweeper game. Immerse yourself in the world of the magical Middle Ages, open chests, use charms and avoid encounters with mysterious crystals!

title: Mysterious House
description: Logic platformer with logic tasks with all sorts of obstacles and teleports. Closed doors, assistants can open. The main thing is to remember, they are very stupid, so it is worth protecting them.

title: Puzzles For Clef
description: Puzzles for Clef is a relaxing adventure game focused on the eponymous heroine. Following a letter from her sister, Cres, our bunny friend Clef journeys to the island of her ancestors, to undertake a treasure hunt.. The journey will take her across a land of beauty, magic, and mystery, as she explores each of the island’s regions, solves its countless puzzles, unearths long-forgotten secrets, and rediscovers her family’s legacy.

title: The Final Rescue
description: The world is plagued by a deadly virus. You are the last human to survive in what is left of the city, and perhaps even the world. Your only mission is to find a way to reverse the effects of the virus.

title: Cubelander
description: Cubelander is a tower-defence game mixed with careful resource management. Take on the role of the "Cubic Commander" as you build up a impervious defence to fend off waves of the Geometric Invasion, using the Cube Army's arsenal of towers and army of defenders!

title: Gun Ugly
description: Gun Ugly is a surreal action packed First Person Shooter. Dash, slide and kick your way through scores of manic enemies in a colourful multiverse that provides you with an arsenal of ridiculous weaponry. In your hands a trombone is just as dangerous as a bucket of pupples.

title: A Step Forward
description: Help balloon Pong to go back to home where his friend is. You have only one way to revive is find and pass all portals. There are various puzzles and obstacles in front of you. Solve and overcome the problem one by one to move forward.

title: City of Murals
description: City of Murals is a cute and gross, action-platformer, rogue-lite. Explore a colorful world with violent and non-violent guns, special traversal abilities, and creatures that range from friendly to deadly. The world is competing to see who can live the longest. How long will you survive?

title: SCP: Keter
description: Based on the SCP Foundation "SCP: Keter" is a combination of Tactical Multiplayer FPS paired with Dead by Daylight and Left 4 Dead-inspired Game mechanics.

title: Ruin or Victory
description: Ruin or Victory is a modern take on the classic RTS genre with added detail, continuity, and strategic depth while remaining accessible and well-paced.

title: Air Traffic
description: Air Traffic is an air traffic control themed game. Direct aircraft in the area where radar coverage is limited. Prevent collisions, organize and expedite the flow of air traffic.

title: 69 Lily Hot
description: A puzzle with visual novel elements in fantasy style. Lily is your magic teacher who uses her own personal approach to teaching. Learn the basics of magic with her and have fun.

title: Book Hunter

Otherwar is an action tower defense game. Take control of an angel and defend heaven from the satan's armies.

description: Cute, relaxing, polygonal puzzle game with cats.

title: Always the Same Nightmare
description: A fast, dynamic die-and-retry style platformer with varied levels and gameplay. Is a passage too difficult? Stop time! Is a boss too strong? Gain experience and upgrade your weapons! Can you escape this dark and perilous dungeon?

title: Nihongo Heroes
description: Learn Japanese language in a fun way! Smart learning system that teach vocabularies with Japanese alphabet: Hiragana, Katakana and Kanji.

title: Crush the Castle Legacy Collection
description:
The hit Armor Games physics destruction game is back! "Crush the Castle Legacy Collection" lets you revisit the chaos and mayhem of the original series with upscaled graphics and new achievements. Load up your trebuchet with special projectiles to topple your foes and score big to carry yourself to victory.

This collection includes all levels from the original;
- Crush the Castle game
- Crush the Castle: Players Pack game
- Crush the Castle 2 game
- Crush the Castle 2: Players Pack game
- Crush the Castle: Adventures game

title: Trails of Gold Privateers
description: With Trails Of Gold Privateers, you're ready to awake the corsair in you!

title: Survival Girls
description: A survival, base building and crafting game. Explore the island, collect resources and defend your base. Search, craft, hunt or steal to buy weapons and vehicles. Hunt and tame animals, grow your herd and attack your enemies base. A FP/TPS survival of the fittest!

title: B-1ll1
description: B-1ll1 is a post-apocalyptic platformer for hardcore gamers. Play as B-1ll1 in the hunt for energy orbs scattered all around you and get through a world destroyed by a catastrophy that you will learn about.

title: Astronautilus
description: Your ship has crash-landed on a stray rogue planet, and you're out of fuel... It's up to you to delve beneath the frozen surface and find a way to get your ship back into space while fighting strange sea creatures and uncovering the mysteries of the world beneath the ice!

title: V-Fighter 2000
description: v-fighter 2000 - Fans of furious action will appreciate the intensity of passion in this shoot 'em up game. Hop into the cockpit of your starship and embark on a long journey across the galaxies, destroying hordes of enemies ..

title: The Ancients
description: The Ancients is a turn-based survival strategy game where you will manage a hunter-gatherer tribe through the ice age. Every decision you make will affect the tribe culturally and politically.

title: Primafloows
description: Ping pong in unoriginal Punk style

title: ShapeVS
description: ShapeTECH welcomes you to participate in their latest aptitude assessment program, ShapeVS. Gather your friends, family members and even colleagues as you participate in a variety of mini-games designed to test your capability of supporting our new society.

title: Brightness
description: Brightness is an extensive single-player game that takes you to the ruins of ancient temples. The main character has to recover stolen souls hidden among dangerous traps. The stolen spirits levitate helplessly in the darkness of the ruins, waiting to be saved.

title: Songs of Armageddopolis
description: A point'n'click detective game where death is irreversible, intuition is more important than logic, and the main evidence is you.

title: The House of Closed Doors
description: The House of Closed Doors is a game in which you are locked in a mysterious house. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a dark old mansion. Explore mysterious rooms, collect various items, try to find a way out and stay alive.

title: Ruinlander
description: Ruinlander is an open-world role-playing game with turn-based combat where you must survive in the post-apocalyptic wasteland as long as you can.

title: Unarmed Area
description: Unarmed Area is different real time strategy game. Build your city and command your units then control units in first person shooter mode. Once for all you need to make a choice. Unarmed area or a New civilization.

title: Chef RPG
description: Craft your culinary adventure in a beautiful pixel art world. Manage your restaurants, forage and hunt for ingredients, befriend locals, and grow your culinary empire. What kind of chef will you be?

title: First Light
description: A story-rich arcade brick-breaker. Break through the Fog to restore a family's century of memories — 132 fully voiced levels, four generations, one old machine that refuses to forget. Play calm. The bricks are somebody's wall.

title: Mining Cats
description: Mining Cats is a logic puzzle that involves blasting rocks and creating paths that connect mines of gemstones of the same color.

title: Friends of Little Yus
description: Friends of little Yus is a game about being the fastest. Get to the flag as fast as possible!

title: Downroll
description: This is a miniature arcade platformer in which you have to control the ball.

title: The Forgotten Empire
description: Now, as the Chosen One of the Empire of Atlantis, Lily must go through the most difficult challenges facing the most ferocious monsters of the Deep Sea during her journey to save Atlantis.

title: Pivot of Hearts
description: Game developer Wén Xiàn has a second chance at love, but it’s not what he expects. Will he be able to stray off the beaten path and find true happiness? Play your cards right and find out in Pivot of Hearts, a non-monogamous visual novel!

title: Splatformer
description: A fast paced hyper challenging puzzle platformer with a twist.

title: Stint: Rift Apart
description: Stint: Through the Universes is a: - 2D Platform game with a nostalgic gameplay - Interesting mixture of different genres' mechanics - Tangled story, accompanied with epic cut scenes - Humorous plot and charismatic characters - Great world with more than 50 unique locations

title: How to Bathe Your Cat: Drawing
description: It is well known that cats aren' t really fond of water, but, as pet owners, we know that sometimes a good bath is welcome. Draw and use bombs to channel the water and clean your cat!

title: Childlike
description: Use objects not to step on the floor. Do not step on the road outside. Run away from the Guard at school. Run away from the haunted doll.

title: The Throne of Bernicia
description: A classic fantasy role-playing game, telling the tale of the kingdom of Bernicia falling into chaos as the forces of darkness encroach on every front. Answer Queen Amelia's call for help as a brave adventurer seeking fame and fortune in a troubled land.

title: Notoris: The Goblin War
description: Notoris is a fantasy war game featuring a unique combination of classic turn-based mechanics in a non-grid-based system. In it, you can command your soldiers in strategic battles, perform epic feats on battlefield and unravel the mysteries behind the Goblins invasion.

title: Polgar: Magic Detective
description: Discover the mysteries of Polgar and solve magic crimes! Investigate the evidences in each case and hunt down the right creature - don't let the culprit go unpunished!

title: Trust Me, Not Her
description: Lost in a secluded forest, you encounter two mysterious girls. One Good. One Evil. But which is which? And who will you Trust in this thrilling, choice-driven Visual Novel?

title: Labyrinth of death
description: Labyrinth of death - You are a brave knight who wanted to perform feats, but failure - you were caught and thrown into the labyrinth of death! Solve clever combinations of levers and buttons in this adventure game and dodge dangerous enemies to reach the exit of the eerie maze and become a hero!

title: Constellation Tango
description: Constellation Tango is an interstellar 3D turn-based strategy-tactics game. Organize and lead troops to victory in battles across planets. Push back against an oppressive empire to save the galaxy, while making new allies across various species.

title: HyperLeague Heroes
description: Recruit. Upgrade. Battle. Assemble a team of heroes, villains, and monsters and delve into the dungeons of Utopia to face off against waves of enemies. Issue commands to your squad or watch them fight on their own.

title: Snow Battle Princess Sayuki
description: Sayuki, a cute and powerful snow goddess is on a quest to save her beloved human boy, from the evil curse of the demon! An exciting, retro style, scrolling shooter. Go to the world of Japanese myth!

title: Cat Fish Island
description: A relaxing adventure of island fishing. Collect wood and fish to build and bait the most amazing fishing rod the world has ever seen. Start your adventure to catch the mythical fish of legend thought to be only an old tale by the island's inhabitants.

title: Tiny Football
description: Tiny Football is a throw back to old top-down retro soccer games of the 90's. Realistic passing and shooting, tackles, crosses, throw balls, overhead kicks, free kicks and more. Compete with 64 national and club teams in a variety of tournaments.

title: Die, A.I
description: You must stay alive in this horror/puzzle space adventure. Survive the vengeful A.I system that has taken over the ship and killed everyone else onboard. Use your limited oxygen supply and cunning to overcome the failing systems and A.I created booby traps. Explore the ship...and don't die.

title: Banish
description: BANISH is a Single and Co-op horror survival game for 1-4 players. As a Priest, you are sent by the local church to a failed exorcism attempt in the Luxford Mansion. Fear, Panic, and Horror awaits you...

title: Cubytet
description: Cubytet is a 3D puzzle game in which you need to place pieces of different shapes on the playing field in order to score as many points as possible. This game is based on the world's most famous 2D puzzle game and is its 3D analog with some additional game mechanics!

title: Spirit and Katana
description: Are you ready for an epic, yet adorable, adventure?! Join the guild waiting for you in the land of Celedain. This is a story about teamwork, friendship, and good times along the way. The bards will be sure to sing soon of your heroism in Spirit and Katana!

title: Slice of Life Fantasy
description: Try to get a girlfriend and be a hero at the same time, in the RPG where you get loot from monsters in order to buy your girl stuff, just like real life!

title: Palliative: Reach for an Angel
description: When youth shines brightest, every second is a tactical battle against time. Join Yuu and a close-knit group of friends in a desaturating world as they help Nana a girl facing her final days reach for a perfectly ordinary life. A story of friendship, and the courage to stay until the final whistle.

title: Cold Harvest
description: Make an incredible Christmas journey, from which you will not be able to tear yourself away until the very end. Playing the game, you will find your holiday spirit too.

title: Tiny Gods of the Nile
description: Welcome to Egypt ! With your friends, play as gods in training and complete magical recipes for your classes ! Have fun : cheat, cast spells… But be careful, Râ your teacher will gladly scold you if you get caught !

title: Solaris Rift
description: Solaris Rift is a roguelike card game featuring variable encounters, sci-fi narrative, and strategic gameplay. Face off against the terrifying storm drones of the Satex Army, the saboteurs of the gang known as the RogueStars, and the venomous vinelings of the Queen of Thorns.

title: Spectral Shades: Fragments
description: Follow Chiharu as she explores an unknown and surreal location, while she tries to figure out what’s going on. -- An exploration-heavy, magical girl themed, eerie adventure game, where two girls fight about poor Chiharu.

title: Mikoshi
description: Twelve levels of dynamic platforming with interesting story, charismatic main character and his friends, ability improvements, epic boss battles, secrets hidden throughout and high quality graphics.

title: Farming Sweeper
description: Build, manage and grow your farm in a unique way: Solving puzzles with traditional minesweeper mechanics and managing your business finances in a relaxing game with great replay factor.

title: Xenoids
description: Xenoids is a survival horror game where you have to come face to face with a hostile life form in the confined space of a spaceship.

title: Just King
description: Just King is an action auto-battler with roguelike elements. Assemble your party to venture into different lands fighting fearsome kings and their deadly armies. Use your loot to hire and upgrade mighty heroes... or the bard.

title: Inquisitor's Heart and Soul
description: Summon demonic invasions, punish heretical enclaves, punish traitors and renegades. Do not deny yourself anything - after all, you are the hand and anger of the highest good. Give the apostates darkness, so that they learn to appreciate the light!

title: Melody in the moonlight
description: A difficult RPG puzzle game. Because of an accident, the two sisters entered a wrong time and space. Please help them find the hidden truth in this false space and time.

title: Puzzle Art: Horses
description: Minimalist, relaxing, picture logic, art - puzzle game with horses.

title: Puzzle Art: Rodents
description: Minimalist, relaxing, picture logic, art - puzzle game with rodents.

title: Puzzle Art: Predators
description: Minimalist, relaxing, picture logic, art - puzzle game with predators.

title: Puzzle Art: Artiodactyls
description: Minimalist, relaxing, picture logic, art - puzzle game with artiodactyls.

title: Steelborn
description: Steelborn - is a run and gun platformer game inspired by the classics and made by a team of Abuse, Ranger-X, Contra, Metal Slug, Blaster Master and H.E.R.O fans.

title: Dig
description: Dig, discover, and compete in this multiplayer digging adventure! Unearth rare treasures, sell your findings, upgrade your gear, and uncover hidden secrets beneath the surface. Who will dig the deepest?

title: Pumpkins
description: Pumpkins is a Halloween themed arcade style puzzle game. Traverse through a set of pumpkin patch mazes while avoiding pests and collecting pumpkins.

title: Karmadillos
description: Battle to be the last-armadillo-standing in this 2-4 local-player party game, knock each player off the level and place traps between rounds to help your efforts.

title: Infinity Girl
description: Infinity Girl is a high-speed rhythm/racer/roguelite where everything — every action, every enemy and every spectacular world you encounter — is driven by the beat of the music. Each run is unique, with procedural levels that test your skills as you grind, drift, boost and leap to the rhythm.

title: Doki Doki Tri-Line Quest
description: Go on an adventure of self-discovery and search for your dear childhood friend who left the village years ago under strange circumstances. Doki Doki Tri-Line Quest is an rpg game in combination with match3 and exclusive for adults, with sex scenes and voices in English.

title: Godbeast Mk.II
description: The Wolf howls in the moonlight! Scarlet blood will glisten on the dark city streets in this stylish and atmospheric action game.

title: Island of Lust
description: Island of Lust is a trainer-type adult game. Master the mechanics of training your elf and turn her into a shinning example of your skills. The game contains several skills to improve and plenty other characters to help you on your journey.

title: Pool Adventure
description: Probably every person at least once in his life dreamed of getting access to video cameras in a women's locker room. Be a visitor to the pool and spy on naked girls! Relaxing music will let you immerse yourself in this process. See all the girls without exception!

title: Atria-1
description: Charge Game Studio presents a dark Sci-Fi action thriller. Challenge yourself as a space colonist on a Russian ship lost so deep in the Universe that even the strongest com ties are torn. Feel the ruthlessness of cosmos, painful past, and extraordinary events on the ship that all mix up into horror.

title: Serious Breakdown
description: Serious Breakdown is a platformer, in the role of a robot, you need to clean up the levels as much as possible and get the necessary parts. Learn to dodge or kill enemies. At the end of the path, you will need to defeat the main villain of this universe.

title: La Maledizione dell'Uccello Serpente
description: A JRPG game with a fantasy setting and retro style. Warning: the game is in Italian.

title: Astralojia
description: A magic school slice-of-life game series, with ATB Turn-Based boss battles. It follows the students of Raynwood Academy as they study and practice martial arts and magic in the world of Astralojia.

title: Artists of Fortune: Paint by Numbers! - Spirit of Christmas Ep. 6
description: Merry Christmas and Happy New Year! Paint by numbers and immerse yourself in a fairy atmosphere!

title: Tabboz Simulator
description: Tabboz Simulator is an Italian management and life simulation indie game launched in 1997 from Obscured Truckware.

title: Yoko Redux: Dreams of a Blue Planet
description: I've been h4ving these dreams la7ely. They can't be real...8ut what if they are? I close my eyes and I see her fac3. Follow Locke as he tries to discover the secrets of Yoko in this point and click, cyberpunk noir adventure.

title: Arcana: Heat and Cold - Season 2
description: New adventures of the unskilled magician, his friends and Miley. Fun events, hentai scenes and unique turn-based combat await you.

title: Attack of Undo Zai
description: High definition furry anime characters in a non-stop action shooter with team.

title: Box Rush
description: The Magic Kingdom was attacked by fantastic monsters who erected siege structures around the entire island.

title: Prototype Blocks
description: Prototype Blocks is a puzzle game with many different levels of varying difficulty.

title: Voice
description: Voice is a game about the story of living in a dystopian world where speaking is forbidden.

title: 001 Earth
description: Dimension 001, Arthur's Timeline, It's not reincarnation but you re-live different realities/timelines. Roam biomes, forage, hunt, fight beasts and monsters, clear dungeons, fight the Demon King and an Omnipotent God

title: CubeLines
description: Sit back and relax with an old school type puzzle game. No haste, take all the time you need and see how many points you can collect before the board fills up and there are no more moves left. Take a high-risk road or slowly but steady it’s up to you.

title: Late For Class: Variety King
description: Use 9 different movement mechanics to overcome challenges on your way to school. Late for Class is a tribute to games that test your skills and dedication to the max. Expect lots of falling and getting back up!

title: Hero Zex
description: In a world with a prophecy where the "Blue Haired Hero" will defeat the Demon Lord, A kingdom is attacked by demons... Just then, "Zex", captured as a prisoner is lucky and escapes. His fate greatly changes from this moment...

title: Fishhead 3: The Search For a Heart of Gold
description: Fishhead 3: The Search For a Heart of Gold is an indie platformer game made in 2003 by Psychoware. It's the third episode of the Fishhead platformer series. The story follows Fishhead in his quest to stop Tomatoman from building a big factory where Fishhead lives.

title: Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden
description:
Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden is a RPG set on a remote chain of islands that have been protected by the maidens for generations, but which now face destruction. The hero of the story vows to save the islanders and sets sail for the high seas, together with Laty, a girl who failed to become a maiden.

A touching tale set in a world of melancholic beauty, brought to you by the creative minds of Yoko Taro, Keiichi Okabe and Kimihiko Fujisaka.

title: Nirvana: Game of Life
description: Play this life simulation as a soul traveling from body to body through the cycle of life, all while experiencing everything life has to offer and trying to break the cycle in order to reach Nirvana. Make your decisions with a simple swipe mechanics in hundreds of life situations in Nirvana Game of Life. Maintain a balance between your needs (money, health, popularity, and happiness) throughout your life. Beware as each choice can be your last one! Hurry up to gain as many experiences as you can, and ultimately, try to reach Nirvana. There are many ways to die, but you will always get another round with a new body to control. Will you be able to defeat The Creator and break the cycle of life? Be careful, a lost soul is going to contact you and promise you a way out - will you trust her?

title: Dymension
description: Dymension is a horror first-person game where you have to plunge into a complicated story that at first glance seems simple, but hides a lot of details and puzzles. You're alone in the dark only to survive this night.

title: I Wanna Eat the Lemon
description: A short "I Wanna Be The Guy" fangame with an emphasis on "Needle" platforming and being beginner friendly.

title: Shadow Fate
description: Shadow Fate is a modernized, turn-based epic adventure where combat is intricate and challenging but immensely fun and satisfying, relying more on intelligent choices than repetitive grinding.

title: Costrutto
description: Costrutto is a casual city builder about building your dream Italian Villa by placing block to block. You are on an empty place in the middle of some Italian waters and the only thing you can do is build! Choose your style from more than 5 different variations. Just keep calm & build to the relaxing lo-fi music.

title: Donkey Kong Craze
description: Donkey Kong Craze is a fan remake of arcade classic Donkey Kong and it's successor Donkey Kong 2.

title: Ghouls 'n Ghosts Remix
description: Ghouls 'n Ghosts Remix is a fan remix made from the games Ghosts 'n Goblins, Ghouls 'n Ghosts, and Super Ghouls 'n Ghosts. It is based on the sprites and music of the first three games of the series.

title: Ghouls 'n Ghosts Remix: Queen Edition
description: Ghouls 'n Ghosts Remix: Queen Edition is a remake of Ghouls 'n Ghosts Remix where you play as Guinevere.

title: Totally Tiny Arcade
description:
Race through a classic 80's video arcade!

27 minigames, with over 100 levels
Collect 8-bit treasures in each minigame
Create your own online scoreboard

title: Lucky Fight vs. Ika Musume 3X
description: Developed by D.C.S. with collaboration from mokonaXVI.

title: Dungeon Ikusa
description: It is an RPG where you build and defend dungeons and invade continents. Use intricate passageways, traps, and powerful fighters to fight off the threat of adventurers.The goal of the game is to expand the dungeon and protect the treasury.

title: Pokémon: Greg Version
description: A Pokemon fangame focusing on the "Greg Discord server" filled with iconic members of the server, in-jokes, and even changes to Pokemon in this incredible journey as you attempt to take on the Gym Challenge, and take down the insidious plot of the nefarious team Primary Colours. Can you save the world of Greg?

title: World Nations Game
description: World Nations Game is an online MMO game in which you can have your own virtual life. You can join a nation, buy vehicles, items, properties, open a political party, fight in international battlefields, participate in races, take part in special agent fights between agents from other countries, attack other citizens space colonies on any country map, be a nation senator or president, be part of the world congress, vote on nation issues and you can do many other activities.

title: Home Wind
description: Home Wind is a minimalist, relaxing and cozy city builder about creating large settlements based on proximity tactics. All for free!

title: CannonBall
description: "CannonBall" is a casual shooting game that trains the nerve reflex ability. Operate the mouse to rotate the turret, shoot bullets to hit the ball, and pass the level within a limited number of times!

title: 1942 Delta
description: Are you a fan of vertical scrolling shooters? Then you will definitely love 1942. The game will keep you busy and entertained for hours. The year 1942 is widely adopted in video games, considering that it is the middle year of the World War II timeline.

title: Harvest Days: My Dream Farm
description:
A unique mix of farming sim, life sim and business sim.

A new life in the country is calling! Fulfil your dreams and manage your very own farm in this lovingly designed open-world game. Work hard, manage your business wisely and your little farm might grow into a personal paradise, surrounded by boundless, untouched nature.

title: The Paper Game
description: A game about tearing paper, cutting stickers, avoiding Goobles, and unlocking the greatest paper puns you've never

title: The Tribe Game
description: The Tribe Game is a story-driven video game where the player gets to create their own custom character and step into the world of The Tribe. In this RPG (role-playing game) they will interact with many iconic characters and explore familiar places from The Tribe TV series. There are quests to be accomplished, profession skills to level up, items and resources to be found, battles to be won, and adventures to unfold… as the player tries to survive in a post-apocalyptic world and to keep their (and their tribe’s) dreams alive.

title: Evilmun
description: Evilmune has over 20 levels. Two characters: a knight and a mage. The power of the magician freeze, the power of the knight... strike! Combine their abilities to complete levels.

title: World Titans War
description:
Tactical survival inspired by WWII.
The action is guaranteed from the first moment. You will start out as a civilian forced to seek resources to survive, you will be able to join an army and fight, with or without allies. In time of war there will be no mercy.

title: Touhou Koujoukaku: Over the Developed Eden
description: Touhou fangame developed by Rodori.

title: Apolysis
description: Apolysis is a third-person, atmospheric narrative. Play as a runaway, called to the husk of an old refinery by the seductive goddess that inhabits it. Face your fear and transcend the flesh.

title: Ghastly Goodies
description: It's Halloween, and that means candy! Play as Pete or Sarah, and try to avoid the tricks as you gather some treats!

title: Still Ridge
description: Still Ridge is a retro-style point-and-click adventure game set in a West Virginia town. Guide Omar Fletcher, a dream traveling therapist, as he investigates a murder he witnessed in his dreams. Navigate the nightmares of Still Ridge's citizens to uncover the mystery of the secluded mountain town.

title: That Which Gave Chase
description: A scientist, seeking to return to the expedition he had to abandon, hires a sled dog musher to bring him on the last leg of his journey. That Which Gave Chase is a narrative-driven, first-person dog sledding thriller.

title: The Salt Order
description: The Salt Order is an adventure horror game created by Khamelot and released on June 3, 2020 for itch.io and Game Jolt.

title: tmOD
description: Cursed love letter/demake on classic GMod and the hl2 modding scene, with a poetry based sandbox/exploration narrative hinting at some burrowed evil.

title: Blazing Worldstars
description: Fast Paced, 2D sprite fighting action! Blazing Worldstars is a furry themed fighting game with 90s arcade flavor!

title: Protagoras Bleeds
description: Protagas Bleeds is a classic 90’s style survival horror game set in a mysterious motel filled with grotesque abominations and TV-headed monsters.

title: Teenage Dirtbag
description:
Teenage Dirtbag is a game based around introducing our ocs. There is no inherent goal in the game and your choices don't really matter. It's a simple introduction to our main cast.

With a relatively shallow plot and one ending, this game was something we thought about for a few years and now we finally made it (it's a bit rough and not entirely done/polished, but it is still playable).

title: Infinity Skies
description: In Infinity Skies, players build a castle on a floating island in the sky from the ground up, using various building components such as walls, floors and furniture. It is then possible to visit other players castle to socialize, make friends and ultimately vote on the best castles so that they can compete in a grand build-competition! Build components are NFTs that can primarily be obtained by playing the Infinity Skies: Immemorial Chronicles Hack-and-slash game.

title: Goodbye Dr. Sanchez
description: A coop horror game where two students were kidnapped by the maniacal Doctor Sanchez and they need to work together in different roles to escape from him.

title: Pink or Blue
description: Choose the image in the center if its pink or blue

title: Ignited Steel: Mech Tactics
description: Ignited Steel is a mech roguelike turn-based-tactics game. Manage a team of overheating old-tech mechs, more heat means more vulnerability and damage! Unravel the galaxy’s story as you travel from node to node, improving your mechs, acquiring new pilots, and defeat the sentient A.I. overlord!

title: Ganryu 2
description: Play as Miyamoto Musasho in this beautiful 2D platformer and travel through a 17th century fantasy Japan, from north to the island of Ganryu-jima where everything happened between Musashi and Kojiro. The game is inspired by the story of Takezo Musashi from the famous novel "The Stone And The Sword".

title: Super Marxist Twins
description: A Parody Propaganda Platformer! Fight for The People through the challenging campaign and contribute to the Common Good by making your own levels and sharing them with your Comrades.

title: Kamigawa: A Visual Novel
description: Experience the world of Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, the upcoming Magic: The Gathering set. Kamigawa: A Visual Novel is a story where your choices matter. Your choices influence not only your companions but also your bonded kami. Diplomacy or intimidation, sympathy or hostility - it's all up to you.

title: Fushigi no Dungeon: Fuurai no Shiren - Tsukikage-mura no Kaibutsu
description: Fushigi no Dungeon: Fuurai no Shiren Tsukikage-mura no Kaibutsu has two versions, offline and Internet. The offline version can be played with old Windows 95, etc., but the Internet version cannot be played now because server authentication is applied. Also, the internet version adds furai rescue system and weekly dungeons. There is no main story difference between the two.

title: Nightmares
description: A game roguelike, 2D plataformer and run and gun. This game has the proposal to unite the thriller/horror genres with the shooter mechanics and where the plot will be crucial throughout the gameplay.

title: Oozescape
description: Oozescape is a challenging 2D platformer where you play as Ooze, a slime creature formed in the depths of a mysterious factory. You guide this newborn life-form through 50 versatile levels while avoiding all the different dangers. The levels have colorful and atmospheric lighting that helps lead Ooze through this strange world. You can further challenge to yourself by trying to achieve the best possible times in all the levels or take your time to get all the collectibles.

title: World Piece and Peace
description: World Piece and Peace is a feature-length dark fantasy RPG. Each of the 3 battle systems require a different set of controls and tactics - it's up to you to grasp their characteristics and defeat the powerful enemies that stand in your way.

title: To the Moon: Sigmund Minisode 1
description: A light 30-minute holiday special taking place at Sigmund Corp, where Neil and Eva work.

title: To the Moon: Sigmund Minisode 2
description: A new 20-minute holiday special taking place at Sigmund Corp, where Neil and Eva work.

title: Lyra's Melody
description:
When Ralle Peregrine was a child, he began to hear a mysterious melody in his head. Around the same time, his childhood sweetheart, Lyra Shire, began to lose her hearing.

As they grew up, Ralle became a guitarist to accompany the strange melody that only he hears whenever he closes his eyes. By then, Lyra had gone completely deaf.

He wrote many songs for her, but she could hear none of them.

title: Sega Mega Drive and Genesis Classics
description: Sega's collection of Mega Drive & Genesis Classics comes to a new generation, now updated with even more features: online multiplayer, achievements, mirror mode, rewind, save states, VR and more! Over 50 classic games in one great package. Get into the classics!

title: Derelicts
description: After crashing on Earth with a space shuttle, you and your friends have to start from scratch. Explore and build a base, then defend it against mutated animals and humans. Find the origin of the defense mechanism that triggered a wave of radiations on Earth, forcing the most privileged part of mankind to go and live on space stations.

title: Santa Lucia
description:
A college-themed, slice-of-life & mystery visual novel with a supernatural twist.

In “Santa Lucia”, you take on the role of a young cat named Ben in his first semester at the University of Santa Lucia. As a child, Ben was prone to crippling headaches and blackouts. One night in his first year of high school, these pains culminated in a terrifying nightmare, which marked the beginning of recurring night terrors which have plagued his life ever since then.

Still, Ben manages to maintain an optimistic view of life, looking forward to the change of pace university has to offer. As you experience Ben's first semester, you'll encounter a wide cast of colorful characters, several of whom you'll be able to pursue a romantic relationship with. However, some nights Ben still has those headaches which caused him so much grief growing up. Will you be able to live your first semester of university to the fullest, or will the pains eventually overwhelm you?

title: Homecoming: Morenatsu Revisited
description:
A remake of the classic Japanese visual novel Morenatsu.

In "Homecoming", you take on the role of a young Japanese snow fox named Hiroyuki Nishimura. After moving away from your hometown Minasato to Osaka five years ago, you receive an unexpected letter from an old friend inviting you back for one last summer vacation before completing your senior year of high school. What complicates things is how you've neglected to contact any of your friends over the years. Although nervous, you accept the invitation.

What awaits you back in Minasato? Will you be welcomed with open arms, or has it been so long that everyone has forgotten about you? Will this be yet another wasted summer, or will you finally have the chance to experience what makes life worth living?

Homecoming is a visual novel about nostalgia, romance, living life to the fullest, reconnecting with old friends, and learning to face your demons, all wrapped up in the cute Japanese kemono aesthetic. The game Homecoming is based on, Morenatsu, is considered to be one of the classic entries in furry culture. Although it was canceled in 2015, dedicated fans have continued to keep its legacy alive through fanworks such as this.

While rough around the edges, the original game captured many hearts, including the members of the Stormsinger Studios development team.
