title: The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child: Log4
description: Two silent wanderers,6 full chapters,A game of exploration and adventure

title: Cursed Fables: White as Snow - Collector's Edition
description: A fable unlike any other...

title: American Truck Simulator: International 9900i
description: A longtime favorite of truckers, the 9900i is making a triumphant return. The International Eagle 9900i is a classic long-nosed tractor that represents your independent spirit without compromising comfort, durability, power or efficiency.

title: Foreigner Teacher
description: You got fired recently, No money, no girlfriend, no prospects. You then see a woman looking for people to teach in Japan. The only problem? You don't know a single thing about Japan. Still, you find yourself taking the job. What's worse, you're stuck with two eccentric spirits for the next year.

title: Mayhem on a Rainbow: VR
description: Shooter and hack 'n' slash in a colorful apocalypse. Fight with fictional or realistic weapons, activate power ups, explore multiple customizable game modes and challenges. Enjoy the satisfying mayhem on a rainbow made of ragdolls where zombies fly in slow motion and chickens lay airstrikes!

title: Pixel Art School
description: For those of you who are just starting to draw pixel art, I've put together a basic knowledge of pixel art. If you're just starting out, I'm sure you'll be able to improve faster after reading this course! I think it explains the material expression in pixel art in an easy to understand way!

title: Flight 737: Maximum
description: Flight 737 - MAXIMUM Desktop version has also been adapted for PCs at the request of many mobile version players. It is designed to be as minimal as possible, simple to use, but to feel like a real pilot, by sticking to the Mobile versions as much as possible.

title: DuckHunt: Missouri
description: Don't get fooled by the simple looks of this game! The way it is played is something unseen so far in the gaming world! Using a novel patented technology you and your friends will use your cellphones to aim at the screen and shoot! Show your friends who is a real gunslinger!

title: SpectrumGames
description: The good old Mafia in a virtual space, as close to the offline version. Become a host, invite players and build the game atmosphere as in real life! Or find an open room to join as a player.

title: American Truck Simulator: International LT
description: Designed and engineered to keep drivers more comfortable and productive for the long haul, the International LT is the most driver-centric, uptime-focused truck that International Trucks has ever delivered.

title: Tiny Islands
description: Tiny Islands is a low poly Point&Click game where you have to find all the ancient artifacts in beautiful worlds.

title: Medusa's Heart of Stone: Chapter 01
description: Medusa's Heart of Stone is a 2D narrative driven game with action sequences, puzzles and quest interspersed throughout. Feared by mortals and forsaken by the gods, Medusa embarks on a journey to find someone who could love her.

title: Haunted Hotel: The Thirteenth - Collector's Edition
description: No good deed goes unpunished…

title: Square Knight
description: A classic platform game, with obstacles, enemies, boss fights, BUT you can level up, jump higher, run faster, and be infinitely stronger.

title: Heart Attack
description: Heart Attack is an FPS Roguelite game where you survive against waves of security robots. Buy the next-tier weapon and upgrade it as well. Protect a moving vehicle from increasingly powerful and diverse security robots alone or with friends.

title: Ark Defender
description: Roguelike missile command. Survive as long as you can aboard the Ark, humanity's last hope, in a hostile galaxy.

title: Dead by Daylight: Sadako Rising Chapter
description: Sadako Rising features a new Killer – The Onryō – and a new Survivor, Yoichi Asakawa. Purchasing this add-on also unlocks an exclusive charm: Cursed Videotape.

title: Fantasylandia World
description: Fantasylandia World is a big open world map which takes you back about 4000 years ago!

title: Vacuum
description: 3d is a first-person shooter in which, by chance, an astronaut gets inside the earthly satellite "Moon" teeming with various alien creatures.

title: Remnants of R'lyeh
description: Remnants of R'lyeh is a Classic Horror Survival game inspired by H.P.Lovecraft's Great Work. An ancient dark power is calling you and you need to find an exit... Face your greatest fear, fight, hide... you must escape before the underwater city rises...

title: Tennis Ace
description: An interactive, furry, adult furry visual novel.

title: FullyBroken: Old Dawn
description: Eight factions fight to conquer Mir. The Resurgence took you in when you had little chance of survival. Now it's up to you. Who will you put in the first place? Your faction or yourself? Be careful! Choices have consequences in this unique card battler RPG with tons of choices and cards.

title: The Wilds
description: Choose your favorite animal and enter The Wilds! Explore the forest in search of food, water, and shelter to survive the harsh conditions of life in the wilderness. Bond with other animals to form families and continue the circle of life!

title: Pogoman
description: POGOMAN is a fast-paced physics platformer where you navigate tough, nerve-wracking levels on a pogostick. Master cool maneuvers, unlock abilities, and survive intense challenges as you bounce through unique biomes. Precision and timing are everything. Oh, and don`t get hit in the head.

title: The Sequence 2
description: Visual Programming Puzzle game inspired by Spacechem and other Zachtronics games.

title: Obscurant
description: A narrative mimicry game. Observe and blend in to survive. Disguise yourself, deceive enemies, and discover the secrets of a mysterious world.

title: Bubble Pop It ASMR
description: If you like antistress games, satisfying relaxing, and anxiety relief pop-it games, then this Bubble POP IT ASMR stress-relieving game is for you. This is the main trend in anti-stress games of 2021. Bubble POP IT ASMR is a satisfying relaxing game that helps deal with everyday stress.

title: Jamm
description: JAMM is a Tabletop RPG map maker that makes it simple and easy to bring your vision to life quickly giving you more time to focus on the story. Make perspective and orthographic maps as well as 3d immersive images in minutes.

title: HoGuru Presents: The House With Too Many Zombies In It
description: HOGuru Presents: The House With Too Many Zombies In It is a new action game from the writer of hit horror film COME TRUE! Set during a zombie apocalypse, it tells the story of Crash Bromwell, who has been chosen by god to save the world - unfortunately, he was not also told HOW to do that.

title: Find Her in Dungeon
description: Find Her in Dungeon - 3D Quest with a variety of actions, where U have to solve (as in quests) your further passage. Sometimes it's fun, sometimes it's scary, sometimes it's sad. With the help of hints and logic, try to find her.

title: Sniper
description: Grab your sniper rifle and your silenced pistol and kill all the invading soldiers on the island!

title: Cow Girls
description: You just want to buy milk, but fate loves to slip adventures where you don't expect it. On the farm, you will meet a milkmaid who will make you play the game by her rules. Play the puzzle with the milkmaid. This is the only way you can get her milk.

title: Twin Mind: Ghost Hunter - Collector's Edition
description: Can the twin detectives solve a new case? You are the only one who can help them catch the killer. Are you up for the challenge?

title: Castillo: Shattered Mirror
description: Castillo Shattered Mirrors is a Gothic FPS and Collectathon. Battle legions of the undead in your quest to defeat Dracula with an arsenal of mythical weaponry. Enter dimensional gates through Dracula's castle and decide which worlds to enter, shards to collect, and bosses to defeat.

title: Sono Higurashi vs. Touhou Universe
description: 90's-style 2D fighting action in which real-life men fight in cosplay. The first work in the series. * This work is a secondary creation game work based on the Touhou Project.

title: New Lands Paradise Island - Collector's Edition
description: Gather seashells and tropical fruit! Develop the best resort in the near lands!

title: Tuwas vs. Muda
description: Real-time economic simulator of an up-and-coming company. Earn profits by distributing the orders to the machines as efficiently as possible. Expand the machine park to be able to accept more and more complex orders.

title: No More Regrets
description: A young upper-class boy discovers he is about to die. Since all his life he bullied everyone around him, in order to have God's forgiveness, he decides to go after the people he has wronged and apologize.

title: ZBloody Hell
description: ZBloody Hell is a standalone game made for the GZDoom engine, aiming to recreate the elements of the game Blood (1997), from monsters and weapons, to levels and atmosphere, while also providing a gameplay addon and / or a level pack that is compatible with the other Doom 2 mods out there, letting you mix different mods with the fantastic Blood levels or the unique arsenal of weapons and new enemies of Blood. Get to ZBloody Hell and Start kicking some Zombie heads today.

title: Rise of the Wool Ball
description: Rise of the Wool Ball is a 2017 total conversion for the ZDoom engine. It was made by MSPaintR0cks and is the sequel to Shadow of the Wool Ball. The game is spread across three episodes, each having five levels with a secret level. Like its predecessor, Rise of the Wool Ball uses a cartoon art style, and it was named a runner-up at the Cacowards that year.

title: Shadow of the Wool Ball
description:
Shadow of the Wool Ball is a 2016 total conversion for the ZDoom engine. Made by MSPaintR0cks, this is a unique shooter in which the player is a hedgehog fighting an army of cats. It is spread across three episodes, each having six levels. The mapping style is more akin to Wolfenstein 3D than classic Doom.

The playful art style, creative gameplay mechanics, and humorous plot were well-received, including a runner-up at the Cacowards 2016. A sequel, Rise of the Wool Ball, was released by MSPaintR0cks the following year.

title: Your Path of Destruction
description:
Your Path of Destruction is a Total Conversion for Quake that attempts to recreate the classic Doom games (Doom & Doom II: Hell on Earth, respectively) and act as both a remake and a sequel to the original Doom series.

All of the Monsters and Weapons have been replaced with their Doom counterparts, all of these were remade in 3D. Ranger was replaced with the Doom Marine.

title: Zerstorer
description: This partial conversion is quite old now, released in 1997. This 6 SP map episode, also including a start map, end map, cutscenes, and 5 DM maps, has stood the test of time as one of the most atmospheric experiences available. Using the episode's additions to full effect, Zerstörer has an atmosphere of unparalleled bleakness and inhospitality - and sometimes outright scariness. In this way, it enhances the dark, gothic aspects of Quake.

title: Jack Move: I.C.E Breaker
description: Jack Move is a JRPG that features a unique blend of gritty cyberpunk storytelling, turn-based battles, and beautiful modern pixel art. In I.C.E BREAKER you will meet Noa for the first time and learn where her story begins!

title: Crime Сity
description: Love fun and endless fun? Do you like cool games with a beautiful world and beautiful graphics? Then Crime City is for you! Immerse yourself in the role of a city criminal who is hunted by absolutely the whole city. car and different weapons do not let yourself be offended !!!

title: Pixel Game Maker Series: Oma2ri Adventure
description: The Ultimate Speedrun Platformer!! On to an adventure to rescue Momo-chan!

title: Mystery Solitaire: Grimm's Tales 5
description: Help Little Red Riding Hood reach her grandmother's house and protect her from the evil gray wolf.

title: Slender: The Eight Pages - Remake
description: No face. No eyes. He's always watching. There's no way out. You are always alone with him. The chilling Slender: The Eight Pages returns on the Unreal Engine 4.

title: Headless Jeff-3
description: Embark on a chaotic adventure through dangerous gauntlets and complex puzzles, all from the perspective of your detached head! Overcome head-twisting obstacles as you stumble along in your quest to escape the abandoned Industrial Megacenter in this action-packed 2nd-person puzzle platformer!

title: New Lands 2: Collector's Edition
description:
Grow cocoa beans, apples and sugarcane. Make the best sweet treats around and win the contest!

The Collector’s Edition includes:
- 15 bonus levels!
- Earn trophies for completing challenges
- Integrated strategy guide
- Concept art and music tracks

title: Grow Up! A Worm Game
description: Worms... Worms! What are worms? Is this... A worm? Do worms really come from space? Only one way to find out! Get your hands ready for this challenging, perhaps tear inducing, humorous 2D precision speed game!

title: Splatter
description: In the dark, where emptiness surrounds you, the only way to see something and find a way out is to spray as much paint as possible everywhere, but you should not rely on paint alone. Visual memory, abstract thinking, the ability to make decisions at lightning speed and, of course, strong nerves - these are the qualities that are needed to complete the game.

title: No 1 Lives
description: No1Lives, It's Your Turn to Die!

title: Bokura
description: Bokura is a puzzle adventure game for 2 players only. Each player will be two boys who have run away from home, and will work together to overcome the wall and aim for "somewhere far".

title: Codebreaker
description: Crack character substitution ciphers. Transmit or receive messages in Morse Code. Decode binary and hexadecimal characters. Memorize sequences of numbers, letters or images. Identify the missing item in a sequence of characters or symbols. Do you have what it takes to be a Codebreaker?

title: Beyond Belief
description: 1997 E1-style single-player episode for Quake, that features 8 small to medium-sized levels as well as a new start map - all of which also support co-op mode and deathmatch - a few new textures, and a modified Chthon boss.

title: Apré Lapli
description: A chill narative adventure starring Maya and her Granpa. Defy the difficulties of the scarce environment to discover Maya's origins as they approach their destination.

title: The Darkest Tales: Into the Nightmare
description: When a nightmare creeps into reality, the only ones that can help are those whose magical powers we’ve believed in since childhood. A brave teddy bear and his fairy sidekick head to the darker side of “happily ever after” to rescue his owner, Alicia.

title: The Art of Flight
description: The Art of Flight is a classic arcade shooter about controlling multiple ships at the same time.

title: Monster Adventure
description: In this game for kids full of weird characters, you learn about everything traffic-related; from traffic behavior, crossing a zebra, using a bicycle properly, wearing seat belts, and many other important things, all through the story of a small park full of cute monsters.

title: Sniper Game
description: Sniper Game is a first-person precision shooter built on a single idea: prove you are the best shot in the world. One handcrafted battleground, relentless escalating waves, and a global leaderboard scoring every shot. Two buildings, three rankings climb the World Championship.

title: Universe 51: Tannhäuser Wars
description: Universe 51: Tannhäuser Wars is a free-to-play fast-paced multiplayer FPS, set in a story-rich universe. In Universe 51: Tannhäuser Wars, two unfamiliar groups are mysteriously teleported to the same location. Since communication between them is impossible or undesirable, they clash!

title: The Hunter's Journals: Tattered Sails
description: A horror lurks beneath the earth. Terror rises from the past.

title: Ghoul Castle 3D: Gold Edition
description: This is a simple old school dungeon crawler. It's made completely by one person - me, who is a fan of dark fantasy games, adventures, dungeons and dragons! Gold Edition means the game is complete with all additional features and items. It also offers new in-game economy based on the gold you collect

title: Survive the Island
description: survive the island you survive from skeletons and humans you can build and mine and level up your stats you can build whatever you want you can raid enemies you can mine and cut down trees and you have to hunt for your own food and you can grow your own crops and you can craft weapons

title: Mirai #167
description: MIRAI #167 is a 2D pixel-art runner where you control two characters at once, rewinding time and jumping through portals. Embark on a frantic adventure to save humanity in a world where AI surpasses human control - upgrade your characters, break records and rewrite history before it’s too late!

title: The Story of Archer
description: The story of archer - the game will tell you the story of an archer who found himself in the midst of a war with zombies.

title: Survival Island
description: Survive through somewhat harsh environment! collect & craft item, manage resources. be aware that you have limited space and time.

title: PhyTetris: Physics Tetris
description: This is a Tetris with a real physics engine and realistic graphics.You can challenge the highest score with superb skills.Support the leaderboard and the world's master competitionIn addition to the classic mode, it also includes a variety of interesting modes

title: Demolish & Build VR
description: Demolish, construct and grow your business! You can purchase new land properties, earn orders and have fun at the same time. It's up to you whether you use a hammer or one of the newest tools and machines. Will you be able to build a strong empire? Get to work!

title: Zovid-19 Remake
description: ZOVID-19 Remake now has better graphics, an even larger arsenal of weapons, a store with more features, new items and a variety of miscellaneous references to other games

title: 12 Labours of Hercules XIII: Wonder-ful Builder
description: Help Hercules build Colossus of Rhodes, Lighthouse of Alexandria and other Wonders of the World despite all the obstacles!

title: A.I.D.: Artificial Intelligence Defence
description: Lead the operations of an artificial intelligence program with only one aim – to clear the Earth from the remains of humanity. Conquer the world campaigning on a single-player dynamic battleground or play with your friends during a real time strategic gameplay.

title: Quake: The Prodigy
description: A 1997 medieval and base-themed classic episode with four medium-sized maps as well as a start-map and a small secret level. Quite hard and challenging at times. Made by the Casali brothers, of Final DOOM fame.

title: Crazy Invader ShootEm Down
description: Enjoy fast paced action in this retro inspired arcade ShootEm Up Style game

title: The Psychoduck
description: The Psychoduck is a stealth game about a psychotic duck who collects crowns and has no problem killing all herons in order to increase his collection.

title: Kickback Slug: Cosmic Courier
description: Kickback Slug: Cosmic Courier is a fun, fast-paced physics game where you must exploit the kickback of your guns to navigate a series of increasingly difficult obstacles across a organic planet floating through space.

title: Park Life: Circuit of Happiness
description: Be the Jissouseki in the Park!! Survive in the Park and make your own Family. Build Your own House, army, and Find your enemy that take your families life. Be Clever. Human's are Dangerous.

title: Déjà-Vu VR
description: In the city of “Evia” several residents are infected with light. A girl discovers what appears to be the host. It befriends it, feeds it and houses it. Not to the delight of the other residents. They want to drive the landlord away. A persecution begins ...

title: F29 Retaliator
description: The skies are your hunting ground in this high speed, high action Cold War flight sim, featuring 100 missions of dogfights and strategic bombings across three geopolitical theaters.

title: The Most Boring Life Ever 2: Work From Home
description: Do you miss life pre covid? The fantastic yet boring 9-5 of our existence? Then this is NOT the game for you. This boring game involves you clicking your way through the day during quarantine as you go by living life with covid in this endless experience.

title: Robo pocket: 3d fighter with rollback
description: A 3d robot fighter with rollback netcode.

title: FireAirPlan
description: Shoting!!!

title: VR Puppet Game
description: Race through a game where you control a puppet... but in VR.

title: Doom Day
description: First person shooter. In the style of famous games like Doom, Quake, Duke Nukem and Call of Duty. You have to play as the only survivor after the crash of the pilot of a combat helicopter, fighting with a huge army of enemies. Improve your skills and upgrade your weapons. All in your hands.

title: Death or Glory
description: Death or Glory is a dueling card game where fighters compete in an arena. Defeat your opponent with ANY character imaginable with a unique deck embodying that fighting style. Unlock more and more cards to customize your deck on your journey to become the ultimate champion!

title: UFO 2: Extraterrestrials
description: Are strategy games with strong RPG elements your cup of tea? Did you enjoy games like Xcom: UFO Defence, the Fallout series, the Civilization series, the Heroes of Might and magic? And now you are looking for something new to satisfy your craving for turn-based fun?

title: Bomb Sweeper: Mine Finder
description: Do you want to play and compete with your friends ? Finally there is a brand new bombsweeper with Steam Leaderboards! Complete all stages and try to go rank 1 of all 100 stages!

title: Monster Master
description: Monster Master makes RTS fight versus FPS. Be the horde or survive together in this asymmetric reverse horror multiplayer

title: Overlook
description: Search for missing people, lost objects, or even help people solve their problems by handing them over their required items. OVERLOOK is hand-drawn, cozy, relaxing, and funny. btw, watch! there might be a cat hidden in bushes.

title: Doomsday Scavenger
description: Although I'm a girl, don't underestimate my shooting. The last pure land of mankind may depend on me to protect it. People call me "Doomsday Scavenger"......

title: Hideaway
description: Hideaway is an online co-op survival-horror game in which you and your friends are staying the night in a winter Cabin and there is something outside, waiting for you to come out.

title: ChronoBreach Ultra
description: Dash through dangerous levels, warp time, and blast enemies in this time-bending action platformer! Manipulate the crumbling dimension of time to escape a deadly factory. Use your wit, your laser weaponry, and your time-warping abilities to face your demise head-on and triumph!

title: Jewel Match Atlantis Solitaire 3: Collector's Edition
description: Plunge into an all-new Atlantis Solitaire adventure! Explore more than 800 (!) detailed aquatic levels and rebuild breathtaking waterscapes to restore Atlantis to unparalleled splendor. Dive into the brilliant world of Jewel Match Atlantis Solitaire 3!

title: Death Code
description: Death Code is a battle royale genre. It tells the story of Lin Mohuai, a female protagonist with amnesia, who wakes up to find herself involved in an eight-person battle royale game. Everyone is given a code, and the way to win is to kill the player whose number is plus one.

title: Unwelcome
description: An unsettling journey through a noir-ish set of maps, primarily focused on a grey/blue/pink color theme and each individual map has its own gimmick

title: Beyond The Board
description: A single player puzzle game that transforms traditional chess into a minimal immersive journey.

title: Boxnigma
description: Move the boxes from each level correctly and simultaneously to move to the next challenge in this minimalist and retro 2D puzzle game!

title: Connection
description: Don't lose the signal to get out of here.

title: Hundred Fires: The Rising of Red Star
description: Hundred Fires is an action, stealth and infiltration game with an exciting story and incredible cinematics. This is a one man infiltration mission, you alone cannot defeat the entire Soviet army, you must use your best skills to hide, sneak away from the enemy and go undetected.

title: Banzai Escape 2: Subterranean
description: Banzai Escape 2 Subterranean is an anime third-person action shooter and a sequel based after the events of Banzai Escape 2

title: Scatch: The Painter Cat
description: sCATch is a puzzle game where the goal is paint all colorful places of the maze and come to the exit. Combining colors and items with different mechanics on the way.

title: Ratten Reich
description: Ratten Reich is a grim and unforgiving world, where war has continued for many years. The war is fought between rats, mice, roaches and lizards alike. Slum like cities, burnt corpses, steam tanks, soldiers in imperial uniforms and armor.

title: Being Left the F*** Alone Simulator
description: Take a step back and relax with this point & click style mindfulness experience. Lovingly crafted in the style of a 90's adventure game, BLTFA Sim lets you explore a world that's all about taking care of yourself.

title: Hover the Edge
description: A fast-paced and challenging VR, hoverboard based adventure, you're an extractor for a well-funded group of individuals who manipulate the past to hunt for ancient artifacts.

title: Tea Time
description: Bad guys have stolen the world's tea supply! Brave the obstacles of five different stages to collect as many falling tea items as possible!

title: Solitaire TED and PET
description: 120 unique layouts from an ancient world await! Experience new thrills!

title: The World's Hardest Game 3D 2
description: 2nd game of the 3D version of the The World's Hardest Game you play on flash game sites! 30 different, unique and challenging levels are waiting for in this 3D Platformer! Will you be able to see the last level?

title: Destroying the Asteroids: Along With Unfair Hurdles
description: I have Created this Game For those who likes to go through the Challenges in the Games. Just Destroy the 2 Asteroids in this Game and that's it. But it is not easy. Unfair Hurdles will not allow to do it easily.

title: Lazriel the Demon's Fall
description: The angel "Lazriel" was dropped into the demon world. The only way to return to the heavenly world is to go up the tower. Go up the tower before she "fall" to the demon's power, and aim to return alive.

title: C.A.P.S.: Cyber Animal Planet Survival
description: A top-down shooter, where in a post-apocalyptic world called Eltopia, our surviving heroes must save the world by facing terrible enemies that mutated in the collapse. Explore a world full of challenges, collect rewards and defeat bosses on your way.

title: Saimin Gakushuu: Secret Desire
description: When a dedicated slacker gains the power of hypnosis, how will he turn his life around?

title: Pinballer
description: Pinballer is the next gen 3D pinball game made for the whole family!

title: Klomanager: Regurgitated
description: Klomanager - Regurgitated is a turn-based economic simulation that deals with the world of toilets.

title: Star Zeal 4x
description: Star Zeal is a space based 4x strategy and rpg hybrid. A mixture between a procedural, open ended RPG and a space civilization builder. Go on an adventure with your character and their faction whilst making friends, enemies and exploring a vast galaxy.

title: ReFactory
description: Build, explore, fight! ReFactory is a 2D strategy game with a focus on construction and logistics where you build an automated mega-factory on an alien planet.

title: Dragon War
description: A real-time combat game played by the flying dragon in the third person. At this stage, the game mode is mainly chaos. The main themes of the game are flying dragon and magic.

title: Fireboy & Watergirl: Fairy Tales
description: Fireboy & Watergirl are back! This time with fairies to help you!

title: Codename: Tiaras
description: Codename: Tiaras is a fast paced cyberpunk game focused on player movement and reaction time to overcome obstacles and collect data cubes.

title: Punihi Loader
description: The 12th release in the franchise, 221Games Punity series is single player, Mech custom & Third person shooter.

title: SuperHot Quake
description:
SUPERHOT Quake is a total conversion for Quake by Ash, inspired by SUPERHOT.
Time advances only when you move or perform an action, such as shooting or jumping.
Use your axe to vaporize incoming bullets, or shoot them if you have a weapon.
Pick up weapons from your fallen enemies and kill their buddies with it.
Blow up your enemies into gibs then pick them up to use them as projectiles.
HOTSWITCH into enemies to telefrag them.

title: Brutal Half-Life
description: Brutal Half-Life is a modification that makes the "Half-Life" game more violent and addictive. It is also a tribute to the classic FPS game "Brutal DOOM".

title: Quake: Dwell
description: Quake Dwell is a modification for Quake that features Four Episodes of varied and unique themes. and Four Custom Bosses, one for each Episode. Brand new monsters, including many returning from other Quake worlds. New weapons to hunt down and utilize. A Complete Soundtrack by Alekswithak. Support for up to 4 player co-op.

title: Project Dagger
description: Project Dagger is a retro FPS roguelike, where you have to return the lost Crown of Benevolence to the King of Delvia! However, your journey will not be easy as many foes along the way will attempt to kill you! Unlock new weapons, upgrade stats, battle enemies as you make your way through the world!

title: Nehahra
description: 17 maps by an all-star team of mappers, cutscenes, new monsters, great features. Comes with a custom engine. Neharha is considered by many as one of the innovative mods that shifted the Quake modding dynamics toward single-player map development. The Episodic spiritual fan sequel to Quake contained a four-hour fully voice acted machinima movie and was well over 53817 kilobytes, an incredible map pack at the time, still considered by many as the best Quake mod.

title: Amadeus
description: Amadeus is a 2017 partial conversion, community scenario for Amnesia the Dark Descent.

title: Amnesia: The Great Work
description:
Amnesia: The Great Work is a 2013 partial conversion scenario for Amnesia the Dark Descent.

You are Charles Longden, an archaeologist studying Minneburg, a German castle abandoned due to recent cave-ins. You are sleeping late one morning when you are shaken awake by a tremor running through the castle. There is no sign of your partner, Jane. Where has she gone?

title: Dreamsettler
description:
Sleepnet. It's where dreams are literally made. But sometimes dreams need a little help, and that's where you come in. They say a private eye never sleeps, but to crack these cases you'll need to be out cold.

Dreamsettler is an early '00s internet simulator in which you solve cases for an array of strange and endearing characters as a Sleepnet Private Investigator. From hunting down elusive soup recipes to unearthing global conspiracies, you'll need to explore countless pages, download apps and master minigames to close your cases and solve Sleepnet's mysteries.

You'll start small, with little more than a bare-bones Dreamsettler template page, but before long find yourself caught up in a plot that will determine the very future of Sleepnet and sleeptime computing at large.

title: Ultimate Jazz Jackrabbit Doom
description: Jazz Jackrabbit Doom is Total Conversion for Doom 2 featuring Jazz Jackrabbit from the same-titled game.

title: CountryCide
description: Prequel to the popular "Trench Foot" Warhammer 40,000 and Lovecraft-inspired total conversion for Doom II.

title: The D-T.E.A.M.
description:
Dwarves. Tanks. Energy. Ammo. MMMGold!

In this 3D Tank Blaster Platformer, you will take down an enemy mining facility, all the while finding energy pickups and collecting sweet gold. Double jump, speed boost, and blast your way to earn performance stars and achieve a personal best in time!

title: Doom3D
description:
Doom3D is a modification for DOOM and DOOM II released in 2020.
This .wad file replaces every sprite (enemies, player, objects) in each DOOM game into 3D models and changes some enemy behavior to resemble Quake.

title: Epochs of Enmity
description: Epochs of Enmity (EoE) is an original Episode Pack for Quake, a collection of 12 maps. A group of reputable mappers has been gathered together to form a “vanilla feel” episode. The goal was to create an “unofficial 6th” episode, to follow Quake’s unofficial 5th, Dimension of the Past. The focus was to design a series of various themed maps, where Ranger is traveling through time to stop the evil that is tainting the time continuum. Main maps had to include at least one quad, stay within the range of 100 enemies (more if multiple quads exist), and not use external models or sounds; however, skyboxes, colored lighting, and the fog were okay. Mappers for the episode include the following: Bal, Fairweather, FifthElephant, Greenwood, JCR, Jpal, Markie Music, Nolcoz, Rhoq, and ZungryWare. Due to the use of the progs_dump mod, some minor, “quality of life” changes have been made. Epochs of Enmity also includes an original soundtrack.

title: VietDoom

title: Half-Payne
description: Half-Payne is a Half-Life mod that brings some gameplay bits from Max Payne, such as Slowmotion, Diving move, Painkillers, and custom game modes.

title: Doom 3: Hard Corps
description: Hard Corps is the remastered Dhewm 3 update to the Doom 3 mod "HardQore2. Hard Corps brings fast-paced, 2.5D side-scrolling action to Doom3. Take on the Forces of Hell in this homage to classic action platformers such as Contra, Metal Slug, and Castlevania.

title: Black Mesa: Blue Shift
description: Initially developed and released by Gearbox Software in 2001, second Half-Life add-on, Half-Life: Blue Shift is a return to the Black Mesa Research Facility and another look at the Incident's consequences from the eyes of Gordon Freeman's best friend - Barney Calhoun. In 2012, Crowbar Collective has delighted Half-Life fans with release of the magnificent Half-Life remake, but there are still no released remakes for add-ons. This is when they are coming in - HECU Collective are developing the Black Mesa: Blue Shift - a free remake with use of Black Mesa resources and style.

title: Quake VR

title: RoboCop Doom
description: RoboCop Doom is a total conversion for Doom II, recapitulating the events of the first RoboCop movie, with many bosses' battles taken from the action scenes of the movie.

title: The Ultimate Simpsons Doom
description: The Ultimate Simpsons Doom is a graphics and sound mod made by Myk Friedman & Walter Stabosz and released in 1998. In the modification, you play as Homer Simpson killing evil clones of his friends, family, neighbors, and co-workers (they replace the normal monsters). As it only replaces graphics and sounds it can be used with either Doom or Doom II.

title: Kriegsland
description:
Kriegsland, or Kriegsland: Blutordnung, is a Doom total conversion mod created by GAA1992 and YukesVonFaust inspired by the Wolfenstein franchise, especially The New Order, that adapts and brings its elements to the other id Software's classic FPS.

This PWAD features a completely new arsenal, monsters (including their behavior), HUD, ammo, items, and power-ups sprites. The game's screens, sounds, and gameplay elements were also added or modified, like separated keys for both grenades and the quick melee attack and the possibility of dual-wielding most of the weapons. It also features a good amount of difficulty, blood, and gibbing system.

Comes with its own Campaign "Spaceship". 10 regular Maps and two secret ones. Its first Secret level gives you a New Game+ option to start the game with most weapons. Its second one (Encore! Slaughterfest! Secret 2) starts directly after you beat the campaign on Ultra-Violence. Chapter I is a unique episode with its own new arsenal of weapons, compatible with most megawads and add-ons.

title: PsychoPhobia
description:
PsychoPhobia is a new Doom2 campaign for GZDoom and Skulltag.
This total conversion features new weapons, new monsters, new textures, new music, new sounds, new decorates, new HUD, new maps, new episodes, and much more.

The modification is separated in 18 maps, with two secret levels and two episodes.

- Episode 1: "Rise of a Psycho" (8 maps) (location: Earth future)
- Episode 2: "The Dark Age" (8 maps) (location: Earth in medieval times)

This is a complete compilation of all the Torment & Torture maps ever made including the all-new Episode 4 "Havoc". Get the full "Torment & Torture" experience with The Ultimate Torment and Torture.

``DoDonPachi DaiOuJou DX'', which is being reprinted as an archive this time, is a feature phone ported version of the same work.

Not only can you take on a barrage of threats, as the title suggests, ``Great Death'', but you can also compete with users from all over the world for your score, thanks to online ranking support.

There are also plenty of elements that allow you to change your play style according to your skill and preference, such as changing the difficulty level, selecting your own aircraft type, and selecting an enhanced type (element doll).

For both shooting game beginners and bullet hell experts. Challenge the line of death and charm the way of death.

description: Enjoy some sexy puzzle action in this relax-alot, 'one handed' puzzle game.

title: Wish
description: Soma, driven by destiny, begins his quest to save his home, Israfil Continent, which trembles in fear of an evil empress… Elf Pontifex, princess knight, the first vampire, etc , with the many beautiful women waiting for their stories to unravel, what will happen in the end of this adventure...?

title: Stacklands
description: Stacklands is a village builder where you stack cards to collect food, build structures, and fight creatures.

title: Arcis Ultima
description: Player finds himself in the war between human race and the invading creatures. You must train yourself, get the very best equipment, recall your past and help human efforts. Otherwise; as the time passes, you may find yourself in a hopeless situation.

title: Foreign Galaxies
description: After a galactic portal failure you find yourself lost in a galaxy 500 light years away from home... With your main propulsion systems disabled you are unable to traverse space, so you try to collect resources you find near you in order to create a galactic portal to return back.

title: Severance
description: Severance is an online co-op horror game for 1-5 players. One becomes a ghost, the others are investigators. Stalk players, throw objects, slam doors, and drain their sanity, or work as a team with paranormal tools to uncover the truth.

title: Sock It
description: Sock It is a wacky, completely unhinged comedy boxing game with platforming and cutscenes. Box more than 12 crazy bosses! Platforming stages to break up the action! Cutscenes that guarantee 1 giggle (Usually around 5 hearty laughs)!

title: Melon Dusk
description: Play as Melon Dusk the famous billionaire who finally landed on Mars. Earn ShibaCoin to buy accessories to customize your appearance !

title: Base Craft: Desolate Survival
description: Co-op twin-stick base building survival game.

title: TukTuk
description: Fight vicious monsters and other unknown threats on a floral and foreign planet as TukTuk. Utilize your imagination on diverse, precise and intense platforming and skill your character based on your preferences on your epic mission to rescue TukTuk's Mother.

title: Ignis Corruption
description: In this Procedural City-Building and Survival game, you must manage your resources, expand your village, assemble an army and destroy the source of evil, which changed the entire eco system of a land that was once prosperous and peaceful.

title: Honey
description:
Honey is a free add-on, made available in the second update of the QUAKE remaster.

An old, abandoned village lies in front of you, and a large church looms overhead. It appears to have been empty for quite some time, but what caused this?

Enter the church and it's depths below and find out.

title: Congestion 1024
description:
Congestion 1024 is a 2005 megawad for Doom II. All maps are designed so that the playing area fits entirely within a 1024×1024-sized area. Authors were allowed to define sectors outside of this area for the purposes of gameplay, detail, and scenery, as long as they are not reachable. MAP01 and MAP19, however, include accessible areas outside of the 1024×1024 boundary.

This project was influenced by the Exquisite Corpse community WAD.

title: Teisatsu
description: Love, war, and spies!

title: The Classic Episode
description: The Classic Episode is a nine-level Doom PWAD that replaces episode 2. It was made by Jan Van der Veken, Anthony Soto, Nick Baker, and Travers Dunne who also worked on The Darkening series. The Classic Episode is one of the few PWADs that Compet-n allows recording on. Two versions of WAD exist: the original version from 2000, which must be used for Compet-n demos, and version 2.0 released in 2002. Only the latter is uploaded on the idgames archive.

title: Winter's Fury
description:
Winter's Fury is a partial conversion of twelve levels for Doom II and GZDoom by Pyroscourge. It was released on December 7, 2012, days before it was named a winner at the 19th Annual Cacowards. The levels are based around a frozen theme, and the WAD's story is highly significant to the overall experience.

Winter's Fury takes place in Siberia, in the year 2033, some time after the events of Doom II.

title: Temp Zero
description: Temp Zero is a minimalist roguelike which mixes intense action and musical bullet hell. Fight enemies which attack to the beat, choose perks, defeat the final boss, unlock new weapons, spells & soundtracks!

title: Beat the Clock
description: Beat The Clock is all about being faster than time itself. Can you get to the hour mark before the clock does? Time, the creator and destroyer of all. No one can beat time right? Well maybe you can.

title: HunterX
description: HunterX is an action-adventure game full of spirited battles. Use various styles of weapons and magic to experience your own fighting style and explore a great world.

title: Bunker 2322
description: A visual novel in a post-apocalyptic setting. Find out what happened to humanity, traveling through the deserted world in search of the main character's family.

title: Astrocat: Milky Way Journey
description: Skylar is an astronaut cat who took a lot of cool pictures of the Milky Way, but she needs to gather the pictures to send to the scientists of her planet, help her and discover lots of data and curiosity about our galaxy in this 2D puzzle.

title: Dummynation
description: Geopolitical management game with real-time shifting borders and a streamlined yet realistic gameplay, designed to minimize all burdensome chores while allowing an absolute strategic control, from military recruitment and deployment, to diplomatic and economic management.

title: Touhou Shinjutou: Hollow Song of Birds
description: Touhou Project fangame developed by raichu, ido, and Shijimi Nono with music by Wanwan. The game centers around a time-stopping incident in Gensokyo and features a gem system providing 7 different optional powers.

title: G-Zilla
description: Play as an overpowered boss monster who has decided to go on a rampage.

title: Damoria
description: Build, settle, trade - 'tis time to claim your throne in this medieval world. Saddle up for adventure now!

title: Space Invasion
description: As a commander of an imperial space force you will conquer unexplored planets, create colonies and equip your fleet for attack or defense. Strategic warfare is the focus of Spaceinvasion!

title: Train Sim World: CSX Heavy Haul
description: Train Sim World: CSX Heavy Haul is an all-new First Person Simulator that brings to life the experience of operating powerful and heavy freight trains on one of America's most stunning and famous railroads; Sand Patch Grade.

title: Immortal Love: True Treasure
description: Not all that glitters is gold...

title: Izmir: An Independence Simulator
description: Fight for the beloved city of Izmir's independence, a tower defence strategy game. Lead the common people of Izmir with tech gear from the future but be aware of holding the balance otherwise people could go nuts.

title: Barton Lynch Pro Surfing 2022
description: Barton Lynch Pro Surfing 2022 pits you against the world’s best surfer’s at the most exotic locations on the planet. An in-depth leader-board sports game meets free surf exploration at 12 massive worlds. Get pumped by the unique control, amazing weather & customization tools.

title: Dice Legacy: Corrupted Fates
description: Corrupted Fates is the new expansion to Dice Legacy, Gamescom's Most Original Game of 2021. A mysterious cult has formed within your realm. Convert your dice into Cultists and obtain powerful Revelations. Your actions, however have wicked consequences.

title: Stellaris: Overlord
description: Realize your Grand Design Overlord, a new full expansion for Stellaris, grants access to new features designed to unlock the next level of your empire. New mechanics to specialize your vassals’ roles within your empire and new magnificent megastructures to project your power further, faster.

title: The Textorcist: Amen Edition
description:
The The Textocist: Amen Edition includes:

- The Textorcist
- The Textorcist: The Village DLC
- The Textorcist Original Soundtrack by Gost
- The Textorcist: The Village DLC Original Sountrack by Carbon Killer

title: The Tale of Onogoro
description:
Experience communication with a virtual character in a VR title developed as "an adventure game for the VR age."
Work with Haru to deactivate the large, puzzle-like barriers blocking your path. Teamwork is key, as some objects can only be used by one of you!

title: Black Swan: Collector's Edition
description: Caught in the wrong place at the wrong time - after visiting a performance of the closed ballet school for orphan girls, you receive a letter for help from one of the students.

title: Grim
description: Reality imprints itself on our individuality through pain. Like grooves on a vinyl record, scars on the soul shape sounds out of emptiness.

title: Iron Order 1919
description: An unique long-term strategy game with week-long matches with up to 101 players, set in the alternate reality of 1919.

title: Burst Witch
description: A bullet hell game with the classic scrolling shooter gameplay

title: BugBits
description: Take part of the largest bug war ever!

title: Yoomp! 64
description: A Three-Dimensional jumping game for the Commodore 64!

title: Pipi Is You
description: Pipi Is You is a platform box-pushing game that solves puzzles by firing bullets to push boxes and changing the rules of the scene, completing levels with smooth, multi-stage jumps.

title: PogoStickMiooooooon
description: An action game where you bounce up and up and up and up, just trying to get to higher. This game is hololive unofficial fangame featuring Ookami Mio.

title: Little Ninja
description: You are a young 8 year old boy named Liam, you recently got a ninja mask for a birthday present! You must protect the house from evil doers! You must be sneaky, and make sure to not get caught!

title: Snooze: A Sleeping Adventure
description: Snooze is a game where an office guy tries to sleep after work, but various and ridiculous events are preventing him to do so. Handle the events, succeed the adventures and just sleep.

title: Fairy Deer
description: Fairy Deer is a kinetic thriller visual novel. Make your way deep into the terrifying Forest in search of the sole pathway to happiness—the mythical Fairy Deer.

title: Siren's Call
description: Siren’s Call is the first "friendship simulator" where your friends can actually fight back. Make these last moments you have with them count. Say the right things...because they won't accept anything less than your absolute best. Will you reach escape velocity?

title: RogueStone
description: Discover Truth Sword and jump into the fight. Farm loot and drops in this Fantasy RPG. Consume Chaos and begin your expedition for artifacts and power.

title: For Your Information
description: First person team multiplayer game. On closed map, battle between Guards and Spies. Spies team need to find locked filling cabinet and documents with parts of the password. Guards team need to find Spies, judging on the basis of spy movement or behavior.

title: Mini Putt Camelot
description: Hear ye! King Arthur enlists noble mini putt players for his most righteous quest yet: Paying Arctic Arcade money! With 54 holes and unlocks aplenty, this is family fun for ye little urchins. Let’s get ready to dance... with swords!

title: Tournament of Beans
description: Tournament of Beans is a unique PvP game where you can alter the map to your advantage.

title: Chaos Law
description: Chaos law is a visual novel about the world and how it changes depending on how we view it. The genre and style constantly changes from meta-comedy to psychological horror. . The game is partly voice acted. There will be fully animated cutscenes and a very diverse soundtrack.

title: Cloud Exiles
description: Rescue survivors and construct cities in the clouds in this post-apocalyptic simulation and role-playing game. Escape from frenzied zombies and a mysterious mist permeating through the air.

title: Asfalia: The Cranky Volcano
description: In this moving and whimsical narrative adventure game, explore Asfalia, a magical world threatened by a raging volcano. Join Charlie as you meet amazing characters, solve fun puzzles, and collect beautiful stickers along the way! A captivating story-driven game suitable for all ages.

title: Nocturama
description: Nocturama Bononia is a container of visual novel, of an urban fantasy genre, set in a nocturnal Bologna. Different stories and characters but with a single common denominator: living the most important night of one's existence.

title: Animaddicts 4
description: In this game you have to climb climbing the objects in the scenario to try to climb as high as possible.

title: Age of Evil
description: Age of Evil is a horror comedy themed total conversion for Duke Nukem 3D: Atomic Edition. It was released in 2003 by Benjamin Richard "Yahtzee" Croshaw and contains new levels, new graphics such as new textures, a new sprite for the player's character (Chris Quinn, a British novelist), new enemies, new weapons, new bosses, new voice-overs, new sound effects, and new music.

title: Linia Super
description:
Linia is back and does it in style with revamped visuals and more than 100 levels packed with original and unpredictable puzzles.

In "Linia super" - the second edition of the game downloaded by over 1 million users worldwide - you will once again go hunting for color sequences, drawing a line to create the correct connection between the different shapes on the screen.

But this time, to make it even more engaging, you will also have to keep an eye on your ink supply while you draw lines and collect the "Liniacoins" that will help you through the exciting chapters of the game.

It's easy to get carried away by this mesmerizing dance of colors that pulse, spin, hide and twirl, going to great lengths to avoid being caught by your line.

It will take skill, a keen eye and a sense of rhythm to get the sequence right. Are you up for the challenge?

title: CrabMania
description: CrabMania is a competitive Party Game of between two and four simultaneous players.Each player controls a character, and must eliminate each other using a throwable object according each level.

title: Quake: The Punishment Due
description: A free DLC for the 2021 Quake remaster made from a mod for the original Quake.

title: Ceremonial Circles
description: Ceremonial Circles is a Large Vertical Wizard map made by CZG. This singular, yet large map totals an average of half an hour for experienced players.

title: Quake: The Purifier
description:
The Purifier is a large expert map for Quake by Zothique.
This large blood sewer level with traps averages at half-an-hour playthrough for experienced players. It is based on the Copper mod and comes with a few new ambient sounds.

title: Quake: A Verdant Dawn
description: Verdant Dawn is a large murky medieval fortress for Quake inspired by Foggy Bogbottom and The Forgotten Sepulcher from Arcane Dimensions. Comes with a custom skybox and a music track. The map source is included. This expert map should last experience players twenty to half an hour.

title: Quake: Realms of the Lost
description: Realms of the Lost is a Finnish mappers episode jam for Quake based on the Copper mod (included) with nine medium to large maps in varying themes, including a start hub and a secret level. It also features a few new sounds and music tracks by Immorpher.

title: Quake: Rubicon2
description: Rubicon2 was a three-map large base/industrial campaign for Quake with new textures, three new monsters, and a few other additions.

title: Quake: Func Jam 9
description: Func Map Jam #9 - a community project at Func_Msgboard. This pack features 15 Contract Revoked / Knave-themed levels of varying sizes. It comes with a start map and many custom models, sounds, and skyboxes. The map sources are included.

title: Quake: Reliquary
description: First "alpha" version of a mod based on Copper with some new and modified weapons, such as a pistol and triple-barreled shotgun, and more challenging gameplay. It comes with two levels plus a start map: a medium-sized sewage facility and a large medieval castle dungeon. The map sources are included.

title: Quake: Arcanum
description:
Battle cultists in the depths of Arcanum.
A huge single-player episode with five huge maps by Tronyn and Pulsar. Based on Drake fork for Quake. Epic in style and scale. Tough battles with high numbers of enemies. Many modified and new monsters, weapons, and items. Very hard. Includes a start map by distrans.

title: Quoth
description:
"Welcome to the third edition of Quoth 2.0. This is a spit-and-polish release, with some new features to play with, but the emphasis on refining the Quoth 2 content, re-balancing some monsters, fixing old bugs, and keeping Quoth as lightweight as possible."

Quoth is an expansion pack for Quake 1 single player.

It is not intended as a series of thematically connected maps with additional custom content, as other packs are. The intention is to provide quality custom content for Q1 mappers and players in a single pak file. There are maps included in the pak, but there are also larger maps using the content already released separately by both Kell and necros, and more maps will surely follow.

Its features include technical additions for mappers, new monsters, and a couple of new weapons/items.

title: Quake: Unforgiven
description:
Epic fantasy episode with three huge levels, hardcore horde battles with many new monsters and bosses, several new and modified weapons and items from the Drake mod (latest version is included). It also comes with a start map, custom skyboxes and background music.

Note: This episode requires an engine port with increased limits. The max_edicts value has to be raised to 2048 if supported.

title: Quake: Altars of Storm
description: Altars of Storm is a large ancient temple ruin, hidden deep beneath a snowy mountain valley. The theme of the map is inspired by the Ayleid ruins from TES4: Oblivion. The map has all new textures, many modified or new monsters from Hexen 2 including a fearsome boss demon, and a custom quad-barrel shotgun.

title: Hordes of Zendar
description:
Large medieval city at nighttime with a strong focus on exploration and route choices. It comes with custom medieval-style items. The map source is included in the PAK.

Note: This map requires an engine port with increased limits.

title: Quake: Xmas Jam 2020
description:
Quake: Xmas Jam 2020 is a Quake map pack held annually.
It is currently the second biggest Quake map pack in file size, next to Arcane Dimension. This pack features 19 small maps in varying styles where all gameplay takes place within a 1024x1024x1024 space. It runs on Arcane Dimensions 1.8 (included) and comes with some additional content like sounds, models, skyboxes, and music tracks. The map sources are included.

title: Quake: Ter Shibboleth
description:
Redux version of the previously-released Ter Shibboleth Part 1 and Part 2, featuring various changes including a port of the first five maps to Drake.

An episode with eight huge, uniquely themed levels: a beach resort under a Golden Gate Bridge, a puzzle map set in an industrial storage facility, an Asian temple, a twisted otherworldly fortress, a desert mining town, a snowy village in the mountains, the city of Paris (complete with Notre Dame and the Eiffel tower), and an ancient Roman city next to a colosseum. Most of the maps use custom textures; the texture wads and the map sources are included.

title: Quake: Xmas Jam 2018
description: Annual Xmas mapping event. This pack features 21 small maps in varied styles where all gameplay takes place within a 1024x1024x1024 space. It includes a start map and is powered by the Arcane Dimensions devkit + some additional content. The map sources are included as well.

title: Quake: Xmas Jam 2019
description: Annual Christmas mapping event. This pack features 17 small maps in varied styles where all gameplay takes place within a 1024x1024x1024 space. It includes a start map and is powered by the Arcane Dimensions devkit (included) + and some additional content. The map sources are included as well.

title: Quake: Xmas Jam 2021
description: Annual Christmas mapping event. This pack features 25 "small" maps in varying styles where all gameplay takes place within a 1024x1024x1024 space. It runs on Arcane Dimensions 1.8 (included) and comes with some additional content like sounds, models, skyboxes, and music tracks. The map sources are included.

title: General Practitioner 2
description: Live the life of two doctors in this brand-new medical simulated Visual Novel. Andrew and Julie are siblings and MDs and they recently inherited a once-renowned medical clinic from their aunt. Join them in rebuilding the clinic, hiring staff and living their lives. This time there are two of them!

title: Furry Shakespeare: Two Incredibly Ripped, Absolutely Shredded Noble Kinsmen
description: Will you help the Emperor get re-elected, or will you just straight-up start a rebellion? It's up to you to decide in this political ballgame.

title: Power & Revolution: 2022 Edition
description: New edition of the ultrarealistic simulator of today's world where you play as the head of state or as the opposition! Major developments: the war in the Ukraine and all of its consequences, conspiracy theories, fake news, interference by secret services, animal welfare and climate objectives.

title: Roadkill
description: You dodged death once — but it's not finished with you yet. Alone in an eerie town, you must search, hide, and survive while a relentless mechanical predator stalks the streets. Stay alert. Stay alive.

title: Orcs Must Die! 3: Tipping the Scales
description: In Tipping the Scales, the new Tuatara enemy race invades across five new maps including a new War Scenario! Bring your new gear to the fight to overcome the Tuatara’s special ability that limits the damage they can take.

title: Simultaneous Control
description: Move two cats at the same time: one character with normal movement control, and one character with inverted movement control. Besides controlling both characters, you must search for a key to open the gate and complete each level!

title: Math Expressions
description: WORDLE for math fans. The perfect daily warm-up routine for your brain.

title: Just a ball: Jumping in the space
description: Just a Ball: Jumping in the Space is a platform game with a simple mechanic inspired by jump king but don't let the name fool you, this is no ordinary little ball... Follow our friend, get to know her story and how she got there!

title: Fortress Building Puzzle
description: Fortress Building Puzzle is a puzzle game where you need to remove all the cubes to bring your castle to the ground, which is quite high.

title: BoingBoingOuch
description: This is the story of a man with a thirst to never be fulfilled to get all of the eggs, the Easter Bunny has. But to say the least the Easter Bunny isn't happy.

title: Wailing Guignol
description: Desert city, Ergerita. Fighting evil and violence to protect the love of my life. An exciting Sci-Fi Fantasy RPG in a world of ruins!

title: Quake: Halloween Jam
description: Halloween Jam was the first Halloween-themed community map pack held on QuakeAddicted in 2018, featuring six mostly Halloween/Horror-themed levels including haunted houses and graveyards. It also comes with a start map and lots of pumpkins and runs on a slightly stripped-down version of Arcane Dimensions that is included. The map sources are included as well.

title: Quake: Halloween Jam 3
description: A Third Halloween Jam was held on QuakeAddicted, a community project featuring 13 levels + a start map of varying sizes and themes. Most of the maps use custom textures. The pack is based on the Arcane Dimensions mod (included) and comes with various custom content like models, sounds, skyboxes, and music tracks. Some of the map sources are included.

title: Quake: Halloween Jam 2
description: Second Halloween Jam community project featuring 14 levels of varying styles, and a start map. The levels run on the Arcane Dimensions mod (included). The map sources are included.

title: Quake: Halloween Jam 4
description: Fourth Halloween Jam held on QuakeAddicted, a community project featuring eight levels + a start map in varying sizes and themes. Some of the maps use custom textures, e.g. Makkon and Alice. The pack runs on Arcane Dimensions 1.8 (included) and comes with various custom content like models, sounds, skyboxes, and music tracks. The map sources are included.

title: Quake: Blue Monday Jam
description:
"Blue"-themed community map pack with 15 mostly small to medium-sized levels including a start map. It comes with a few high-res textures, custom skyboxes, and music tracks. The map sources are included. Each of the maps have a "blue" palette to strands from the usual monotone brown palette of Quake.

Note: These maps require Quoth 2.2 and a source port supporting the -quoth command-line switch. Additionally, for some of these maps, it must have increased limits and/or BSP2 support.

title: Quake: Coffee Quake
description:
Coffee Quake is one of the largest Community map packs featuring 74 small levels across four episodes following the classic Quake themes. Each map was made within two hours and has an average playtime of 3-5 minutes - well-suited for the occasional coffee break. The pack comes with a start map and a remix/remake of the original end map as well as a music track and some demos. The map sources are included.

Note: Some of these maps require a source port with increased limits and/or BSP2 support.

title: Quake: SMEJ Jam
description: Community map pack inspired by SMEJ and SMEJ2: nine small to large levels plus a start/hub map in varying themes, mostly set in snowy Finnish landscapes. It is based on the SMEJ2 mod (included) and features new enemies, models, custom textures, skyboxes, and music tracks. The map sources are included. SMEJ made were originally a map pack of Finnish mappers - Curiously, none of the maps are made by the Finnish SMEJ team.

title: Quake: Func Xmas Jam 2017
description:
Func Xmas Jam 2017 - a community Xmas Jam this time held at Func_Msgboard. This pack features 11 small "Arcane Dimensions" maps in varied styles where all gameplay takes place within a 1024x1024x1024 space. It comes with a few custom skyboxes, sounds, and a music track. The map sources are included.

Note: These maps require Arcane Dimensions 1.60 or later and a source port with increased limits.

title: Club Suicide
description: Club Suicide is an anti-romanticism otome game developed by Morpath for PC. There are 20 endings in this game, and players' choices throughout the game will alter the ending of the game.

title: Quake: Backsteingotik
description:
A very large brick-style dungeon with wind tunnels from Arcane Dimension's "sock". It has a built-in skill selection area and comes with custom medieval items. The source is included in the PAK.

Note: Maps requires an engine port with increased limits.

title: Quake: Func Jam 2
description:
Func Map Jam 2 - IKblue/IKwhite Theme - a community project at Func_Msgboard. The pack features 8 medium to large ikblue / ikwhite-themed maps. It comes with a couple of modified models and custom skyboxes. The map sources are included.

Note: Some of the maps require an engine port with increased limits.

title: Quake: Func Jam
description: First map jam of the Func_Msgboard - a community project at Func_Msgboard. The pack features 12 Honey-themed maps of varying sizes. It comes with a couple of modified models. The map sources are included.

title: Quake: Insomnia
description:
Popular map pack dating back to 2000 by CZG (of Honey fame).

Large, intricate levels with great gameplay and connectivity, offset with interesting details and clever design. The start map is followed by 2 a2base and a q3gothic map. It also features some new ambient sounds.

I was one of the first map packs to be extensively large and demonstrated the full ability of the Quake "id tech 1" engine. This map pack is still largely popular to this day, and earned favorable reviews.

The map received a nod in the 2017 video game "Quake Champions".

title: Quake: Torrent of Impurities
description: Finnish mappers of the first acclaimed "SMEJ" came back for an episode jam 2, the sequel to Realm of the Lost: seven large maps in varying themes, based on the Copper mod (included). It also features four new monsters, a new boss, a few new sounds, and music tracks. The map pack then inspired the community to create a "SMEJ Map Jam", with no intervention from the original SMEJ team.

title: Quake: Coppertone Summer Jam
description: Community mapping event based on the Copper mod: 16 levels of varying sizes and texture themes plus a start map. It contains custom skyboxes, a few new sounds/models, and some music tracks. The map sources are included.

title: Quake: Imhotep's Legacy
description:
Large Egyptian temple with tech elements using sock textures. It comes with statue models, a few sounds, custom skyboxes, and a music track. The map source is included.

Note: This level requires Arcane Dimensions 1.8 and a source port with increased limits + BSP2 support.

title: Contract Revoked
description: Contract Revoked is a 2002 episode consisting of 4 levels and a start map, with knave textures, some modified models, and sounds.

title: Quake: Bestial Devastation
description:
Very large industrial/Zerstorer-inspired zone with great details and gameplay.
Recommended to use with Zerstorer, but works in id tech 1 too, then it is quite hard. Made in 1999 by John "DaMaul" McCann and stood the test of time fairly well.

title: Shadow Over Innsmouth
description:
Very Early and Historically-relevant in the Quake modding scene, this map stood out when single-player modding wasn't common, with its moody atmosphere.
Shadow over Innsmouth is a large medieval village with a few new textures and reskinned monsters. Somewhat of a sequel to "Village of Dread".

This is considered Steve Rescoe's finest map by many.

The map was featured on the RockPaperShotgun's "Quake Renaissance: a short history of 25 years of Quake modding" article.

The map name is taken from a horror-occult short story by author H.P. Lovecraft, main inspiration for the Quake game.

title: DogeFight
description: DogeFight is a third-person multiplayer game where you can play with your favorite memes and be the last survivor by defeating your opponents, and gaining social credit. But be careful not to be sus.

title: DefenceOrder
description: When monster troops flocked to the kingdom, which was troubled by the king's tyranny, the king, who had been tyranny, abandoned the kingdom and left. May you be our king and guardian and protect the kingdom. Hire archers, artillery, wizards, and develop their abilities, and save the kingdom

title: Gem Tower Defense 2
description: Gem tower defense is different from general tower defense games. The map of gem tower defense is extremely open and free. Players need to constantly plan and build labyrinths to delay the advance of waves of monsters hitting the fortress.

title: Ponster
description: In the game, weapons will revolve around small monsters and launch them at the right time, causing damage to the enemy. The unique real-time turn system makes the launch time of weapons very important. Acquire weapons and relics to arm yourself and ascend the throne of weapons master!

title: Kickflip Quake
description:
Kickflip Quake was a popular, humorous modification early in the Quake modding scene, inspired by Tony Hawk Pro Skater, and allowed for online co-op play.

Also included were numerous "skate" maps.

Its creator, Micheal Büttner, as well as the mod, were featured in the Video Game Museum, which acknowledged the "Beginning of Modding".

title: Quake: Penumbra of Domination
description:
An episode with four varied, medium to large Wizard maps, as well as a start map. Also features some modified progs, like rotation, breaking walls, and cutscenes.

Made by mexx (Marcus Dromowicz), the earliest "big name" in the Quake modding scene back in 1996 (not even one year past its release). Penumbra of Domination is considered by many to be mexx's finest work and is one of the few early Quake maps which stood the test of time, using limited tools.

Map packs were rare back then, and having more than two maps was considered out-of-the-ordinary.

title: Quake: Cassandra Calamity
description:
Cassandra Calamity (also known as Mexx10) is the last map pack of Marcus Dromowicz (mexx), of early Quake fame. It is the second-largest mexx map, with two large, detailed base levels with a story, some new textures, skins and sounds, and custom cyborg enforcers, along with a few other additions. The author encouraged co-op play.

The map was one-of-a-kind for its custom enemies and the presence of a story, as well as being a comparatively large map pack at its time (3420kb).

title: Atelier Online: Alchemists of Braceir
description: A free-to-play multiplayer mobile game set in the Atelier universe.

title: Quake: Marcher Fortress
description:
While quite dated in 2005, was also quite early for singleplayer Quake 1 mapping.
Marcher Fortress impressed many with its Q3stone/metal-styled fortress of epic scale, with a few new monsters in lots of hardcore horde combat (almost 400 monsters in total) as well as its many other custom gameplay additions.
Marcher Fortress impressed many with its use of curved surfaces, as well as its vast landscape similar to the Halo games.

title: Brown Dust II
description:
The continent of Svern, which had been under the rule of the Karian Empire a long time ago, became peaceful under the reign of five kingdoms.
However, an ominous shadow of dark magic looms, and the fate of the Five Kingdoms is slowly twisted.
Tensions rise amid the growing embers of war, and the terrifying fiend of fate heads for the peaceful Lugo village...

title: Force of Warships: Battleship
description: Direct your battleship to glorious victory! Online battle under your leadership!

title: Panda vs. Bugs
description: The cute panda "Shearer" is playing happily on the bamboo, an army of bugs is climbing up the tree unknowingly, avoid the bugs carefully and use "weapons" to defeat the army of bugs!

title: Quake: Func Jam 3
description: A community project at Func_Msgboard. The pack features 6 small to large Zerstörer-themed maps. The complete Zer mod is included in this release, and so are the map sources. This map pack was very early in Quake single-player modding and included impressive map designs.

title: Administrators
description: A visual novel in which you have to try on the role of the administrator of a small provincial hotel. There are many different rumors about the hotel. But sooner or later, even secrets turn into a routine…

title: Familiar
description: Familiar is an illustrated puzzle misadventure from Damsel Stone, following a witch's cat trying to undo a spell gone-wrong. Use a combination of platforming, problem solving, potion drinking, and people pleasing to undo the ongoing disaster and bring familiarity back to your home.

title: Fantasy Quake: Rise of the Phoenix
description:
This map pack was an early bird in 1997, very early for single-player modding. Not without its merit, Fantasy Quake was one the biggest Quake modification of its time, at a whopping 24223 Kilobytes, roughly fifteen times as much as the average map pack.

Rise of the Phoenix is a Total Conversion (TC) with almost new everything. Around 20 single-player maps in varying medieval/ fantasy themes and 4 deathmatch maps; multiple player classes to choose from, new weapons, new enemies, etc.

The mod was made by Team Phoenix, an all-star team of curated mappers and modders.

Years later, it was featured in Rock, Paper, Shotgun's "Quake Renaissance: a short history of 25 years of Quake modding" article.

title: Sanctum Breach: Rebirth
description: A vast ocean of uncertainty clouds your past, present and future. Venture forth as you struggle to find your place in the world, a Nomad, wandering from village to village attempting to unravel the mysteries of your place here in Petura. An Endgame focused ARPG full of customisation, loot and more!

title: Quake: Prelude to Apocalypse & Mordrigor's Demise
description:
Prelude to Apocalypse (most commonly known as mexx8) was an extensive two-map wizmetal medieval map pack, with tense gameplay. While a little dated or "blocky" by modern standard, used the cutscene engine that first debuted in "Vision of Hatred", this time, the cutscenes have been used in moderation in a way that doesn't break immersion. The maps used custom models and sounds, a rare occurrence in 1997.

Another of Marcus Dromowicz's (mexx) very early works, and one of his most notable ones.

title: Emperial Knights
description: You incarnate as a powerful knight to help the Emperials to defeat the darkness in the Tower of Infinite game mode. You will vanquish waves of monsters to reach the bosses and claim your loot with your friends or alone.

title: Quake: Func Jam 4
description: The least popular Func Jam - a community project at Func_Msgboard. This pack features two large low gravity runic maps. The theme is "low gravity". The map sources are included.

title: Project Utgardr
description:
Project Utgardr is a first-person parkour platform adventure inspired by Norse and pre-Viking culture.
Explore ancient Scandinavian mountains as a young Norse woman, use your parkour skills to find a way home, and discover the mystery behind a forgotten myth scrawled all over the mountain range.

title: Quake: Func Jam 5
description:
A return to form for Func Jam, this pack features a start map and 8 maps of various themes made for WarrenM's Qonquer mod (included), which lets the player fight waves of monsters in arena-style maps, with the occasional assistance of minions. The theme for this jam was originally "Prisons of the underworld".

The map sources are included.

title: Quake: Func Jam 6
description:
Func Map Jam 6 - Fire and Brimstone - a community project at Func_Msgboard. The pack features 13 Fire and Brimstone-themed levels of varying sizes as well as a start map. It comes with a couple of skyboxes, and the map sources are included.

Note: Some of the maps require an engine port with increased limits; ericw/Tronyn's map requires 2PSB support. Additionally, support for fog and colored lighting is recommended. You will need to increase the default heap size for some maps, see the comments for more information.

title: Quake: Func Jam 7
description:
Func Jam 7's theme is "Back to Bases" - a community project at Func_Msgboard.

The pack follows a Base theme and features five small to medium-sized levels, some of which add unique twists to the gameplay. A skill selection/start hub map is included.

Note: These maps require Quoth and an engine port with increased limits.
This file has been repacked for Quaddicted.
An updated version of NewHouse's map is available here.

title: Quake: Func Jam 8
description:
Func Jam 8 is a community project at Func_Msgboard.
This pack features four Film Noir / black&white-themed levels as well as a start map and comes bundled with Arcane Dimensions enemies. The map sources are included.

Note: These maps require a source port with increased limits.

title: Quake: Func Jam X
description:
After a long wait, the Func Forum release its tenth Func Jam X - Tenth community mapping jam: 14 Insomnia-themed levels plus a start map. It comes with a couple of custom skyboxes, sounds, and music tracks. The map sources are included.

Possibly the last Func Jam.

title: Quake: Warp Spasm
description:
Probably the evilest and most hostile atmosphere a Quake release ever had. This episode is built upon Quoth code and monsters. It comes with "dark ambient" music which adds to the feeling. The levels are huge, and the number of monsters in each one is extreme. An essential release, but clearly not for everyone.

This episode is three-hour-long for experienced players to clear.

title: Quake: Underwater Jam
description:
Another Func_Msgboard release.

Underwater Jam - a community map pack featuring nine (under)water-themed levels by various authors. They use different texture styles and some custom monsters/assets.
This massive (66366 Kilobytes) map pack will last you well over 3 hours of playtime.

title: Saimai Rd
description: Grow a city with your transport system in this minimal logistic management game!

title: Champion of Venus
description: Champion of Venus is an erotic visual novel where you play as a virgin NEET dragged into a tournament to elect the next Queen of Lust. She'll have to learn fast if she wants to stand a chance...

title: Something Wicked This Way Comes
description:
A huge three-map single-player campaign of epic proportions: A vast arcane demon fortress built into a mountain, complete with a canyon start map and a bloody boss arena. The levels are based on the Drake mod (included) which features a plethora of new monsters and items. Many secrets (up to 30 secrets on the main map) and hard gameplay.

This map should last an experienced player up to one hour.

One of Tronyn's best map packs.

title: Quake: Forgotten Sepulcher
